`apps/victory/src/shader.rs`:

```rs
//! Survey shader containers: bitcode, console additions and native code.

use std::borrow::Cow;
use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use std::path::PathBuf;

use anyhow::Result;
use victory_game::sgd5;
use victory_shader::gfx10::{self, Instruction};
use victory_shader::{Container, DxilProgram, FourCC, HwStage, ShaderError, native_programs};

/// Files above this size are skipped (read whole into memory for now).
pub(crate) const MAX_FILE: u64 = 2 << 30;

/// A shader container in a file: as is, or packed in an SGD5 record.
pub(crate) enum Source<'a> {
    Raw { offset: usize, data: &'a [u8] },
    Packed(sgd5::Record<'a>),
}

impl Source<'_> {
    /// The container bytes; `None` if a packed record is corrupt.
    pub(crate) fn bytes(&self) -> Option<Cow<'_, [u8]>> {
        match self {
            Source::Raw { data, .. } => Some(Cow::Borrowed(data)),
            Source::Packed(r) => r.unpack().map(Cow::Owned),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn label(&self) -> String {
        match self {
            Source::Raw { offset, .. } => format!("@{offset:#x}"),
            Source::Packed(r) => format!("@{:#x} {}", r.offset, r.name.unwrap_or("?")),
        }
    }
}

/// The packed records of SGD5 data, and every container stored as is (the
/// executable keeps some records uncompressed), found by its magic.
pub(crate) fn sources(data: &[u8]) -> Vec<Source<'_>> {
    let mut out: Vec<Source<'_>> = Vec::new();
    if sgd5::is_sgd5(data) {
        out.extend(sgd5::records(data).map(Source::Packed));
    }
    let raw = memchr::memmem::find_iter(data, b"DXBC")
        .filter(|&offset| Container::parse(&data[offset..]).is_ok())
        .map(|offset| Source::Raw {
            offset,
            data: &data[offset..],
        });
    out.extend(raw);
    out
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct Totals {
    containers: usize,
    with_dxil_part: usize,
    with_bitcode: usize,
    standard_layout: usize,
    xdat: usize,
    xbop: usize,
    kinds: BTreeMap<String, usize>,
    with_native: usize,
    native_stages: BTreeMap<HwStage, usize>,
    native_errors: BTreeMap<String, usize>,
    decoded: usize,
    instructions: usize,
    unnamed: BTreeMap<String, usize>,
    decode_errors: BTreeMap<&'static str, usize>,
    files_with_shaders: usize,
}

pub fn run(paths: Vec<PathBuf>, verbose: bool, disasm: bool) -> Result<()> {
    let paths = crate::default_paths(paths)?;
    let mut t = Totals::default();
    for root in &paths {
        for entry in walkdir::WalkDir::new(root)
            .into_iter()
            .filter_map(Result::ok)
        {
            if !entry.file_type().is_file() {
                continue;
            }
            let path = entry.path();
            if entry.metadata().map(|m| m.len()).unwrap_or(0) > MAX_FILE {
                eprintln!("skipping large file {}", path.display());
                continue;
            }
            let Ok(data) = std::fs::read(path) else {
                continue;
            };
            let mut found_here = 0;
            for source in sources(&data) {
                let Some(bytes) = source.bytes() else {
                    eprintln!("corrupt record {}{}", path.display(), source.label());
                    continue;
                };
                let Ok(container) = Container::parse(&bytes) else {
                    continue;
                };
                found_here += 1;
                t.containers += 1;
                let dxil = container.part(FourCC::DXIL);
                t.with_dxil_part += usize::from(dxil.is_some());
                let program = dxil.and_then(|p| DxilProgram::parse(p.data).ok());
                let mut listing = Vec::new();
                // Independent of the bitcode: titles may strip it.
                let native = match dxil.map(|p| native_programs(p.data)) {
                    Some(Ok(programs)) if !programs.is_empty() => {
                        t.with_native += 1;
                        let mut list = Vec::new();
                        for n in &programs {
                            *t.native_stages.entry(n.stage).or_default() += 1;
                            list.push(format!("{:?} {} B", n.stage, n.code.len()));
                            match gfx10::decode(&n.code) {
                                Ok(insts) => {
                                    t.decoded += 1;
                                    t.instructions += insts.len();
                                    for i in insts.iter().filter(|i| i.name().is_none()) {
                                        let key = format!("{:?} {:#x}", i.encoding, i.opcode);
                                        *t.unnamed.entry(key).or_default() += 1;
                                    }
                                    if disasm {
                                        listing
                                            .extend(n.layout.iter().map(|p| format!("    {p:?}")));
                                        listing.extend(n.used.iter().map(|u| format!("    {u:?}")));
                                        listing.extend(
                                            insts.iter().map(|i| format_instruction(i, n.wave64)),
                                        );
                                    }
                                }
                                Err(e) => {
                                    let reason = match e {
                                        ShaderError::Isa { reason, .. } => reason,
                                        _ => "other",
                                    };
                                    *t.decode_errors.entry(reason).or_default() += 1;
                                    list.push(format!("({e})"));
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        format!(", native {}", list.join(" "))
                    }
                    Some(Err(e)) => {
                        *t.native_errors.entry(e.to_string()).or_default() += 1;
                        format!(", native: {e}")
                    }
                    _ => String::new(),
                };
                let line = match &program {
                    Some(p) => {
                        t.with_bitcode += 1;
                        let x = p.xbox_extras();
                        t.standard_layout += usize::from(p.is_standard_layout());
                        t.xdat += usize::from(x.xdat);
                        t.xbop += usize::from(x.xbop);
                        *t.kinds.entry(format!("{:?}", p.kind)).or_default() += 1;
                        format!(
                            "{:?} sm{}.{} bitcode {} B, xdat {}, xbop {}",
                            p.kind,
                            p.shader_model.0,
                            p.shader_model.1,
                            p.bitcode.len(),
                            x.xdat,
                            x.xbop
                        )
                    }
                    None => "no parsable DXIL program".to_owned(),
                } + &native;
                if verbose {
                    println!("{}{}: {line}", path.display(), source.label());
                    for l in &listing {
                        println!("{l}");
                    }
                }
            }
            t.files_with_shaders += usize::from(found_here > 0);
        }
    }
    println!(
        "containers found       {} (in {} files)",
        t.containers, t.files_with_shaders
    );
    println!("  with DXIL part       {}", t.with_dxil_part);
    println!("  with LLVM bitcode    {}", t.with_bitcode);
    println!("  PC-standard layout   {}", t.standard_layout);
    println!("  XDAT prefix          {}", t.xdat);
    println!("  xbop trailer         {}", t.xbop);
    for (k, n) in &t.kinds {
        println!("  {k:<20} {n}");
    }
    println!("  with native code     {}", t.with_native);
    for (stage, n) in &t.native_stages {
        println!("    {:<18} {n}", format!("{stage:?}"));
    }
    for (e, n) in &t.native_errors {
        println!("  native unreadable    {n}: {e}");
    }
    if t.with_native > 0 {
        println!(
            "  decoded programs     {} ({} instructions)",
            t.decoded, t.instructions
        );
        for (e, n) in &t.decode_errors {
            println!("  decode failed        {n}: {e}");
        }
        let mut unnamed: Vec<_> = t.unnamed.iter().collect();
        unnamed.sort_by_key(|&(_, n)| std::cmp::Reverse(*n));
        for (op, n) in unnamed.iter().take(10) {
            println!("  opcode not in table  {op} x{n}");
        }
    }
    if t.containers == 0 {
        println!("(none found: shaders may sit in compressed or encrypted archives)");
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn format_instruction(i: &Instruction, wave64: bool) -> String {
    let words: Vec<_> = i.words.iter().map(|w| format!("{w:08X}")).collect();
    let text = match i.name() {
        Some(_) => i.text(wave64),
        None => format!("<{:?} {:#x}>", i.encoding, i.opcode),
    };
    format!("    {:06x}: {:<44} {text}", i.offset, words.join(" "))
}
```

`apps/victory/src/translate.rs`:

```rs
//! The offline batch: every shader found goes through the translator, and
//! what it cannot handle yet is tallied (decision 0003).

use std::collections::{BTreeMap, HashSet};
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::sync::Mutex;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering};

use anyhow::Result;
use victory_shader::emit::host::{self, Host};
use victory_shader::emit::{self, validator::Validator};
use victory_shader::structure::{self, Atom, LaneExit};
use victory_shader::{
    Container, FourCC, HwStage, NativeProgram, RootType, ShaderError, ir, native_programs,
};
use victory_shader::{io, resource};

use crate::shader::{MAX_FILE, Source, sources};

#[derive(Default)]
struct Tally {
    containers: usize,
    duplicates: usize,
    programs: usize,
    translated: usize,
    instructions: usize,
    structured: usize,
    vector: usize,
    guarded: usize,
    /// Guards that read a mask the pass cannot see into.
    opaque: usize,
    lane_branches: usize,
    uniform_branches: usize,
    tracked: usize,
    loaded: usize,
    built: usize,
    constant: usize,
    /// Descriptors and scalar accesses with a computed address term.
    dynamic: usize,
    scalar: usize,
    used: usize,
    /// Used-resource entries whose root parameter no descriptor traces
    /// to, by resource and root type.
    untraced_used: BTreeMap<String, usize>,
    /// Root parameters descriptors trace to that no used entry names.
    unlisted: usize,
    /// Vertex and pixel programs, and those whose I/O was raised.
    io_programs: usize,
    io_raised: usize,
    interpolated: usize,
    vertex_values: usize,
    /// Exports by target kind.
    exports: BTreeMap<&'static str, usize>,
    /// Exports still packed as f16 pairs after the export patch.
    compressed: usize,
    /// Vertex and pixel programs every earlier stage handled, and how far
    /// emission got with them.
    emit_programs: usize,
    emitted: usize,
    validated: usize,
    pipelines: usize,
    /// The same for compute programs.
    cs_programs: usize,
    cs_emitted: usize,
    cs_validated: usize,
    cs_pipelines: usize,
    /// The same for mesh programs.
    ms_programs: usize,
    ms_emitted: usize,
    ms_validated: usize,
    ms_pipelines: usize,
    /// Reason → programs stopped by it, and the first one.
    failed: BTreeMap<String, (usize, String)>,
    /// With `--list`: one line per program and outcome.
    list: bool,
    lines: Vec<String>,
}

impl Tally {
    fn fail(&mut self, reason: String, example: impl FnOnce() -> String) {
        if self.list {
            let e = example();
            self.lines.push(format!("{e}  {reason}"));
            self.failed.entry(reason).or_insert((0, e)).0 += 1;
            return;
        }
        self.failed
            .entry(reason)
            .or_insert_with(|| (0, example()))
            .0 += 1;
    }

    fn merge(&mut self, other: Tally) {
        self.containers += other.containers;
        self.duplicates += other.duplicates;
        self.programs += other.programs;
        self.translated += other.translated;
        self.instructions += other.instructions;
        self.structured += other.structured;
        self.vector += other.vector;
        self.guarded += other.guarded;
        self.opaque += other.opaque;
        self.lane_branches += other.lane_branches;
        self.uniform_branches += other.uniform_branches;
        self.tracked += other.tracked;
        self.loaded += other.loaded;
        self.built += other.built;
        self.constant += other.constant;
        self.dynamic += other.dynamic;
        self.scalar += other.scalar;
        self.used += other.used;
        for (k, n) in other.untraced_used {
            *self.untraced_used.entry(k).or_default() += n;
        }
        self.unlisted += other.unlisted;
        self.io_programs += other.io_programs;
        self.io_raised += other.io_raised;
        self.interpolated += other.interpolated;
        self.vertex_values += other.vertex_values;
        self.compressed += other.compressed;
        self.emit_programs += other.emit_programs;
        self.emitted += other.emitted;
        self.validated += other.validated;
        self.pipelines += other.pipelines;
        self.cs_programs += other.cs_programs;
        self.cs_emitted += other.cs_emitted;
        self.cs_validated += other.cs_validated;
        self.cs_pipelines += other.cs_pipelines;
        self.ms_programs += other.ms_programs;
        self.ms_emitted += other.ms_emitted;
        self.ms_validated += other.ms_validated;
        self.ms_pipelines += other.ms_pipelines;
        for (k, n) in other.exports {
            *self.exports.entry(k).or_default() += n;
        }
        self.lines.extend(other.lines);
        for (reason, (n, example)) in other.failed {
            self.failed.entry(reason).or_insert((0, example)).0 += n;
        }
    }
}

/// Emitted shaders by label, shared between threads.
type Kept = std::sync::Arc<Mutex<Vec<(String, emit::HostShader)>>>;

/// The optional checks after emission, one set per thread.
struct Checks {
    /// Shaders named in `VICTORY_PAIRS` (`vs+ps,...`, label substrings),
    /// kept to build those pipelines after the walk.
    keep: Option<Kept>,
    validator: Option<Validator>,
    host: Option<(Host, emit::HostShader)>,
}

/// `translate --warm <file>`: the containers whose hash the file names are
/// translated into the run's shader cache, on `jobs` threads; nothing is
/// made on the GPU. A run of the title then finds them there instead of
/// translating each at its first use.
pub fn warm(paths: Vec<PathBuf>, file: &Path, jobs: Option<usize>) -> Result<()> {
    // `--warm all`: every container found, whatever its hash.
    let all = file.as_os_str() == "all";
    let mut wanted: HashSet<String> = HashSet::new();
    if !all {
        let text = std::fs::read_to_string(file)?;
        for line in text.lines() {
            for word in line.split(|c: char| !c.is_ascii_hexdigit()) {
                if word.len() == 16 {
                    wanted.insert(word.to_ascii_lowercase());
                }
            }
        }
        anyhow::ensure!(!wanted.is_empty(), "no 16-digit shader hash in {}", file.display());
    }
    // `VICTORY_WARM_SECONDS=<n>`: stop taking new shaders after n seconds
    // (what is done stays in the cache; the next warm-up goes on from there).
    let limit = std::env::var("VICTORY_WARM_SECONDS").ok().and_then(|v| v.trim().parse::<u64>().ok());
    let cfg = victory_core::Config::load()?;
    victory_hle::modules::d3d12x::use_shader_cache(cfg.cache_subdir("shaders")?);
    let paths = crate::default_paths(paths)?;
    let threads = jobs.unwrap_or(4).max(1);
    let began = std::time::Instant::now();
    let done = Mutex::new(HashSet::new());
    let counts = [const { AtomicUsize::new(0) }; 5];
    for root in &paths {
        for entry in walkdir::WalkDir::new(root).into_iter().filter_map(Result::ok) {
            if !entry.file_type().is_file() || entry.metadata().map_or(0, |m| m.len()) > MAX_FILE {
                continue;
            }
            let Ok(data) = std::fs::read(entry.path()) else {
                continue;
            };
            let jobs = sources(&data);
            let next = AtomicUsize::new(0);
            std::thread::scope(|s| {
                for _ in 0..threads.min(jobs.len()) {
                    s.spawn(|| {
                        while let Some(job) = jobs.get(next.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed)) {
                            let Some(bytes) = job.bytes() else {
                                continue;
                            };
                            let hash = blake3::hash(&bytes).to_hex()[..16].to_owned();
                            if limit.is_some_and(|n| began.elapsed().as_secs() >= n) {
                                counts[3].fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
                                break;
                            }
                            if (!all && !wanted.contains(&hash)) || !lock(&done).insert(hash) {
                                continue;
                            }
                            let n = counts[4].fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed) + 1;
                            if n.is_multiple_of(1000) {
                                println!("warm-up      {n} shaders so far, {:.0} s", began.elapsed().as_secs_f64());
                            }
                            let which = match victory_hle::modules::d3d12x::warm_shader(&bytes) {
                                Ok(true) => 0,
                                Ok(false) => 1,
                                Err(_) => 2,
                            };
                            counts[which].fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
                        }
                    });
                }
            });
        }
    }
    let [translated, there, failed] = [0, 1, 2].map(|i| counts[i].load(Ordering::Relaxed));
    let asked = if all { "all".to_owned() } else { wanted.len().to_string() };
    let stopped = if counts[3].load(Ordering::Relaxed) > 0 { " (stopped at the time limit)" } else { "" };
    println!(
        "warm-up      {asked} hashes asked, {} found: {translated} translated now, {there} in the cache already, {failed} do not translate; {:.1} s on {threads} threads{stopped}",
        translated + there + failed,
        began.elapsed().as_secs_f64()
    );
    Ok(())
}

pub fn run(
    paths: Vec<PathBuf>,
    validate: bool,
    pipelines: bool,
    list: bool,
    jobs: Option<usize>,
) -> Result<()> {
    let paths = crate::default_paths(paths)?;
    // `VICTORY_HOST_MAX_WAVE=32`: translate as for a host whose waves have
    // at most 32 lanes (as the runtime does on such a card).
    if let Some(n) = std::env::var("VICTORY_HOST_MAX_WAVE").ok().and_then(|v| v.parse().ok()) {
        victory_shader::emit::set_host_max_wave(n);
    }
    let dll = validate.then(Validator::default_path).flatten();
    if validate {
        Validator::load(dll.as_deref()).map_err(anyhow::Error::msg)?;
        println!(
            "validator    {}",
            dll.as_ref()
                .map_or("dxil.dll".into(), |p| p.display().to_string())
        );
    }
    if pipelines {
        Host::new(false).map_err(anyhow::Error::msg)?;
    }
    let pairs: Vec<(String, String)> = std::env::var("VICTORY_PAIRS")
        .unwrap_or_default()
        .split(',')
        .filter_map(|p| p.split_once('+'))
        .map(|(v, p)| (v.trim().to_owned(), p.trim().to_owned()))
        .collect();
    let kept = std::sync::Arc::new(Mutex::new(Vec::new()));
    let threads =
        jobs.unwrap_or_else(|| std::thread::available_parallelism().map_or(4, |n| n.get()));
    let seen = Mutex::new(HashSet::new());
    let total = Mutex::new(Tally::default());
    for root in &paths {
        for entry in walkdir::WalkDir::new(root)
            .into_iter()
            .filter_map(Result::ok)
        {
            if !entry.file_type().is_file() || entry.metadata().map_or(0, |m| m.len()) > MAX_FILE {
                continue;
            }
            let Ok(data) = std::fs::read(entry.path()) else {
                continue;
            };
            let jobs = sources(&data);
            let next = AtomicUsize::new(0);
            std::thread::scope(|s| {
                for _ in 0..threads.min(jobs.len()) {
                    s.spawn(|| {
                        let mut t = Tally {
                            list,
                            ..Tally::default()
                        };
                        let mut checks = Checks {
                            keep: (!pairs.is_empty()).then(|| kept.clone()),
                            validator: validate
                                .then(|| Validator::load(dll.as_deref()).ok())
                                .flatten(),
                            host: pipelines
                                .then(|| Host::new(false).ok().map(|h| (h, host::stub_ps())))
                                .flatten(),
                        };
                        while let Some(job) = jobs.get(next.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed)) {
                            translate(job, entry.path(), &seen, &mut t, &mut checks);
                        }
                        lock(&total).merge(t);
                    });
                }
            });
        }
    }
    let t = total.into_inner().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    println!(
        "containers   {} ({} duplicates skipped)",
        t.containers, t.duplicates
    );
    println!(
        "programs     {} translated of {} ({} IR instructions)",
        t.translated, t.programs, t.instructions
    );
    println!(
        "structured   {} of {} ({} vector instructions, {} guarded, {} on opaque masks; \
         branches {} per lane, {} uniform)",
        t.structured,
        t.translated,
        t.vector,
        t.guarded,
        t.opaque,
        t.lane_branches,
        t.uniform_branches
    );
    println!(
        "resources    {} of {} tracked (descriptors {} loaded, {} built, {} constant; \
         {} scalar accesses; {} with a computed term)",
        t.tracked, t.translated, t.loaded, t.built, t.constant, t.scalar, t.dynamic
    );
    println!(
        "  used-resource entries {}: {} not traced {:?}; {} traced parameters not listed",
        t.used,
        t.untraced_used.values().sum::<usize>(),
        t.untraced_used,
        t.unlisted
    );
    println!(
        "I/O          {} of {} vertex and pixel programs raised ({} interpolations, \
         {} vertex values; exports {:?}, {} still f16 pairs)",
        t.io_raised, t.io_programs, t.interpolated, t.vertex_values, t.exports, t.compressed
    );
    println!(
        "DXIL         {} emitted of {} vertex and pixel programs; {} validated, {} pipelines",
        t.emitted, t.emit_programs, t.validated, t.pipelines
    );
    println!(
        "             {} emitted of {} compute programs; {} validated, {} pipelines",
        t.cs_emitted, t.cs_programs, t.cs_validated, t.cs_pipelines
    );
    println!(
        "             {} emitted of {} mesh programs; {} validated, {} pipelines",
        t.ms_emitted, t.ms_programs, t.ms_validated, t.ms_pipelines
    );
    if !pairs.is_empty() {
        let host = Host::new(false).map_err(anyhow::Error::msg)?;
        let kept = lock(&kept);
        let find = |name: &str| kept.iter().find(|(l, _)| l.contains(name));
        for (v, p) in &pairs {
            let made = match (find(v), find(p)) {
                (Some((_, vs)), Some((_, ps))) => if vs.stage == HwStage::Ms {
                    host.mesh_pipeline(vs, ps)
                } else {
                    host.pipeline(vs, ps)
                }
                .map(|_| "pipeline created".to_owned())
                .unwrap_or_else(|e| e),
                _ => "not emitted".to_owned(),
            };
            println!("pair {v} + {p}: {made}");
        }
    }
    let mut lines = t.lines;
    lines.sort();
    for l in lines {
        println!("{l}");
    }
    let mut failed: Vec<_> = t.failed.into_iter().collect();
    failed.sort_by_key(|(_, (n, _))| std::cmp::Reverse(*n));
    for (reason, (n, example)) in failed {
        println!("  {n:>7}  {reason}  (e.g. {example})");
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn translate(
    source: &Source,
    path: &Path,
    seen: &Mutex<HashSet<blake3::Hash>>,
    t: &mut Tally,
    checks: &mut Checks,
) {
    let example = || format!("{}{}", path.display(), source.label());
    let Some(bytes) = source.bytes() else {
        return t.fail("corrupt record".into(), example);
    };
    // The hash a run's log names the shader by (`hash=` in "first bind",
    // "shader does not translate", "host pipeline refused").
    let hash = blake3::hash(&bytes).to_hex()[..16].to_owned();
    // Diagnostics: `VICTORY_TRANSLATE_ONLY=<hash prefix>,...` translates
    // those containers alone.
    static ONLY: std::sync::OnceLock<Vec<String>> = std::sync::OnceLock::new();
    let only = ONLY.get_or_init(|| {
        std::env::var("VICTORY_TRANSLATE_ONLY")
            .unwrap_or_default()
            .split(',')
            .map(|h| h.trim().to_lowercase())
            .filter(|h| !h.is_empty())
            .collect()
    });
    if !only.is_empty() && !only.iter().any(|o| hash.starts_with(o.as_str())) {
        return;
    }
    let example = || format!("{}{} #{hash}", path.display(), source.label());
    t.containers += 1;
    let Ok(container) = Container::parse(&bytes) else {
        return t.fail("no DXIL part (SM5 or older)".into(), example);
    };
    let Some(dxil) = container.part(FourCC::DXIL).map(|p| p.data) else {
        return t.fail("no DXIL part (SM5 or older)".into(), example);
    };
    // `~`: the hash of the code alone; containers that differ only around
    // it are translated once, the others listed as duplicates of it.
    let code = blake3::hash(dxil);
    let code8 = code.to_hex()[..8].to_owned();
    let example = || format!("{} ~{code8}", example());
    // `VICTORY_DUMP_MATCH=<dir>;<text>|<text>...`: the containers whose
    // line holds one of the texts (a name, `#hash`), as the title has them.
    if let Ok(spec) = std::env::var("VICTORY_DUMP_MATCH")
        && let Some((dir, texts)) = spec.split_once(';')
    {
        let line = example();
        if texts.split('|').any(|text| !text.is_empty() && line.contains(text)) {
            let name: String = source
                .label()
                .chars()
                .skip_while(|c| *c != ' ')
                .filter(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || *c == '_')
                .take(70)
                .collect();
            let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(dir);
            let _ = std::fs::write(std::path::Path::new(dir).join(format!("{name}.{hash}.cdxil")), &bytes[..]);
        }
    }
    if !lock(seen).insert(code) {
        t.duplicates += 1;
        if t.list {
            t.lines.push(format!("{}  duplicate", example()));
        }
        return;
    }
    let programs = match native_programs(dxil) {
        Ok(p) => p,
        Err(e) => return t.fail(e.to_string(), example),
    };
    // `VICTORY_FAIL_DUMP=<dir>`: the first 3 containers of each failure reason, as the title
    // has them (`.cdxil`), to work on a translator gap offline
    let dump = std::env::var_os("VICTORY_FAIL_DUMP");
    let before: Option<BTreeMap<String, usize>> = dump.as_ref().map(|_| t.failed.iter().map(|(k, v)| (k.clone(), v.0)).collect());
    translate_programs(&container, programs, &example, t, checks);
    if let (Some(dir), Some(before)) = (dump, before) {
        for (reason, (n, _)) in &t.failed {
            let was = before.get(reason).copied().unwrap_or(0);
            if *n > was && was < 3 {
                let stem: String = reason.chars().map(|c| if c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() { c } else { '_' }).take(60).collect();
                let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir);
                let _ = std::fs::write(std::path::Path::new(&dir).join(format!("{stem}_{was}.cdxil")), &bytes[..]);
            }
        }
    }
}

fn translate_programs(container: &Container, programs: Vec<NativeProgram>, example: &dyn Fn() -> String, t: &mut Tally, checks: &mut Checks) {
    for p in programs {
        t.programs += 1;
        match victory_shader::spill::build(&p) {
            Ok(program) => {
                t.translated += 1;
                t.instructions += program.blocks.iter().map(|b| b.insts.len()).sum::<usize>();
                // Per-lane descriptors are traced on the per-lane form; its
                // failure is listed after the resources' and I/O's.
                let structured = structure::structure(&program);
                let lanes = structured.as_ref().ok();
                let res = match resource::track(&program, &p.layout, p.stage, lanes) {
                    Ok(r) => {
                        tally_resources(&p, &r, t);
                        Some(r)
                    }
                    Err(ShaderError::Unsupported { offset, what }) => {
                        t.fail(format!("resources: {what}"), || {
                            format!("{} {:?} at {offset:#x}", example(), p.stage)
                        });
                        None
                    }
                    Err(e) => {
                        t.fail(e.to_string(), || format!("{} {:?}", example(), p.stage));
                        None
                    }
                };
                let graphics = matches!(p.stage, HwStage::Vs | HwStage::Ps);
                let compute = p.stage == HwStage::Cs;
                let mut raised = None;
                if graphics || compute || p.stage == HwStage::Ms {
                    t.io_programs += usize::from(graphics);
                    match io::raise(&program, &p) {
                        Ok(r) => {
                            if graphics {
                                tally_io(&r, t);
                            }
                            raised = Some(r);
                        }
                        Err(ShaderError::Unsupported { offset, what }) => t
                            .fail(format!("I/O: {what}"), || {
                                format!("{} {:?} at {offset:#x}", example(), p.stage)
                            }),
                        Err(e) => t.fail(e.to_string(), || format!("{} {:?}", example(), p.stage)),
                    }
                }
                let structured = match structured {
                    Ok(s) => {
                        tally_structured(&program, &s, t);
                        Some(s)
                    }
                    Err(e) => {
                        let reason = match e {
                            ShaderError::Unsupported { what, .. } => format!("structure: {what}"),
                            ShaderError::Isa { reason, .. } => format!("structure: {reason}"),
                            e => e.to_string(),
                        };
                        t.fail(reason, || format!("{} {:?}", example(), p.stage));
                        None
                    }
                };
                if let (Some(r), Some(i), Some(s)) = (res, raised, structured) {
                    let label = || format!("{} {:?}", example(), p.stage);
                    *counter(t, p.stage, 0) += 1;
                    match emit::emit(container, &p, &program, &s, &i, &r) {
                        Ok(shader) => {
                            census_line(&label(), &p, &program, &shader);
                            *counter(t, p.stage, 1) += 1;
                            check(shader, t, checks, label);
                        }
                        Err(ShaderError::Unsupported { offset, what }) => t
                            .fail(format!("emit: {what}"), || {
                                format!("{} at {offset:#x}", label())
                            }),
                        Err(e) => t.fail(format!("emit: {e}"), label),
                    }
                }
            }
            Err(e) => {
                let reason = match e {
                    ShaderError::Unsupported { what, .. } => format!("unsupported: {what}"),
                    e => e.to_string(),
                };
                t.fail(reason, || format!("{} {:?}", example(), p.stage));
            }
        }
    }
}

/// `VICTORY_SHADER_CENSUS=<file>`: one line per emitted program, appended:
/// its label, the console program's instructions by encoding class (a
/// static count of the whole program, not of one thread's path), and the
/// host module's instructions by kind (`emit::census::KINDS`).
fn census_line(label: &str, native: &NativeProgram, p: &ir::Program, shader: &emit::HostShader) {
    use std::io::Write;
    use victory_shader::gfx10::Fields;
    static OUT: std::sync::OnceLock<Option<Mutex<std::fs::File>>> = std::sync::OnceLock::new();
    let Some(out) = OUT.get_or_init(|| {
        let path = std::env::var_os("VICTORY_SHADER_CENSUS")?;
        let file = std::fs::OpenOptions::new().create(true).append(true).open(path).ok()?;
        Some(Mutex::new(file))
    }) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some(census) = emit::census::take(&shader.dxil) else {
        return;
    };
    // total, vector, scalar, descriptor loads, buffer and memory, image, LDS, control, other
    let mut console = [0u32; 9];
    for inst in p.blocks.iter().flat_map(|b| &b.insts) {
        console[0] += 1;
        let k = match &inst.fields {
            Fields::Valu(_) => 1,
            Fields::Sop { .. } => 2,
            Fields::Smem { .. } => 3,
            Fields::Buffer { .. } | Fields::Flat { .. } => 4,
            Fields::Image { .. } => 5,
            Fields::Ds { .. } => 6,
            Fields::Sopp { .. } => 7,
            _ => 8,
        };
        console[k] += 1;
    }
    let mut line = format!("{label}\twave64={}", u8::from(native.wave64));
    for (name, n) in ["c_total", "c_valu", "c_sop", "c_smem", "c_buffer", "c_image", "c_ds", "c_sopp", "c_other"].iter().zip(console) {
        line.push_str(&format!("\t{name}={n}"));
    }
    for (name, n) in emit::census::KINDS.iter().zip(census.counts) {
        line.push_str(&format!("\t{name}={n}"));
    }
    line.push('\n');
    let _ = lock(out).write_all(line.as_bytes());
}

/// Validates an emitted shader if asked to.
fn check(
    mut shader: emit::HostShader,
    t: &mut Tally,
    checks: &mut Checks,
    label: impl Fn() -> String,
) {
    if let Some(keep) = &checks.keep {
        lock(keep).push((label(), shader.clone()));
    }
    // `VICTORY_EMIT_DUMP` with `--list`: every emitted shader as a file.
    if t.list
        && let Ok(dir) = std::env::var("VICTORY_EMIT_DUMP")
    {
        let name: String = label()
            .chars()
            .map(|c| if c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() { c } else { '_' })
            .collect();
        let _ = std::fs::write(
            format!("{dir}/{}.dxil", &name[name.len().saturating_sub(100)..]),
            &shader.dxil,
        );
    }
    if let Some((h, stub_ps)) = &checks.host {
        let made = match shader.stage {
            HwStage::Vs => h.pipeline(&shader, stub_ps).map(drop),
            HwStage::Cs => h.compute_pipeline(&shader).map(drop),
            HwStage::Ms => h.mesh_pipeline(&shader, stub_ps).map(drop),
            _ => host::stub_vs(&shader).and_then(|vs| h.pipeline(&vs, &shader).map(drop)),
        };
        match made {
            Ok(()) => {
                *counter(t, shader.stage, 3) += 1;
                if t.list {
                    t.lines.push(format!("{}  pipeline created", label()));
                }
            }
            Err(e) => t.fail(format!("pipeline: {e}"), &label),
        }
    }
    let Some(v) = checks.validator.as_mut() else {
        return;
    };
    match v.validate(&mut shader.dxil) {
        Ok(()) => {
            *counter(t, shader.stage, 2) += 1;
            if t.list {
                t.lines.push(format!("{}  validated", label()));
            }
        }
        Err(text) => {
            let first = text
                .lines()
                .find(|l| l.contains("error"))
                .unwrap_or(text.lines().next().unwrap_or(""))
                .to_owned();
            if let Ok(dir) = std::env::var("VICTORY_EMIT_DUMP") {
                let n = t
                    .failed
                    .get(&format!("validator: {first}"))
                    .map_or(0, |f| f.0);
                if n < 3 {
                    let name = format!(
                        "{dir}/{}_{n}",
                        first
                            .chars()
                            .filter(char::is_ascii_alphanumeric)
                            .take(40)
                            .collect::<String>()
                    );
                    let _ = std::fs::write(format!("{name}.dxil"), &shader.dxil);
                    let _ = std::fs::write(format!("{name}.txt"), format!("{}\n{text}", label()));
                }
            }
            t.fail(format!("validator: {first}"), label);
        }
    }
}

/// Emission counts of `stage`'s kind: 0 programs, 1 emitted, 2 validated,
/// 3 pipelines.
fn counter(t: &mut Tally, stage: HwStage, k: usize) -> &mut usize {
    let [a, b, c, d] = match stage {
        HwStage::Cs => [
            &mut t.cs_programs,
            &mut t.cs_emitted,
            &mut t.cs_validated,
            &mut t.cs_pipelines,
        ],
        HwStage::Ms => [
            &mut t.ms_programs,
            &mut t.ms_emitted,
            &mut t.ms_validated,
            &mut t.ms_pipelines,
        ],
        _ => [
            &mut t.emit_programs,
            &mut t.emitted,
            &mut t.validated,
            &mut t.pipelines,
        ],
    };
    [a, b, c, d].into_iter().nth(k).expect("0 to 3")
}

fn tally_io(r: &io::Io, t: &mut Tally) {
    t.io_raised += 1;
    for (_, i) in &r.interps {
        match i {
            io::Interp::Interpolated { .. } => t.interpolated += 1,
            io::Interp::Vertex { .. } => t.vertex_values += 1,
            io::Interp::Weighted { .. } => t.interpolated += 1,
        }
    }
    for e in &r.exports {
        let kind = match e.target {
            io::Target::Color(_) => "color",
            io::Target::Depth => "depth",
            io::Target::Null => "null",
            io::Target::Position(_) => "position",
            io::Target::Param { .. } => "param",
            io::Target::Unread => "unread param",
            io::Target::Primitive => "primitive",
            io::Target::PrimitiveParam { .. } => "primitive param",
        };
        *t.exports.entry(kind).or_default() += 1;
        t.compressed += usize::from(e.compressed);
    }
}

fn tally_resources(p: &NativeProgram, r: &resource::Resources, t: &mut Tally) {
    t.tracked += 1;
    t.scalar += r.scalar.len();
    t.dynamic += r.scalar.iter().filter(|s| s.1.dynamic.is_some()).count();
    let address = |load| r.scalar.iter().find(|s| s.0 == load).map(|s| s.1);
    let mut traced = HashSet::new();
    for leaf in r.descriptors.iter().flat_map(|d| d.source.leaves()) {
        let a = match *leaf {
            resource::Source::Loaded { load, .. } | resource::Source::Fetched { load, .. } => {
                t.loaded += 1;
                address(load)
            }
            resource::Source::Built { address, .. } => {
                t.built += 1;
                t.dynamic += usize::from(address.dynamic.is_some());
                Some(address)
            }
            resource::Source::Constant(_) => {
                t.constant += 1;
                None
            }
            resource::Source::Phi { .. }
            | resource::Source::Select { .. }
            | resource::Source::Lanes { .. }
            | resource::Source::LanePhi { .. } => {
                unreachable!("leaves are no phis, selects or per-lane choices")
            }
        };
        // Heaps hold dynamic resources, which no used entry lists; code
        // tables are no root parameter.
        if let Some(a) = a
            && a.param != resource::CODE
            && !matches!(
                p.layout[a.param].root,
                RootType::ResourceHeap | RootType::SamplerHeap
            )
        {
            traced.insert(p.layout[a.param].user_data);
        }
    }
    // Root constants are listed as a CBV, read straight from the SGPRs.
    traced.extend(
        r.params
            .iter()
            .map(|&(_, param, _)| &p.layout[param])
            .filter(|l| l.root == RootType::Constants)
            .map(|l| l.user_data),
    );
    let listed: HashSet<u8> = p.used.iter().map(|u| u.user_data).collect();
    t.used += p.used.len();
    // Immediate samplers are literals in the code: the distinct sampler
    // values (decoded) are matched against the listed entries, which do not
    // say which value is whose.
    let mut values: Vec<emit::StaticSampler> = Vec::new();
    for d in r
        .descriptors
        .iter()
        .filter(|d| d.role == resource::Role::Sampler)
    {
        for leaf in d.source.leaves() {
            if let resource::Source::Constant(words) = leaf
                && let Ok(w) = <[u32; 4]>::try_from(&words[..words.len().min(4)])
            {
                let s = emit::StaticSampler::from_words(w);
                if !values.contains(&s) {
                    values.push(s);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    // Engines often declare equal samplers at several registers, so equal
    // values may stand for several entries, but never more values than
    // entries.
    let immediate = p
        .used
        .iter()
        .filter(|u| u.root == RootType::ImmediateSampler)
        .count();
    let samplers_match = !values.is_empty() && values.len() <= immediate;
    let matched = |u: &&victory_shader::UsedResource| {
        if u.root == RootType::ImmediateSampler {
            samplers_match
        } else {
            traced.contains(&u.user_data)
        }
    };
    for u in p.used.iter().filter(|u| !matched(u)) {
        *t.untraced_used
            .entry(format!("{:?} via {:?}", u.kind, u.root))
            .or_default() += 1;
    }
    t.unlisted += traced.difference(&listed).count();
}

fn tally_structured(program: &ir::Program, s: &structure::Structured, t: &mut Tally) {
    t.structured += 1;
    for (block, guards) in program.blocks.iter().zip(&s.guards) {
        t.vector += block
            .insts
            .iter()
            .filter(|i| i.read(ir::Reg::S(ir::EXEC)).is_some())
            .count();
        for &g in guards.iter().flatten() {
            t.guarded += 1;
            let support = s.bools.support(g);
            t.opaque += usize::from(support.iter().any(|a| matches!(a, Atom::Opaque(_))));
        }
    }
    for exit in &s.exits {
        if let LaneExit::Branch { when, .. } = *exit {
            if s.bools
                .support(when)
                .iter()
                .all(|a| matches!(a, Atom::Uniform(_)))
            {
                t.uniform_branches += 1;
            } else {
                t.lane_branches += 1;
            }
        }
    }
}

fn lock<T>(m: &Mutex<T>) -> std::sync::MutexGuard<'_, T> {
    m.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())
}
```

`crates/victory-core/src/config.rs`:

```rs
//! Where the user's files live.
//!
//! Resolution order for each value: environment variable, then the config
//! file (`VICTORY_CONFIG`, else `./victory.toml`), then the default.
//! See `victory.example.toml` at the repository root.

use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

use anyhow::{Context, Result};
use serde::Deserialize;

use crate::policy::ensure_outside_repo;

#[derive(Debug, Default, Clone)]
pub struct Config {
    /// The user's dump of the title.
    pub game_dir: Option<PathBuf>,
    /// Root for all derived data. Always outside the repository.
    pub cache_dir: PathBuf,
    /// What titles write and must keep (persistent local storage). Never
    /// inside the cache, which may be deleted at any time.
    pub data_dir: PathBuf,
    /// Other titles used to exercise platform-level code.
    pub test_titles: Vec<PathBuf>,
    /// The config file that was read, if any.
    pub source: Option<PathBuf>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Default, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
struct FileConfig {
    #[serde(default)]
    paths: FilePaths,
}

#[derive(Debug, Default, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
struct FilePaths {
    game_dir: Option<PathBuf>,
    cache_dir: Option<PathBuf>,
    data_dir: Option<PathBuf>,
    #[serde(default)]
    test_titles: Vec<PathBuf>,
}

impl Config {
    /// Loads configuration from the environment and the config file.
    pub fn load() -> Result<Self> {
        let explicit = std::env::var_os("VICTORY_CONFIG").map(PathBuf::from);
        let path = explicit
            .clone()
            .unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from("victory.toml"));
        let file = if path.is_file() {
            let text = std::fs::read_to_string(&path)
                .with_context(|| format!("reading {}", path.display()))?;
            Some((path, text))
        } else if let Some(p) = explicit {
            anyhow::bail!(
                "VICTORY_CONFIG points at {}, which does not exist",
                p.display()
            );
        } else {
            None
        };
        let (source, parsed) = match file {
            Some((path, text)) => {
                let parsed: FileConfig =
                    toml::from_str(&text).with_context(|| format!("parsing {}", path.display()))?;
                (Some(path), parsed)
            }
            None => (None, FileConfig::default()),
        };
        Self::resolve(parsed.paths, source, |k| std::env::var_os(k))
    }

    fn resolve(
        file: FilePaths,
        source: Option<PathBuf>,
        env: impl Fn(&str) -> Option<std::ffi::OsString>,
    ) -> Result<Self> {
        let env_path = |k: &str| env(k).filter(|v| !v.is_empty()).map(PathBuf::from);
        let test_titles = match env("VICTORY_TEST_TITLES") {
            Some(v) if !v.is_empty() => std::env::split_paths(&v)
                .filter(|p| !p.as_os_str().is_empty())
                .collect(),
            _ => file.test_titles,
        };
        let cache_dir = env_path("VICTORY_CACHE_DIR")
            .or(file.cache_dir)
            .map_or_else(|| default_dir("cache"), Ok)?;
        let data_dir = env_path("VICTORY_DATA_DIR")
            .or(file.data_dir)
            .map_or_else(|| default_dir("data"), Ok)?;
        Ok(Config {
            game_dir: env_path("VICTORY_GAME_DIR").or(file.game_dir),
            cache_dir,
            data_dir,
            test_titles,
            source,
        })
    }

    /// The game directory, or a helpful error if it is not configured.
    pub fn require_game_dir(&self) -> Result<&Path> {
        self.game_dir.as_deref().context(
            "no game directory configured: set VICTORY_GAME_DIR or [paths].game_dir in \
             victory.toml (see victory.example.toml)",
        )
    }

    /// Returns `<cache>/<sub>`, creating it, after checking the asset policy.
    pub fn cache_subdir(&self, sub: &str) -> Result<PathBuf> {
        subdir(&self.cache_dir, sub)
    }

    /// Returns `<data>/<sub>`, creating it, after checking the asset policy.
    pub fn data_subdir(&self, sub: &str) -> Result<PathBuf> {
        subdir(&self.data_dir, sub)
    }
}

fn subdir(root: &Path, sub: &str) -> Result<PathBuf> {
    let dir = root.join(sub);
    ensure_outside_repo(&dir)?;
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).with_context(|| format!("creating {}", dir.display()))?;
    Ok(dir)
}

/// `%LOCALAPPDATA%/victory/<name>` (elsewhere the XDG or home cache).
fn default_dir(name: &str) -> Result<PathBuf> {
    let base = std::env::var_os("LOCALAPPDATA")
        .or_else(|| std::env::var_os("XDG_CACHE_HOME"))
        .map(PathBuf::from)
        .or_else(|| std::env::var_os("HOME").map(|h| PathBuf::from(h).join(".cache")))
        .context("cannot determine a user directory; set VICTORY_CACHE_DIR and VICTORY_DATA_DIR")?;
    Ok(base.join("victory").join(name))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use std::ffi::OsString;

    #[test]
    fn environment_overrides_file() {
        let file = FilePaths {
            game_dir: Some("from-file".into()),
            cache_dir: Some("cache-from-file".into()),
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let env = |k: &str| (k == "VICTORY_GAME_DIR").then(|| OsString::from("from-env"));
        let cfg = Config::resolve(file, None, env).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(cfg.game_dir.unwrap(), PathBuf::from("from-env"));
        assert_eq!(cfg.cache_dir, PathBuf::from("cache-from-file"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn empty_env_values_are_ignored() {
        let file = FilePaths {
            game_dir: Some("from-file".into()),
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let env = |k: &str| (k == "VICTORY_GAME_DIR").then(OsString::new);
        let cfg = Config::resolve(file, None, env).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(cfg.game_dir.unwrap(), PathBuf::from("from-file"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn empty_test_titles_env_is_ignored() {
        let file = FilePaths {
            test_titles: vec!["from-file".into()],
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let env = |k: &str| (k == "VICTORY_TEST_TITLES").then(OsString::new);
        let cfg = Config::resolve(file, None, env).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(cfg.test_titles, vec![PathBuf::from("from-file")]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_titles_env_splits_paths() {
        let value = std::env::join_paths(["first", "second"]).unwrap();
        let file = FilePaths::default();
        let env = |k: &str| (k == "VICTORY_TEST_TITLES").then(|| value.clone());
        let cfg = Config::resolve(file, None, env).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            cfg.test_titles,
            vec![PathBuf::from("first"), PathBuf::from("second")]
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn example_config_parses() {
        let text = include_str!("../../../victory.example.toml");
        let parsed: FileConfig = toml::from_str(text).unwrap();
        assert!(parsed.paths.game_dir.is_some());
    }

    #[test]
    fn cache_inside_repo_is_refused() {
        let inside = Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("cache");
        let cfg = Config {
            cache_dir: inside,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        assert!(cfg.cache_subdir("x").is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn data_inside_repo_is_refused() {
        let inside = Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("data");
        let cfg = Config {
            data_dir: inside,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        assert!(cfg.data_subdir("x").is_err());
    }
}
```

`crates/victory-core/src/logging.rs`:

```rs
//! One tracing setup for every binary.
//!
//! Filter with `VICTORY_LOG` (falls back to `RUST_LOG`), e.g.
//! `VICTORY_LOG=victory_loader=trace,info`. Debug and trace output exist
//! only in builds with the `diagnostics` feature; a plain release build
//! logs info and above whatever the filter asks for.

use tracing_subscriber::EnvFilter;
use tracing_subscriber::filter::LevelFilter;
use tracing_subscriber::layer::SubscriberExt;
use tracing_subscriber::util::SubscriberInitExt;

/// The most verbose level this build can log.
const CAP: LevelFilter = if cfg!(feature = "diagnostics") {
    LevelFilter::TRACE
} else {
    LevelFilter::INFO
};

pub fn init(default_level: &str) {
    let filter = std::env::var("VICTORY_LOG")
        .or_else(|_| std::env::var("RUST_LOG"))
        .ok()
        .and_then(|v| EnvFilter::try_new(v).ok())
        .unwrap_or_else(|| EnvFilter::new(default_level));
    let _ = tracing_subscriber::registry()
        .with(CAP)
        .with(filter)
        .with(
            tracing_subscriber::fmt::layer()
                .with_target(true)
                .with_writer(std::io::stderr),
        )
        .try_init();
}
```

`crates/victory-core/src/policy.rs`:

```rs
//! Rule #1, enforced at runtime: game-derived data never lands in the repo.
//!
//! Everything VIctory produces from the user's files (converted assets,
//! prepared images, shader caches, crash dumps) is as much "from the game"
//! as the files themselves. Every tool that writes such output must call
//! [`ensure_outside_repo`] on the destination first. The static half of the
//! rule is `cargo xtask policy`, which checks what git tracks.

use std::path::{Component, Path, PathBuf};

/// Marker file at the root of the source tree.
pub const ROOT_MARKER: &str = ".victory-root";

/// The source tree this binary was compiled from.
fn compiled_workspace_root() -> PathBuf {
    // crates/victory-core -> workspace root
    Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("..").join("..")
}

#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error)]
pub enum PolicyError {
    #[error(
        "refusing to use {path} for game-derived data: it is inside the VIctory source tree \
         ({root}). Keep game files, caches and outputs outside the repository \
         (see docs/asset-policy.md)"
    )]
    InsideRepo { path: PathBuf, root: PathBuf },
    #[error("cannot resolve {path}: {source}")]
    Io {
        path: PathBuf,
        source: std::io::Error,
    },
}

/// Returns `Ok` only if `path` is outside every VIctory source tree.
///
/// `path` does not have to exist yet. Two checks are made:
/// 1. it is not below the source tree this binary was built from;
/// 2. none of its ancestors contains the [`ROOT_MARKER`] file (catches
///    other clones/copies of the repository).
pub fn ensure_outside_repo(path: &Path) -> Result<(), PolicyError> {
    let resolved = resolve(path)?;

    if let Ok(root) = std::fs::canonicalize(compiled_workspace_root())
        && root.join(ROOT_MARKER).is_file()
        && resolved.starts_with(&root)
    {
        return Err(PolicyError::InsideRepo {
            path: path.to_path_buf(),
            root,
        });
    }

    for ancestor in resolved.ancestors() {
        if ancestor.join(ROOT_MARKER).is_file() {
            return Err(PolicyError::InsideRepo {
                path: path.to_path_buf(),
                root: ancestor.to_path_buf(),
            });
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// Canonicalizes the longest existing prefix of `path` and re-appends the
/// rest, so that paths which do not exist yet can still be compared.
fn resolve(path: &Path) -> Result<PathBuf, PolicyError> {
    let absolute = if path.is_absolute() {
        path.to_path_buf()
    } else {
        std::env::current_dir()
            .map_err(|source| PolicyError::Io {
                path: path.to_path_buf(),
                source,
            })?
            .join(path)
    };

    let mut existing = absolute.as_path();
    let mut rest = Vec::new();
    loop {
        match std::fs::canonicalize(existing) {
            Ok(canon) => {
                let mut out = canon;
                for component in rest.iter().rev() {
                    out.push(component);
                }
                return Ok(normalize(&out));
            }
            Err(source) => match (existing.parent(), existing.file_name()) {
                (Some(parent), Some(name)) => {
                    rest.push(name.to_os_string());
                    existing = parent;
                }
                _ => {
                    return Err(PolicyError::Io {
                        path: path.to_path_buf(),
                        source,
                    });
                }
            },
        }
    }
}

/// Removes `.` and resolves `..` lexically (only used on the non-existing tail).
fn normalize(path: &Path) -> PathBuf {
    let mut out = PathBuf::new();
    for component in path.components() {
        match component {
            Component::CurDir => {}
            Component::ParentDir => {
                out.pop();
            }
            c => out.push(c),
        }
    }
    out
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn rejects_paths_inside_this_repo() {
        let inside = compiled_workspace_root().join("cache").join("textures");
        assert!(matches!(
            ensure_outside_repo(&inside),
            Err(PolicyError::InsideRepo { .. })
        ));
        let sneaky = std::env::temp_dir().join("..").join("x"); // sanity: no panic
        let _ = ensure_outside_repo(&sneaky);
    }

    #[test]
    fn rejects_dotdot_escapes_back_into_repo() {
        let root = compiled_workspace_root();
        let path = root
            .join("crates")
            .join("..")
            .join("not-yet-created")
            .join("out");
        assert!(ensure_outside_repo(&path).is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn rejects_other_clones_via_marker() {
        let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        std::fs::write(tmp.path().join(ROOT_MARKER), "").unwrap();
        assert!(ensure_outside_repo(&tmp.path().join("cache")).is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn accepts_unrelated_directories() {
        let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        ensure_outside_repo(&tmp.path().join("does").join("not").join("exist")).unwrap();
    }
}
```
