`crates/victory-gpu/src/backreads.rs`:

```rs
//! Diagnostics: who touches what the copy-back stored
//! (`VICTORY_BACK_READS`; off unless set; diagnostics builds only).
//!
//! What shaders wrote is fetched from the card and merged into title
//! memory after every submission (`Shadow::card_merge_relay`,
//! `Shadow::relay_merge`), 41 to 59 MB a frame in the first room, whether
//! or not anything reads those bytes there afterwards. This module counts,
//! per frame and per host copy, what happens to each stored 64 KiB page of
//! title memory between one store and the next: which reader of ours took
//! it, whether the title wrote it, and (for one page in [`SAMPLE`], view
//! memory stored through a view of our own only) whether ANYTHING touched
//! it through the title's addresses.
//!
//! The touch is seen without changing a byte or a protection. After the
//! store the 4 KiB pages of the stored stretch are taken out of the
//! process's working set at every title address that shows them
//! (`VirtualUnlock` of pages that are not locked: the documented way, as
//! `crate::pipeline::library::trim` does for the pipeline file). The bytes
//! stay in physical memory (our own view of the section holds the same
//! pages valid). The next access through a title address, by the title, by
//! a reader of ours or by the kernel on someone's behalf, is a soft fault
//! that Windows resolves by itself and that puts the page back in the
//! working set, where `QueryWorkingSetEx` shows it. Nothing faults into a
//! handler, a kernel call that reads or writes the page succeeds as
//! before, a read-only guard stays read-only and still takes the title's
//! writes. Measured on this PC (a probe outside the game): 5.4
//! us to trim a 64 KiB piece beside six running threads, 2.8 us to ask
//! about its 16 pages, 0.89 us for each 4 KiB page somebody then reads.
//!
//! Values: `1` counts only (stores, readers of ours, title writes; no
//! page leaves the working set); `2` also looks at one page in [`SAMPLE`];
//! `alt` is twenty seconds of `2` and twenty of `1` in turn, each change
//! said in the log, so that the look's own cost shows in the frame log.
//!
//! What a look cannot tell: WHO touched. A reader of ours is told apart by
//! the hooks in `crate::host` (`read_into`, `copy_mapped`, `write_mapped`);
//! a touch with no hook and no write is "something else", which is the
//! title's own reads at most (it also holds readers of ours that read in
//! place with no hook: a texture's refresh in place, the rectangle
//! vertices of `crate::draw`, and host libraries called by the title).

use std::cell::Cell;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU8, AtomicU64, Ordering::Relaxed};
use std::sync::{Mutex, MutexGuard, OnceLock};

use crate::watch::PAGE;

const KERNEL_PAGE: usize = 4096;
/// One stored page in this many is looked at (`2`, `alt`).
const SAMPLE: u64 = 8;
/// A stored page not stored again within this many frames is closed.
const KEEP: u64 = 8;
/// Frames between two summary lines; the buffers' table follows every
/// eighth of them.
const EVERY: f64 = 256.0;

/// Readers of ours, as bits of `Seen::layer`.
pub(crate) const MERGE: u8 = 0;
pub(crate) const REFRESH: u8 = 1;
const REFRESH_OTHER: u8 = 2;
pub(crate) const UNDER: u8 = 3;
pub(crate) const TITLE_COPY: u8 = 4;
const STORE: u8 = 5;
const OTHER: u8 = 6;
const WHO: usize = 7;

/// 0 off, 1 counted only, 2 with looks, 3 in turn.
fn setting() -> u8 {
    static MODE: OnceLock<u8> = OnceLock::new();
    *MODE.get_or_init(|| match std::env::var("VICTORY_BACK_READS").as_deref().map(str::trim) {
        Ok("1") => 1,
        Ok("2") => 2,
        Ok("alt") => 3,
        _ => 0,
    })
}

/// Whether anything is counted at all.
pub(crate) fn on() -> bool {
    setting() != 0
}

/// Whether stored pages are looked at now.
fn looking() -> bool {
    match setting() {
        2 => true,
        3 => {
            static EPOCH: OnceLock<std::time::Instant> = OnceLock::new();
            let on = (EPOCH.get_or_init(std::time::Instant::now).elapsed().as_secs() / 20) % 2 == 1;
            static LAST: AtomicU8 = AtomicU8::new(2);
            if LAST.swap(u8::from(on), Relaxed) != u8::from(on) {
                tracing::info!(
                    "pages that came back are looked at for a touch from now (VICTORY_BACK_READS=alt): {}",
                    if on { "ON" } else { "off, counted only" }
                );
            }
            on
        }
        _ => false,
    }
}

/// Whether `page` is one of the pages looked at in `frame`: one in
/// [`SAMPLE`] by its number, another set every 512 frames.
fn sampled(page: usize, frame: u64) -> bool {
    ((page as u64).wrapping_mul(0x9E37_79B9_7F4A_7C15) >> 40) % SAMPLE == (frame / 512) % SAMPLE
}

/// Sums, of one host copy or of all.
#[derive(Default, Clone, Copy)]
struct Tally {
    /// Stretches stored, their bytes, those stored through a view of our
    /// own and their bytes, pages stored for the first time in their
    /// frame, and stores of a page stored a frame before or in the same.
    stores: u64,
    bytes: u64,
    own: u64,
    own_bytes: u64,
    pages: u64,
    again: u64,
    /// Stores followed to their end, by which reader of ours took them
    /// meanwhile ([`MERGE`]..), those whose guard was clean right after
    /// the store, and of those the ones the title wrote.
    ended: u64,
    who: [u64; WHO],
    clean: u64,
    written: u64,
    /// Stores whose pages were taken out of the working set, and those
    /// looked at afterwards.
    trimmed: u64,
    looked: u64,
    /// Of the looked at: nothing touched them (and their bytes); the
    /// title wrote; readers of ours and no write; something else (and
    /// their bytes).
    untouched: u64,
    untouched_bytes: u64,
    wrote: u64,
    ours: u64,
    other: u64,
    other_bytes: u64,
    /// Their 4 KiB pages: touched, asked about.
    small: [u64; 2],
    /// Ends: no store of the page again within [`KEEP`] frames; the
    /// runtime remapped the page; no look because a mapping was changing.
    late: u64,
    remapped: u64,
    busy: u64,
}

/// A stored page, from its store to the next one.
struct Seen {
    /// The copy that stored: its number, and its title buffer's start and
    /// bytes.
    id: u64,
    copy: (u64, u64),
    /// The page's number at the address stored at.
    page: usize,
    frame: u64,
    bytes: u64,
    /// The stretch as whole 4 KiB pages: offsets in the 64 KiB page.
    from: usize,
    to: usize,
    /// The page's address in every title view that shows it.
    shown: Vec<usize>,
    /// Not ended yet.
    open: bool,
    /// Stored through a view of our own.
    own: bool,
    trimmed: bool,
    /// The guard of the page was clean right after the store, and the
    /// journal's number for the page then.
    clean: bool,
    stamp: u64,
    /// Readers of ours since the store.
    layer: u8,
}

/// What an ended store was found to be.
struct Judged {
    written: bool,
    /// 4 KiB pages touched, asked about.
    looked: Option<(u32, u32)>,
    busy: bool,
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct State {
    /// By page number (the address of the last store).
    seen: HashMap<usize, Seen>,
    /// Every title page number of a seen page: its key in `seen`.
    names: HashMap<usize, usize>,
    /// By copy (start, bytes), since the start.
    buffers: HashMap<(u64, u64), Tally>,
    since: Tally,
    all: Tally,
    frames: f64,
    lines: u64,
}

static STATE: Mutex<Option<State>> = Mutex::new(None);

fn state() -> MutexGuard<'static, Option<State>> {
    STATE.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())
}

/// A bit per title page number (its low 18 bits): set while the page may
/// be a seen one. What the hooks look at first, without a lock.
const BITS: usize = 1 << 18;
static TRACKED: [AtomicU64; BITS / 64] = [const { AtomicU64::new(0) }; BITS / 64];

fn bit(page: usize) -> (usize, u64) {
    let b = page & (BITS - 1);
    (b / 64, 1u64 << (b % 64))
}

fn mark(page: usize) {
    let (word, b) = bit(page);
    TRACKED[word].fetch_or(b, Relaxed);
}

fn marked(page: usize) -> bool {
    let (word, b) = bit(page);
    TRACKED[word].load(Relaxed) & b != 0
}

thread_local! {
    /// Which reader of ours this thread is now, and for which copy.
    static AS: Cell<(u8, u64)> = const { Cell::new((OTHER, 0)) };
}

/// Puts back what the thread was reading as.
pub(crate) struct Scope((u8, u64));

impl Drop for Scope {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        AS.with(|a| a.set(self.0));
    }
}

/// Until what it returns is dropped, this thread's reads of title memory
/// count as `who`'s, for copy number `copy`.
pub(crate) fn reading_as(who: u8, copy: u64) -> Option<Scope> {
    if !on() {
        return None;
    }
    Some(Scope(AS.with(|a| a.replace((who, copy)))))
}

fn each(s: &mut State, copy: (u64, u64), f: impl Fn(&mut Tally)) {
    f(&mut s.since);
    f(&mut s.all);
    f(s.buffers.entry(copy).or_default());
}

/// The 4 KiB pages of the stretch found in the working set at any of the
/// page's title addresses, and how many there are; `None` if Windows did
/// not answer.
fn valid(seen: &Seen) -> Option<(u32, u32)> {
    use windows_sys::Win32::System::ProcessStatus::{K32QueryWorkingSetEx, PSAPI_WORKING_SET_EX_INFORMATION};
    use windows_sys::Win32::System::Threading::GetCurrentProcess;
    let pages = ((seen.to - seen.from) / KERNEL_PAGE).min(16);
    let mut touched = [false; 16];
    for &base in &seen.shown {
        // SAFETY: plain data.
        let mut info: [PSAPI_WORKING_SET_EX_INFORMATION; 16] = unsafe { std::mem::zeroed() };
        for (i, entry) in info[..pages].iter_mut().enumerate() {
            entry.VirtualAddress = (base + seen.from + i * KERNEL_PAGE) as *mut _;
        }
        // SAFETY: `pages` entries of the size given; our own process. The
        // call reads page table state and touches no page.
        let asked = unsafe {
            K32QueryWorkingSetEx(
                GetCurrentProcess(),
                info.as_mut_ptr().cast(),
                (pages * size_of::<PSAPI_WORKING_SET_EX_INFORMATION>()) as u32,
            )
        } != 0;
        if !asked {
            return None;
        }
        for (i, entry) in info[..pages].iter().enumerate() {
            // Bit 0 of the answer: the page is in the working set.
            // SAFETY: plain data the query filled in.
            if unsafe { entry.VirtualAttributes.Flags } & 1 != 0 {
                touched[i] = true;
            }
        }
    }
    Some((touched[..pages].iter().filter(|&&t| t).count() as u32, pages as u32))
}

/// Takes the stretch's 4 KiB pages out of the working set at every title
/// address of the page; false, with nothing done, while the runtime
/// changes a mapping.
fn trim(shown: &[usize], from: usize, to: usize) -> bool {
    use windows_sys::Win32::System::Memory::VirtualUnlock;
    // No mapping changes until the addresses have been used.
    let Some(_still) = crate::watch::title_memory_reading_now() else {
        return false;
    };
    for &base in shown {
        // SAFETY: only the working set changes. Unlocking pages that are
        // not locked fails, as expected, and takes them out of it; an
        // address with nothing mapped fails and does nothing. Each range
        // lies inside one 64 KiB page, so inside one view.
        unsafe { VirtualUnlock((base + from) as *const _, to - from) };
    }
    true
}

/// Looks at an ended store, with no lock of ours held: whether the title
/// wrote the page (a store through our own view that left the guard
/// clean: the guard is open now, or the journal found the page written
/// since), and which of its trimmed pages are back in the working set.
fn judge(seen: &Seen) -> Judged {
    let written = seen.own
        && seen.clean
        && (!crate::watch::clean(seen.page) || crate::watch::stamp(seen.page) > seen.stamp);
    let looked = if seen.trimmed {
        match crate::watch::title_memory_reading_now() {
            Some(_still) => valid(seen),
            None => None,
        }
    } else {
        None
    };
    Judged { written, looked, busy: seen.trimmed && looked.is_none() }
}

/// Counts an ended store. `how`: 0 the page's next store, 1 none within
/// [`KEEP`] frames, 2 a remapping.
fn tally(s: &mut State, seen: &Seen, judged: &Judged, how: u8) {
    let (layer, bytes, guarded) = (seen.layer, seen.bytes, seen.own && seen.clean);
    let (written, looked, busy) = (judged.written, judged.looked, judged.busy);
    each(s, seen.copy, |t| {
        t.ended += 1;
        for (who, count) in t.who.iter_mut().enumerate() {
            if layer & (1 << who) != 0 {
                *count += 1;
            }
        }
        if guarded {
            t.clean += 1;
        }
        if written {
            t.written += 1;
        }
        match how {
            1 => t.late += 1,
            2 => t.remapped += 1,
            _ => {}
        }
        if busy {
            t.busy += 1;
        }
        if let Some((touched, asked)) = looked {
            t.looked += 1;
            t.small[0] += u64::from(touched);
            t.small[1] += u64::from(asked);
            if touched == 0 {
                t.untouched += 1;
                t.untouched_bytes += bytes;
            } else if written {
                t.wrote += 1;
            } else if layer != 0 {
                t.ours += 1;
            } else {
                t.other += 1;
                t.other_bytes += bytes;
            }
        }
    });
}

/// A merge is about to read title memory at `at` and may store there: the
/// page's last store ends here, before our own read touches the page.
/// Called by the thread that copies back, ahead of the merge's read.
pub(crate) fn before(at: usize) {
    if !on() {
        return;
    }
    let page = at / PAGE;
    if !marked(page) {
        return;
    }
    let (key, mut seen) = {
        let mut guard = state();
        let Some(s) = guard.as_mut() else {
            return;
        };
        let Some(&key) = s.names.get(&page) else {
            return;
        };
        if !s.seen.get(&key).is_some_and(|seen| seen.open) {
            return;
        }
        let Some(seen) = s.seen.remove(&key) else {
            return;
        };
        (key, seen)
    };
    let judged = judge(&seen);
    let mut guard = state();
    let Some(s) = guard.as_mut() else {
        return;
    };
    tally(s, &seen, &judged, 0);
    seen.open = false;
    // Kept, closed, for "stored again within a frame".
    s.seen.entry(key).or_insert(seen);
}

/// A merge of copy `id` (title buffer `copy`: start, bytes) stored
/// `[at, at + n)` of title memory, inside one 64 KiB page; `own`: through
/// a view of our own (`Shadow::put_back_own`), else through the kernel at
/// the title's address.
pub(crate) fn stored(id: u64, copy: (u64, u64), at: usize, n: usize, own: bool) {
    if !on() || n == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let page = at / PAGE;
    let base = page * PAGE;
    let from = (at - base) & !(KERNEL_PAGE - 1);
    let to = (at - base + n).min(PAGE).next_multiple_of(KERNEL_PAGE);
    let frame = crate::frame::current();
    // Asked with no lock of ours held.
    let mut shown = crate::inplace::pages_of(base);
    let many = shown.len() > crate::watch::MANY_VIEWS;
    if shown.is_empty() || many {
        shown = vec![base];
    }
    let (clean, stamp) = if own { (crate::watch::clean(page), crate::watch::stamp(page)) } else { (false, 0) };
    // Only what went through our own view: its pages stay in physical
    // memory whatever happens to the title's addresses (our view holds
    // them), and the guard tells the title's writes there.
    let trimmed = own && !many && looking() && sampled(page, frame) && trim(&shown, from, to);
    let mut guard = state();
    let s = guard.get_or_insert_with(State::default);
    let key = s.names.get(&page).copied().unwrap_or(page);
    let old = s.seen.remove(&key);
    let (again, first) = match &old {
        Some(old) => (old.frame + 1 >= frame, old.frame != frame),
        None => (false, true),
    };
    if let Some(old) = old {
        if old.open {
            // A store with no `before` ahead of it: ended unlooked.
            tally(s, &old, &Judged { written: false, looked: None, busy: old.trimmed }, 0);
        }
        for a in &old.shown {
            s.names.remove(&(a / PAGE));
        }
    }
    each(s, copy, |t| {
        t.stores += 1;
        t.bytes += n as u64;
        if own {
            t.own += 1;
            t.own_bytes += n as u64;
        }
        if first {
            t.pages += 1;
        }
        if again {
            t.again += 1;
        }
        if trimmed {
            t.trimmed += 1;
        }
    });
    for a in &shown {
        s.names.insert(a / PAGE, page);
        mark(a / PAGE);
    }
    s.seen.insert(
        page,
        Seen { id, copy, page, frame, bytes: n as u64, from, to, shown, open: true, own, trimmed, clean, stamp, layer: 0 },
    );
}

/// A reader of ours reads title memory `[at, at + len)` (`store`: it
/// writes there through the kernel, as a merge does the old way). The
/// seen pages whose stored stretch it meets are noted read by it.
pub(crate) fn touched(at: usize, len: usize, store: bool) {
    if !on() || len == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let end = at.saturating_add(len);
    let (first, last) = (at / PAGE, (end - 1) / PAGE);
    if last - first > 1 << 16 || !(first..=last).any(marked) {
        return;
    }
    let (who, copy) = AS.with(|a| a.get());
    let mut guard = state();
    let Some(s) = guard.as_mut() else {
        return;
    };
    for page in first..=last {
        let Some(&key) = s.names.get(&page) else {
            continue;
        };
        let Some(seen) = s.seen.get_mut(&key) else {
            continue;
        };
        if !seen.open {
            continue;
        }
        let base = page * PAGE;
        let (a, b) = (at.max(base) - base, end.min(base + PAGE) - base);
        if a >= seen.to || b <= seen.from {
            continue;
        }
        let who = if store {
            STORE
        } else if who == REFRESH && copy != seen.id {
            REFRESH_OTHER
        } else {
            who
        };
        seen.layer |= 1 << who;
    }
}

/// The runtime mapped or unmapped title memory `[at, at + len)`
/// (`crate::watch::title_memory_remapped`): the seen pages there end,
/// unlooked (their addresses show something else from now on).
pub(crate) fn remapped(at: usize, len: usize) {
    if !on() || len == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let (first, last) = (at / PAGE, (at.saturating_add(len) - 1) / PAGE);
    let mut guard = state();
    let Some(s) = guard.as_mut() else {
        return;
    };
    if s.names.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    let keys: Vec<usize> = if last - first < s.names.len() {
        (first..=last).filter_map(|page| s.names.get(&page).copied()).collect()
    } else {
        s.names.iter().filter(|(page, _)| (first..=last).contains(*page)).map(|(_, key)| *key).collect()
    };
    for key in keys {
        // (A key may be named twice: two addresses of one page.)
        let Some(seen) = s.seen.remove(&key) else {
            continue;
        };
        if seen.open {
            tally(s, &seen, &Judged { written: false, looked: None, busy: false }, 2);
        }
        for a in &seen.shown {
            s.names.remove(&(a / PAGE));
        }
    }
}

/// The sums as text, each divided by `per` (frames, or 1 for totals).
fn words(t: &Tally, per: f64) -> String {
    let n = |v: u64| v as f64 / per;
    let mb = |v: u64| v as f64 / per / (1 << 20) as f64;
    let stores = format!(
        "{:.1} stretches {:.2} MB stored in {:.1} pages ({:.1} stretches {:.2} MB through views of our own; the rest the \
         old way, counted and never looked at); {:.1} were of a page stored a frame before or in the same frame",
        n(t.stores),
        mb(t.bytes),
        n(t.pages),
        n(t.own),
        mb(t.own_bytes),
        n(t.again),
    );
    let readers = format!(
        "{:.1} stores followed to their end, taken meanwhile by: a refresh of the copy that stored {:.1}, a refresh of \
         another copy {:.1}, another merge {:.1}, the look for title bytes under flights {:.1}, a title copy or a fill \
         {:.1}, a store the old way {:.1}, another reader of ours {:.1}; the guard was clean after {:.1} stores and the \
         title wrote {:.1} of those",
        n(t.ended),
        n(t.who[REFRESH as usize]),
        n(t.who[REFRESH_OTHER as usize]),
        n(t.who[MERGE as usize]),
        n(t.who[UNDER as usize]),
        n(t.who[TITLE_COPY as usize]),
        n(t.who[STORE as usize]),
        n(t.who[OTHER as usize]),
        n(t.clean),
        n(t.written),
    );
    let looks = format!(
        "looked at {:.1} of {:.1} taken out of the working set (one page in {SAMPLE}): untouched {:.1} ({:.2} MB), \
         written by the title {:.1}, touched with readers of ours and no write {:.1}, touched by something else (the \
         title's reads at most) {:.1} ({:.2} MB); of their 4 KiB pages {:.1} of {:.1} were touched; ended with no store \
         of the page again in {KEEP} frames {:.1}, by a remapping {:.1}, with no look because a mapping was changing {:.1}",
        n(t.looked),
        n(t.trimmed),
        n(t.untouched),
        mb(t.untouched_bytes),
        n(t.wrote),
        n(t.ours),
        n(t.other),
        mb(t.other_bytes),
        n(t.small[0]),
        n(t.small[1]),
        n(t.late),
        n(t.remapped),
        n(t.busy),
    );
    format!("{stores}; {readers}; {looks}")
}

/// The ten copies with the most bytes stored, and everything, since the
/// start.
fn table(s: &State) {
    let mut rows: Vec<(&(u64, u64), &Tally)> = s.buffers.iter().collect();
    rows.sort_by_key(|(_, t)| std::cmp::Reverse(t.bytes));
    tracing::info!(
        "what came back from the card and who touched it, since the start (VICTORY_BACK_READS), totals not per frame: {} \
         buffers; all of them: {}",
        rows.len(),
        words(&s.all, 1.0)
    );
    for ((start, len), t) in rows.into_iter().take(10) {
        tracing::info!("  came back to {start:#x}+{len:#x}: {}", words(t, 1.0));
    }
}

unsafe extern "C" {
    fn atexit(f: extern "C" fn()) -> i32;
}

/// At process exit (not reached when the process is ended from outside:
/// the table is also logged with every eighth line).
extern "C" fn at_exit() {
    if let Ok(guard) = STATE.try_lock()
        && let Some(s) = guard.as_ref()
    {
        table(s);
    }
}

/// With the frame-rate line, over `frames` more frames: stores not
/// followed by another within [`KEEP`] frames end here, and every
/// [`EVERY`] frames the sums are said.
pub(crate) fn line(frames: f64) {
    if !on() {
        return;
    }
    static AT_EXIT: std::sync::Once = std::sync::Once::new();
    // SAFETY: registers a function with the host CRT's exit table.
    AT_EXIT.call_once(|| unsafe {
        atexit(at_exit);
    });
    let frame = crate::frame::current();
    let old: Vec<Seen> = {
        let mut guard = state();
        let s = guard.get_or_insert_with(State::default);
        let keys: Vec<usize> = s.seen.iter().filter(|(_, seen)| seen.frame + KEEP < frame).map(|(key, _)| *key).collect();
        let old: Vec<Seen> = keys.into_iter().filter_map(|key| s.seen.remove(&key)).collect();
        old
    };
    // Looked at with no lock of ours held.
    let judged: Vec<Option<Judged>> = old.iter().map(|seen| seen.open.then(|| judge(seen))).collect();
    let mut guard = state();
    let s = guard.get_or_insert_with(State::default);
    for (seen, judged) in old.iter().zip(&judged) {
        if let Some(judged) = judged {
            tally(s, seen, judged, 1);
        }
    }
    // The names of what is gone, and the hooks' filter anew (a hook that
    // looks while it is rebuilt may miss one read).
    let seen = &s.seen;
    s.names.retain(|_, key| seen.contains_key(key));
    for word in &TRACKED {
        word.store(0, Relaxed);
    }
    for page in s.names.keys() {
        mark(*page);
    }
    s.frames += frames;
    if s.frames < EVERY {
        return;
    }
    let (since, over) = (std::mem::take(&mut s.since), std::mem::replace(&mut s.frames, 0.0));
    tracing::info!(
        "what came back from the card and who touched it, per frame over {over:.0} frames (VICTORY_BACK_READS={}): {}",
        std::env::var("VICTORY_BACK_READS").unwrap_or_default(),
        words(&since, over)
    );
    s.lines += 1;
    if s.lines.is_multiple_of(8) {
        table(s);
    }
}
```

`crates/victory-gpu/src/capture.rs`:

```rs
//! Presented frames written to PNG files, to see what reaches the screen:
//! with `VICTORY_CAPTURE=<folder>`, every frame whose number is a power of
//! two (the frames the log reports) is saved as `frame-<n>.png`, at half
//! size. Only in builds with diagnostics.

use std::path::PathBuf;

use windows::Win32::Graphics::Direct3D12::*;
use windows::Win32::Graphics::Dxgi::Common::*;

/// The folder frames go to, if capturing.
pub(crate) fn folder() -> Option<&'static PathBuf> {
    static FOLDER: std::sync::OnceLock<Option<PathBuf>> = std::sync::OnceLock::new();
    FOLDER
        .get_or_init(|| std::env::var_os("VICTORY_CAPTURE").map(PathBuf::from))
        .as_ref()
}

/// Frames listed in `VICTORY_CAPTURE_FRAMES` (comma-separated): saved
/// too, and their draws traced at debug level.
pub(crate) fn listed(n: u64) -> bool {
    static LIST: std::sync::OnceLock<Vec<u64>> = std::sync::OnceLock::new();
    let named = LIST
        .get_or_init(|| {
            let list = std::env::var("VICTORY_CAPTURE_FRAMES").unwrap_or_default();
            list.split(',')
                .filter_map(|f| f.trim().parse().ok())
                .collect()
        })
        .contains(&n);
    // `VICTORY_CAPTURE_WORLD`: also the 2nd and the 6th frame after the first
    // one that ran 500 draws or more (a title's first 3D frames: their
    // numbers depend on how long the menus were shown), and the 30th and
    // the 80th (the title opens with a cutscene made in the
    // engine: later shots of it, in case the first is dark by design).
    //
    // `VICTORY_CAPTURE_WORLD_ALSO` (comma-separated): more frames counted
    // from that first one (the title's blue patches show from
    // about the 118th frame on, when the window's model has arrived and
    // the reflections hold values: none of the four above has them).
    static ALSO: std::sync::OnceLock<Vec<u64>> = std::sync::OnceLock::new();
    let also = ALSO.get_or_init(|| {
        let list = std::env::var("VICTORY_CAPTURE_WORLD_ALSO").unwrap_or_default();
        list.split(',')
            .filter_map(|f| f.trim().parse().ok())
            .collect()
    });
    let first = WORLD.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
    let after = n.wrapping_sub(first);
    named || first != u64::MAX && ([2, 6, 30, 80].contains(&after) || also.contains(&after))
}

/// With a capture folder, for the frames [`listed`]: `what` is added to
/// the frame's `frame-<n>-ops.txt`, one line per draw, dispatch, copy or
/// drop in the order recorded (the title records on several threads, so
/// lines of different lists interleave; each names its list). The file
/// says which pass writes which target, to find the pass whose output
/// stays empty.
#[cfg(feature = "diagnostics")]
pub(crate) fn op(list: usize, what: impl FnOnce() -> String) {
    // A frame shot (`crate::shot`) keeps every line of its frame.
    if crate::shot::keeping_lines() {
        let text = what();
        crate::shot::line(list, &text);
        return op_listed(list, move || text);
    }
    op_listed(list, what);
}

/// [`op`] for the frames [`listed`] and the lines before the world.
#[cfg(feature = "diagnostics")]
fn op_listed(list: usize, what: impl FnOnce() -> String) {
    use std::io::Write;
    let frame = crate::queue::presented() + 1;
    if !listed(frame) {
        // Before the world: the last lines are kept, and written out when
        // it starts (`before-world-ops.txt`): what the title drew just
        // before (the title shows a title card there, whose text
        // did not show).
        if world_on() && WORLD.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed) == u64::MAX {
            // At most 300 lines of a frame: the world's first frame alone
            // (thousands of operations, recorded before it is known to be
            // the world's) pushed everything before it out.
            static IN_FRAME: std::sync::Mutex<(u64, u32)> = std::sync::Mutex::new((0, 0));
            {
                let mut in_frame = IN_FRAME.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
                if in_frame.0 != frame {
                    *in_frame = (frame, 0);
                }
                in_frame.1 += 1;
                if in_frame.1 > 300 {
                    return;
                }
            }
            let what = what();
            let mut ring = RING.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
            if ring.len() >= RING_LINES {
                ring.pop_front();
            }
            ring.push_back(format!("frame {frame} list {list:#x} {what}"));
        }
        return;
    }
    let Some(folder) = folder() else {
        return;
    };
    static FILE: std::sync::Mutex<Option<(u64, u64, std::fs::File)>> = std::sync::Mutex::new(None);
    let what = what();
    let mut file = FILE.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    if file.as_ref().is_none_or(|f| f.0 != frame) {
        let Ok(made) = std::fs::File::create(folder.join(format!("frame-{frame}-ops.txt"))) else {
            return;
        };
        *file = Some((frame, 0, made));
    }
    if let Some((_, n, f)) = file.as_mut() {
        *n += 1;
        let _ = writeln!(f, "{n} list {list:#x} {what}");
    }
}

/// The last lines of [`op`] before the world.
#[cfg(feature = "diagnostics")]
static RING: std::sync::Mutex<std::collections::VecDeque<String>> =
    std::sync::Mutex::new(std::collections::VecDeque::new());
#[cfg(feature = "diagnostics")]
const RING_LINES: usize = 6000;

/// Whether `VICTORY_CAPTURE_WORLD` is set.
fn world_on() -> bool {
    static ON: std::sync::OnceLock<bool> = std::sync::OnceLock::new();
    *ON.get_or_init(|| std::env::var_os("VICTORY_CAPTURE_WORLD").is_some())
}

/// Every how many world frames a picture is saved with
/// `VICTORY_CAPTURE_WORLD` (`VICTORY_CAPTURE_WORLD_EVERY`, 8 unless said).
///
/// A saved frame is read back at once and written as a PNG inside the
/// present: run 225's frame log has every saved frame of the cell at 371 ms
/// against a usual 136 (the present's own copy and show 137 ms instead of
/// 2, and 123 ms more waiting for the card). At every 8th frame that was
/// the regular dip of every test run, and a fifth of its time. A run that
/// measures speed asks for 64 or more.
fn world_every() -> u64 {
    static EVERY: std::sync::OnceLock<u64> = std::sync::OnceLock::new();
    *EVERY.get_or_init(|| {
        std::env::var("VICTORY_CAPTURE_WORLD_EVERY").ok().and_then(|v| v.trim().parse().ok()).filter(|&n| n > 0).unwrap_or(8)
    })
}

/// The first frame that ran 500 draws or more (`VICTORY_CAPTURE_WORLD`).
static WORLD: std::sync::atomic::AtomicU64 = std::sync::atomic::AtomicU64::new(u64::MAX);

/// At the present of `frame`: the draws run on the host so far.
pub(crate) fn frame_drew(frame: u64, drawn: u64) {
    use std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed;
    static LAST: std::sync::atomic::AtomicU64 = std::sync::atomic::AtomicU64::new(0);
    let before = LAST.swap(drawn, Relaxed);
    if world_on()
        && drawn.saturating_sub(before) >= 500
        && WORLD.compare_exchange(u64::MAX, frame, Relaxed, Relaxed).is_ok()
    {
        tracing::info!(frame, "the first frame of 500 draws or more: frames {} and {} are captured", frame + 2, frame + 6);
        #[cfg(feature = "diagnostics")]
        if let Some(folder) = folder() {
            let lines: Vec<String> = std::mem::take(&mut *RING.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())).into();
            let _ = std::fs::write(folder.join("before-world-ops.txt"), lines.join("
"));
        }
    }
}

/// Whether frame `n` is saved.
pub(crate) fn wanted(n: u64) -> bool {
    // Before the world, with `VICTORY_CAPTURE_WORLD`: every 16th frame too
    // (small pictures of menus, loading screens and title cards).
    let before_world = world_on() && n.is_multiple_of(16) && WORLD.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed) == u64::MAX;
    // In the world: every 8th frame's picture, a timeline of the opening
    // cutscene (its shots do not fall on the same frame numbers from run to
    // run, so single frames cannot be compared between runs).
    let first = WORLD.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
    let in_world = world_on() && first != u64::MAX && n > first && (n - first).is_multiple_of(world_every());
    folder().is_some() && (n.is_power_of_two() || listed(n) || before_world || in_world)
}

/// Saves 8-bit RGBA or BGRA rows (`pitch` bytes apart) as frame `n`.
pub(crate) fn save(n: u64, width: u32, height: u32, pitch: usize, bgra: bool, rows: &[u8]) {
    save_as(&format!("frame-{n}"), width, height, pitch, bgra, rows);
}

/// Saves 8-bit RGBA or BGRA rows as `<name>.png`, at half size.
fn save_as(name: &str, width: u32, height: u32, pitch: usize, bgra: bool, rows: &[u8]) {
    let Some(folder) = folder() else { return };
    let (w, h) = ((width / 2).max(1), (height / 2).max(1));
    // Filter byte 0 per row, then RGB of every other pixel of every other row.
    let mut raw = Vec::with_capacity((w as usize * 3 + 1) * h as usize);
    for y in 0..h as usize {
        raw.push(0);
        let row = &rows[(2 * y).min(height as usize - 1) * pitch..];
        for x in 0..w as usize {
            let p = &row[(2 * x).min(width as usize - 1) * 4..][..3];
            if bgra {
                raw.extend([p[2], p[1], p[0]]);
            } else {
                raw.extend_from_slice(p);
            }
        }
    }
    let mut png = b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n".to_vec();
    let mut header = Vec::new();
    header.extend(w.to_be_bytes());
    header.extend(h.to_be_bytes());
    header.extend([8, 2, 0, 0, 0]); // 8-bit RGB
    chunk(&mut png, b"IHDR", &header);
    let mut compressed = vec![0u8; zlib_rs::compress_bound(raw.len())];
    let (idat, rc) = zlib_rs::compress_slice(&mut compressed, &raw, zlib_rs::DeflateConfig::new(3));
    debug_assert_eq!(rc, zlib_rs::ReturnCode::Ok);
    chunk(&mut png, b"IDAT", idat);
    chunk(&mut png, b"IEND", &[]);
    let path = folder.join(format!("{name}.png"));
    match std::fs::write(&path, png) {
        Ok(()) => tracing::info!(path = %path.display(), "frame saved"),
        Err(e) => tracing::warn!(error = %e, path = %path.display(), "frame not saved"),
    }
}

/// A PNG of `w` by `h` 8-bit RGB pixels; `raw` is its rows, each after a
/// filter byte 0 (for `crate::shot`, whose pictures have names and sizes
/// of their own).
pub(crate) fn png_rgb(w: u32, h: u32, raw: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut png = b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n".to_vec();
    let mut header = Vec::new();
    header.extend(w.to_be_bytes());
    header.extend(h.to_be_bytes());
    header.extend([8, 2, 0, 0, 0]); // 8-bit RGB
    chunk(&mut png, b"IHDR", &header);
    let mut compressed = vec![0u8; zlib_rs::compress_bound(raw.len())];
    let (idat, rc) = zlib_rs::compress_slice(&mut compressed, raw, zlib_rs::DeflateConfig::new(3));
    debug_assert_eq!(rc, zlib_rs::ReturnCode::Ok);
    chunk(&mut png, b"IDAT", idat);
    chunk(&mut png, b"IEND", &[]);
    png
}

fn chunk(png: &mut Vec<u8>, kind: &[u8; 4], data: &[u8]) {
    png.extend((data.len() as u32).to_be_bytes());
    let start = png.len();
    png.extend(kind);
    png.extend(data);
    let crc = crc32(&png[start..]);
    png.extend(crc.to_be_bytes());
}

fn crc32(bytes: &[u8]) -> u32 {
    let mut crc = !0u32;
    for &b in bytes {
        crc ^= u32::from(b);
        for _ in 0..8 {
            crc = (crc >> 1) ^ (0xedb8_8320 & (crc & 1).wrapping_neg());
        }
    }
    !crc
}

/// Records a copy of `texture` (in the copy-source state) into a
/// readback buffer.
pub(crate) fn read_back(
    device: &ID3D12Device,
    list: &ID3D12GraphicsCommandList,
    texture: &ID3D12Resource,
) -> Option<(ID3D12Resource, D3D12_PLACED_SUBRESOURCE_FOOTPRINT)> {
    read_back_of(device, list, texture, 0)
}

/// As [`read_back`], of subresource `sub` (the stencil plane of a
/// one-level, one-slice depth-stencil texture is subresource 1).
pub(crate) fn read_back_of(
    device: &ID3D12Device,
    list: &ID3D12GraphicsCommandList,
    texture: &ID3D12Resource,
    sub: u32,
) -> Option<(ID3D12Resource, D3D12_PLACED_SUBRESOURCE_FOOTPRINT)> {
    let mut footprint = D3D12_PLACED_SUBRESOURCE_FOOTPRINT::default();
    let mut total = 0;
    // SAFETY: a live texture; outputs for one subresource.
    unsafe {
        let desc = texture.GetDesc();
        device.GetCopyableFootprints(
            &desc,
            sub,
            1,
            0,
            Some(&mut footprint),
            None,
            None,
            Some(&mut total),
        );
    }
    let heap = D3D12_HEAP_PROPERTIES {
        Type: D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_READBACK,
        ..Default::default()
    };
    let desc = D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC {
        Dimension: D3D12_RESOURCE_DIMENSION_BUFFER,
        Width: total,
        Height: 1,
        DepthOrArraySize: 1,
        MipLevels: 1,
        SampleDesc: DXGI_SAMPLE_DESC {
            Count: 1,
            Quality: 0,
        },
        Layout: D3D12_TEXTURE_LAYOUT_ROW_MAJOR,
        ..Default::default()
    };
    let mut buffer: Option<ID3D12Resource> = None;
    // SAFETY: plain creation; an open list; locations naming live resources.
    unsafe {
        device
            .CreateCommittedResource(
                &heap,
                D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE,
                &desc,
                D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST,
                None,
                &mut buffer,
            )
            .ok()?;
        let buffer = buffer?;
        let to = D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION {
            pResource: std::mem::transmute_copy(&buffer),
            Type: D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_TYPE_PLACED_FOOTPRINT,
            Anonymous: D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION_0 {
                PlacedFootprint: footprint,
            },
        };
        let from = D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION {
            pResource: std::mem::transmute_copy(texture),
            Type: D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_TYPE_SUBRESOURCE_INDEX,
            Anonymous: D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION_0 {
                SubresourceIndex: sub,
            },
        };
        list.CopyTextureRegion(&to, 0, 0, 0, &from, None);
        Some((buffer, footprint))
    }
}

/// Saves a frame read back by [`read_back`] (8-bit color only).
pub(crate) fn save_read_back(
    frame: u64,
    buffer: &ID3D12Resource,
    footprint: &D3D12_PLACED_SUBRESOURCE_FOOTPRINT,
) {
    let f = footprint.Footprint;
    let bgra = match f.Format {
        DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM | DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM_SRGB => false,
        DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM | DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM_SRGB => true,
        other => {
            tracing::warn!(format = other.0, "frame not saved: not 8-bit color");
            return;
        }
    };
    let mut data = std::ptr::null_mut();
    // SAFETY: the copy finished (every submission is waited for); the
    // mapping spans the footprint's rows.
    unsafe {
        if buffer.Map(0, None, Some(&mut data)).is_err() {
            return;
        }
        let len = f.RowPitch as usize * f.Height as usize;
        let rows = std::slice::from_raw_parts(data.cast::<u8>(), len);
        save(frame, f.Width, f.Height, f.RowPitch as usize, bgra, rows);
        buffer.Unmap(0, None);
    }
}

/// With `VICTORY_DUMP_TARGETS` set: title textures the frames listed in
/// `VICTORY_CAPTURE_FRAMES` render to or write, in first-use order, saved
/// at that frame's present as `frame-<n>-<i>-<resource>-<w>x<h>-f<format>.png`
/// (what each holds at the end of the frame; formats normalized to show
/// structure: floats scaled by their largest value, depth by its range).
/// The host copies are held: the title may release a target before the
/// frame is presented.
static TARGETS: std::sync::Mutex<Vec<(usize, std::sync::Arc<crate::resource::HostTexture>)>> =
    std::sync::Mutex::new(Vec::new());

fn dump_on() -> bool {
    static ON: std::sync::OnceLock<bool> = std::sync::OnceLock::new();
    *ON.get_or_init(|| folder().is_some() && std::env::var_os("VICTORY_DUMP_TARGETS").is_some())
}

/// Notes a title texture the frame being built renders to or writes.
pub(crate) fn note_target(resource: crate::object::This) {
    if resource.is_null() || !dump_on() || !listed(crate::queue::presented() + 1) {
        return;
    }
    let mut targets = TARGETS.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    if !targets.iter().any(|&(r, _)| r == resource as usize)
        && let Some(copy) = crate::resource::host_copy(resource)
    {
        targets.push((resource as usize, copy));
    }
}

/// At the present of frame `frame`: saves the noted targets.
pub(crate) fn dump_targets(frame: u64) {
    use std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed;
    let targets = std::mem::take(&mut *TARGETS.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()));
    let Some(host) = crate::host::host() else { return };
    for (i, (resource, copy)) in targets.iter().enumerate() {
        let texture = &copy.texture;
        // SAFETY: a live resource.
        let d = unsafe { texture.GetDesc() };
        if d.SampleDesc.Count > 1 || d.Dimension != D3D12_RESOURCE_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D {
            continue;
        }
        // Every submission has run; the dump's list moves it there and back.
        let state = copy.state.load(Relaxed);
        dump_one(host, texture, state, frame, i, *resource as crate::object::This, &d);
    }
}

fn dump_one(
    host: &crate::host::Host,
    texture: &ID3D12Resource,
    state: u32,
    frame: u64,
    i: usize,
    resource: crate::object::This,
    d: &D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC,
) {
    let Ok(list) = host.new_list() else { return };
    let state = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES(crate::host::legal_state(texture, state) as i32);
    let copy = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE;
    // SAFETY: an open list of ours and a live texture.
    let read = unsafe {
        if state != copy {
            list.list
                .ResourceBarrier(&[crate::host::transition(texture, state, copy)]);
        }
        let read = read_back(&host.device, &list.list, texture);
        // The stencil plane of a depth-stencil target, which the title's
        // lighting reads (material class in the low bits; 0x08 "inside a
        // room", which the lamps of a room are multiplied by): the plane
        // after the depth plane of a one-level, one-slice texture.
        let stencil = (matches!(d.Format.0, 19..=22 | 44..=47)
            && d.MipLevels == 1
            && d.DepthOrArraySize == 1)
            .then(|| read_back_of(&host.device, &list.list, texture, 1))
            .flatten();
        if state != copy {
            list.list
                .ResourceBarrier(&[crate::host::transition(texture, copy, state)]);
        }
        (read, stencil)
    };
    let (read, stencil) = read;
    list.close();
    host.execute(&[&list]);
    if let Some((buffer, footprint)) = stencil {
        stencil_values(&buffer, &footprint, frame, resource);
    }
    let Some((buffer, footprint)) = read else { return };
    let f = footprint.Footprint;
    let mut data = std::ptr::null_mut();
    // SAFETY: the copy finished; the mapping spans the footprint's rows.
    unsafe {
        if buffer.Map(0, None, Some(&mut data)).is_err() {
            return;
        }
        let pitch = f.RowPitch as usize;
        let rows = std::slice::from_raw_parts(data.cast::<u8>(), pitch * f.Height as usize);
        // A 24-bit depth plane comes back as 32-bit words: which depth values
        // (low 24 bits) and which top bytes it holds, the most common first.
        if matches!(d.Format.0, 44..=47) {
            let mut depths = std::collections::HashMap::<u32, u32>::new();
            let mut tops = std::collections::HashMap::<u32, u32>::new();
            for y in 0..f.Height as usize {
                for x in 0..f.Width as usize {
                    let at = y * pitch + x * 4;
                    let w = u32::from_le_bytes(rows[at..at + 4].try_into().unwrap_or([0; 4]));
                    *depths.entry(w & 0xff_ffff).or_default() += 1;
                    *tops.entry(w >> 24).or_default() += 1;
                }
            }
            let most = |m: std::collections::HashMap<u32, u32>| {
                let mut v: Vec<(u32, u32)> = m.into_iter().collect();
                v.sort_by_key(|e| std::cmp::Reverse(e.1));
                (v.len(), v.into_iter().take(12).collect::<Vec<_>>())
            };
            tracing::info!(?resource, depths = ?most(depths), top_bytes = ?most(tops), "24-bit depth plane values (value, texels)");
        }
        if let Some(rgba) = to_rgba(f.Format.0 as u32, f.Width as usize, f.Height as usize, pitch, rows) {
            let name = format!(
                "frame-{frame}-{i:02}-{resource:?}-{}x{}-f{}",
                d.Width, d.Height, d.Format.0
            );
            save_as(&name, f.Width, f.Height, f.Width as usize * 4, false, &rgba);
        } else {
            tracing::info!(format = f.Format.0, ?resource, "target not dumped: format");
        }
        buffer.Unmap(0, None);
    }
}

/// Logs which values a stencil plane read back by [`read_back_of`] holds
/// (the most common first), how many texels have each of its bits, and the
/// box of the texels with bit 3 (0x08).
fn stencil_values(
    buffer: &ID3D12Resource,
    footprint: &D3D12_PLACED_SUBRESOURCE_FOOTPRINT,
    frame: u64,
    resource: crate::object::This,
) {
    let f = footprint.Footprint;
    let (w, h, pitch) = (f.Width as usize, f.Height as usize, f.RowPitch as usize);
    let mut data = std::ptr::null_mut();
    // SAFETY: the copy finished; the mapping spans the footprint's rows of
    // one byte a texel, the last row without its padding.
    unsafe {
        if h == 0 || w == 0 || buffer.Map(0, None, Some(&mut data)).is_err() {
            return;
        }
        let rows = std::slice::from_raw_parts(data.cast::<u8>(), pitch * (h - 1) + w);
        let mut values = [0u32; 256];
        let mut bits = [0u32; 8];
        // Left, top, right, bottom of the texels with bit 3.
        let mut inside = [u32::MAX, u32::MAX, 0, 0];
        for y in 0..h {
            for (x, &v) in rows[y * pitch..y * pitch + w].iter().enumerate() {
                values[usize::from(v)] += 1;
                for (bit, count) in bits.iter_mut().enumerate() {
                    *count += u32::from(v >> bit & 1);
                }
                if v & 8 != 0 {
                    inside = [
                        inside[0].min(x as u32),
                        inside[1].min(y as u32),
                        inside[2].max(x as u32),
                        inside[3].max(y as u32),
                    ];
                }
            }
        }
        let mut most: Vec<(usize, u32)> = values
            .iter()
            .copied()
            .enumerate()
            .filter(|v| v.1 != 0)
            .collect();
        most.sort_by_key(|v| std::cmp::Reverse(v.1));
        most.truncate(16);
        tracing::info!(
            frame,
            ?resource,
            width = w,
            height = h,
            values = ?most,
            texels_with_bit = ?bits,
            bit3_box = ?inside,
            "stencil plane values (value, texels)"
        );
        buffer.Unmap(0, None);
    }
}

fn half(h: u16) -> f32 {
    let (sign, exp, man) = ((h >> 15) as u32, ((h >> 10) & 0x1f) as i32, (h & 0x3ff) as f32);
    let v = match exp {
        0 => man * 2f32.powi(-24),
        31 => f32::INFINITY,
        e => (1.0 + man / 1024.0) * 2f32.powi(e - 15),
    };
    if sign == 1 { -v } else { v }
}

/// A float packed in `bits` with a 5-bit exponent and `man` mantissa bits
/// (the 11- and 10-bit floats of R11G11B10).
fn small_float(bits: u32, man: u32) -> f32 {
    let (exp, m) = ((bits >> man) & 0x1f, (bits & ((1 << man) - 1)) as f32);
    match exp {
        0 => m / (1 << man) as f32 * 2f32.powi(-14),
        31 => f32::INFINITY,
        e => (1.0 + m / (1 << man) as f32) * 2f32.powi(e as i32 - 15),
    }
}

/// Rows of a host format as 8-bit RGBA: 8-bit color as is, everything else
/// as channel values scaled so the largest finite one is white (single
/// channels: lowest black, highest white, as grey). `None` for formats not
/// handled.
pub(crate) fn to_rgba(format: u32, w: usize, h: usize, pitch: usize, rows: &[u8]) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(w * h * 4);
    let px = |x: usize, y: usize, n: usize| &rows[y * pitch + x * n..][..n];
    let u16_at = |b: &[u8], i: usize| u16::from_le_bytes([b[2 * i], b[2 * i + 1]]);
    let u32_at = |b: &[u8], i: usize| u32::from_le_bytes(b[4 * i..4 * i + 4].try_into().unwrap_or([0; 4]));
    // Channel values as floats, then scaled.
    type Decode = Box<dyn Fn(&[u8]) -> [f32; 3]>;
    let (n, decode): (usize, Decode) = match format {
        27..=32 => {
            for y in 0..h {
                for x in 0..w {
                    let p = px(x, y, 4);
                    out.extend([p[0], p[1], p[2], 255]);
                }
            }
            return Some(out);
        }
        // B8G8R8A8 and B8G8R8X8 (89 is R10G10B10_XR_BIAS_A2, below).
        87 | 88 | 90..=93 => {
            for y in 0..h {
                for x in 0..w {
                    let p = px(x, y, 4);
                    out.extend([p[2], p[1], p[0], 255]);
                }
            }
            return Some(out);
        }
        23..=25 | 89 => (4, Box::new(move |b| {
            let v = u32_at(b, 0);
            [(v & 0x3ff) as f32, (v >> 10 & 0x3ff) as f32, (v >> 20 & 0x3ff) as f32]
        })),
        26 => (4, Box::new(move |b| {
            let v = u32_at(b, 0);
            [small_float(v & 0x7ff, 6), small_float(v >> 11 & 0x7ff, 6), small_float(v >> 22, 5)]
        })),
        9..=10 => (8, Box::new(move |b| [half(u16_at(b, 0)), half(u16_at(b, 1)), half(u16_at(b, 2))])),
        11..=14 => (8, Box::new(move |b| [0, 1, 2].map(|i| f32::from(u16_at(b, i))))),
        33..=34 => (4, Box::new(move |b| [half(u16_at(b, 0)), half(u16_at(b, 1)), 0.0])),
        1..=2 => (16, Box::new(move |b| {
            [0, 1, 2].map(|i| f32::from_bits(u32_at(b, i)))
        })),
        15..=16 => (8, Box::new(move |b| [f32::from_bits(u32_at(b, 0)), f32::from_bits(u32_at(b, 1)), 0.0])),
        35..=38 => (4, Box::new(move |b| [f32::from(u16_at(b, 0)), f32::from(u16_at(b, 1)), 0.0])),
        48..=52 => (2, Box::new(move |b| [f32::from(b[0]), f32::from(b[1]), 0.0])),
        // Single channels (and depth planes): shown as grey.
        39..=43 => (4, Box::new(move |b| [f32::from_bits(u32_at(b, 0)); 3])),
        19..=22 => (8, Box::new(move |b| [f32::from_bits(u32_at(b, 0)); 3])),
        44..=47 => (4, Box::new(move |b| [(u32_at(b, 0) & 0xff_ffff) as f32; 3])),
        53..=54 => (2, Box::new(move |b| [half(u16_at(b, 0)); 3])),
        55..=59 => (2, Box::new(move |b| [f32::from(u16_at(b, 0)); 3])),
        60..=65 => (1, Box::new(move |b| [f32::from(b[0]); 3])),
        _ => return None,
    };
    let values: Vec<[f32; 3]> = (0..h)
        .flat_map(|y| (0..w).map(move |x| (x, y)))
        .map(|(x, y)| decode(px(x, y, n)))
        .collect();
    let grey = matches!(format, 19..=22 | 39..=47 | 53..=65);
    let finite = values.iter().flatten().copied().filter(|v| v.is_finite());
    let (low, high) = if grey {
        finite.fold((f32::MAX, f32::MIN), |(l, h), v| (l.min(v), h.max(v)))
    } else {
        (0.0, finite.fold(0.0f32, f32::max))
    };
    let range = (high - low).max(1e-20);
    // How much of the target holds anything: a lit scene and one bright
    // lamp on black have the same highest value.
    let above = values.iter().filter(|v| v.iter().any(|c| c.is_finite() && *c > low)).count();
    let nonzero_percent = above as f32 * 100.0 / values.len().max(1) as f32;
    tracing::info!(format, low, high, nonzero_percent, "target values");
    // Small float colour targets (the 1x1 luminance and exposure targets):
    // every texel's four channels as numbers. The picture has no alpha and
    // eight bits a channel.
    if matches!(format, 1..=2 | 9..=10) && w * h <= 16 {
        for y in 0..h {
            for x in 0..w {
                let b = px(x, y, n);
                let texel: [f32; 4] = if n == 16 {
                    [0, 1, 2, 3].map(|i| f32::from_bits(u32_at(b, i)))
                } else {
                    [0, 1, 2, 3].map(|i| half(u16_at(b, i)))
                };
                tracing::info!(format, x, y, ?texel, "target texel");
            }
        }
    }
    // R32_UINT targets hold packed light (the title reads them back as
    // R9G9B9E5): as floats their low, high and share above the lowest say
    // nothing. How many texels hold any bit, and the highest channel value
    // of the packed reading.
    if format == 42 {
        let (mut set, mut packed_high) = (0usize, 0f32);
        for y in 0..h {
            for x in 0..w {
                let v = u32_at(px(x, y, 4), 0);
                set += usize::from(v != 0);
                let scale = 2f32.powi((v >> 27) as i32 - 24);
                for k in 0..3 {
                    packed_high = packed_high.max((v >> (9 * k) & 0x1ff) as f32 * scale);
                }
            }
        }
        let nonzero_bits_percent = set as f32 * 100.0 / (w * h).max(1) as f32;
        tracing::info!(format, nonzero_bits_percent, packed_high, "target values as packed light");
        // The same words as plain numbers, by class. Tables of indices and
        // masks say nothing as floats or as packed light: in the title's
        // shadow-mask table 0 is a block in full shadow, a word up to 255
        // one value for the block, above that a block of the atlas, and all
        // ones a texel never written.
        let mut classes = [0usize; 6];
        let mut highest_below_ones = 0u32;
        for y in 0..h {
            for x in 0..w {
                let v = u32_at(px(x, y, 4), 0);
                classes[match v {
                    0 => 0,
                    1..=15 => 1,
                    16..=255 => 2,
                    256..=0x00ff_ffff => 3,
                    u32::MAX => 5,
                    _ => 4,
                }] += 1;
                if v != u32::MAX {
                    highest_below_ones = highest_below_ones.max(v);
                }
            }
        }
        tracing::info!(
            format,
            width = w,
            height = h,
            zero = classes[0],
            one_to_15 = classes[1],
            to_255 = classes[2],
            to_24_bits = classes[3],
            larger = classes[4],
            all_ones = classes[5],
            highest_below_ones,
            "target values as words"
        );
    }
    // Float colours (scene light) go through a cube root: scaled linearly,
    // a night scene under one lamp of 50 units came out all black.
    let curved = matches!(format, 1..=2 | 9..=10 | 26);
    for v in values {
        let c = v.map(|c| {
            let t = ((c - low) / range).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
            ((if curved { t.cbrt() } else { t }) * 255.0) as u8
        });
        out.extend([c[0], c[1], c[2], 255]);
    }
    Some(out)
}

/// Pixels per side of the grid [`probe`] reads.
const GRID: u32 = 4;
/// Bytes between the grid's pixels in the readback buffer (placement
/// alignment).
const SLOT: u64 = 512;

/// Records copies of a grid of pixels of `texture` (8-bit color, in the
/// copy-source state) into a readback buffer, to tell black frames.
pub(crate) fn probe(
    device: &ID3D12Device,
    list: &ID3D12GraphicsCommandList,
    texture: &ID3D12Resource,
) -> Option<ID3D12Resource> {
    // SAFETY: a live resource.
    let d = unsafe { texture.GetDesc() };
    if !matches!(d.Format.0, 27..=29 | 87 | 90 | 91) {
        return None;
    }
    let desc = D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC {
        Dimension: D3D12_RESOURCE_DIMENSION_BUFFER,
        Width: SLOT * u64::from(GRID * GRID),
        Height: 1,
        DepthOrArraySize: 1,
        MipLevels: 1,
        SampleDesc: DXGI_SAMPLE_DESC {
            Count: 1,
            Quality: 0,
        },
        Layout: D3D12_TEXTURE_LAYOUT_ROW_MAJOR,
        ..Default::default()
    };
    let heap = D3D12_HEAP_PROPERTIES {
        Type: D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_READBACK,
        ..Default::default()
    };
    let mut buffer: Option<ID3D12Resource> = None;
    // SAFETY: plain creation; an open list; locations naming live resources.
    unsafe {
        device
            .CreateCommittedResource(
                &heap,
                D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE,
                &desc,
                D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST,
                None,
                &mut buffer,
            )
            .ok()?;
        let buffer = buffer?;
        for i in 0..GRID * GRID {
            let (x, y) = (
                (2 * (i % GRID) + 1) * d.Width as u32 / (2 * GRID),
                (2 * (i / GRID) + 1) * d.Height / (2 * GRID),
            );
            let to = D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION {
                pResource: std::mem::transmute_copy(&buffer),
                Type: D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_TYPE_PLACED_FOOTPRINT,
                Anonymous: D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION_0 {
                    PlacedFootprint: D3D12_PLACED_SUBRESOURCE_FOOTPRINT {
                        Offset: SLOT * u64::from(i),
                        Footprint: D3D12_SUBRESOURCE_FOOTPRINT {
                            Format: d.Format,
                            Width: 1,
                            Height: 1,
                            Depth: 1,
                            RowPitch: 256,
                        },
                    },
                },
            };
            let from = D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION {
                pResource: std::mem::transmute_copy(texture),
                Type: D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_TYPE_SUBRESOURCE_INDEX,
                Anonymous: D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION_0 {
                    SubresourceIndex: 0,
                },
            };
            let pixel = D3D12_BOX {
                left: x,
                top: y,
                front: 0,
                right: x + 1,
                bottom: y + 1,
                back: 1,
            };
            list.CopyTextureRegion(&to, 0, 0, 0, &from, Some(&pixel));
        }
        Some(buffer)
    }
}

/// Whether every pixel [`probe`] read is (near) black.
pub(crate) fn black(buffer: &ID3D12Resource) -> bool {
    let mut data = std::ptr::null_mut();
    // SAFETY: the copies finished (every submission is waited for).
    unsafe {
        if buffer.Map(0, None, Some(&mut data)).is_err() {
            return false;
        }
        let bytes =
            std::slice::from_raw_parts(data.cast::<u8>(), (SLOT * u64::from(GRID * GRID)) as usize);
        let level = bytes
            .chunks(SLOT as usize)
            .flat_map(|pixel| pixel[..3].iter().copied())
            .max()
            .unwrap_or(0);
        buffer.Unmap(0, None);
        let mut levels = LEVELS.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
        if levels.len() == 12 {
            levels.pop_front();
        }
        levels.push_back(level);
        level < 8
    }
}

/// The brightest probed channel of the last frames, oldest first: a fade
/// darkens over several, a glitch drops at once.
static LEVELS: std::sync::Mutex<std::collections::VecDeque<u8>> =
    std::sync::Mutex::new(std::collections::VecDeque::new());

pub(crate) fn recent_levels() -> Vec<u8> {
    let levels = LEVELS.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    levels.iter().copied().collect()
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    #[test]
    fn crc_matches_the_png_check_value() {
        assert_eq!(super::crc32(b"IEND"), 0xae42_6082);
    }

    /// R16G16B16A16_UNORM is integers, not half floats; 89 is 10:10:10:2,
    /// not B8G8R8A8.
    #[test]
    fn unorm16_and_xr_bias_targets_decode_as_their_formats() {
        // Red 0x8000 (a half-float -0), green 0x4000, blue 0.
        let unorm16 = [0x00, 0x80, 0x00, 0x40, 0, 0, 0xff, 0xff];
        assert_eq!(super::to_rgba(11, 1, 1, 8, &unorm16), Some(vec![255, 127, 0, 255]));
        // Red 0x3ff, green 0x1ff, blue 0, alpha 3.
        let xr = (0x3ffu32 | 0x1ff << 10 | 3 << 30).to_le_bytes();
        assert_eq!(super::to_rgba(89, 1, 1, 4, &xr), Some(vec![255, 127, 0, 255]));
        // B8G8R8A8 still swaps to RGBA.
        assert_eq!(super::to_rgba(87, 1, 1, 4, &[1, 2, 3, 4]), Some(vec![3, 2, 1, 255]));
    }
}

```

`crates/victory-gpu/src/cardmeter.rs`:

```rs
//! What the card's time goes to, by kind of list, in every run.
//!
//! The card's clock (`crate::host`) says how long the card had work of
//! ours, not which work. The timing run (`VICTORY_GPU_TIMING`) names every
//! title command but sends each list on its own, which changes the frame,
//! and it never timed the lists the layer adds for itself: the one that
//! brings copies in the card's memory up to date and hashes their pieces
//! again, and the one that compares pieces after a submission's lists.
//! Run 187's table left 64 ms a frame of card time unexplained beside
//! them (40 ms by the count outside timing runs); with draw windows off
//! the card is the frame's limit (run 225: 85 to 98 % busy), so that sum
//! decides what is worth changing.
//!
//! Here a list gets one timestamp where it begins and one where it ends,
//! both resolved into one read-back buffer by the list itself. The card
//! writes them when it gets there; a pair is read a second and a half
//! after it was recorded, when every flight of that time has long landed,
//! and its length goes to the frame log's totals by kind. So the frame
//! log's card columns are of the frames of a moment ago: right for the
//! usual frame, not for placing one long frame.
//!
//! On by default in diagnostics builds; `VICTORY_CARD_METER=0` or `1` says
//! otherwise. Two queries and a resolve a list.

use std::sync::Mutex;

use windows::Win32::Graphics::Direct3D12::*;
use windows::Win32::Graphics::Dxgi::Common::DXGI_SAMPLE_DESC;

/// What a timed list is.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(crate) enum Kind {
    /// Ours: changed bytes go up to copies in the card's memory and their
    /// pieces are hashed again (`Host::card_before`).
    Sync,
    /// Ours: the compare of the pieces a submission's shaders may have
    /// written, and the fetch of the flagged ones inside the flight.
    Check,
    /// Every other host list: the title's own, our present copies.
    Lists,
    /// Inside one of those: from where a pipeline is bound to where the
    /// next one is, or the list ends ([`begin_named`]).
    Pipeline,
}

/// Pairs of timestamps in the ring.
const PAIRS: u32 = 32768;
/// A pair is read this long after it was recorded.
const AFTER: std::time::Duration = std::time::Duration::from_millis(1000);

/// A pair being recorded: its place in the ring, or none.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(crate) struct Span(u32);

impl Span {
    pub(crate) const NONE: Span = Span(u32::MAX);
    /// For keeping in an atomic.
    pub(crate) fn raw(self) -> u32 {
        self.0
    }
    pub(crate) fn from_raw(raw: u32) -> Span {
        Span(raw)
    }
}

struct Meter {
    heap: ID3D12QueryHeap,
    back: ID3D12Resource,
    /// The read-back buffer's bytes, mapped for good.
    mapped: usize,
    /// Ticks a second of the queue's clock.
    frequency: u64,
    next: u32,
    /// Pairs recorded and not read yet: place, kind, when recorded.
    pending: std::collections::VecDeque<(u32, Kind, std::time::Instant)>,
    /// What the list of a pair mostly is ([`end_named`]), by place, until
    /// the pair is read.
    names: std::collections::HashMap<u32, String>,
    /// Since the last table: by name, the lists and their microseconds.
    by_name: std::collections::HashMap<String, (u64, u64)>,
    /// The same by pipeline ([`begin_named`]): the times it was bound and
    /// the microseconds until the next one was.
    by_pipeline: std::collections::HashMap<String, (u64, u64)>,
    /// Frames since the last table.
    frames: u64,
    /// What each place held when it was last read: a place the card has
    /// not written since (its list never ran) still holds that, and is
    /// not counted again.
    seen: Vec<(u64, u64)>,
}

// SAFETY: host objects (free-threaded) and a mapping only read, behind a lock.
unsafe impl Send for Meter {}

static METER: Mutex<Option<Option<Meter>>> = Mutex::new(None);

/// Whether lists are timed.
pub(crate) fn on() -> bool {
    static ON: std::sync::OnceLock<bool> = std::sync::OnceLock::new();
    *ON.get_or_init(|| match std::env::var_os("VICTORY_CARD_METER") {
        Some(v) => v != "0",
        None => cfg!(feature = "diagnostics"),
    })
}

fn make() -> Option<Meter> {
    let host = crate::host::host()?;
    let device = host.device();
    let mut heap: Option<ID3D12QueryHeap> = None;
    let mut back: Option<ID3D12Resource> = None;
    let readback = D3D12_HEAP_PROPERTIES { Type: D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_READBACK, ..Default::default() };
    let desc = D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC {
        Dimension: D3D12_RESOURCE_DIMENSION_BUFFER,
        Width: u64::from(PAIRS) * 16,
        Height: 1,
        DepthOrArraySize: 1,
        MipLevels: 1,
        SampleDesc: DXGI_SAMPLE_DESC { Count: 1, Quality: 0 },
        Layout: D3D12_TEXTURE_LAYOUT_ROW_MAJOR,
        ..Default::default()
    };
    // SAFETY: plain object creation; the buffer is mapped once and stays so.
    unsafe {
        device
            .CreateQueryHeap(
                &D3D12_QUERY_HEAP_DESC { Type: D3D12_QUERY_HEAP_TYPE_TIMESTAMP, Count: PAIRS * 2, NodeMask: 0 },
                &mut heap,
            )
            .ok()?;
        device
            .CreateCommittedResource(&readback, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &desc, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST, None, &mut back)
            .ok()?;
        let (heap, back) = (heap?, back?);
        let mut mapped = std::ptr::null_mut();
        back.Map(0, None, Some(&mut mapped)).ok()?;
        let frequency = host.timestamp_frequency();
        if mapped.is_null() || frequency == 0 {
            return None;
        }
        tracing::info!(
            "the card's time is measured by kind of list, a timestamp where each list begins and ends (VICTORY_CARD_METER=0: not)"
        );
        Some(Meter {
            heap,
            back,
            mapped: mapped as usize,
            frequency,
            next: 0,
            pending: Default::default(),
            names: Default::default(),
            by_name: Default::default(),
            by_pipeline: Default::default(),
            frames: 0,
            seen: vec![(0, 0); PAIRS as usize],
        })
    }
}

/// A list of `kind` begins here: the first timestamp of a pair.
pub(crate) fn begin(list: &ID3D12GraphicsCommandList, kind: Kind) -> Span {
    if !on() {
        return Span::NONE;
    }
    let mut meter = METER.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    let Some(m) = meter.get_or_insert_with(make) else {
        return Span::NONE;
    };
    // The ring must not come round to pairs that were not read yet.
    if m.pending.len() as u32 >= PAIRS - 64 {
        return Span::NONE;
    }
    let pair = m.next;
    m.next = (m.next + 1) % PAIRS;
    m.pending.push_back((pair, kind, std::time::Instant::now()));
    // SAFETY: an open list and our query heap.
    unsafe { list.EndQuery(&m.heap, D3D12_QUERY_TYPE_TIMESTAMP, pair * 2) };
    Span(pair)
}

/// The list ends here: the pair's second timestamp, and both go to the
/// read-back buffer when the card has run the list.
pub(crate) fn end(list: &ID3D12GraphicsCommandList, span: Span) {
    if span.0 == u32::MAX {
        return;
    }
    let meter = METER.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    let Some(Some(m)) = meter.as_ref() else {
        return;
    };
    // SAFETY: an open list, our heap and our read-back buffer, the pair's
    // own sixteen bytes of it.
    unsafe {
        list.EndQuery(&m.heap, D3D12_QUERY_TYPE_TIMESTAMP, span.0 * 2 + 1);
        list.ResolveQueryData(&m.heap, D3D12_QUERY_TYPE_TIMESTAMP, span.0 * 2, 2, &m.back, u64::from(span.0) * 16);
    }
}

/// Whether the card's time is also measured pipeline by pipeline inside the
/// title's lists (`VICTORY_CARD_METER_PIPELINES=1`; off by default: two
/// more queries and a resolve at every change of pipeline).
pub(crate) fn pipelines() -> bool {
    static ON: std::sync::OnceLock<bool> = std::sync::OnceLock::new();
    *ON.get_or_init(|| on() && std::env::var_os("VICTORY_CARD_METER_PIPELINES").is_some_and(|v| v == "1"))
}

/// The pipeline `name` is bound on `list` here: the first timestamp of a
/// pair that [`end`] closes where the next pipeline is bound or the list
/// ends. What the card does between the two (the draws or dispatches of
/// that pipeline, and what the layer records around them) is that
/// pipeline's time in the table.
pub(crate) fn begin_named(list: &ID3D12GraphicsCommandList, name: &str) -> Span {
    let span = begin(list, Kind::Pipeline);
    if span.0 != u32::MAX {
        let mut meter = METER.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
        if let Some(Some(m)) = meter.as_mut() {
            m.names.insert(span.0, name.to_owned());
        }
    }
    span
}

/// [`end`] for one of the title's lists, with what it mostly is: the
/// pipelines it binds (`names`, in order, as the list keeps them). Every
/// 256 frames the card's time is logged by that name: which of the title's
/// passes the card's time goes to, in a run like any other (the timing run
/// that names every command sends each list alone and needs the
/// device-removed notes).
pub(crate) fn end_named(list: &ID3D12GraphicsCommandList, span: Span, names: &std::collections::BTreeSet<String>) {
    if span.0 == u32::MAX {
        return;
    }
    end(list, span);
    let name = name_of(names);
    let mut meter = METER.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    if let Some(Some(m)) = meter.as_mut() {
        m.names.insert(span.0, name);
    }
}

/// A list's name in the table: how many pipelines it binds and the first
/// two of them (the set is in the order of the names, so a pass has the
/// same name every frame).
fn name_of(names: &std::collections::BTreeSet<String>) -> String {
    let short = |n: &String| n.chars().take(60).collect::<String>();
    let mut first = names.iter();
    match (first.next(), first.next()) {
        (None, _) => "no pipeline (copies, clears, barriers)".to_string(),
        (Some(a), None) => format!("1 pipeline: {}", short(a)),
        (Some(a), Some(b)) => format!("{} pipelines: {} / {}", names.len(), short(a), short(b)),
    }
}

/// Microseconds between two timestamps of a clock of `frequency` ticks a
/// second; 0 if the second is not after the first (a pair the card has not
/// written, or a list that never ran).
fn micros(begin: u64, end: u64, frequency: u64) -> u64 {
    if end <= begin || frequency == 0 {
        return 0;
    }
    ((end - begin) as u128 * 1_000_000 / frequency as u128).min(10_000_000) as u64
}

/// The pairs recorded long enough ago are read and added to the frame
/// log's totals. Called once a frame.
pub(crate) fn collect() {
    if !on() {
        return;
    }
    let mut meter = METER.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    let Some(Some(m)) = meter.as_mut() else {
        return;
    };
    let now = std::time::Instant::now();
    while let Some(&(pair, kind, at)) = m.pending.front() {
        if now.duration_since(at) < AFTER {
            break;
        }
        m.pending.pop_front();
        // SAFETY: the pair's sixteen bytes of the mapped read-back buffer;
        // the card wrote them long ago or never.
        let (begin, end) = unsafe {
            let p = (m.mapped as *const u64).add(pair as usize * 2);
            (p.read_volatile(), p.add(1).read_volatile())
        };
        if std::mem::replace(&mut m.seen[pair as usize], (begin, end)) == (begin, end) {
            continue;
        }
        let us = micros(begin, end, m.frequency);
        use crate::framelog::{T, add};
        match kind {
            Kind::Sync => {
                add(T::CardSyncUs, us);
                add(T::CardSyncLists, 1);
            }
            Kind::Check => {
                add(T::CardCheckUs, us);
                add(T::CardCheckLists, 1);
            }
            Kind::Lists => {
                add(T::CardListsUs, us);
                add(T::CardLists, 1);
                if let Some(name) = m.names.remove(&pair) {
                    let e = m.by_name.entry(name).or_insert((0, 0));
                    e.0 += 1;
                    e.1 += us;
                }
            }
            Kind::Pipeline => {
                if let Some(name) = m.names.remove(&pair) {
                    let e = m.by_pipeline.entry(name).or_insert((0, 0));
                    e.0 += 1;
                    e.1 += us;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    m.frames += 1;
    if m.frames >= 256 {
        let frames = m.frames as f64;
        let mut table: Vec<(String, (u64, u64))> = m.by_name.drain().collect();
        table.sort_by_key(|&(_, (_, us))| std::cmp::Reverse(us));
        let all: u64 = table.iter().map(|&(_, (_, us))| us).sum();
        tracing::info!(
            "card time of the title's lists by what they bind, per frame over {} frames: {:.1} ms in {:.0} lists of {} kinds; the largest follow",
            m.frames,
            all as f64 / 1e3 / frames,
            table.iter().map(|&(_, (n, _))| n).sum::<u64>() as f64 / frames,
            table.len()
        );
        for (name, (n, us)) in table.into_iter().take(24) {
            tracing::info!("  card {:6.2} ms a frame in {:5.1} lists: {name}", us as f64 / 1e3 / frames, n as f64 / frames);
        }
        if !m.by_pipeline.is_empty() {
            let mut table: Vec<(String, (u64, u64))> = m.by_pipeline.drain().collect();
            table.sort_by_key(|&(_, (_, us))| std::cmp::Reverse(us));
            let all: u64 = table.iter().map(|&(_, (_, us))| us).sum();
            tracing::info!(
                "card time by pipeline (from where it is bound to where the next is), per frame over {} frames: {:.1} ms in {:.0} bindings of {} pipelines; the largest follow",
                m.frames,
                all as f64 / 1e3 / frames,
                table.iter().map(|&(_, (n, _))| n).sum::<u64>() as f64 / frames,
                table.len()
            );
            for (name, (n, us)) in table.into_iter().take(48) {
                tracing::info!(
                    "  pipeline {:6.2} ms a frame in {:6.1} bindings ({:7.1} us each): {name}",
                    us as f64 / 1e3 / frames,
                    n as f64 / frames,
                    us as f64 / n.max(1) as f64
                );
            }
        }
        m.frames = 0;
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn a_list_is_named_by_the_pipelines_it_binds() {
        let mut names = std::collections::BTreeSet::new();
        assert_eq!(name_of(&names), "no pipeline (copies, clears, barriers)");
        names.insert("compute CS_Blur".to_string());
        assert_eq!(name_of(&names), "1 pipeline: compute CS_Blur");
        names.insert("mesh VS_A, pixel PS_B".to_string());
        names.insert("a".repeat(100));
        assert_eq!(name_of(&names), format!("3 pipelines: {} / compute CS_Blur", "a".repeat(60)));
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_pairs_length_is_in_microseconds_of_the_queues_clock() {
        assert_eq!(micros(1_000, 11_000, 10_000_000), 1_000);
        assert_eq!(micros(0, 25_000_000, 25_000_000), 1_000_000);
        // Not written, or the wrong way round: nothing.
        assert_eq!(micros(5, 5, 1_000), 0);
        assert_eq!(micros(9, 5, 1_000), 0);
        assert_eq!(micros(1, 2, 0), 0);
        // A stale second stamp from the ring's last round cannot add hours.
        assert_eq!(micros(1, u64::MAX, 1), 10_000_000);
    }
}
```

`crates/victory-gpu/src/console.rs`:

```rs
//! Which console the title runs on. Titles pick settings (resolution,
//! memory budgets) by it, so the user chooses; Series X unless told.

use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};

const GIB: usize = 1 << 30;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Console {
    #[default]
    SeriesX,
    SeriesS,
}

impl Console {
    /// Title memory in bytes: (GPU-optimal, standard). Series X in the
    /// advanced configuration; Series S has one range, counted as standard
    /// (7,776 MiB, the published console-mode figure).
    // shortcut: later system updates gave Series S titles more (amount not
    // published here); the title sizes nothing from this figure
    // (it goes by the device type), so update it if a title does.
    pub const fn title_memory(self) -> (usize, usize) {
        match self {
            Console::SeriesX => (10 * GIB, 7 * GIB / 2),
            Console::SeriesS => (0, 7_776 << 20),
        }
    }

    pub const fn name(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Console::SeriesX => "Xbox Series X",
            Console::SeriesS => "Xbox Series S",
        }
    }
}

static SERIES_S: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);

/// Set before the title starts.
pub fn set(console: Console) {
    SERIES_S.store(console == Console::SeriesS, Ordering::Relaxed);
}

pub fn current() -> Console {
    if SERIES_S.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
        Console::SeriesS
    } else {
        Console::SeriesX
    }
}
```
