```rs
extern "system" fn resource_query(this: This, iid: *const Iid, out: *mut This) -> HRESULT {
    object::answer(
        RESOURCE,
        iid,
        object::is(iid, &RESOURCE_IIDS).then_some(this),
        out,
    )
}
extern "system" fn resource_release(this: This) -> u32 {
    object::release_boxed::<Resource>(this)
}
/// Memory is always mapped (subresources are not told apart yet); a null
/// `out` only asks for residency.
extern "system" fn map(this: This, _sub: u32, _read: *const c_void, out: *mut *mut u8) -> HRESULT {
    if !out.is_null() {
        // SAFETY: checked non-null; the title passes room for a pointer.
        unsafe { out.write(resource(this).data()) };
    }
    S_OK
}
extern "system" fn unmap(_: This, _sub: u32, _written: *const c_void) {}
extern "system" fn resource_desc(this: This, out: *mut ResourceDesc) {
    if !out.is_null() {
        // SAFETY: checked non-null; the title passes room for a description.
        unsafe { out.write(resource(this).desc) };
    }
}
/// Device method `GetCustomHeapProperties`, returning its struct through a
/// hidden first argument: what a standard heap type is as a custom heap.
/// Memory is unified and cache-coherent (as the architecture query says),
/// so every type is in pool L0, default heaps are not CPU-visible and the
/// others are write-back.
pub(crate) extern "system" fn custom_heap_properties(
    out: *mut HeapProperties,
    _: This,
    nodes: u32,
    kind: u32,
) -> *mut HeapProperties {
    const CUSTOM: u32 = 4;
    const NOT_AVAILABLE: u32 = 1;
    const WRITE_BACK: u32 = 3;
    const L0: u32 = 1;
    let nodes = nodes.max(1);
    let cpu_pages = match kind {
        1 => NOT_AVAILABLE,
        2 | 3 => WRITE_BACK,
        _ => 0,
    };
    let properties = HeapProperties {
        kind: CUSTOM,
        cpu_pages,
        pool: if cpu_pages == 0 { 0 } else { L0 },
        creation_nodes: nodes,
        visible_nodes: nodes,
    };
    // SAFETY: the title passes room for the result (null is tolerated).
    if let Some(out) = unsafe { out.as_mut() } {
        *out = properties;
    }
    out
}

extern "system" fn gpu_address(this: This) -> u64 {
    let r = resource(this);
    let at = r.data() as u64;
    // The console's GPU addresses fit in 40 bits; its ray-tracing builder
    // refuses others (diagnostics: which memory breaks that).
    #[cfg(feature = "diagnostics")]
    if at >> 40 != 0 {
        static ONCE: [std::sync::Once; 2] = [std::sync::Once::new(), std::sync::Once::new()];
        let backing = match r.backing {
            Backing::Committed(ref m) => format!("committed, attributes {:?}", m.attributes),
            Backing::Placed { offset, .. } => format!("placed in a heap at {offset:#x}"),
            Backing::Address(_) => "at a title address".into(),
        };
        ONCE[usize::from(r.desc.dimension == BUFFER)].call_once(|| {
            tracing::warn!(address = format_args!("{at:#x}"), backing, desc = ?r.desc, "a GPU address above 40 bits")
        });
    }
    at
}
extern "system" fn heap_properties(
    this: This,
    properties: *mut HeapProperties,
    flags: *mut u32,
) -> HRESULT {
    let r = resource(this);
    // SAFETY: either pointer may be null; otherwise the title passes room.
    unsafe {
        if let Some(p) = properties.as_mut() {
            *p = r.heap;
        }
        if let Some(f) = flags.as_mut() {
            *f = r.heap_flags;
        }
    }
    S_OK
}

/// IUnknown 3, object 4, device child 1, heap 1.
static HEAP_FUNCTIONS: Table<24> = {
    let mut f = object::d3d12_object(object::missing_table::<HEAP, 24>());
    f[0] = heap_query as *const ();
    f[2] = heap_release as *const ();
    f[7] = object::parent_device as *const (); // 0x38
    f[8] = heap_desc as *const (); // 0x40
    Table(f)
};

/// IUnknown 3, object 4, device child 1, resource 10 (7 as on PC, then 3
/// console ones).
static RESOURCE_FUNCTIONS: Table<32> = {
    let mut f = object::d3d12_object(object::missing_table::<RESOURCE, 32>());
    f[0] = resource_query as *const ();
    f[2] = resource_release as *const ();
    f[7] = object::parent_device as *const (); // 0x38
    f[8] = map as *const (); // 0x40
    f[9] = unmap as *const (); // 0x48
    f[10] = resource_desc as *const (); // 0x50
    f[11] = gpu_address as *const (); // 0x58
    f[14] = heap_properties as *const (); // 0x70
    Table(f)
};

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::object::slot;

    type Release = extern "system" fn(This) -> u32;
    type Map = extern "system" fn(This, u32, *const c_void, *mut *mut u8) -> HRESULT;
    type Address = extern "system" fn(This) -> u64;

    const PROPERTIES: HeapProperties = HeapProperties {
        kind: 1,
        cpu_pages: 0,
        pool: 0,
        creation_nodes: 0,
        visible_nodes: 0,
    };

    fn buffer(width: u64) -> ResourceDesc {
        ResourceDesc {
            dimension: BUFFER,
            alignment: 0,
            width,
            height: 1,
            depth_or_array_size: 1,
            mip_levels: 1,
            format: 0,
            sample_count: 1,
            sample_quality: 0,
            layout: 1,
            flags: 0,
        }
    }

    fn texture(width: u64, height: u32, format: u32, mips: u16) -> ResourceDesc {
        ResourceDesc {
            dimension: 3,
            width,
            height,
            format,
            mip_levels: mips,
            layout: 0,
            ..buffer(0)
        }
    }

    fn heap(size: u64) -> This {
        let desc = HeapDesc {
            size,
            properties: PROPERTIES,
            alignment: 0,
            flags: 0,
        };
        let mut heap = std::ptr::null();
        assert_eq!(
            create_heap(std::ptr::null(), &desc, &HEAP_IIDS[0], &mut heap),
            S_OK
        );
        heap
    }

    #[test]
    fn heaps_are_zeroed_aligned_memory() {
        let heap = heap(1 << 20);
        // SAFETY: a heap we just made.
        let memory = unsafe { &(*heap.cast::<Heap>()).memory };
        assert_eq!(memory.ptr.as_ptr() as u64 % KIB_64, 0);
        let mut back = std::mem::MaybeUninit::<HeapDesc>::uninit();
        slot::<extern "system" fn(This, *mut HeapDesc)>(heap, 0x40)(heap, back.as_mut_ptr());
        // SAFETY: written above.
        assert_eq!(unsafe { back.assume_init() }.size, 1 << 20);
        assert_eq!(slot::<Release>(heap, 0x10)(heap), 0);

        let bad = HeapDesc {
            size: 1 << 20,
            properties: PROPERTIES,
            alignment: 3,
            flags: 0,
        };
        let mut out = std::ptr::null();
        assert_eq!(
            create_heap(std::ptr::null(), &bad, &HEAP_IIDS[0], &mut out),
            E_INVALIDARG
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn device_setup_heap_properties_and_resources_at_addresses() {
        let device = crate::device::device();
        // GetCustomHeapProperties (0xd0): the struct comes back through the
        // hidden first argument, which is also returned.
        type Custom =
            extern "system" fn(*mut HeapProperties, This, u32, u32) -> *mut HeapProperties;
        let mut p = PROPERTIES;
        let back = slot::<Custom>(device, 0xd0)(&mut p, device, 1, 2);
        assert_eq!(back, &raw mut p);
        assert_eq!(
            (
                p.kind,
                p.cpu_pages,
                p.pool,
                p.creation_nodes,
                p.visible_nodes
            ),
            (4, 3, 1, 1, 1),
            "upload: custom, write-back, L0"
        );
        slot::<Custom>(device, 0xd0)(&mut p, device, 1, 1);
        assert_eq!(p.cpu_pages, 1, "default: not CPU-visible");

        // 0x428: a buffer over memory the title owns, as the title asks.
        type At = extern "system" fn(
            This,
            u64,
            *const ResourceDesc,
            u32,
            *const c_void,
            *const Iid,
            *mut This,
        ) -> HRESULT;
        let memory = vec![0u8; 0x1_0000];
        let address = memory.as_ptr() as u64;
        let mut r = std::ptr::null();
        let create = slot::<At>(device, 0x428);
        let desc = buffer(0x1_0000);
        let null = std::ptr::null();
        assert_eq!(
            create(
                device,
                address,
                &desc,
                u32::MAX,
                null,
                &RESOURCE_IIDS[0],
                &mut r
            ),
            0
        );
        assert_eq!(slot::<Address>(r, 0x58)(r), address);
        assert_eq!(slot::<Release>(r, 0x10)(r), 0);
        // The title's memory is still there after the release.
        assert_eq!(memory[0xffff], 0);
        assert_ne!(
            create(device, 0, &desc, u32::MAX, null, &RESOURCE_IIDS[0], &mut r),
            0
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn sizes_cover_every_mip() {
        let size = |d: &ResourceDesc| footprint(d).map(|i| i.size);
        assert_eq!(size(&buffer(256)), Some(KIB_64));
        // Textures take their console layout and its alignment (4 KiB
        // standard swizzle when the description leaves it to the library):
        // 512x512 BC7 with 10 mips is 0x56000 bytes, 4 KiB aligned, as on
        // the console.
        let layout = |d: &ResourceDesc| texture_layout(d).unwrap().size;
        let rgba = texture(256, 256, 28, 0);
        assert_eq!(size(&rgba), Some(layout(&rgba).next_multiple_of(4096)));
        let bc7 = footprint(&texture(512, 512, 98, 10));
        let console = AllocationInfo {
            size: 0x56000,
            alignment: 0x1000,
        };
        assert_eq!(bc7, Some(console));
        assert!(layout(&rgba) >= 4 * (256 * 256 * 4) / 3, "every mip");
        // BC1 is 8 bytes per 4x4 block: 1024x1024, one mip = 512 KiB.
        assert_eq!(size(&texture(1024, 1024, 71, 1)), Some(512 << 10));
        assert_eq!(size(&texture(16, 16, 66, 1)), None, "1-bit format");
        // Linear layout (1) and an explicit mode (64 KiB display, 0x10a).
        let linear = ResourceDesc {
            layout: 1,
            ..texture(100, 60, 28, 1)
        };
        assert_eq!(
            texture_layout(&linear).unwrap().planes[0]
                .layout
                .desc
                .swizzle
                .0,
            0
        );
        let display = ResourceDesc {
            layout: 0x10a,
            ..texture(100, 60, 28, 1)
        };
        assert_eq!(
            texture_layout(&display).unwrap().planes[0]
                .layout
                .desc
                .swizzle
                .0,
            10
        );

        let mut info = AllocationInfo {
            size: 0,
            alignment: 0,
        };
        let descs = [buffer(100), texture(256, 256, 28, 0)];
        allocation_info(&mut info, std::ptr::null(), 0, 2, descs.as_ptr());
        assert_eq!(
            info,
            AllocationInfo {
                size: KIB_64 + size(&descs[1]).unwrap(),
                alignment: KIB_64
            }
        );
        allocation_info(&mut info, std::ptr::null(), 0, 1, &texture(1, 1, 999, 1));
        assert_eq!(info.size, u64::MAX);
    }

    #[test]
    fn upload_footprints_follow_the_pc_rules() {
        let null = std::ptr::null();
        let mut layouts = [NO_FOOTPRINT; 2];
        let (mut rows, mut sizes, mut total) = ([0; 2], [0; 2], 0);
        let mut footprints = |desc: &ResourceDesc, first, count| {
            let (l, r, s) = (layouts.as_mut_ptr(), rows.as_mut_ptr(), sizes.as_mut_ptr());
            copyable_footprints(null, desc, first, count, 0, l, r, s, &mut total);
            (layouts, rows, sizes, total)
        };
        // 100x60 RGBA8, 2 mips: 400-byte rows pitched to 512.
        let (l, r, s, t) = footprints(&texture(100, 60, 28, 2), 0, 2);
        assert_eq!((l[0].row_pitch, r[0], s[0]), (512, 60, 400));
        // Mip 1 (50x30, 200-byte rows) starts after 59 pitched rows and one
        // packed row, rounded up to 512.
        assert_eq!(l[1].offset, (512 * 59 + 400u64).next_multiple_of(512));
        assert_eq!((l[1].width, l[1].height, r[1]), (50, 30, 30));
        assert_eq!(t, l[1].offset + 256 * 29 + 200);
        // BC1: rows of 4x4 blocks, 8 bytes each.
        let (_, r, s, _) = footprints(&texture(64, 64, 71, 1), 0, 1);
        assert_eq!((r[0], s[0]), (16, 128));
        let (_, _, _, t) = footprints(&texture(64, 64, 71, 1), 1, 1);
        assert_eq!(t, u64::MAX, "no second subresource");
    }

    /// A 4x4 texture filled from a title buffer through our list and queue,
    /// then read back from the host GPU.
    #[cfg(windows)]
    #[test]
    fn buffer_data_reaches_the_host_texture() {
        use windows::Win32::Graphics::Direct3D12::*;
        let Some(host) = crate::host::host() else {
            return; // no host GPU here
        };
        let null = std::ptr::null();
        let iid = &RESOURCE_IIDS[0];
        const COPY_DEST: u32 = 0x400;
        let (mut image, mut source) = (null, null);
        let rgba = texture(4, 4, 28, 1);
        assert_eq!(
            create_committed(
                null,
                &PROPERTIES,
                0,
                &rgba,
                COPY_DEST,
                null.cast(),
                iid,
                &mut image
            ),
            S_OK
        );
        assert_eq!(
            create_committed(
                null,
                &PROPERTIES,
                0,
                &buffer(1024),
                0,
                null.cast(),
                iid,
                &mut source
            ),
            S_OK
        );
        let (data, _) = buffer_bytes(source).unwrap();
        // SAFETY: the buffer holds 1024 bytes.
        let bytes = unsafe { std::slice::from_raw_parts_mut(data, 1024) };
        for (i, b) in bytes.iter_mut().enumerate() {
            *b = (i % 251) as u8;
        }

        let queue_iid = guid(
            0x0ec870a6,
            0x5d7e,
            0x4c22,
            [0x8c, 0xfc, 0x5b, 0xaa, 0xe0, 0x76, 0x16, 0xed],
        );
        let allocator_iid = guid(
            0x6102dee4,
            0xaf59,
            0x4b09,
            [0xb9, 0x99, 0xb4, 0x4d, 0x73, 0xf0, 0x9b, 0x24],
        );
        let list_iid = guid(
            0x5b160d0f,
            0xac1b,
            0x4185,
            [0x8b, 0xa8, 0xb3, 0xae, 0x42, 0xa5, 0xa4, 0x55],
        );
        let (mut queue, mut allocator, mut list) = (null, null, null);
        let queue_desc = [0u32; 4];
        assert_eq!(
            crate::queue::create(null, queue_desc.as_ptr().cast(), &queue_iid, &mut queue),
            S_OK
        );
        assert_eq!(
            crate::list::create_allocator(null, 0, &allocator_iid, &mut allocator),
            S_OK
        );
        assert_eq!(
            crate::list::create_list(null, 0, 0, allocator, null, &list_iid, &mut list),
            S_OK
        );

        #[repr(C)]
        struct Location {
            resource: This,
            kind: u32,
            footprint: PlacedFootprint,
        }
        let rows = PlacedFootprint {
            offset: 0,
            format: 28,
            width: 4,
            height: 4,
            depth: 1,
            row_pitch: 256,
        };
        let to = Location {
            resource: image,
            kind: 0,
            footprint: PlacedFootprint { offset: 0, ..rows },
        };
        let from = Location {
            resource: source,
            kind: 1,
            footprint: rows,
        };
        type Copy =
            extern "system" fn(This, *const Location, u32, u32, u32, *const Location, *const u8);
        slot::<Copy>(list, 0x80)(list, &to, 0, 0, 0, &from, null.cast());
        slot::<extern "system" fn(This) -> HRESULT>(list, 0x48)(list);
        slot::<extern "system" fn(This, u32, *const This)>(queue, 0x50)(queue, 1, &list);

        // Read the host texture back into a readback buffer.
        let readback_heap = D3D12_HEAP_PROPERTIES {
            Type: D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_READBACK,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let readback_desc = D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC {
            Dimension: D3D12_RESOURCE_DIMENSION_BUFFER,
            Width: 1024,
            Height: 1,
            DepthOrArraySize: 1,
            MipLevels: 1,
            SampleDesc: windows::Win32::Graphics::Dxgi::Common::DXGI_SAMPLE_DESC {
                Count: 1,
                Quality: 0,
            },
            Layout: D3D12_TEXTURE_LAYOUT_ROW_MAJOR,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let mut readback: Option<ID3D12Resource> = None;
        // SAFETY: plain creation of a readback buffer.
        unsafe {
            host.device
                .CreateCommittedResource(
                    &readback_heap,
                    D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE,
                    &readback_desc,
                    D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST,
                    None,
                    &mut readback,
                )
                .unwrap();
        }
        let readback = readback.unwrap();
        let host_image = host_resource(image).unwrap();
        let back = host.new_list().unwrap();
        let (_, before) = host_transition(image, 0x800).unwrap();
        // The upload list holds the texture until it is reset.
        assert!(std::sync::Arc::strong_count(&host_copy(image).unwrap()) > 2);
        use windows::core::Interface;
        let out_to = Location {
            resource: readback.as_raw().cast_const().cast(),
            kind: 1,
            footprint: rows,
        };
        let out_from = Location {
            resource: host_image.as_raw().cast_const().cast(),
            kind: 0,
            footprint: to.footprint,
        };
        // SAFETY: an open list, live resources, locations in the host layout.
        unsafe {
            back.list.ResourceBarrier(&[crate::host::transition(
                host_image,
                D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES(before as i32),
                D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE,
            )]);
            back.list.CopyTextureRegion(
                (&raw const out_to).cast(),
                0,
                0,
                0,
                (&raw const out_from).cast(),
                None,
            );
        }
        back.close();
        host.execute(&[&back]);
        let mut mapped = std::ptr::null_mut();
        // SAFETY: the copy finished (execute waits); the buffer is 1024 bytes.
        let read = unsafe {
            readback
                .Map(
                    0,
                    Some(&D3D12_RANGE {
                        Begin: 0,
                        End: 1024,
                    }),
                    Some(&mut mapped),
                )
                .unwrap();
            std::slice::from_raw_parts(mapped.cast::<u8>(), 1024)
        };
        for row in 0..4 {
            let at = row * 256;
            assert_eq!(read[at..at + 16], bytes[at..at + 16], "row {row}");
        }
    }

    /// A 16-bit depth texture the title also asks unordered access for gets
    /// a colour twin, and the host copies one into the other, both ways: a
    /// pattern put into the twin is copied to the depth texture, the twin
    /// is overwritten with zeros, and the pattern comes back from the depth
    /// texture. A copy the host does not allow ends the test (with the
    /// debug layer's message under `VICTORY_D3D12_DEBUG=1` in a diagnostics
    /// build).
    #[cfg(windows)]
    #[test]
    fn a_depth_texture_and_its_twin_copy_into_each_other() {
        use windows::Win32::Graphics::Direct3D12::*;
        use windows::Win32::Graphics::Dxgi::Common::{DXGI_FORMAT, DXGI_SAMPLE_DESC};
        let Some(host) = crate::host::host() else {
            return; // no host GPU here
        };
        let null = std::ptr::null();
        const DEPTH_WRITE: u32 = 0x10;
        let desc = ResourceDesc {
            flags: 6,
            ..texture(4, 4, 55, 1)
        };
        let mut depth = null;
        assert_eq!(
            create_committed(
                null,
                &PROPERTIES,
                0,
                &desc,
                DEPTH_WRITE,
                null.cast(),
                &RESOURCE_IIDS[0],
                &mut depth
            ),
            S_OK
        );
        let host_depth = host_resource(depth).unwrap();
        let Some(twin) = twin_resource(depth) else {
            return; // twins are turned off
        };
        // SAFETY: live resources.
        let (d, t) = unsafe { (host_depth.GetDesc(), twin.GetDesc()) };
        // Both R16 typeless: one a depth texture, one with unordered access.
        assert_eq!((d.Format.0, d.Flags.0), (53, 2));
        assert_eq!((t.Format.0, t.Flags.0), (53, 4));

        // Four rows of four 16-bit texels, 256 bytes apart as copies place
        // them: the pattern, then as many zeros.
        let mut pattern = vec![0u8; 1024];
        for row in 0..4 {
            for b in 0..8 {
                pattern[row * 256 + b] = (1 + row * 8 + b) as u8;
            }
        }
        let (upload, data) = host.upload_buffer(2048).unwrap();
        // SAFETY: the buffer's mapping, 2048 bytes.
        unsafe {
            std::ptr::copy_nonoverlapping(pattern.as_ptr(), data, 1024);
            std::ptr::write_bytes(data.add(1024), 0, 1024);
        }
        let readback_heap = D3D12_HEAP_PROPERTIES {
            Type: D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_READBACK,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let readback_desc = D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC {
            Dimension: D3D12_RESOURCE_DIMENSION_BUFFER,
            Width: 1024,
            Height: 1,
            DepthOrArraySize: 1,
            MipLevels: 1,
            SampleDesc: DXGI_SAMPLE_DESC {
                Count: 1,
                Quality: 0,
            },
            Layout: D3D12_TEXTURE_LAYOUT_ROW_MAJOR,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let mut readback: Option<ID3D12Resource> = None;
        // SAFETY: plain creation of a readback buffer.
        unsafe {
            host.device
                .CreateCommittedResource(
                    &readback_heap,
                    D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE,
                    &readback_desc,
                    D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST,
                    None,
                    &mut readback,
                )
                .unwrap();
        }
        let readback = readback.unwrap();

        // A texture's one subresource; the four rows of a buffer at `offset`.
        let whole = |texture: &ID3D12Resource| D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION {
            // SAFETY: a borrowed pointer the location never releases.
            pResource: unsafe { std::mem::transmute_copy(texture) },
            Type: D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_TYPE_SUBRESOURCE_INDEX,
            Anonymous: D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION_0 {
                SubresourceIndex: 0,
            },
        };
        let rows = |buffer: &ID3D12Resource, offset: u64| D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION {
            // SAFETY: as above.
            pResource: unsafe { std::mem::transmute_copy(buffer) },
            Type: D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_TYPE_PLACED_FOOTPRINT,
            Anonymous: D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION_0 {
                PlacedFootprint: D3D12_PLACED_SUBRESOURCE_FOOTPRINT {
                    Offset: offset,
                    Footprint: D3D12_SUBRESOURCE_FOOTPRINT {
                        Format: DXGI_FORMAT(53),
                        Width: 4,
                        Height: 4,
                        Depth: 1,
                        RowPitch: 256,
                    },
                },
            },
        };
        let (written, tested, source, dest) = (
            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS,
            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_DEPTH_WRITE,
            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE,
            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST,
        );
        let moved = crate::host::transition;
        let list = host.new_list().unwrap();
        // SAFETY: an open list and live resources; the two textures are one
        // size in one format family.
        unsafe {
            let l = &list.list;
            // The pattern into the twin, the twin into the depth texture.
            l.ResourceBarrier(&[moved(twin, written, dest), moved(host_depth, tested, dest)]);
            l.CopyTextureRegion(&whole(twin), 0, 0, 0, &rows(&upload, 0), None);
            l.ResourceBarrier(&[moved(twin, dest, source)]);
            l.CopyResource(host_depth, twin);
            // Zeros over the twin, then the depth texture back into it.
            l.ResourceBarrier(&[moved(twin, source, dest)]);
            l.CopyTextureRegion(&whole(twin), 0, 0, 0, &rows(&upload, 1024), None);
            l.ResourceBarrier(&[moved(host_depth, dest, source)]);
            l.CopyResource(twin, host_depth);
            // The twin read back; both textures to the states they had.
            l.ResourceBarrier(&[moved(twin, dest, source)]);
            l.CopyTextureRegion(&rows(&readback, 0), 0, 0, 0, &whole(twin), None);
            l.ResourceBarrier(&[
                moved(twin, source, written),
                moved(host_depth, source, tested),
            ]);
        }
        list.close();
        host.execute(&[&list]);
        let mut mapped = std::ptr::null_mut();
        // SAFETY: the copies finished (execute waits); the buffer is 1024 bytes.
        let read = unsafe {
            readback
                .Map(
                    0,
                    Some(&D3D12_RANGE {
                        Begin: 0,
                        End: 1024,
                    }),
                    Some(&mut mapped),
                )
                .unwrap();
            std::slice::from_raw_parts(mapped.cast::<u8>(), 1024)
        };
        for row in 0..4 {
            let at = row * 256;
            assert_eq!(read[at..at + 8], pattern[at..at + 8], "row {row}");
        }
    }

    /// A depth texture with a stencil plane that the title also asks
    /// unordered access for gets a twin of the stencil plane, and what
    /// shaders write there is in the stencil plane once the list is closed:
    /// a pattern put into the twin is read back from the plane.
    #[cfg(windows)]
    #[test]
    fn a_stencil_planes_twin_reaches_the_plane() {
        use std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed;
        use windows::Win32::Graphics::Direct3D12::*;
        use windows::Win32::Graphics::Dxgi::Common::{DXGI_FORMAT, DXGI_SAMPLE_DESC};
        let Some(host) = crate::host::host() else {
            return; // no host GPU here
        };
        let null = std::ptr::null();
        const DEPTH_WRITE: u32 = 0x10;
        let desc = ResourceDesc {
            flags: 6,
            ..texture(4, 4, 45, 1)
        };
        let mut depth = null;
        assert_eq!(
            create_committed(
                null,
                &PROPERTIES,
                0,
                &desc,
                DEPTH_WRITE,
                null.cast(),
                &RESOURCE_IIDS[0],
                &mut depth
            ),
            S_OK
        );
        let host_depth = host_resource(depth).unwrap();
        let Some(twin) = twin_resource(depth) else {
            return; // twins are turned off
        };
        // SAFETY: live resources.
        let (d, t) = unsafe { (host_depth.GetDesc(), twin.GetDesc()) };
        // R24G8 typeless with depth, R8 typeless with unordered access.
        assert_eq!((d.Format.0, d.Flags.0), (44, 2));
        assert_eq!((t.Format.0, t.Flags.0), (60, 4));

        // Four rows of four texels, 256 bytes apart as copies place them.
        let mut pattern = vec![0u8; 1024];
        for row in 0..4 {
            for b in 0..4 {
                pattern[row * 256 + b] = (1 + row * 4 + b) as u8;
            }
        }
        let (upload, data) = host.upload_buffer(1024).unwrap();
        // SAFETY: the buffer's mapping, 1024 bytes.
        unsafe { std::ptr::copy_nonoverlapping(pattern.as_ptr(), data, 1024) };
        let readback_heap = D3D12_HEAP_PROPERTIES {
            Type: D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_READBACK,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let readback_desc = D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC {
            Dimension: D3D12_RESOURCE_DIMENSION_BUFFER,
            // Room for the rows as the host places them (512 bytes apart
            // for the stencil plane on NVIDIA, not 256).
            Width: 4096,
            Height: 1,
            DepthOrArraySize: 1,
            MipLevels: 1,
            SampleDesc: DXGI_SAMPLE_DESC {
                Count: 1,
                Quality: 0,
            },
            Layout: D3D12_TEXTURE_LAYOUT_ROW_MAJOR,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let mut readback: Option<ID3D12Resource> = None;
        // SAFETY: plain creation of a readback buffer.
        unsafe {
            host.device
                .CreateCommittedResource(
                    &readback_heap,
                    D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE,
                    &readback_desc,
                    D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST,
                    None,
                    &mut readback,
                )
                .unwrap();
        }
        let readback = readback.unwrap();
        // How the host lays the stencil plane (subresource 1) out in a buffer.
        let mut plane = D3D12_PLACED_SUBRESOURCE_FOOTPRINT::default();
        // SAFETY: a plain query writing one footprint.
        unsafe {
            host.device
                .GetCopyableFootprints(&d, 1, 1, 0, Some(&mut plane), None, None, None);
        }
        let pattern_rows = D3D12_PLACED_SUBRESOURCE_FOOTPRINT {
            Offset: 0,
            Footprint: D3D12_SUBRESOURCE_FOOTPRINT {
                Format: DXGI_FORMAT(60),
                Width: 4,
                Height: 4,
                Depth: 1,
                RowPitch: 256,
            },
        };

        // A subresource of a texture; rows of a buffer.
        let whole = |texture: &ID3D12Resource, index: u32| D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION {
            // SAFETY: a borrowed pointer the location never releases.
            pResource: unsafe { std::mem::transmute_copy(texture) },
            Type: D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_TYPE_SUBRESOURCE_INDEX,
            Anonymous: D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION_0 {
                SubresourceIndex: index,
            },
        };
        let rows = |buffer: &ID3D12Resource, placed: D3D12_PLACED_SUBRESOURCE_FOOTPRINT| {
            D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION {
                // SAFETY: as above.
                pResource: unsafe { std::mem::transmute_copy(buffer) },
                Type: D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_TYPE_PLACED_FOOTPRINT,
                Anonymous: D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION_0 {
                    PlacedFootprint: placed,
                },
            }
        };
        let (written, source, dest) = (
            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS,
            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE,
            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST,
        );
        let moved = crate::host::transition;

        // The pattern into the twin, where a shader would write it.
        let fill = host.new_list().unwrap();
        // SAFETY: an open list and live resources.
        unsafe {
            let l = &fill.list;
            l.ResourceBarrier(&[moved(twin, written, dest)]);
            l.CopyTextureRegion(&whole(twin, 0), 0, 0, 0, &rows(&upload, pattern_rows), None);
            l.ResourceBarrier(&[moved(twin, dest, written)]);
        }
        fill.close();
        host.execute(&[&fill]);

        // A list in which a shader writes the twin: closing it copies the
        // twin into the stencil plane.
        let list = host.new_list().unwrap();
        assert!(list.twin_use(depth, true, true));
        list.twins_written();
        list.close();
        host.execute(&[&list]);

        // The stencil plane read back from the state the list left it in.
        let state = host_copy(depth).unwrap().state.load(Relaxed);
        let state = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES(state as i32);
        let back = host.new_list().unwrap();
        // SAFETY: an open list and live resources; a whole subresource.
        unsafe {
            let l = &back.list;
            l.ResourceBarrier(&[moved(host_depth, state, source)]);
            let (to, from) = (rows(&readback, plane), whole(host_depth, 1));
            l.CopyTextureRegion(&to, 0, 0, 0, &from, None);
            l.ResourceBarrier(&[moved(host_depth, source, state)]);
        }
        back.close();
        host.execute(&[&back]);
        let mut mapped = std::ptr::null_mut();
        // SAFETY: the copies finished (execute waits); the buffer is 4096 bytes.
        let read = unsafe {
            readback
                .Map(
                    0,
                    Some(&D3D12_RANGE {
                        Begin: 0,
                        End: 4096,
                    }),
                    Some(&mut mapped),
                )
                .unwrap();
            std::slice::from_raw_parts(mapped.cast::<u8>(), 4096)
        };
        let pitch = plane.Footprint.RowPitch as usize;
        for row in 0..4 {
            let (at, from) = (row * pitch, row * 256);
            assert_eq!(read[at..at + 4], pattern[from..from + 4], "row {row}");
        }
    }

    /// The depth plane of a depth-stencil texture is drawn from the plane's
    /// twin when the list that wrote the twin closes: class numbers are put
    /// into the twin of a texture in the console's 16-bit depth-stencil
    /// format, and draws with the depth test "equal" at the depth the
    /// title's lighting computes for a class (the number times the float
    /// nearest 1/65535) then cover the texels of that class and no other.
    #[cfg(windows)]
    #[test]
    fn a_depth_planes_twin_is_drawn_into_the_plane() {
        use std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed;
        use windows::Win32::Foundation::RECT;
        use windows::Win32::Graphics::Direct3D::D3D_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY;
        use windows::Win32::Graphics::Direct3D12::*;
        use windows::Win32::Graphics::Dxgi::Common::{DXGI_FORMAT, DXGI_SAMPLE_DESC};
        use windows::core::s;
        let Some(host) = crate::host::host() else {
            return; // no host GPU here
        };
        let null = std::ptr::null();
        const DEPTH_WRITE: u32 = 0x10;
        let desc = ResourceDesc {
            flags: 6,
            ..texture(4, 4, 118, 1)
        };
        let mut depth = null;
        assert_eq!(
            create_committed(
                null,
                &PROPERTIES,
                0,
                &desc,
                DEPTH_WRITE,
                null.cast(),
                &RESOURCE_IIDS[0],
                &mut depth
            ),
            S_OK
        );
        let host_depth = host_resource(depth).unwrap();
        let Some(plane) = twin_plane_resource(depth) else {
            return; // these twins are turned off
        };
        // SAFETY: live resources.
        let (d, t) = unsafe { (host_depth.GetDesc(), plane.GetDesc()) };
        // R24G8 typeless with depth, R16 typeless with unordered access.
        assert_eq!((d.Format.0, d.Flags.0), (44, 2));
        assert_eq!((t.Format.0, t.Flags.0), (53, 4));

        // Four rows of four class numbers (16 bits each), 256 bytes apart
        // as copies place them. 128 and 129 are the classes whose 24-bit
        // depth lies nearest a half step.
        const CLASSES: [u16; 16] = [
            8, 65, 128, 129, 65, 8, 129, 128, 0, 255, 65, 64, 129, 130, 8, 65,
        ];
        let mut pattern = vec![0u8; 1024];
        for (i, class) in CLASSES.into_iter().enumerate() {
            let at = i / 4 * 256 + i % 4 * 2;
            pattern[at..at + 2].copy_from_slice(&class.to_le_bytes());
        }
        let (upload, data) = host.upload_buffer(1024).unwrap();
        // SAFETY: the buffer's mapping, 1024 bytes.
        unsafe { std::ptr::copy_nonoverlapping(pattern.as_ptr(), data, 1024) };
        let buffer = |kind: D3D12_HEAP_TYPE, state: D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES| {
            let heap = D3D12_HEAP_PROPERTIES {
                Type: kind,
                ..Default::default()
            };
            let desc = D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC {
                Dimension: D3D12_RESOURCE_DIMENSION_BUFFER,
                Width: 1024,
                Height: 1,
                DepthOrArraySize: 1,
                MipLevels: 1,
                SampleDesc: DXGI_SAMPLE_DESC {
                    Count: 1,
                    Quality: 0,
                },
                Layout: D3D12_TEXTURE_LAYOUT_ROW_MAJOR,
                ..Default::default()
            };
            let mut made: Option<ID3D12Resource> = None;
            // SAFETY: plain creation of a buffer.
            unsafe {
                host.device
                    .CreateCommittedResource(
                        &heap,
                        D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE,
                        &desc,
                        state,
                        None,
                        &mut made,
                    )
                    .unwrap();
            }
            made.unwrap()
        };
        let readback = buffer(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_READBACK, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST);
        // The colour target the draws cover: 4x4, 8 bits a texel.
        let target = {
            let heap = D3D12_HEAP_PROPERTIES {
                Type: D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT,
                ..Default::default()
            };
            let desc = D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC {
                Dimension: D3D12_RESOURCE_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D,
                Width: 4,
                Height: 4,
                DepthOrArraySize: 1,
                MipLevels: 1,
                Format: DXGI_FORMAT(61),
                SampleDesc: DXGI_SAMPLE_DESC {
                    Count: 1,
                    Quality: 0,
                },
                Flags: D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_RENDER_TARGET,
                ..Default::default()
            };
            let mut made: Option<ID3D12Resource> = None;
            // SAFETY: plain creation of a texture.
            unsafe {
                host.device
                    .CreateCommittedResource(
                        &heap,
                        D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE,
                        &desc,
                        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET,
                        None,
                        &mut made,
                    )
                    .unwrap();
            }
            made.unwrap()
        };
        let rows_of = |format: i32| D3D12_PLACED_SUBRESOURCE_FOOTPRINT {
            Offset: 0,
            Footprint: D3D12_SUBRESOURCE_FOOTPRINT {
                Format: DXGI_FORMAT(format),
                Width: 4,
                Height: 4,
                Depth: 1,
                RowPitch: 256,
            },
        };
        // A texture's one subresource; rows of a buffer.
        let whole = |texture: &ID3D12Resource| D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION {
            // SAFETY: a borrowed pointer the location never releases.
            pResource: unsafe { std::mem::transmute_copy(texture) },
            Type: D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_TYPE_SUBRESOURCE_INDEX,
            Anonymous: D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION_0 {
                SubresourceIndex: 0,
            },
        };
        let rows = |buffer: &ID3D12Resource, placed: D3D12_PLACED_SUBRESOURCE_FOOTPRINT| {
            D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION {
                // SAFETY: as above.
                pResource: unsafe { std::mem::transmute_copy(buffer) },
                Type: D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_TYPE_PLACED_FOOTPRINT,
                Anonymous: D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION_0 {
                    PlacedFootprint: placed,
                },
            }
        };
        let (written, source, dest, tested, drawn) = (
            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS,
            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE,
            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST,
            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_DEPTH_WRITE,
            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET,
        );
        let moved = crate::host::transition;

        // The class numbers into the twin, where a shader would write them.
        let fill = host.new_list().unwrap();
        // SAFETY: an open list and live resources.
        unsafe {
            let l = &fill.list;
            l.ResourceBarrier(&[moved(plane, written, dest)]);
            l.CopyTextureRegion(&whole(plane), 0, 0, 0, &rows(&upload, rows_of(53)), None);
            l.ResourceBarrier(&[moved(plane, dest, written)]);
        }
        fill.close();
        host.execute(&[&fill]);

        // A list in which a shader writes the twins: closing it draws the
        // depth plane's twin into the plane.
        let list = host.new_list().unwrap();
        assert!(list.twin_use(depth, true, true));
        list.twins_written();
        list.close();
        host.execute(&[&list]);

        // The draws: a triangle over the target at the depth of a class,
        // as the title's lighting places its rectangles.
        const SOURCE: &str = r#"
#define RS "RootConstants(num32BitConstants = 1, b0)"
cbuffer Drawn : register(b0) { uint number; };
[RootSignature(RS)]
float4 corner(uint i : SV_VertexID) : SV_Position {
    float z = float(number) * asfloat(0x37800080);
    return float4(float(i & 1) * 4.0 - 1.0, float(i >> 1) * 4.0 - 1.0, z, 1.0);
}
float4 lit() : SV_Target { return 1.0; }
"#;
        let vs = crate::host::compile(SOURCE, s!("corner"), s!("vs_5_1")).unwrap();
        let ps = crate::host::compile(SOURCE, s!("lit"), s!("ps_5_1")).unwrap();
        let code = |bytes: &[u8]| D3D12_SHADER_BYTECODE {
            pShaderBytecode: bytes.as_ptr().cast(),
            BytecodeLength: bytes.len(),
        };
        let mut blend = D3D12_BLEND_DESC::default();
        blend.RenderTarget[0].RenderTargetWriteMask = 0xf;
        let mut formats = [DXGI_FORMAT(0); 8];
        formats[0] = DXGI_FORMAT(61);
        // SAFETY: plain creation; the description points at live data.
        let (signature, pipeline) = unsafe {
            let signature: ID3D12RootSignature =
                host.device.CreateRootSignature(0, &vs[..]).unwrap();
            let desc = D3D12_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC {
                pRootSignature: std::mem::transmute_copy(&signature),
                VS: code(&vs[..]),
                PS: code(&ps[..]),
                BlendState: blend,
                SampleMask: u32::MAX,
                RasterizerState: D3D12_RASTERIZER_DESC {
                    FillMode: D3D12_FILL_MODE_SOLID,
                    CullMode: D3D12_CULL_MODE_NONE,
                    DepthClipEnable: true.into(),
                    ..Default::default()
                },
                // As the title's lighting: test "equal", nothing written.
                DepthStencilState: D3D12_DEPTH_STENCIL_DESC {
                    DepthEnable: true.into(),
                    DepthWriteMask: D3D12_DEPTH_WRITE_MASK_ZERO,
                    DepthFunc: D3D12_COMPARISON_FUNC_EQUAL,
                    ..Default::default()
                },
                PrimitiveTopologyType: D3D12_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TYPE_TRIANGLE,
                NumRenderTargets: 1,
                RTVFormats: formats,
                DSVFormat: DXGI_FORMAT(45),
                SampleDesc: DXGI_SAMPLE_DESC {
                    Count: 1,
                    Quality: 0,
                },
                ..Default::default()
            };
            let pipeline: ID3D12PipelineState =
                host.device.CreateGraphicsPipelineState(&desc).unwrap();
            (signature, pipeline)
        };
        let state = host_copy(depth).unwrap().state.load(Relaxed);
        let state = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES(state as i32);
        let colour = host.rtv(Some(&target), None);
        let depth_view = host.dsv(
            host_depth,
            Some(&D3D12_DEPTH_STENCIL_VIEW_DESC {
                Format: DXGI_FORMAT(45),
                ViewDimension: D3D12_DSV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D,
                ..Default::default()
            }),
        );
        let back = host.new_list().unwrap();
        // SAFETY: an open list and live resources and views.
        unsafe {
            let l = &back.list;
            if state != tested {
                l.ResourceBarrier(&[moved(host_depth, state, tested)]);
            }
            l.ClearRenderTargetView(colour, &[0.0; 4], None);
            l.SetGraphicsRootSignature(&signature);
            l.SetPipelineState(&pipeline);
            l.OMSetRenderTargets(1, Some(&colour), false, Some(&depth_view));
            l.RSSetViewports(&[D3D12_VIEWPORT {
                TopLeftX: 0.0,
                TopLeftY: 0.0,
                Width: 4.0,
                Height: 4.0,
                MinDepth: 0.0,
                MaxDepth: 1.0,
            }]);
            l.RSSetScissorRects(&[RECT {
                left: 0,
                top: 0,
                right: 4,
                bottom: 4,
            }]);
            l.IASetPrimitiveTopology(D3D_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY(4));
            // Classes 65 and 129 are drawn; the others are not.
            for class in [65u32, 129] {
                l.SetGraphicsRoot32BitConstant(0, class, 0);
                l.DrawInstanced(3, 1, 0, 0);
            }
            l.ResourceBarrier(&[moved(&target, drawn, source)]);
            let (to, from) = (rows(&readback, rows_of(61)), whole(&target));
            l.CopyTextureRegion(&to, 0, 0, 0, &from, None);
        }
        back.close();
        host.execute(&[&back]);
        let mut mapped = std::ptr::null_mut();
        // SAFETY: the copy finished (execute waits); the buffer is 1024 bytes.
        let read = unsafe {
            readback
                .Map(
                    0,
                    Some(&D3D12_RANGE {
                        Begin: 0,
                        End: 1024,
                    }),
                    Some(&mut mapped),
                )
                .unwrap();
            std::slice::from_raw_parts(mapped.cast::<u8>(), 1024)
        };
        for (i, class) in CLASSES.into_iter().enumerate() {
            let covered = read[i / 4 * 256 + i % 4] != 0;
            let drawn = matches!(class, 65 | 129);
            assert_eq!(covered, drawn, "texel {i}, class {class}");
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn committed_and_placed_resources_map_at_their_gpu_address() {
        let null = std::ptr::null();
        let mut committed = null;
        let hr = create_committed(
            null,
            &PROPERTIES,
            0,
            &buffer(256),
            0,
            null.cast(),
            &RESOURCE_IIDS[0],
            &mut committed,
        );
        assert_eq!(hr, S_OK);
        let mut data = std::ptr::null_mut();
        assert_eq!(
            slot::<Map>(committed, 0x40)(committed, 0, null.cast(), &mut data),
            S_OK
        );
        assert_eq!(slot::<Address>(committed, 0x58)(committed), data as u64);
        // SAFETY: the buffer is at least 256 zeroed bytes.
        assert_eq!(unsafe { *data.add(255) }, 0);
        assert_eq!(slot::<Release>(committed, 0x10)(committed), 0);

        let heap = heap(4 * KIB_64);
        let place = |offset, desc: &ResourceDesc, out: &mut This| {
            create_placed(
                null,
                heap,
                offset,
                desc,
                0,
                null.cast(),
                &RESOURCE_IIDS[0],
                out,
            )
        };
        let mut placed = null;
        assert_eq!(place(KIB_64, &buffer(KIB_64), &mut placed), S_OK);
        // SAFETY: a heap we made.
        let base = unsafe { (*heap.cast::<Heap>()).memory.ptr.as_ptr() } as u64;
        assert_eq!(slot::<Address>(placed, 0x58)(placed), base + KIB_64);
        let mut other = null;
        assert_eq!(
            place(4 * KIB_64, &buffer(1), &mut other),
            E_INVALIDARG,
            "past the end"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            place(100, &buffer(1), &mut other),
            E_INVALIDARG,
            "misaligned"
        );
        // The resource keeps the heap alive.
        assert_eq!(slot::<Release>(heap, 0x10)(heap), 1);
        assert_eq!(slot::<Release>(placed, 0x10)(placed), 0);
    }
}
```

`crates/victory-gpu/src/root.rs`:

```rs
//! Root signatures.
//!
//! Serializing goes to the host's `D3D12SerializeRootSignature` (or its
//! versioned form): the description is laid out as on PC, and the blob it
//! returns works as the console's, whose two methods sit in the same slots.
//! The console's own flags (bit 24 and up) are dropped first.
#![allow(clippy::not_unsafe_ptr_arg_deref)]

use std::ffi::{CStr, c_void};
use std::sync::OnceLock;

use crate::object::{
    self, E_INVALIDARG, E_NOTIMPL, HRESULT, Iid, Object, ROOT_SIGNATURE, Table, This, guid,
};
use crate::resource::PAGEABLE_IIDS;

const ROOT_SIGNATURE_IIDS: [Iid; 3] = [
    guid(
        0xc54a6b66,
        0x72df,
        0x4ee8,
        [0x8b, 0xe5, 0xa9, 0x46, 0xa1, 0x42, 0x92, 0x14],
    ),
    PAGEABLE_IIDS[1],
    PAGEABLE_IIDS[2],
];

const CONSOLE_FLAGS: u32 = 0xff00_0000;

#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub struct Desc {
    parameter_count: u32,
    parameters: *const c_void,
    sampler_count: u32,
    samplers: *const c_void,
    flags: u32,
}

/// Every version's description starts with the fields of [`Desc`].
#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub struct VersionedDesc {
    version: u32,
    desc: Desc,
}

type Serialize =
    unsafe extern "system" fn(*const Desc, u32, *mut *mut c_void, *mut *mut c_void) -> HRESULT;
type SerializeVersioned =
    unsafe extern "system" fn(*const VersionedDesc, *mut *mut c_void, *mut *mut c_void) -> HRESULT;

/// An export of the host's `d3d12.dll` in System32, looked up once.
fn host_export(cache: &OnceLock<Option<usize>>, name: &CStr) -> Option<usize> {
    *cache.get_or_init(|| {
        #[cfg(windows)]
        {
            use windows_sys::Win32::System::LibraryLoader::{
                GetProcAddress, LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_SYSTEM32, LoadLibraryExW,
            };
            let dll: Vec<u16> = "d3d12.dll".encode_utf16().chain([0]).collect();
            // SAFETY: a NUL-terminated name; System32 only.
            let module = unsafe {
                LoadLibraryExW(
                    dll.as_ptr(),
                    std::ptr::null_mut(),
                    LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_SYSTEM32,
                )
            };
            if module.is_null() {
                return None;
            }
            // SAFETY: a loaded module and a NUL-terminated name.
            unsafe { GetProcAddress(module, name.as_ptr().cast()) }.map(|f| f as usize)
        }
        #[cfg(not(windows))]
        None
    })
}

fn without_console_flags(desc: Desc) -> Desc {
    if desc.flags & CONSOLE_FLAGS != 0 {
        tracing::debug!(
            flags = format_args!("{:#x}", desc.flags),
            "console root signature flags dropped"
        );
    }
    Desc {
        flags: desc.flags & !CONSOLE_FLAGS,
        ..desc
    }
}

/// `d3d12_xs!D3D12SerializeRootSignature`.
pub extern "system" fn serialize(
    desc: *const Desc,
    version: u32,
    blob: *mut *mut c_void,
    error: *mut *mut c_void,
) -> HRESULT {
    // SAFETY: the title passes a description (null is tolerated).
    let Some(&desc) = (unsafe { desc.as_ref() }) else {
        return E_INVALIDARG;
    };
    static FUNCTION: OnceLock<Option<usize>> = OnceLock::new();
    let Some(address) = host_export(&FUNCTION, c"D3D12SerializeRootSignature") else {
        tracing::warn!("no host d3d12.dll to serialize root signatures");
        return E_NOTIMPL;
    };
    // SAFETY: the export has this signature; it takes what the title passed.
    unsafe {
        std::mem::transmute::<usize, Serialize>(address)(
            &without_console_flags(desc),
            version,
            blob,
            error,
        )
    }
}

/// `d3d12_xs!D3D12SerializeVersionedRootSignature`.
pub extern "system" fn serialize_versioned(
    desc: *const VersionedDesc,
    blob: *mut *mut c_void,
    error: *mut *mut c_void,
) -> HRESULT {
    // SAFETY: the title passes a description (null is tolerated).
    let Some(&desc) = (unsafe { desc.as_ref() }) else {
        return E_INVALIDARG;
    };
    static FUNCTION: OnceLock<Option<usize>> = OnceLock::new();
    let Some(address) = host_export(&FUNCTION, c"D3D12SerializeVersionedRootSignature") else {
        tracing::warn!("no host d3d12.dll to serialize root signatures");
        return E_NOTIMPL;
    };
    let desc = VersionedDesc {
        desc: without_console_flags(desc.desc),
        ..desc
    };
    // SAFETY: the export has this signature; it takes what the title passed.
    unsafe { std::mem::transmute::<usize, SerializeVersioned>(address)(&desc, blob, error) }
}

type Deserialize =
    unsafe extern "system" fn(*const u8, usize, *const Iid, *mut *mut c_void) -> HRESULT;

/// `d3d12_xs!D3D12CreateRootSignatureDeserializer`: our blobs are the
/// host's serialization, so the host's deserializer reads them, and its
/// object (IUnknown, then the description getter) is laid out as the
/// console's. The title's upscaler asks with the PC interface id.
pub extern "system" fn create_deserializer(
    blob: *const u8,
    size: usize,
    iid: *const Iid,
    out: *mut *mut c_void,
) -> HRESULT {
    if blob.is_null() || out.is_null() {
        return E_INVALIDARG;
    }
    static FUNCTION: OnceLock<Option<usize>> = OnceLock::new();
    let Some(address) = host_export(&FUNCTION, c"D3D12CreateRootSignatureDeserializer") else {
        tracing::warn!("no host d3d12.dll to deserialize root signatures");
        return E_NOTIMPL;
    };
    // SAFETY: the export has this signature; it takes what the title passed.
    unsafe { std::mem::transmute::<usize, Deserialize>(address)(blob, size, iid, out) }
}

#[repr(C)]
struct RootSignature {
    object: Object,
    /// The serialized form, kept for translating pipelines later.
    blob: Vec<u8>,
}

/// Device method.
pub(crate) extern "system" fn create(
    _: This,
    _nodes: u32,
    blob: *const u8,
    size: usize,
    iid: *const Iid,
    out: *mut This,
) -> HRESULT {
    if blob.is_null() || size == 0 {
        return E_INVALIDARG;
    }
    // SAFETY: the title passes `size` bytes.
    let blob = unsafe { std::slice::from_raw_parts(blob, size) }.to_vec();
    tracing::debug!(size, "root signature");
    let root = Box::new(RootSignature {
        object: Object::new(&FUNCTIONS),
        blob,
    });
    object::hand_out(ROOT_SIGNATURE, root, iid, &ROOT_SIGNATURE_IIDS, out)
}

extern "system" fn query(this: This, iid: *const Iid, out: *mut This) -> HRESULT {
    let found = object::is(iid, &ROOT_SIGNATURE_IIDS).then_some(this);
    object::answer(ROOT_SIGNATURE, iid, found, out)
}
extern "system" fn release(this: This) -> u32 {
    object::release_boxed::<RootSignature>(this)
}

/// IUnknown 3, object 4, device child 1.
static FUNCTIONS: Table<24> = {
    let mut f = object::d3d12_object(object::missing_table::<ROOT_SIGNATURE, 24>());
    f[0] = query as *const ();
    f[2] = release as *const ();
    f[7] = object::parent_device as *const (); // 0x38
    Table(f)
};

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::object::{S_OK, slot};

    /// One 32-bit constant at b0, serialized by the host, then created.
    #[cfg(windows)]
    #[test]
    fn host_serialized_blobs_create_root_signatures() {
        use windows::Win32::Graphics::Direct3D12::{
            D3D12_ROOT_CONSTANTS, D3D12_ROOT_PARAMETER, D3D12_ROOT_PARAMETER_0,
            D3D12_ROOT_PARAMETER_TYPE_32BIT_CONSTANTS, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_ALL,
        };
        let parameter = D3D12_ROOT_PARAMETER {
            ParameterType: D3D12_ROOT_PARAMETER_TYPE_32BIT_CONSTANTS,
            Anonymous: D3D12_ROOT_PARAMETER_0 {
                Constants: D3D12_ROOT_CONSTANTS {
                    ShaderRegister: 0,
                    RegisterSpace: 0,
                    Num32BitValues: 1,
                },
            },
            ShaderVisibility: D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_ALL,
        };
        let desc = Desc {
            parameter_count: 1,
            parameters: (&raw const parameter).cast(),
            sampler_count: 0,

            flags: 0x0100_0001,
        };
        let (mut blob, mut error) = (std::ptr::null_mut(), std::ptr::null_mut());
        assert_eq!(serialize(&desc, 1, &mut blob, &mut error), S_OK);
        let blob = blob.cast_const().cast::<Object>();
        let data = slot::<extern "system" fn(This) -> *const u8>(blob, 0x18)(blob);
        let size = slot::<extern "system" fn(This) -> usize>(blob, 0x20)(blob);
        assert!(size > 0);

        let mut root = null;
        assert_eq!(
            create(null, 0, data, size, &ROOT_SIGNATURE_IIDS[0], &mut root),
            S_OK
        );
        assert_eq!(slot::<extern "system" fn(This) -> u32>(root, 0x10)(root), 0);
        slot::<extern "system" fn(This) -> u32>(blob, 0x10)(blob);
    }

    /// The host's deserializer reads our blobs back (the upscaler's call).
    #[cfg(windows)]
    #[test]
    fn our_blobs_deserialize_on_the_host() {
        use windows::Win32::Graphics::Direct3D12::ID3D12RootSignatureDeserializer;
        use windows::core::Interface;
        let desc = VersionedDesc {
            version: 1,
            desc: Desc {
                parameter_count: 0,
                parameters: std::ptr::null(),
                sampler_count: 0,
                samplers: std::ptr::null(),
                flags: 1,
            },
        };
        let (mut blob, mut error) = (std::ptr::null_mut(), std::ptr::null_mut());
        assert_eq!(serialize_versioned(&desc, &mut blob, &mut error), S_OK);
        let blob = blob.cast_const().cast::<Object>();
        let data = slot::<extern "system" fn(This) -> *const u8>(blob, 0x18)(blob);
        let size = slot::<extern "system" fn(This) -> usize>(blob, 0x20)(blob);
        let iid: Iid = ID3D12RootSignatureDeserializer::IID.to_u128().to_be_bytes();
        let iid = guid(
            u32::from_be_bytes(iid[0..4].try_into().unwrap()),
            u16::from_be_bytes(iid[4..6].try_into().unwrap()),
            u16::from_be_bytes(iid[6..8].try_into().unwrap()),

        let mut out = std::ptr::null_mut();
        assert_eq!(create_deserializer(data, size, &iid, &mut out), S_OK);
        // SAFETY: the host handed out this interface.
        let deserializer = unsafe { ID3D12RootSignatureDeserializer::from_raw(out) };
        // SAFETY: valid while the deserializer lives.

        assert_eq!((read.NumParameters, read.Flags.0), (0, 1));
```

`crates/victory-gpu/src/sampler.rs`:

```rs
//! Samplers as the host describes them, from the console's sampler
//! description (`CreateSamplerX`), which names the hardware's sampler
//! fields. (Immediate samplers in shader code come decoded with the
//! translation.)

use windows::Win32::Graphics::Direct3D12::*;

/// The fields both forms share.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
struct Fields {
    /// Point 0, bilinear 1, anisotropic point 2, anisotropic bilinear 3.
    mag: u32,
    min: u32,
    /// None 0, point 1, linear 2.
    mip: u32,
    /// Plain 0, minimum 1, maximum 2.
    mode: u32,
    /// Host address modes.
    address: [u32; 3],
    anisotropy: u32,
    /// Host comparison function.
    compare: u32,
    min_lod: f32,
    max_lod: f32,
    bias: f32,
    border: [f32; 4],
}

impl Fields {
    fn host(&self) -> D3D12_SAMPLER_DESC {
        let linear = |f: u32| u32::from(f == 1 || f == 3);
        let aniso = self.mag >= 2 || self.min >= 2;
        // The console compares when the instruction says so, with the
        // sampler's function; the host needs a comparison sampler for that.
        // A sampler given a real test (less ... greater-or-equal) is one;
        // never, always and none are plain samplers.
        const LESS: u32 = 2;
        const GREATER_EQUAL: u32 = 7;
        let compares = (LESS..=GREATER_EQUAL).contains(&self.compare);
        let reduction = match self.mode {
            1 => 2,
            2 => 3,
            _ => u32::from(compares),
        };
        let filter = if aniso {
            0x55
        } else {
            linear(self.min) << 4 | linear(self.mag) << 2 | u32::from(self.mip == 2)
        };
        D3D12_SAMPLER_DESC {
            Filter: D3D12_FILTER((reduction << 7 | filter) as i32),
            AddressU: D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE(self.address[0] as i32),
            AddressV: D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE(self.address[1] as i32),
            AddressW: D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE(self.address[2] as i32),
            MipLODBias: self.bias,
            MaxAnisotropy: if aniso {
                self.anisotropy.clamp(1, 16)
            } else {
                1
            },
            ComparisonFunc: D3D12_COMPARISON_FUNC(self.compare.max(1) as i32),
            BorderColor: self.border,
            MinLOD: self.min_lod,
            // Without a mip filter the console samples mip 0 only.
            MaxLOD: if self.mip == 0 {
                self.min_lod
            } else {
                self.max_lod
            },
        }
    }
}

/// The console's sampler description (27 words): flags, magnification,
/// minification, mip and depth filters, filter mode, three address modes,
/// minimum and maximum LOD, LOD bias, secondary bias, anisotropy, its bias
/// and threshold, comparison, border color, then tuning words.
pub(crate) fn console(words: &[u32; 27]) -> D3D12_SAMPLER_DESC {
    let f = |i: usize| f32::from_bits(words[i]);
    Fields {
        mag: words[1],
        min: words[2],
        mip: words[3],
        mode: words[5],
        address: [words[6], words[7], words[8]],
        min_lod: f(9),
        max_lod: f(10),
        bias: f(11),
        anisotropy: words[13],
        compare: words[16],
        border: [f(17), f(18), f(19), f(20)],
    }
    .host()
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn console_descriptions_decode() {
        let mut w = [0u32; 27];
        w[1] = 1; // bilinear magnification
        w[2] = 0; // point minification
        w[3] = 2; // linear mips
        w[6..9].copy_from_slice(&[3, 3, 3]);
        w[10] = 1000.0f32.to_bits();
        let d = console(&w);
        assert_eq!(d.Filter.0, 0x5, "min point, mag and mip linear");
        assert_eq!(d.AddressW, D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP);
        assert_eq!(d.MaxLOD, 1000.0);
        // A less-or-equal test makes a comparison sampler; never does not.
        w[16] = 4;
        assert_eq!(console(&w).Filter.0, 0x85);
        assert_eq!(console(&w).ComparisonFunc, D3D12_COMPARISON_FUNC_LESS_EQUAL);
        w[16] = 1;
        assert_eq!(console(&w).Filter.0, 0x5);
    }
}
```

`crates/victory-gpu/src/shader_cache.rs`:

```rs
//! Translated shaders kept on disk (decision 0003): under the configured
//! cache folder, keyed by the container's content and by the translator
//! that translated it (its source fingerprint and settings, see `build`), so
//! a changed translator never serves an old translation. Entries go through
//! `victory-pipeline`'s content-addressed cache, which writes them
//! atomically; an entry that does not read back is translated again.
//!
//! The entry is our own encoding of [`HostShader`]: a field added to it
//! must be added to `encode` and `decode` too (entries of older builds
//! are ignored anyway).

use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::sync::OnceLock;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, AtomicU64, Ordering};

use victory_pipeline::{Cache, Converter};
use victory_shader::emit::{HostShader, StaticSampler, UserData};
use victory_shader::resource::RootIndexedView;
use victory_shader::{HwStage, RootType};

static CACHE: OnceLock<Cache> = OnceLock::new();
static HITS: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(0);
static MISSES: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(0);

/// Keeps translated shaders in `dir` from now on.
pub fn use_shader_cache(dir: PathBuf) {
    match Cache::open(dir) {
        Ok(cache) => {
            let _ = CACHE.set(cache);
        }
        Err(e) => tracing::warn!(error = %e, "no shader cache"),
    }
}

/// Shaders found in the cache and translated since the start.
pub(crate) fn counts() -> (u64, u64) {
    (HITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed), MISSES.load(Ordering::Relaxed))
}

/// What identifies the translation, besides the container: the shader
/// crate's fingerprint (its source, every switch it reads, the host facts the
/// device gave it, the loop limit, barrier waits and clean-up passes) and
/// this file's encoding of the result. Not the whole executable any more: a
/// rebuild that leaves the translator alone keeps its translations (each new
/// build used to translate the title's thousands of shaders again, which kept
/// the first minutes of every test run short of pipelines).
/// `VICTORY_SHADER_CACHE_KEY=exe` restores the old key (the executable's hash).
/// Worked out per lookup, so a translation made before the device said its
/// wave size is never filed under the later key.
fn build() -> [u8; 32] {
    static WARNED: std::sync::Once = std::sync::Once::new();
    let limit = victory_shader::emit::loop_limit();
    if limit != victory_shader::emit::DEFAULT_LOOP_LIMIT {
        WARNED.call_once(|| tracing::warn!(limit, "VICTORY_SHADER_LOOP_LIMIT: translated loops stop sooner"));
    }
    static EXE: OnceLock<Option<[u8; 32]>> = OnceLock::new();
    let exe = EXE.get_or_init(|| {
        if std::env::var_os("VICTORY_SHADER_CACHE_KEY").is_some_and(|v| v == "exe") {
            match std::env::current_exe().and_then(std::fs::read) {
                Ok(bytes) => Some(*blake3::hash(&bytes).as_bytes()),
                Err(e) => {
                    tracing::warn!(error = %e, "cannot read our executable; keying on the translator");
                    None
                }
            }
        } else {
            None
        }
    });
    let mut h = blake3::Hasher::new();
    h.update(b"victory shader cache key 2\0");
    if let Some(exe) = exe {
        h.update(exe);
    }
    h.update(&victory_shader::emit::translation_fingerprint());
    h.update(include_bytes!("shader_cache.rs"));
    *h.finalize().as_bytes()
}

/// The offline warm-up (`victory translate --warm`): `container` is
/// translated into the cache unless it is there already. `Ok(true)`: it
/// was translated now. Needs [`use_shader_cache`] and the same host facts
/// the run will have (`victory_shader::emit::translation_fingerprint`).
pub fn warm(container: &[u8]) -> Result<bool, String> {
    let cache = CACHE.get().ok_or("no shader cache")?;
    let ran = AtomicBool::new(false);
    let translate = |c: &[u8]| {
        ran.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
        victory_shader::emit::translate(c).map_err(|e| e.to_string())
    };
    cached(cache, &build(), container, translate).map(|_| ran.load(Ordering::Relaxed))
}

/// The translation of a console shader container, from the cache when
/// there is one.
pub(crate) fn host_shader(container: &[u8]) -> Result<HostShader, String> {
    let translate = |c: &[u8]| victory_shader::emit::translate(c).map_err(|e| e.to_string());
    match CACHE.get() {
        Some(cache) => cached(cache, &build(), container, translate),
        None => translate(container),
    }
}

/// The cache entry's converter: the build and the container in, the
/// encoded translation out. `ran` tells a miss from a hit.
struct Translate<F> {
    translate: F,
    ran: AtomicBool,
}

impl<F: Fn(&[u8]) -> Result<HostShader, String> + Send + Sync> Converter for Translate<F> {
    fn id(&self) -> &'static str {
        "shader.dxil"
    }
    fn version(&self) -> u32 {
        // The build fingerprint in the input does the versioning.
        1
    }
    fn convert(&self, input: &[u8]) -> anyhow::Result<Vec<u8>> {
        self.ran.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
        let shader = (self.translate)(&input[32..]).map_err(anyhow::Error::msg)?;
        Ok(encode(&shader))
    }
}

fn cached(
    cache: &Cache,
    build: &[u8; 32],
    container: &[u8],
    translate: impl Fn(&[u8]) -> Result<HostShader, String> + Send + Sync,
) -> Result<HostShader, String> {
    let input = [&build[..], container].concat();
    let converter = Translate {
        translate,
        ran: AtomicBool::new(false),
    };
    for _ in 0..2 {
        let path = cache
            .get_or_convert(&converter, &input)
            .map_err(|e| format!("{e:#}"))?;
        if let Some(shader) = std::fs::read(&path).ok().and_then(|b| decode(&b)) {
            let (counter, what) = if converter.ran.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
                (&MISSES, "translated and cached")
            } else {
                (&HITS, "from the cache")
            };
            counter.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
            tracing::debug!(path = %path.display(), "shader {what}");
            return Ok(shader);
        }
        tracing::debug!(path = %path.display(), "unreadable shader cache entry; translating again");
        let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&path);
    }
    MISSES.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
    (converter.translate)(container)
}

const MAGIC: &[u8; 4] = b"VSH1";
const STAGES: [HwStage; 8] = [
    HwStage::Ls,
    HwStage::Hs,
    HwStage::Es,
    HwStage::Gs,
    HwStage::Vs,
    HwStage::Ps,
    HwStage::Ms,
    HwStage::Cs,
];

fn root_code(r: RootType) -> u32 {
    match r {
        RootType::Constants => 0,
        RootType::Descriptor => 1,
        RootType::Table => 2,
        RootType::ImmediateSampler => 3,
        RootType::ResourceHeap => 4,
        RootType::SamplerHeap => 5,
        RootType::Other(x) => 6 + x,
    }
}

fn root_type(code: u32) -> RootType {
    match code {
        0 => RootType::Constants,
        1 => RootType::Descriptor,
        2 => RootType::Table,
        3 => RootType::ImmediateSampler,
        4 => RootType::ResourceHeap,
        5 => RootType::SamplerHeap,
        x => RootType::Other(x - 6),
    }
}

/// Little-endian words and length-prefixed lists.
fn encode(s: &HostShader) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut out = MAGIC.to_vec();
    let word = |out: &mut Vec<u8>, v: u32| out.extend(v.to_le_bytes());
    let stage = STAGES.iter().position(|&x| x == s.stage).unwrap_or(0) as u32;
    word(&mut out, stage);
    word(&mut out, s.dxil.len() as u32);
    out.extend(&s.dxil);
    word(&mut out, s.user_data.len() as u32);
    for u in &s.user_data {
        for v in [u.index, u32::from(u.slot), root_code(u.root), u.dword] {
            word(&mut out, v);
        }
    }
    word(&mut out, s.samplers.len() as u32);
    for sampler in &s.samplers {
        for &v in sampler {
            word(&mut out, v);
        }
    }
    word(&mut out, s.static_samplers.len() as u32);
    for t in &s.static_samplers {
        let [u, v, w] = t.address;
        let words = [
            t.filter,
            u,
            v,
            w,
            t.mip_lod_bias.to_bits(),
            t.max_anisotropy,
            t.comparison,
            t.border,
            t.min_lod.to_bits(),
            t.max_lod.to_bits(),
        ];
        for v in words {
            word(&mut out, v);
        }
    }
    for slots in [&s.root_cbvs, &s.root_srvs, &s.root_uavs] {
        word(&mut out, slots.len() as u32);
        out.extend(slots);
    }
    word(&mut out, s.root_indexed_views.len() as u32);
    for view in &s.root_indexed_views {
        for value in [
            u32::from(view.table_slot),
            u32::from(view.constant_slot),
            view.constant_dword,
            view.byte_offset,
            u32::from(view.shift),
        ] {
            word(&mut out, value);
        }
    }
    out
}

fn decode(bytes: &[u8]) -> Option<HostShader> {
    struct Reader<'a>(&'a [u8]);
    impl<'a> Reader<'a> {
        fn take(&mut self, n: usize) -> Option<&'a [u8]> {
            let (head, rest) = self.0.split_at_checked(n)?;
            self.0 = rest;
            Some(head)
        }
        fn word(&mut self) -> Option<u32> {
            Some(u32::from_le_bytes(self.take(4)?.try_into().ok()?))
        }
        fn list(&mut self) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
            let n = self.word()? as usize;
            Some(self.take(n)?.to_vec())
        }
    }
    let mut r = Reader(bytes);
    if r.take(4)? != MAGIC {
        return None;
    }
    let stage = *STAGES.get(r.word()? as usize)?;
    let dxil = r.list()?;
    let n = r.word()? as usize;
    let mut user_data = Vec::with_capacity(n.min(256));
    for _ in 0..n {
        user_data.push(UserData {
            index: r.word()?,
            slot: u8::try_from(r.word()?).ok()?,
            root: root_type(r.word()?),
            dword: r.word()?,
        });
    }
    let n = r.word()? as usize;
    let mut samplers = Vec::with_capacity(n.min(256));
    for _ in 0..n {
        samplers.push([r.word()?, r.word()?, r.word()?, r.word()?]);
    }
    let n = r.word()? as usize;
    let mut static_samplers = Vec::with_capacity(n.min(256));
    for _ in 0..n {
        static_samplers.push(StaticSampler {
            filter: r.word()?,
            address: [r.word()?, r.word()?, r.word()?],
            mip_lod_bias: f32::from_bits(r.word()?),
            max_anisotropy: r.word()?,
            comparison: r.word()?,
            border: r.word()?,
            min_lod: f32::from_bits(r.word()?),
            max_lod: f32::from_bits(r.word()?),
        });
    }
    let root_cbvs = r.list()?;
    let root_srvs = r.list()?;
    let root_uavs = r.list()?;
    let n = r.word()? as usize;
    let mut root_indexed_views = Vec::with_capacity(n.min(256));
    for _ in 0..n {
        root_indexed_views.push(RootIndexedView {
            table_slot: u8::try_from(r.word()?).ok()?,
            constant_slot: u8::try_from(r.word()?).ok()?,
            constant_dword: r.word()?,
            byte_offset: r.word()?,
            shift: u8::try_from(r.word()?).ok().filter(|&s| s < 32)?,
        });
    }
    r.0.is_empty().then_some(HostShader {
        stage,
        dxil,
        user_data,
        samplers,
        static_samplers,
        root_cbvs,
        root_srvs,
        root_uavs,
        root_indexed_views,
    })
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn shader() -> HostShader {
        HostShader {
            stage: HwStage::Ps,
            dxil: b"DXBC and the rest".to_vec(),
            user_data: vec![UserData {
                index: 8,
                slot: 1,
                root: RootType::Table,
                dword: 0,
            }],
            samplers: vec![[0x400, 0xc0_0000, 0x18f0_0000, 0]],
            static_samplers: vec![StaticSampler::from_words([
                0x400,
                0xc0_0000,
                0x18f0_0000,
                0,
            ])],
            root_cbvs: vec![2],
            root_srvs: vec![0, 3],
            root_uavs: vec![1],
            root_indexed_views: vec![RootIndexedView {
                table_slot: 1,
                constant_slot: 2,
                constant_dword: 3,
                byte_offset: 32,
                shift: 5,
            }],
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn translations_come_back_from_the_cache() {
        let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let cache = Cache::open(dir.path()).unwrap();
        let build = [7u8; 32];
        let container = b"a console container".as_slice();
        let runs = AtomicU64::new(0);
        let translate = |_: &[u8]| {
            runs.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
            Ok(shader())
        };
        assert_eq!(cached(&cache, &build, container, translate), Ok(shader()));
        assert_eq!(cached(&cache, &build, container, translate), Ok(shader()));
        assert_eq!(runs.load(Ordering::Relaxed), 1, "the second came from disk");

        // Another build translates again.
        assert_eq!(cached(&cache, &[8; 32], container, translate), Ok(shader()));
        assert_eq!(runs.load(Ordering::Relaxed), 2);

        // A damaged entry is a miss, translated and stored again.
        for e in walk(dir.path()) {
            std::fs::write(e, b"VSH1 broken").unwrap();
        }
        assert_eq!(cached(&cache, &build, container, translate), Ok(shader()));
        assert_eq!(runs.load(Ordering::Relaxed), 3);
        assert_eq!(cached(&cache, &build, container, translate), Ok(shader()));
        assert_eq!(runs.load(Ordering::Relaxed), 3);

        // Failures are not stored.
        let fail = |_: &[u8]| Err::<HostShader, _>("unsupported".to_owned());
        assert!(cached(&cache, &build, b"other", fail).is_err());
    }

    fn walk(dir: &std::path::Path) -> Vec<PathBuf> {
        let mut files = Vec::new();
        for e in std::fs::read_dir(dir).unwrap().flatten() {
            if e.path().is_dir() {
                files.extend(walk(&e.path()));
            } else {
                files.push(e.path());
            }
        }
        files
    }

    #[test]
    fn entries_round_trip_and_reject_damage() {
        let bytes = encode(&shader());
        assert_eq!(decode(&bytes), Some(shader()));
        assert_eq!(decode(&bytes[..bytes.len() - 1]), None);
        assert_eq!(decode(&[bytes.as_slice(), &[0]].concat()), None);
        assert_eq!(decode(b"VSH0"), None);
    }
}
```

`crates/victory-gpu/src/shadow.rs`:

```rs
//! Host copies of title buffers (decision 0007, step 3 and "Copies of title
//! memory"). Title buffers are title memory, which the host GPU cannot
//! read, so a buffer a draw uses gets a persistent host buffer of its size
//! on first use (system memory shaders may also write), and the ranges each
//! submission reads (vertex, index and constant data, buffer views) are
//! brought up to date from title memory before it runs: the 64 KiB pages
//! the title wrote since they were last copied ([`crate::watch`]: write
//! watching, or read-only guards on physical-page views), all of it where
//! neither works. A title GPU address inside the buffer is the same offset
//! in its copy. Ranges shaders write go back to title memory after the
//! submission ([`Shadow::gpu_writes`]).
//!
//! shortcut: only the ranges draws are known to read are brought up to
//! date (vertex and index buffer views, constant buffers in tables, root
//! descriptors, buffer views in tables); buffers read through directly
//! indexed heaps keep what their first use copied.

use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU8, AtomicU64, Ordering};
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};

use windows::Win32::Graphics::Direct3D12::ID3D12Resource;

use crate::host::{HostList, host};
use crate::watch::PAGE;

/// A title buffer's host copy.
pub(crate) struct Shadow {
    pub(crate) buffer: ID3D12Resource,
    data: *mut u8,
    gpu: u64,
    /// Where the title buffer starts and how long it is.
    start: u64,
    len: u64,
    /// Per page of title memory from `start`'s on: the write-watch asking
    /// after which it was last copied (0: never).
    copied: Mutex<Vec<u64>>,
    /// Whether the memory is write-watched: unknown, yes, no.
    watched: AtomicU8,
    /// Ranges shaders of a submission not yet copied back may be writing:
    /// title memory there is older than the copy.
    pending: Mutex<Vec<(usize, usize)>>,
    /// With [`relay`]: how many submissions not yet copied back declared
    /// each range of `pending` ([`Flights`]). Locked inside `pending`'s
    /// lock.
    flights: Mutex<Flights>,
    /// The copy's bytes before the submission ran, for the ranges its
    /// shaders write (`pending`), each at its offset in the copy: what the
    /// GPU wrote differs. Room for the whole copy; only those ranges' bytes
    /// are set (and read).
    before: Mutex<Option<Vec<u8>>>,
    /// With snapshots kept ([`keeps`]): which 64 KiB pieces of the snapshot
    /// hold the copy's bytes as they are now, and whether the snapshot is
    /// counted in [`KEPT_BYTES`].
    kept: Mutex<(Vec<bool>, bool)>,
```
