`crates/victory-hle/src/modules/dsp.rs`:

```rs
//! The console's audio DSP (`chad.dll`): streams that convolve blocks of
//! float samples with an impulse response (reverb), or run other block
//! transforms, on a coprocessor.
//!
//! A title connects once with a memory block for the DSP, activates
//! streams, and submits one command per block (gains, an input and an
//! output buffer). Activation hands back a status block whose second word is
//! the ticket of the last completed command and whose fourth is its result;
//! the title checks it one block later and treats a late command as an
//! overrun. Commands complete when submitted here.
//!
//! The transforms themselves are not computed: the hardware takes impulse
//! responses already in its own partitioned frequency-domain layout, which
//! is not known. Outputs are silence, so reverb returns are dry.
// shortcut: no convolution or block transform; outputs are zeros. Needs the
// coprocessor's impulse response and spectrum layouts to do better.
#![allow(non_snake_case)]
#![allow(clippy::not_unsafe_ptr_arg_deref)]

use std::ffi::c_void;
use std::sync::Mutex;

use super::xasync::E_INVALIDARG;
use super::xgameruntime::{HRESULT, S_OK};
use crate::{HleModule, hle_export};

const E_POINTER: HRESULT = 0x8000_4003_u32 as i32;
const E_OUTOFMEMORY: HRESULT = 0x8007_000E_u32 as i32;

const CONVOLUTION: u32 = 1;
/// Option bits that need a stereo stream, and one convolution refuses.
const STEREO_OPTIONS: u32 = 2 | 8;
const NOT_FOR_CONVOLUTION: u32 = 4;

pub struct Dsp {
    max_streams: u32,
    active: Mutex<u32>,
}

/// What activation describes.
#[repr(C, packed)]
pub struct StreamDesc {
    kind: u32,
    options: u32,
    frames: u32,
    channels: u32,
    ir_floats: u32,
    ir: *const f32,
}

/// The status block a stream's owner polls.
#[repr(C)]
pub struct Status {
    submitted: u32,
    completed: u32,
    reserved: u32,
    result: HRESULT,
}

pub struct Stream {
    dsp: *mut Dsp,
    frames: u32,
    channels: u32,
    status: Box<Status>,
}

/// One block of work.
#[repr(C)]
pub struct Command {
    gains: [f32; 2],
    input: *const f32,
    output: *mut f32,
    reserved: u64,
}

pub extern "system" fn XDspConnectWithMaximumStreamLimit(
    base: *mut c_void,
    base_length: u32,
    ir_seconds: u32,
    max_streams: u32,
    max_channels: u32,
    out: *mut *mut Dsp,
) -> HRESULT {
    if base.is_null()
        || !(0x1_0000..=0x1F40_0000).contains(&base_length)
        || ir_seconds > 0x80
        || max_streams > 0x100
        || max_channels > 2
    {
        return E_INVALIDARG;
    }
    if out.is_null() {
        return E_POINTER;
    }
    tracing::info!(
        base_length,
        ir_seconds,
        max_streams,
        max_channels,
        "audio DSP connected"
    );
    let dsp = Box::new(Dsp {
        max_streams,
        active: Mutex::new(0),
    });
    // SAFETY: checked non-null.
    unsafe { out.write(Box::into_raw(dsp)) };
    S_OK
}

pub extern "system" fn XDspDisconnect(dsp: *mut Dsp) -> HRESULT {
    if dsp.is_null() {
        return E_INVALIDARG;
    }
    // SAFETY: made by `XDspConnectWithMaximumStreamLimit`; disconnected
    // once, after its streams.
    drop(unsafe { Box::from_raw(dsp) });
    S_OK
}

fn valid(desc: &StreamDesc) -> bool {
    let (kind, options, frames, channels) = (desc.kind, desc.options, desc.frames, desc.channels);
    let shape = if kind == CONVOLUTION {
        (1..=2).contains(&channels)
            && matches!(frames, 0x200 | 0x400)
            && options & NOT_FOR_CONVOLUTION == 0
    } else {
        channels == 1 && matches!(frames, 0x200 | 0x400 | 0x800)
    };
    shape && (options & STEREO_OPTIONS == 0 || channels == 2)
}

pub extern "system" fn XDspActivate(
    dsp: *mut Dsp,
    desc: *const StreamDesc,
    status: *mut *const Status,
    stream: *mut *mut Stream,
) -> HRESULT {
    if status.is_null() || stream.is_null() {
        return E_POINTER;
    }
    if dsp.is_null() || desc.is_null() {
        return E_INVALIDARG;
    }
    // SAFETY: checked non-null; the title passes its description.
    let desc = unsafe { &*desc };
    if !valid(desc) {
        return E_INVALIDARG;
    }
    let (kind, options, frames, channels) = (desc.kind, desc.options, desc.frames, desc.channels);
    tracing::debug!(
        kind,
        options,
        frames,
        channels,
        "audio DSP stream activated"
    );
    {
        // SAFETY: a connection from `XDspConnectWithMaximumStreamLimit`.
        let dsp = unsafe { &*dsp };
        let mut active = dsp.active.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
        if *active >= dsp.max_streams {
            return E_OUTOFMEMORY;
        }
        *active += 1;
    }
    let new = Box::new(Stream {
        dsp,
        frames: desc.frames,
        channels: desc.channels,
        status: Box::new(Status {
            submitted: 0,
            completed: 0,
            reserved: 0,
            result: S_OK,
        }),
    });
    // SAFETY: checked non-null.
    unsafe {
        status.write(&*new.status);
        stream.write(Box::into_raw(new));
    }
    S_OK
}

pub extern "system" fn XDspDeactivate(stream: *mut Stream) -> HRESULT {
    if stream.is_null() {
        return E_INVALIDARG;
    }
    // SAFETY: made by `XDspActivate`; deactivated once.
    let stream = unsafe { Box::from_raw(stream) };
    // SAFETY: the connection outlives its streams.
    let dsp = unsafe { &*stream.dsp };
    *dsp.active.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()) -= 1;
    S_OK
}

/// Completes the command at once: its output block is silence.
pub extern "system" fn XDspSubmitCommand(
    stream: *mut Stream,
    command: *const Command,
    ticket: *mut u32,
) -> HRESULT {
    if stream.is_null() || command.is_null() {
        return E_INVALIDARG;
    }
    // SAFETY: a stream from `XDspActivate`, the title's command.
    let (stream, command) = unsafe { (&mut *stream, &*command) };
    if !command.output.is_null() {
        let samples = (stream.frames * stream.channels) as usize;
        // SAFETY: the title's output buffer holds one block of the stream.
        unsafe { std::ptr::write_bytes(command.output, 0, samples) };
    }
    let status = &mut *stream.status;
    let next = status.submitted.wrapping_add(1);
    // SAFETY: the status block is read by title code on other threads.
    unsafe {
        std::ptr::write_volatile(&mut status.submitted, next);
        std::ptr::write_volatile(&mut status.result, S_OK);
        std::ptr::write_volatile(&mut status.completed, next);
    }
    if !ticket.is_null() {
        // SAFETY: optional out parameter.
        unsafe { ticket.write(next) };
    }
    S_OK
}

pub(crate) fn module() -> HleModule {
    HleModule {
        name: "dsp",
        dlls: &["chad.dll"],
        exports: vec![
            hle_export!(XDspConnectWithMaximumStreamLimit),
            hle_export!(XDspDisconnect),
            hle_export!(XDspActivate),
            hle_export!(XDspDeactivate),
            hle_export!(XDspSubmitCommand),
        ],
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn convolution_stream_as_the_title_drives_it() {
        let mut base = vec![0u8; 0x10_0000];
        let mut dsp = std::ptr::null_mut();
        assert_eq!(
            XDspConnectWithMaximumStreamLimit(
                base.as_mut_ptr().cast(),
                0x10_0000,
                24,
                0x80,
                1,
                &mut dsp
            ),
            S_OK
        );
        let ir = vec![0f32; 0x800];
        // Stereo convolution with option 2, as the title asks for.
        let desc = StreamDesc {
            kind: CONVOLUTION,
            options: 2,
            frames: 0x400,
            channels: 2,
            ir_floats: 0x800,
            ir: ir.as_ptr(),
        };
        let (mut status, mut stream) = (std::ptr::null(), std::ptr::null_mut());
        assert_eq!(XDspActivate(dsp, &desc, &mut status, &mut stream), S_OK);
        let mut output = vec![1f32; 0x800];
        let input = vec![0.5f32; 0x800];
        let command = Command {
            gains: [1.0, 1.0],
            input: input.as_ptr(),
            output: output.as_mut_ptr(),
            reserved: 0,
        };
        let mut ticket = 0;
        assert_eq!(XDspSubmitCommand(stream, &command, &mut ticket), S_OK);
        // SAFETY: the stream's status block.
        let (completed, result) = unsafe { ((*status).completed, (*status).result) };
        assert_eq!((completed, result), (ticket, S_OK));
        assert!(output.iter().all(|&s| s == 0.0));
        assert_eq!(XDspDeactivate(stream), S_OK);

        // Mono streams refuse stereo options; transforms are mono only.
        let bad = StreamDesc {
            channels: 1,
            ..desc
        };
        assert_eq!(
            XDspActivate(dsp, &bad, &mut status, &mut stream),
            E_INVALIDARG
        );
        let transform = StreamDesc {
            kind: 2,
            options: 0,
            channels: 1,
            ir_floats: 0,
            ir: std::ptr::null(),
            ..desc
        };
        assert_eq!(
            XDspActivate(dsp, &transform, &mut status, &mut stream),
            S_OK
        );
        assert_eq!(XDspDeactivate(stream), S_OK);
        assert_eq!(XDspDisconnect(dsp), S_OK);
    }
}
```

`crates/victory-hle/src/modules/dstorage.rs`:

```rs
//! The console's DirectStorage (`XCRDAPI.dll`): a factory that opens files
//! and creates request queues and status arrays the title polls. Its
//! interfaces have grown since 2020 (new interface ids, new slots); the
//! slots here are the ones the title calls, read from its call
//! sites. Slots nobody has needed yet log their offset.
//!
//! Submitted requests of every queue run on one pool of workers, as the
//! console's hardware runs them: in parallel, started in queue order,
//! queues served by weighted round robin over their priorities (about 10x
//! per level, counted in bytes), with at most the staging buffer's worth of
//! compressed source in flight. Each request reads its source (a file or
//! memory), inflates zlib data and/or unpacks BCPack data, and writes the
//! destination (an address, or physical pages). Completion is what stays
//! in order: a status entry is written once every request enqueued before
//! it on its queue has finished, with the first failure (in queue order)
//! since the previous status entry, or success.
#![allow(non_snake_case)]
#![allow(clippy::not_unsafe_ptr_arg_deref)]

use std::borrow::Cow;
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet, HashMap, VecDeque};
use std::ffi::{CStr, c_char, c_void};
use std::os::windows::fs::FileExt;
use std::os::windows::io::FromRawHandle;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, AtomicI32, AtomicU32, AtomicU64, Ordering};
use std::sync::{Condvar, Mutex, MutexGuard, OnceLock};

use victory_formats::bcpack::{self, Tables};

use super::xasync::{E_INVALIDARG, E_NOTIMPL, E_PENDING};
use super::xgameruntime::{Guid, HRESULT, Methods, Object, S_OK, add_ref, missing, put};
use crate::{HleModule, hle_export};

/// The factory interface the title asks for.
const FACTORY: Guid = Guid::new(
    0x6295_9d11,
    0xd45f,
    0x4884,
    [0xa0, 0xa3, 0xf7, 0x86, 0x2e, 0xa2, 0x43, 0xae],
);
const E_NOINTERFACE: HRESULT = 0x8000_4002_u32 as i32;
const E_OUTOFMEMORY: HRESULT = 0x8007_000E_u32 as i32;
/// `HRESULT_FROM_WIN32(ERROR_HANDLE_EOF)`: the source ends early.
const END_OF_FILE: HRESULT = 0x8007_0026_u32 as i32;
/// `HRESULT_FROM_WIN32(ERROR_INVALID_DATA)`: a bad compressed stream.
const INVALID_DATA: HRESULT = 0x8007_000D_u32 as i32;

type Out = *mut *mut c_void;

static FACTORY_OBJECT: Object = Object::new("dstorage factory", &FACTORY_VTABLE);

pub extern "system" fn DStorageGetFactory(iid: *const Guid, out: Out) -> HRESULT {
    // SAFETY: the title passes a GUID (null tolerated).
    match unsafe { iid.as_ref() } {
        Some(&iid) if iid == FACTORY => {
            put(out, std::ptr::from_ref(&FACTORY_OBJECT).cast_mut().cast())
        }
        iid => {
            tracing::warn!(iid = ?iid.map(Guid::to_string), "DStorageGetFactory: unknown interface");
            E_NOINTERFACE
        }
    }
}

/// One of our objects with state: the runtime's object header (method
/// table first), a reference count, then `T`.
#[repr(C)]
struct Instance<T> {
    base: Object,
    refs: AtomicU32,
    state: T,
}

impl<T> Instance<T> {
    fn create(base: Object, state: T) -> *mut c_void {
        Box::into_raw(Box::new(Instance {
            base,
            refs: AtomicU32::new(1),
            state,
        }))
        .cast()
    }
}

extern "system" fn add_ref_instance<T>(this: *const Instance<T>) -> u32 {
    // SAFETY: an instance we created and the title still holds.
    unsafe { &*this }.refs.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed) + 1
}

extern "system" fn release<T>(this: *mut Instance<T>) -> u32 {
    // SAFETY: as above.
    let left = unsafe { &*this }.refs.fetch_sub(1, Ordering::AcqRel) - 1;
    if left == 0 {
        // SAFETY: the last reference; created by `Instance::create`.
        drop(unsafe { Box::from_raw(this) });
    }
    left
}

fn iid_text(iid: *const Guid) -> String {
    // SAFETY: the title passes a GUID (null tolerated).
    unsafe { iid.as_ref() }.map_or_else(|| "null".into(), Guid::to_string)
}

/// `HRESULT_FROM_WIN32` of a host error.
fn from_win32(error: &std::io::Error) -> HRESULT {
    error
        .raw_os_error()
        .map_or(E_INVALIDARG, |e| (0x8007_0000 | (e as u32 & 0xffff)) as i32)
}

// The factory.

type Factory = *const Object;

/// Opens `path` for reading; the file object owns the handle.
extern "system" fn open_file(_: Factory, path: *const u16, iid: *const Guid, out: Out) -> HRESULT {
    const GENERIC_READ: u32 = 0x8000_0000;
    const FILE_SHARE_READ: u32 = 1;
    const OPEN_EXISTING: u32 = 3;
    if path.is_null() {
        return E_INVALIDARG;
    }
    // Goes through `files`, so paths on our virtual drives work too.
    let handle = super::files::CreateFileW(
        path,
        GENERIC_READ,
        FILE_SHARE_READ,
        std::ptr::null(),
        OPEN_EXISTING,
        0,
        std::ptr::null_mut(),
    );
    // SAFETY: the title passes a NUL-terminated path.
    let name = unsafe {
        let len = (0..).take_while(|&i| *path.add(i) != 0).count();
        String::from_utf16_lossy(std::slice::from_raw_parts(path, len))
    };
    if handle as isize == -1 {
        let error = std::io::Error::last_os_error();
        tracing::warn!(path = name, %error, "dstorage: opening a file failed");
        return from_win32(&error);
    }
    let kept = name.clone();
    tracing::info!(path = name, iid = iid_text(iid), "dstorage: file opened");
    // SAFETY: a handle we just opened and nobody else owns.
    let file = unsafe { std::fs::File::from_raw_handle(handle) };
    let file = Instance::create(Object::new("dstorage file", &FILE_VTABLE), File { file });
    WALLS_FILES.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()).push((file as usize, kept));
    put(out, file)
}

/// `(capacity, name, iid, out)`.
extern "system" fn create_status_array(
    _: Factory,
    capacity: u32,
    name: *const c_char,
    iid: *const Guid,
    out: Out,
) -> HRESULT {
    tracing::info!(
        capacity,
        name = text(name),
        iid = iid_text(iid),
        "dstorage: status array"
    );
    let entries = (0..capacity).map(|_| AtomicI32::new(S_OK)).collect();
    let array = Instance::create(
        Object::new("dstorage status array", &STATUS_VTABLE),
        StatusArray { entries },
    );
    put(out, array)
}

/// The queue's description: as in 2020 (source type, capacity, priority,
/// name), plus a field the title sets to 1.
#[repr(C)]
struct QueueDesc {
    source_type: u64,
    capacity: u16,
    priority: i8,
    name: *const c_char,
    unknown: u64,
}

extern "system" fn create_queue(
    _: Factory,
    desc: *const QueueDesc,
    iid: *const Guid,
    out: Out,
) -> HRESULT {
    // SAFETY: the title passes its description (null tolerated).
    let Some(desc) = (unsafe { desc.as_ref() }) else {
        return E_INVALIDARG;
    };
    let name = text(desc.name);
    tracing::info!(
        source = desc.source_type,
        capacity = desc.capacity,
        priority = desc.priority,
        name,
        unknown = desc.unknown,
        iid = iid_text(iid),
        "dstorage: queue"
    );
    let Some(scheduler) = scheduler() else {
        return E_OUTOFMEMORY;
    };
    let mut lanes = scheduler.lock();
    let id = lanes.next_id;
    lanes.next_id += 1;
    let lane = Lane::new(desc.priority, desc.capacity);
    lanes.lanes.insert(id, lane);
    drop(lanes);
    put(
        out,
        Instance::create(Object::new("dstorage queue", &QUEUE_VTABLE), Queue { id }),
    )
}

/// The title asks for 32 MiB and stops if this fails.
extern "system" fn set_staging_buffer_size(_: Factory, size: u32) -> HRESULT {
    tracing::info!(size, "dstorage: staging buffer size");
    if let Some(scheduler) = scheduler() {
        scheduler.lock().staging = u64::from(size);
    }
    S_OK
}

fn text(name: *const c_char) -> String {
    if name.is_null() {
        return String::new();
    }
    // SAFETY: a NUL-terminated name from the title.
    unsafe { CStr::from_ptr(name) }
        .to_string_lossy()
        .into_owned()
}

static FACTORY_VTABLE: Methods<16> = Methods([

    missing::<7> as *const (),            // 0x38 (2020: debug flags)

    missing::<9> as *const (),

    missing::<12> as *const (),
    missing::<13> as *const (),
    missing::<14> as *const (),
    missing::<15> as *const (),
```
