`crates/victory-hle/src/modules/lifecycle.rs`:

```rs
//! The title's life cycle. A console title is never told it is closing:
//! quitting it or launching a new game first suspends it (its suspend
//! routines run, and it has a second to save) and then ends the process.
//! Closing the title's window does the same here; a new launch then starts
//! `victory` again, which waits for this process to be gone.
#![allow(non_snake_case)]
#![allow(clippy::not_unsafe_ptr_arg_deref)]
#![allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]

use std::ffi::c_void;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, AtomicUsize, Ordering};
use std::sync::{Mutex, MutexGuard};
use std::time::Duration;

use windows_sys::Win32::Foundation::{HINSTANCE, HWND, LPARAM, LRESULT, RECT, WPARAM};
use windows_sys::Win32::System::Threading::{GetCurrentProcess, TerminateProcess};
use windows_sys::Win32::UI::WindowsAndMessaging::{self as wm, HMENU};
use windows_sys::core::{PCSTR, PCWSTR, w};

use crate::{HleModule, hle_export};

type Routine = extern "system" fn(quiesced: u8, context: *mut c_void);

/// Registration id, routine and context of each suspend routine.
static ROUTINES: Mutex<Vec<(usize, Routine, usize)>> = Mutex::new(Vec::new());

fn routines() -> MutexGuard<'static, Vec<(usize, Routine, usize)>> {
    ROUTINES.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())
}

/// How long the console lets suspend routines run before it ends the title.
const SUSPEND_DEADLINE: Duration = Duration::from_secs(1);

const ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER: u32 = 87;

pub extern "system" fn RegisterAppStateChangeNotification(
    routine: Option<Routine>,
    context: *mut c_void,
    registration: *mut usize,
) -> u32 {
    let Some(routine) = routine else {
        return ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER;
    };
    if registration.is_null() {
        return ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER;
    }
    static NEXT: AtomicUsize = AtomicUsize::new(1);
    let id = NEXT.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
    routines().push((id, routine, context as usize));
    // SAFETY: checked non-null; the title passes room for its registration.
    unsafe { registration.write(id) };
    0
}

pub extern "system" fn UnregisterAppStateChangeNotification(registration: usize) {
    routines().retain(|&(id, ..)| id != registration);
}

/// The window procedure a title window had before ours.
const TITLE_PROC: PCWSTR = w!("victory.wndproc");

pub extern "system" fn CreateWindowExW(
    ex_style: u32,
    class: PCWSTR,
    name: PCWSTR,
    style: u32,
    x: i32,
    y: i32,
    width: i32,
    height: i32,
    parent: HWND,
    menu: HMENU,
    instance: HINSTANCE,
    param: *const c_void,
) -> HWND {
    let (x, y, width, height) = fit(parent, x, y, width, height);
    // SAFETY: the title's own arguments, forwarded (the size fitted).
    let hwnd = unsafe {
        wm::CreateWindowExW(
            ex_style, class, name, style, x, y, width, height, parent, menu, instance, param,
        )
    };
    hook(hwnd);
    hwnd
}

/// See [`CreateWindowExW`].
pub extern "system" fn CreateWindowExA(
    ex_style: u32,
    class: PCSTR,
    name: PCSTR,
    style: u32,
    x: i32,
    y: i32,
    width: i32,
    height: i32,
    parent: HWND,
    menu: HMENU,
    instance: HINSTANCE,
    param: *const c_void,
) -> HWND {
    let (x, y, width, height) = fit(parent, x, y, width, height);
    // SAFETY: the title's own arguments, forwarded (the size fitted).
    let hwnd = unsafe {
        wm::CreateWindowExA(
            ex_style, class, name, style, x, y, width, height, parent, menu, instance, param,
        )
    };
    hook(hwnd);
    hwnd
}

/// A console title sizes its window to its render target (
/// the title: 3840x2160 on a Series X), which can exceed the host's screen.
/// A top-level window larger than the work area is shrunk to fit, keeping
/// its proportions, and centred; what it shows is scaled to it (the swap
/// chain stretches).
fn fit(parent: HWND, x: i32, y: i32, width: i32, height: i32) -> (i32, i32, i32, i32) {
    let mut area = RECT::default();
    // SAFETY: `area` receives the primary monitor's work area.
    let known =
        unsafe { wm::SystemParametersInfoW(wm::SPI_GETWORKAREA, 0, (&raw mut area).cast(), 0) };
    let fitted = fit_into(&area, width, height);
    if !parent.is_null() || known == 0 || fitted == (width, height) {
        return (x, y, width, height);
    }
    tracing::info!(width, height, to = ?fitted, "title window fitted to the screen");
    let (w, h) = fitted;
    let left = area.left + (area.right - area.left - w) / 2;
    let top = area.top + (area.bottom - area.top - h) / 2;
    (left, top, w, h)
}

/// `width` x `height` scaled down to fit `area`, or unchanged if it fits
/// (or is `CW_USEDEFAULT`).
fn fit_into(area: &RECT, width: i32, height: i32) -> (i32, i32) {
    let (aw, ah) = (area.right - area.left, area.bottom - area.top);
    if width <= 0 || height <= 0 || aw <= 0 || ah <= 0 || (width <= aw && height <= ah) {
        return (width, height);
    }
    let scale = f64::min(
        f64::from(aw) / f64::from(width),
        f64::from(ah) / f64::from(height),
    );
    (
        (f64::from(width) * scale) as i32,
        (f64::from(height) * scale) as i32,
    )
}

/// Puts our procedure in front of the title's.
fn hook(hwnd: HWND) {
    if hwnd.is_null() {
        return;
    }
    // SAFETY: a window this thread just created. The title's procedure is
    // stored before ours can run.
    unsafe {
        let title = wm::GetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, wm::GWLP_WNDPROC);
        wm::SetPropW(hwnd, TITLE_PROC, title as *mut c_void);
        wm::SetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, wm::GWLP_WNDPROC, window_proc as *const () as isize);
    }
}

extern "system" fn window_proc(
    hwnd: HWND,
    message: u32,
    wparam: WPARAM,
    lparam: LPARAM,
) -> LRESULT {
    // A user close (close button, Alt+F4, window or taskbar menu); a
    // console title never sees one, nor a WM_CLOSE from it.
    if message == wm::WM_SYSCOMMAND && wparam & 0xFFF0 == wm::SC_CLOSE as usize {
        end_title("window closed", Box::new(|| {}));
        return 0;
    }
    // Alt or F10 puts a window into menu mode: the system runs a modal menu
    // loop on the thread that owns the window, which is the title's. The
    // title then stops (no frames, no input) until a key ends the loop, and
    // nothing shows it, since the window has no menu bar;
    // the title aborts itself about half a minute later. A console has no window
    // menu. The mouse still opens it from the title bar.
    if message == wm::WM_SYSCOMMAND && wparam & 0xFFF0 == wm::SC_KEYMENU as usize {
        return 0;
    }
    // SAFETY: the procedure `hook` stored, called the way the system would.
    unsafe {
        let title = wm::GetPropW(hwnd, TITLE_PROC);
        if message == wm::WM_NCDESTROY {
            wm::RemovePropW(hwnd, TITLE_PROC);
        }
        let title = std::mem::transmute::<*mut c_void, wm::WNDPROC>(title);
        wm::CallWindowProcW(title, hwnd, message, wparam, lparam)
    }
}

/// Suspends the title as the console does when it ends it, runs `then`
/// (once), then ends the process. Returns at once; later calls do nothing.
pub(crate) fn end_title(why: &'static str, then: Box<dyn FnOnce() + Send>) {
    static ENDING: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
    if ENDING.swap(true, Ordering::SeqCst) {
        return;
    }
    let suspend = routines().clone();
    tracing::info!(routines = suspend.len(), "{why}: suspending the title");
    // Whoever comes first (the routines or the deadline) runs `then`; the
    // other waits for it, so the process never ends halfway through.
    let then = std::sync::Arc::new(Mutex::new(Some(then)));
    let finish = move |how: &str| {
        let mut then = then.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
        tracing::info!("{how}; ending the title");
        if let Some(then) = then.take() {
            then();
        }
        end();
    };
    let late = finish.clone();
    // Not on the calling thread: titles hand the suspend to their window
    // thread and wait for it inside the routine.
    std::thread::spawn(move || {
        for (_, routine, context) in suspend {
            routine(1, context as *mut c_void);
        }
        finish("title suspended");
    });
    std::thread::spawn(move || {
        std::thread::sleep(SUSPEND_DEADLINE);
        late("title did not finish suspending in time");
    });
}

/// Set in the environment of a relaunched `victory`: an inherited handle
/// of the process it replaces.
const RELAUNCHED_FROM: &str = "VICTORY_RELAUNCHED_FROM";

/// Starts `victory` again with `args` (after the title has suspended); the
/// new process waits until this one has ended.
pub(crate) fn relaunch(args: Vec<std::ffi::OsString>) {
    use windows_sys::Win32::Foundation::{DUPLICATE_SAME_ACCESS, DuplicateHandle, HANDLE};
    let mut me: HANDLE = std::ptr::null_mut();
    // SAFETY: an inheritable duplicate of our own process handle.
    let duplicated = unsafe {
        DuplicateHandle(
            GetCurrentProcess(),
            GetCurrentProcess(),
            GetCurrentProcess(),
            &mut me,
            0,
            1,
            DUPLICATE_SAME_ACCESS,
        )
    } != 0;
    let spawned = std::env::current_exe().and_then(|exe| {
        let mut command = std::process::Command::new(exe);
        command.args(&args);
        if duplicated {
            command.env(RELAUNCHED_FROM, (me as usize).to_string());
        }
        command.spawn()
    });
    match spawned {
        Ok(child) => tracing::info!(pid = child.id(), ?args, "relaunched"),
        Err(e) => tracing::warn!(%e, "relaunch failed; the title just ends"),
    }
}

/// In a relaunched `victory`: waits (30 s at most) for the process it
/// replaces to be gone, so the two never share the title's files.
pub fn wait_for_previous() {
    use windows_sys::Win32::Foundation::{CloseHandle, HANDLE};
    use windows_sys::Win32::System::Threading::WaitForSingleObject;
    let Some(handle) = std::env::var(RELAUNCHED_FROM)
        .ok()
        .and_then(|h| h.parse::<usize>().ok())
    else {
        return;
    };
    // SAFETY: removing our own variable before any other thread reads it.
    unsafe { std::env::remove_var(RELAUNCHED_FROM) };
    let handle = handle as HANDLE;
    // SAFETY: the inherited process handle the previous process gave us.
    unsafe {
        WaitForSingleObject(handle, 30_000);
        CloseHandle(handle);
    }
}

fn end() {
    // Compiled host pipelines kept for the next run.
    #[cfg(windows)]
    victory_gpu::pipeline::save_pipeline_cache();
    // SAFETY: ends this process, as the console ends a suspended title.
    unsafe { TerminateProcess(GetCurrentProcess(), 0) };
}

pub(crate) fn module() -> HleModule {
    HleModule {
        name: "lifecycle",
        dlls: &[
            "api-ms-win-core-psm-appnotify-*",
            "ext-ms-win-rtcore-ntuser-window-*",
        ],
        exports: vec![
            hle_export!(RegisterAppStateChangeNotification),
            hle_export!(UnregisterAppStateChangeNotification),
            hle_export!(CreateWindowExW),
            hle_export!(CreateWindowExA),
        ],
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {

    fn hooked_windows_still_reach_the_title_procedure() {
        let null = std::ptr::null_mut();
        let hwnd = CreateWindowExW(
            0,
            w!("STATIC"),
            w!("before"),
            0,
            0,
            0,
            10,
            10,
            null,
            null,
            null,
            std::ptr::null(),
        );
        assert!(!hwnd.is_null());
        let mut text = [0u16; 16];
        // SAFETY: our window; the buffer holds 16 characters.
        unsafe {
            wm::SetWindowTextW(hwnd, w!("after"));
            let n = wm::GetWindowTextW(hwnd, text.as_mut_ptr(), 16);
            assert_eq!(String::from_utf16_lossy(&text[..n as usize]), "after");
            assert!(!wm::GetPropW(hwnd, TITLE_PROC).is_null());
            wm::DestroyWindow(hwnd);
        }
    }

    thread_local! {
        /// The system commands `recording` received, low four bits cleared.
        static COMMANDS: std::cell::RefCell<Vec<usize>> = const { std::cell::RefCell::new(Vec::new()) };
    }

    /// Stands in for a title's procedure: notes system commands and acts
    /// on none of them (no menu loop, no minimising).
    extern "system" fn recording(
        hwnd: HWND,
        message: u32,
        wparam: WPARAM,
        lparam: LPARAM,
    ) -> LRESULT {
        if message == wm::WM_SYSCOMMAND {
            COMMANDS.with(|c| c.borrow_mut().push(wparam & 0xFFF0));
            return 0;
        }
        // SAFETY: the system's default procedure, called as the system would.
        unsafe { wm::DefWindowProcW(hwnd, message, wparam, lparam) }
    }

    #[test]
    fn the_keyboard_menu_never_reaches_the_title() {
        let null = std::ptr::null_mut();
        let hwnd = CreateWindowExW(
            0,
            w!("STATIC"),
            w!("menu"),
            0,
            0,
            0,
            10,
            10,
            null,
            null,
            null,
            std::ptr::null(),
        );
        assert!(!hwnd.is_null());
        // SAFETY: our window, owned by this thread, so each message is
        // handled before SendMessageW returns. `recording` stands in for the
        // title's procedure and the original is put back before the window
        // is destroyed.
        unsafe {
            let title = wm::GetPropW(hwnd, TITLE_PROC);
            wm::SetPropW(hwnd, TITLE_PROC, recording as *const () as *mut c_void);
            let command = |c: u32, key: u8| {
                wm::SendMessageW(hwnd, wm::WM_SYSCOMMAND, c as usize, LPARAM::from(key))
            };
            command(wm::SC_KEYMENU, 0); // Alt or F10
            command(wm::SC_KEYMENU, b' '); // Alt+Space
            command(wm::SC_KEYMENU | 1, 0); // the low bits are the system's
            command(wm::SC_MINIMIZE, 0);
            wm::SetPropW(hwnd, TITLE_PROC, title);
            wm::DestroyWindow(hwnd);
        }
        let seen = COMMANDS.with(|c| c.borrow().clone());
        assert_eq!(seen, [wm::SC_MINIMIZE as usize]);
    }
}
```

`crates/victory-hle/src/modules/media.rs`:

```rs
//! Media Foundation is the host's (`mfplat.dll` passes through), except for
//! the source resolver: the host's would fetch `http`, `rtsp` and other
//! URLs over the network, past `modules::net`. Titles get a proxy that
//! opens local files only, with paths on our virtual drives rewritten to
//! their host folders, and forwards everything else to the host's resolver.
#![allow(non_snake_case)]
#![allow(clippy::not_unsafe_ptr_arg_deref)]

use std::collections::HashSet;
use std::ffi::c_void;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU32, Ordering};
use std::sync::{Mutex, OnceLock};

use super::files;
use super::xgameruntime::{HRESULT, S_OK};
use crate::{HleModule, hle_export};

const E_NOINTERFACE: HRESULT = 0x8000_4002_u32 as i32;
const E_POINTER: HRESULT = 0x8000_4003_u32 as i32;
/// What Media Foundation answers for a URL scheme it has no handler for.
const UNSUPPORTED_SCHEME: HRESULT = 0xC00D_36C3_u32 as i32;

const IID_IUNKNOWN: [u8; 16] = guid(0x0000_0000, 0x0000, 0x0000, [0xC0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0x46]);
const IID_RESOLVER: [u8; 16] = guid(
    0xFBE5_A32D,
    0xA497,
    0x4B61,
    [0xBB, 0x85, 0x97, 0xB1, 0xA8, 0x48, 0xA6, 0xE3],
);

const fn guid(a: u32, b: u16, c: u16, d: [u8; 8]) -> [u8; 16] {
    let (a, b, c) = (a.to_le_bytes(), b.to_le_bytes(), c.to_le_bytes());
    [
        a[0], a[1], a[2], a[3], b[0], b[1], c[0], c[1], d[0], d[1], d[2], d[3], d[4], d[5], d[6],
        d[7],
    ]
}

// The URL rule.

/// Where a resolver may read `url` from: `Ok` with the NUL-terminated
/// string to hand to the host, or `Err((scheme, host))` for anything that
/// is not a local file.
fn local(url: &[u16]) -> Result<Vec<u16>, (String, String)> {
    let text = String::from_utf16_lossy(url);
    let drive = |s: &str| {
        let b = s.as_bytes();
        b.len() >= 2 && b[0].is_ascii_alphabetic() && b[1] == b':'
    };
    let host_of = |rest: &str| rest.split(['/', '\\']).next().unwrap_or("").to_string();
    let path = if let Some(rest) = text.strip_prefix(r"\\?\") {
        if !drive(rest) {
            return Err(("unc".into(), host_of(rest.trim_start_matches("UNC\\"))));
        }
        text.clone()
    } else if let Some(rest) = text.strip_prefix(r"\\").or_else(|| text.strip_prefix("//")) {
        return Err(("unc".into(), host_of(rest)));
    } else if drive(&text) {
        text.clone()
    } else if let Some((scheme, rest)) = text.split_once(':').filter(|(s, _)| {
        s.len() > 1
            && s.bytes()
                .all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || b"+-.".contains(&c))
    }) {
        let scheme = scheme.to_ascii_lowercase();
        let authority = rest.strip_prefix("//");
        if scheme != "file" {
            return Err((scheme, authority.map(host_of).unwrap_or_default()));
        }
        let path = match authority {
            Some(rest) => {
                let host = host_of(rest);
                if !host.is_empty() && !host.eq_ignore_ascii_case("localhost") {
                    return Err((scheme, host));
                }
                &rest[host.len()..]
            }
            None => rest,
        };
        let path = percent_decode(path.trim_start_matches(['/', '\\'])).replace('/', "\\");
        if !drive(&path) {
            // A local file without a drive: the host resolves it as is.
            return Ok(with_nul(url));
        }
        path
    } else {
        // A relative path.
        return Ok(with_nul(url));
    };
    let wide: Vec<u16> = path.encode_utf16().collect();
    Ok(files::translate(&wide).unwrap_or_else(|| with_nul(&wide)))
}

fn with_nul(s: &[u16]) -> Vec<u16> {
    s.iter().copied().chain([0]).collect()
}

fn percent_decode(s: &str) -> String {
    let b = s.as_bytes();
    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(b.len());
    let mut i = 0;
    while i < b.len() {
        let hex = b
            .get(i + 1..i + 3)
            .and_then(|h| std::str::from_utf8(h).ok());
        match (b[i], hex.and_then(|h| u8::from_str_radix(h, 16).ok())) {
            (b'%', Some(v)) => {
                out.push(v);
                i += 3;
            }
            (c, _) => {
                out.push(c);
                i += 1;
            }
        }
    }
    String::from_utf8_lossy(&out).into_owned()
}

/// The URL to give the host, or the refusal (logged once per scheme and
/// host).
fn checked(url: *const u16) -> Result<Vec<u16>, HRESULT> {
    if url.is_null() {
        return Err(E_POINTER);
    }
    // SAFETY: a NUL-terminated wide string from the title.
    let len = (0..)
        .take_while(|&i| unsafe { url.add(i).read() } != 0)
        .count();
    // SAFETY: as above, `len` characters before the NUL.
    let wide = unsafe { std::slice::from_raw_parts(url, len) };
    local(wide).map_err(|(scheme, host)| {
        static REFUSED: Mutex<Option<HashSet<(String, String)>>> = Mutex::new(None);
        let mut refused = REFUSED.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
        if refused
            .get_or_insert_with(HashSet::new)
            .insert((scheme.clone(), host.clone()))
        {
            tracing::warn!(
                scheme,
                host,
                "media: refused a URL that is not a local file"
            );
        }
        UNSUPPORTED_SCHEME
    })
}

// The proxy resolver.

/// The host's resolver, called through its method table.
#[repr(C)]
struct Host {
    vtable: *const usize,
}

impl Host {
    /// Method `n` of the host object, typed by the caller.
    unsafe fn method<F: Copy>(this: *mut Host, n: usize) -> F {
        // SAFETY: the caller names the slot's real signature; `this` is the
        // host's live resolver.
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute_copy(&*(*this).vtable.add(n)) }
    }
}

#[repr(C)]
pub struct Resolver {
    vtable: &'static Methods,
    host: *mut Host,
    refs: AtomicU32,
}

type Unknown = *mut c_void;

#[repr(C)]
struct Methods {
    query_interface:
        extern "system" fn(*mut Resolver, *const [u8; 16], *mut *mut c_void) -> HRESULT,
    add_ref: extern "system" fn(*mut Resolver) -> u32,
    release: extern "system" fn(*mut Resolver) -> u32,
    create_from_url: extern "system" fn(
        *mut Resolver,
        *const u16,
        u32,
        Unknown,
        *mut u32,
        *mut Unknown,
    ) -> HRESULT,
    create_from_stream: extern "system" fn(
        *mut Resolver,
        Unknown,
        *const u16,
        u32,
        Unknown,
        *mut u32,
        *mut Unknown,
    ) -> HRESULT,
    begin_from_url: extern "system" fn(
        *mut Resolver,
        *const u16,
        u32,
        Unknown,
        *mut Unknown,
        Unknown,
        Unknown,
    ) -> HRESULT,
    end_from_url: extern "system" fn(*mut Resolver, Unknown, *mut u32, *mut Unknown) -> HRESULT,
    begin_from_stream: extern "system" fn(
        *mut Resolver,
        Unknown,
        *const u16,
        u32,
        Unknown,
        *mut Unknown,
        Unknown,
        Unknown,
    ) -> HRESULT,
    end_from_stream: extern "system" fn(*mut Resolver, Unknown, *mut u32, *mut Unknown) -> HRESULT,
    cancel: extern "system" fn(*mut Resolver, Unknown) -> HRESULT,
}

static METHODS: Methods = Methods {
    query_interface,
    add_ref,
    release,
    create_from_url,
    create_from_stream,
    begin_from_url,
    end_from_url,
    begin_from_stream,
    end_from_stream,
    cancel,
};

fn host(this: *mut Resolver) -> *mut Host {
    // SAFETY: title code calls methods on a proxy we made, alive until its
    // last release.
    unsafe { (*this).host }
}

/// Only the resolver's own interfaces: anything else could hand out the
/// host object unguarded.
extern "system" fn query_interface(
    this: *mut Resolver,
    iid: *const [u8; 16],
    out: *mut *mut c_void,
) -> HRESULT {
    if iid.is_null() || out.is_null() {
        return E_POINTER;
    }
    // SAFETY: checked non-null.
    let iid = unsafe { *iid };
    let found = iid == IID_IUNKNOWN || iid == IID_RESOLVER;
    // SAFETY: checked non-null.
    unsafe {
        out.write(if found {
            this.cast()
        } else {
            std::ptr::null_mut()
        })
    };
    if !found {
        return E_NOINTERFACE;
    }
    add_ref(this);
    S_OK
}

extern "system" fn add_ref(this: *mut Resolver) -> u32 {
    // SAFETY: as in `host`.
    unsafe { (*this).refs.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed) + 1 }
}

extern "system" fn release(this: *mut Resolver) -> u32 {
    // SAFETY: as in `host`.
    let left = unsafe { (*this).refs.fetch_sub(1, Ordering::AcqRel) } - 1;
    if left == 0 {
        // SAFETY: made by `MFCreateSourceResolver`; this was the last
        // reference, to the proxy and to the host object it holds.
        let proxy = unsafe { Box::from_raw(this) };
        // SAFETY: slot 2 is `Release`.
        let release: extern "system" fn(*mut Host) -> u32 = unsafe { Host::method(proxy.host, 2) };
        release(proxy.host);
    }
    left
}

extern "system" fn create_from_url(
    this: *mut Resolver,
    url: *const u16,
    flags: u32,
    props: Unknown,
    kind: *mut u32,
    object: *mut Unknown,
) -> HRESULT {
    let url = match checked(url) {
        Ok(url) => url,
        Err(error) => {
            if !object.is_null() {
                // SAFETY: the title's out parameter.
                unsafe { object.write(std::ptr::null_mut()) };
            }
            return error;
        }
    };
    let host = host(this);
    // SAFETY: slot 3 is `CreateObjectFromURL`.
    let f: extern "system" fn(
        *mut Host,
        *const u16,
        u32,
        Unknown,
        *mut u32,
        *mut Unknown,
    ) -> HRESULT = unsafe { Host::method(host, 3) };
    f(host, url.as_ptr(), flags, props, kind, object)
}

extern "system" fn begin_from_url(
    this: *mut Resolver,
    url: *const u16,
    flags: u32,
    props: Unknown,
    cookie: *mut Unknown,
    callback: Unknown,
    state: Unknown,
) -> HRESULT {
    let url = match checked(url) {
        Ok(url) => url,
        Err(error) => return error,
    };
    let host = host(this);
    // SAFETY: slot 5 is `BeginCreateObjectFromURL`.
    let f: extern "system" fn(
        *mut Host,
        *const u16,
        u32,
        Unknown,
        *mut Unknown,
        Unknown,
        Unknown,
    ) -> HRESULT = unsafe { Host::method(host, 5) };
    f(host, url.as_ptr(), flags, props, cookie, callback, state)
}

extern "system" fn create_from_stream(
    this: *mut Resolver,
    stream: Unknown,
    url: *const u16,
    flags: u32,
    props: Unknown,
    kind: *mut u32,
    object: *mut Unknown,
) -> HRESULT {
    let host = host(this);
    // SAFETY: slot 4 is `CreateObjectFromByteStream`; the URL is only a
    // hint for picking a handler.
    let f: extern "system" fn(
        *mut Host,
        Unknown,
        *const u16,
        u32,
        Unknown,
        *mut u32,
        *mut Unknown,
    ) -> HRESULT = unsafe { Host::method(host, 4) };
    f(host, stream, url, flags, props, kind, object)
}

extern "system" fn end_from_url(
    this: *mut Resolver,
    result: Unknown,
    kind: *mut u32,
    object: *mut Unknown,
) -> HRESULT {
    let host = host(this);
    // SAFETY: slot 6 is `EndCreateObjectFromURL`.
    let f: extern "system" fn(*mut Host, Unknown, *mut u32, *mut Unknown) -> HRESULT =
        unsafe { Host::method(host, 6) };
    f(host, result, kind, object)
}

#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
extern "system" fn begin_from_stream(
    this: *mut Resolver,
    stream: Unknown,
    url: *const u16,
    flags: u32,
    props: Unknown,
    cookie: *mut Unknown,
    callback: Unknown,
    state: Unknown,
) -> HRESULT {
    let host = host(this);
    // SAFETY: slot 7 is `BeginCreateObjectFromByteStream`.
    let f: extern "system" fn(
        *mut Host,
        Unknown,
        *const u16,
        u32,
        Unknown,
        *mut Unknown,
        Unknown,
        Unknown,
    ) -> HRESULT = unsafe { Host::method(host, 7) };
    f(host, stream, url, flags, props, cookie, callback, state)
}

extern "system" fn end_from_stream(
    this: *mut Resolver,
    result: Unknown,
    kind: *mut u32,
    object: *mut Unknown,
) -> HRESULT {
    let host = host(this);
    // SAFETY: slot 8 is `EndCreateObjectFromByteStream`.
    let f: extern "system" fn(*mut Host, Unknown, *mut u32, *mut Unknown) -> HRESULT =
        unsafe { Host::method(host, 8) };
    f(host, result, kind, object)
}

extern "system" fn cancel(this: *mut Resolver, cookie: Unknown) -> HRESULT {
    let host = host(this);
    // SAFETY: slot 9 is `CancelObjectCreation`.
    let f: extern "system" fn(*mut Host, Unknown) -> HRESULT = unsafe { Host::method(host, 9) };
    f(host, cookie)
}

/// The host's resolver behind our proxy.
pub extern "system" fn MFCreateSourceResolver(out: *mut *mut Resolver) -> HRESULT {
    if out.is_null() {
        return E_POINTER;
    }
    static CREATE: OnceLock<Option<usize>> = OnceLock::new();
    let Some(create) =
        *CREATE.get_or_init(|| crate::host::function("mfplat.dll", "MFCreateSourceResolver"))
    else {
        return UNSUPPORTED_SCHEME;
    };
    // SAFETY: the host's `MFCreateSourceResolver(IMFSourceResolver**)`.
    let create: extern "system" fn(*mut *mut Host) -> HRESULT =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute(create) };
    let mut host = std::ptr::null_mut();
    let hr = create(&mut host);
    if hr < 0 || host.is_null() {
        return hr;
    }
    let proxy = Box::new(Resolver {
        vtable: &METHODS,
        host,
        refs: AtomicU32::new(1),
    });
    // SAFETY: checked non-null.
    unsafe { out.write(Box::into_raw(proxy)) };
    S_OK
}

pub(crate) fn module() -> HleModule {
    HleModule {
        name: "media",
        dlls: &["mfplat.dll"],
        exports: vec![hle_export!(MFCreateSourceResolver)],
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn wide(s: &str) -> Vec<u16> {
        s.encode_utf16().collect()
    }

    fn text(v: &[u16]) -> String {
        String::from_utf16_lossy(v.strip_suffix(&[0]).unwrap_or(v))
    }

    #[test]
    fn only_local_files_reach_the_host() {
        // Network schemes and shares are refused, naming scheme and host.
        let refused = |url: &str| local(&wide(url)).unwrap_err();
        assert_eq!(
            refused("https://cdn.example.com/a.mp4"),
            ("https".into(), "cdn.example.com".into())
        );
        assert_eq!(refused("RTSP://10.0.0.1:554/x").0, "rtsp");
        assert_eq!(refused("mms://h/x").0, "mms");
        assert_eq!(
            refused(r"\\server\share\a.mp4"),
            ("unc".into(), "server".into())
        );
        assert_eq!(
            refused("file://server/share/a.mp4"),
            ("file".into(), "server".into())
        );

        // A path on a virtual drive goes to its host folder, also as a
        // `file:` URL; other local files pass as they are.
        // Checked by opening the files: `files` may spell the host root
        // differently (absolute, `\\?\` for long paths) from the temp dir.
        let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        std::fs::create_dir(dir.path().join("movies")).unwrap();
        std::fs::write(dir.path().join("movies").join("intro.mp4"), b"1").unwrap();
        std::fs::write(dir.path().join("movies").join("intro a.mp4"), b"2").unwrap();
        let letter = files::mount(dir.path()).expect("a free drive letter");
        let host = text(&local(&wide(&format!(r"{letter}:\movies\intro.mp4"))).unwrap());
        assert_eq!(
            std::fs::read(&host).ok().as_deref(),
            Some(&b"1"[..]),
            "{host}"
        );
        let from_url =
            text(&local(&wide(&format!("file:///{letter}:/movies/intro%20a.mp4"))).unwrap());
        assert_eq!(
            std::fs::read(&from_url).ok().as_deref(),
            Some(&b"2"[..]),
            "{from_url}"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            text(&local(&wide("file:///C:/Windows/a.wav")).unwrap()),
            r"C:\Windows\a.wav"
        );
        assert_eq!(text(&local(&wide("clip.mp4")).unwrap()), "clip.mp4");
    }

    #[test]
    fn interface_ids_are_the_resolvers() {
        assert_eq!(&IID_IUNKNOWN[8..], &[0xC0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0x46]);
        assert_eq!(&IID_RESOLVER[..4], &[0x2D, 0xA3, 0xE5, 0xFB]);
    }
}
```

`crates/victory-hle/src/modules/net.rs`:

```rs
//! A console without a network cable: the title reaches loopback only.
//!
//! Every way out of Winsock and WinHTTP a title can import or look up by
//! name is vetted here; the rest of both DLLs is the host's own.
//!
//! * Connects (also by name, by list, `ConnectEx` from `WSAIoctl`) and
//!   datagram sends to anything but 127.0.0.0/8 and ::1 fail with
//!   `WSAENETUNREACH`.
//! * Forward lookups other than `localhost` and IP literals fail with
//!   `WSAHOST_NOT_FOUND`; reverse lookups of other addresses come back
//!   numeric, or fail if a name is required, as with no network.
//! * `WinHttpConnect` to a host that is not loopback fails with
//!   `ERROR_WINHTTP_CANNOT_CONNECT`, so no request (or WebSocket) handle can
//!   exist for one. Proxies are off and proxy auto-detection (WPAD, PAC
//!   downloads) fails with `ERROR_WINHTTP_AUTODETECTION_FAILED`.
//! * A bind to all interfaces is narrowed to loopback, so nothing on the
//!   network can connect in.
#![allow(non_snake_case)]
#![allow(clippy::not_unsafe_ptr_arg_deref)]
#![allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]

use std::ffi::{CStr, c_char, c_void};
use std::net::{IpAddr, SocketAddr};
use std::sync::Mutex;

use windows_sys::Win32::Foundation::SetLastError;

use crate::modules::files::host;
use crate::{HleExport, HleModule, hle_export};

const SOCKET_ERROR: i32 = -1;
const INVALID_SOCKET: Socket = !0;
const WSAEINVAL: i32 = 10022;
const WSAEADDRNOTAVAIL: i32 = 10049;
const WSAENETUNREACH: i32 = 10051;
const WSASERVICE_NOT_FOUND: i32 = 10108;
const WSAHOST_NOT_FOUND: i32 = 11001;
const ERROR_WINHTTP_CANNOT_CONNECT: u32 = 12029;
const ERROR_WINHTTP_AUTODETECTION_FAILED: u32 = 12180;
const AF_INET: u16 = 2;
const AF_INET6: u16 = 23;
const NI_NUMERICHOST: i32 = 0x02;
const NI_NAMEREQD: i32 = 0x04;
const SIO_GET_EXTENSION_FUNCTION_POINTER: u32 = 0xC800_0006;
const SIO_GET_MULTIPLE_EXTENSION_FUNCTION_POINTER: u32 = 0xC800_0024;
const WINHTTP_ACCESS_TYPE_NO_PROXY: u32 = 1;
const WINHTTP_OPTION_PROXY: u32 = 38;

#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
struct Guid(u32, u16, u16, [u8; 8]);

const WSAID_CONNECTEX: Guid = Guid(
    0x25a2_07b9,
    0xddf3,
    0x4660,
    [0x8e, 0xe9, 0x76, 0xe5, 0x8c, 0x74, 0x06, 0x3e],
);
const WSAID_WSASENDMSG: Guid = Guid(
    0xa441_e712,
    0x754f,
    0x43ca,
    [0x84, 0xa7, 0x0d, 0xee, 0x44, 0xcf, 0x60, 0x6d],
);

type Socket = usize;
type Handle = *mut c_void;

/// Logs `what` for `destination` the first time (no payload, ever).
fn once(what: &'static str, destination: String) {
    static SEEN: Mutex<Vec<(&str, String)>> = Mutex::new(Vec::new());
    let mut seen = SEEN.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    if !seen.iter().any(|(w, d)| *w == what && *d == destination) {
        tracing::info!(%destination, "{what}");
        seen.push((what, destination));
    }
}

fn wsa_error(code: i32) {
    host!("ws2_32.dll", "WSASetLastError": extern "system" fn(i32))(code);
}

fn narrow(text: *const c_char) -> Option<String> {
    (!text.is_null()).then(|| {
        // SAFETY: the title passes a NUL-terminated string.
        unsafe { CStr::from_ptr(text) }
            .to_string_lossy()
            .into_owned()
    })
}

fn wide(text: *const u16) -> Option<String> {
    // SAFETY: the title passes a NUL-terminated string or null.
    (!text.is_null()).then(|| unsafe {
        let len = (0..).take_while(|&i| *text.add(i) != 0).count();
        String::from_utf16_lossy(std::slice::from_raw_parts(text, len))
    })
}

/// An IPv4 or IPv6 `sockaddr` of `len` bytes.
fn socket_addr(addr: *const u8, len: i32) -> Option<SocketAddr> {
    let len = usize::try_from(len).ok()?;
    if addr.is_null() || len < 4 {
        return None;
    }
    // SAFETY: the title passes `len` readable bytes.
    let b = unsafe { std::slice::from_raw_parts(addr, len) };
    let port = u16::from_be_bytes([b[2], b[3]]);
    match u16::from_le_bytes([b[0], b[1]]) {
        AF_INET if len >= 16 => Some((<[u8; 4]>::try_from(&b[4..8]).ok()?, port).into()),
        AF_INET6 if len >= 28 => Some((<[u8; 16]>::try_from(&b[8..24]).ok()?, port).into()),
        _ => None,
    }
}

/// A raw address of family `kind` (`gethostbyaddr` style).
fn raw_ip(addr: *const c_char, len: i32, kind: i32) -> Option<IpAddr> {
    let len = usize::try_from(len).ok()?;
    if addr.is_null() {
        return None;
    }
    // SAFETY: the title passes `len` readable bytes.
    let b = unsafe { std::slice::from_raw_parts(addr.cast::<u8>(), len) };
    match (u16::try_from(kind).ok()?, len) {
        (AF_INET, 4..) => Some(<[u8; 4]>::try_from(&b[..4]).ok()?.into()),
        (AF_INET6, 16..) => Some(<[u8; 16]>::try_from(&b[..16]).ok()?.into()),
        _ => None,
    }
}

fn loopback(ip: IpAddr) -> bool {
    ip.to_canonical().is_loopback()
}

/// `localhost` or a loopback literal (bracketed IPv6 too).
fn loopback_name(name: &str) -> bool {
    let bare = name.trim_start_matches('[').trim_end_matches(']');
    bare.eq_ignore_ascii_case("localhost") || bare.parse().is_ok_and(loopback)
}

fn shown(addr: Option<impl ToString>) -> String {
    addr.map_or_else(|| "not an IP address".into(), |a| a.to_string())
}

/// True for a loopback `sockaddr`; otherwise logs it and sets
/// `WSAENETUNREACH`. Other address families count as off the machine.
fn reachable(what: &'static str, addr: *const u8, len: i32) -> bool {
    match socket_addr(addr, len) {
        Some(a) if loopback(a.ip()) => true,
        a => {
            once(what, shown(a));
            wsa_error(WSAENETUNREACH);
            false
        }
    }
}

/// Connecting by name: only to loopback. A name would need a lookup
/// (`WSAHOST_NOT_FOUND`), an address a route (`WSAENETUNREACH`).
fn reachable_name(name: Option<String>) -> bool {
    match name {
        Some(name) if !loopback_name(&name) => {
            let literal = name.parse::<IpAddr>().is_ok();
            once("network connect blocked", name);
            wsa_error(if literal {
                WSAENETUNREACH
            } else {
                WSAHOST_NOT_FOUND
            });
            false
        }
        // No name: the host rejects the call itself.
        _ => true,
    }
}

/// Names answered without asking the network: none, `localhost`, IP
/// literals (connecting to one is vetted separately).
fn resolvable(name: Option<String>) -> bool {
    match name {
        Some(name)
            if !(name.is_empty()
                || name.eq_ignore_ascii_case("localhost")
                || name.parse::<IpAddr>().is_ok()) =>
        {
            once("network name lookup blocked", name);
            wsa_error(WSAHOST_NOT_FOUND);
            false
        }
        _ => true,
    }
}

/// Reverse lookups ask DNS unless the address is loopback.
fn reverse_resolvable(ip: Option<IpAddr>) -> bool {
    match ip {
        Some(ip) if loopback(ip) => true,
        ip => {
            once("network reverse lookup blocked", shown(ip));
            false
        }
    }
}

/// `getnameinfo` flags that keep a host name lookup on the machine: the
/// numeric form, as without a network, or `None` if a name is required.
fn name_info_flags(sa: *const u8, len: i32, host_wanted: bool, flags: i32) -> Option<i32> {
    if !host_wanted
        || flags & NI_NUMERICHOST != 0
        || reverse_resolvable(socket_addr(sa, len).map(|a| a.ip()))
    {
        Some(flags)
    } else if flags & NI_NAMEREQD != 0 {
        wsa_error(WSAHOST_NOT_FOUND);
        None
    } else {
        Some(flags | NI_NUMERICHOST)
    }
}

// Connects.

pub extern "system" fn connect(s: Socket, name: *const u8, len: i32) -> i32 {
    if !reachable("network connect blocked", name, len) {
        return SOCKET_ERROR;
    }
    host!("ws2_32.dll", "connect": extern "system" fn(Socket, *const u8, i32) -> i32)(s, name, len)
}

pub extern "system" fn WSAConnect(
    s: Socket,
    name: *const u8,
    len: i32,
    caller_data: *const c_void,
    callee_data: *mut c_void,
    sqos: *const c_void,
    gqos: *const c_void,
) -> i32 {
    if !reachable("network connect blocked", name, len) {
        return SOCKET_ERROR;
    }
    host!("ws2_32.dll", "WSAConnect": extern "system" fn(Socket, *const u8, i32, *const c_void, *mut c_void, *const c_void, *const c_void) -> i32)(
        s,
        name,
        len,
        caller_data,
        callee_data,
        sqos,
        gqos,
    )
}

/// `SOCKET_ADDRESS`; a `SOCKET_ADDRESS_LIST` is an `i32` count, then these
/// (pointer aligned).
#[repr(C)]
struct SocketAddress {
    addr: *const u8,
    len: i32,
}

/// Every candidate must be loopback.
pub extern "system" fn WSAConnectByList(
    s: Socket,
    list: *const u8,
    local_len: *mut u32,
    local: *mut c_void,
    remote_len: *mut u32,
    remote: *mut c_void,
    timeout: *const c_void,
    reserved: *mut c_void,
) -> i32 {
    if !list.is_null() {
        // SAFETY: the title passes a `SOCKET_ADDRESS_LIST`.
        let entries = unsafe {
            let count = usize::try_from(list.cast::<i32>().read()).unwrap_or(0);
            std::slice::from_raw_parts(list.add(8).cast::<SocketAddress>(), count)
        };
        if !entries
            .iter()
            .all(|e| reachable("network connect blocked", e.addr, e.len))
        {
            return 0;
        }
    }
    host!("ws2_32.dll", "WSAConnectByList": extern "system" fn(Socket, *const u8, *mut u32, *mut c_void, *mut u32, *mut c_void, *const c_void, *mut c_void) -> i32)(
        s, list, local_len, local, remote_len, remote, timeout, reserved,
    )
}

pub extern "system" fn WSAJoinLeaf(
    s: Socket,
    name: *const u8,
    len: i32,
    caller_data: *const c_void,
    callee_data: *mut c_void,
    sqos: *const c_void,
    gqos: *const c_void,
    flags: u32,
) -> Socket {
    if !reachable("network connect blocked", name, len) {
        return INVALID_SOCKET;
    }
    host!("ws2_32.dll", "WSAJoinLeaf": extern "system" fn(Socket, *const u8, i32, *const c_void, *mut c_void, *const c_void, *const c_void, u32) -> Socket)(
        s,
        name,
        len,
        caller_data,
        callee_data,
        sqos,
        gqos,
        flags,
    )
}

/// `ConnectEx` as `WSAIoctl` hands it out: vetted, then the socket's own.
extern "system" fn connect_ex(
    s: Socket,
    name: *const u8,
    len: i32,
    send: *const c_void,
    send_len: u32,
    sent: *mut u32,
    overlapped: *mut c_void,
) -> i32 {
    if !reachable("network connect blocked", name, len) {
        return 0;
    }
    let (mut real, mut size) = (0usize, 0u32);
    let ioctl = host!("ws2_32.dll", "WSAIoctl": extern "system" fn(Socket, u32, *const c_void, u32, *mut c_void, u32, *mut u32, *mut c_void, *const c_void) -> i32);
    let guid = WSAID_CONNECTEX;
    let found = ioctl(
        s,
        SIO_GET_EXTENSION_FUNCTION_POINTER,
        (&raw const guid).cast(),
        16,
        (&raw mut real).cast(),
        8,
        &mut size,
        std::ptr::null_mut(),
        std::ptr::null(),
    );
    if found != 0 || real == 0 {
        return 0;
    }
    // SAFETY: the provider's `ConnectEx` for this socket.
    let real = unsafe {
        std::mem::transmute::<
            usize,
            extern "system" fn(
                Socket,
                *const u8,
                i32,
                *const c_void,
                u32,
                *mut u32,
                *mut c_void,
            ) -> i32,
        >(real)
    };
    real(s, name, len, send, send_len, sent, overlapped)
}

/// The `ConnectEx` and `WSASendMsg` pointers it hands out are ours; the
/// multi-pointer query (Registered I/O, whose `RIOSendEx` takes any
/// address) is refused as by an old system. Other controls pass through.
pub extern "system" fn WSAIoctl(
    s: Socket,
    code: u32,
    input: *const c_void,
    input_len: u32,
    output: *mut c_void,
    output_len: u32,
    returned: *mut u32,
    overlapped: *mut c_void,
    completion: *const c_void,
) -> i32 {
    if code == SIO_GET_MULTIPLE_EXTENSION_FUNCTION_POINTER {
        wsa_error(WSAEINVAL);
        return SOCKET_ERROR;
    }
    let result = host!("ws2_32.dll", "WSAIoctl": extern "system" fn(Socket, u32, *const c_void, u32, *mut c_void, u32, *mut u32, *mut c_void, *const c_void) -> i32)(
        s, code, input, input_len, output, output_len, returned, overlapped, completion,
    );
    if result == 0 && code == SIO_GET_EXTENSION_FUNCTION_POINTER && input_len >= 16 {
        // SAFETY: the host just read a GUID from `input` and wrote a pointer to `output`.
        unsafe {
            let ours = match input.cast::<Guid>().read_unaligned() {
                WSAID_CONNECTEX => connect_ex as *const () as usize,
                WSAID_WSASENDMSG => WSASendMsg as *const () as usize,
                _ => return result,
            };
            output.cast::<usize>().write_unaligned(ours);
        }
    }
    result
}

// Datagram sends.

/// Without an address it sends to the connected peer, which `connect` vetted;
/// so does a stream socket whatever `to` says (Winsock ignores it there).
pub extern "system" fn sendto(
    s: Socket,
    buf: *const u8,
    len: i32,
    flags: i32,
    to: *const u8,
    to_len: i32,
) -> i32 {
    if !to.is_null() && !stream(s) && !reachable("network datagram blocked", to, to_len) {
        return SOCKET_ERROR;
    }
    host!("ws2_32.dll", "sendto": extern "system" fn(Socket, *const u8, i32, i32, *const u8, i32) -> i32)(
        s, buf, len, flags, to, to_len,
    )
}

pub extern "system" fn WSASendTo(
    s: Socket,
    buffers: *const c_void,
    count: u32,
    sent: *mut u32,
    flags: u32,
    to: *const u8,
    to_len: i32,
    overlapped: *mut c_void,
    completion: *const c_void,
) -> i32 {
    if !to.is_null() && !stream(s) && !reachable("network datagram blocked", to, to_len) {
        return SOCKET_ERROR;
    }
    host!("ws2_32.dll", "WSASendTo": extern "system" fn(Socket, *const c_void, u32, *mut u32, u32, *const u8, i32, *mut c_void, *const c_void) -> i32)(
        s, buffers, count, sent, flags, to, to_len, overlapped, completion,
    )
}

/// A connection-oriented socket, whose sends go to the peer `connect` vetted.
fn stream(s: Socket) -> bool {
    const SOL_SOCKET: i32 = 0xffff;
    const SO_TYPE: i32 = 0x1008;
    const SOCK_STREAM: i32 = 1;
    let (mut kind, mut len) = (0i32, 4i32);
    let getsockopt = host!("ws2_32.dll", "getsockopt": extern "system" fn(Socket, i32, i32, *mut i32, *mut i32) -> i32);
    getsockopt(s, SOL_SOCKET, SO_TYPE, &mut kind, &mut len) == 0 && kind == SOCK_STREAM
}

/// The start of a `WSAMSG`: the destination.
#[repr(C)]
struct MessageName {
    name: *const u8,
    len: i32,
}

pub extern "system" fn WSASendMsg(
    s: Socket,
    message: *const c_void,
    flags: u32,
    sent: *mut u32,
    overlapped: *mut c_void,
    completion: *const c_void,
) -> i32 {
    // SAFETY: the title passes a `WSAMSG` or null.
    if let Some(m) = unsafe { message.cast::<MessageName>().as_ref() }
        && !m.name.is_null()
        && !reachable("network datagram blocked", m.name, m.len)
    {
        return SOCKET_ERROR;
    }
    host!("ws2_32.dll", "WSASendMsg": extern "system" fn(Socket, *const c_void, u32, *mut u32, *mut c_void, *const c_void) -> i32)(
        s, message, flags, sent, overlapped, completion,
    )
}

/// All interfaces become loopback, the only one an unplugged console has;
/// any other address is not ours (`WSAEADDRNOTAVAIL`).
// shortcut: `[::]` becomes `[::1]`, so a dual-stack listener no longer hears
// 127.0.0.1; bind both families if a title relies on that.
pub extern "system" fn bind(s: Socket, name: *const u8, len: i32) -> i32 {
    let host_bind = host!("ws2_32.dll", "bind": extern "system" fn(Socket, *const u8, i32) -> i32);
    match socket_addr(name, len) {
        Some(a) if loopback(a.ip()) => host_bind(s, name, len),
        Some(a) if a.ip().is_unspecified() => {
            once("network bind narrowed to loopback", a.to_string());
            // SAFETY: `socket_addr` checked `len` readable bytes.
            let mut local = unsafe { std::slice::from_raw_parts(name, len as usize) }.to_vec();
            match a {
                SocketAddr::V4(_) => local[4..8].copy_from_slice(&[127, 0, 0, 1]),
                SocketAddr::V6(_) => local[23] = 1,
            }
            host_bind(s, local.as_ptr(), len)
        }
        a => {
            once("network bind blocked", shown(a));
            wsa_error(WSAEADDRNOTAVAIL);
            SOCKET_ERROR
        }
    }
}

// WinHTTP.

/// The one door to a server: requests, uploads and WebSockets all hang off
/// the handle this returns.
pub extern "system" fn WinHttpConnect(
    session: Handle,
    server: *const u16,
    port: u16,
    reserved: u32,
) -> Handle {
    if let Some(name) = wide(server)
        && !loopback_name(&name)
    {
        once("HTTP connection blocked", format!("{name}:{port}"));
        // SAFETY: no pointers.
        unsafe { SetLastError(ERROR_WINHTTP_CANNOT_CONNECT) };
        return std::ptr::null_mut();
    }
    host!("winhttp.dll", "WinHttpConnect": extern "system" fn(Handle, *const u16, u16, u32) -> Handle)(
        session, server, port, reserved,
    )
}

/// Sessions never use a proxy: only loopback is reachable, and a proxy
/// (named, or found by auto-detection) would carry it off the machine.
pub extern "system" fn WinHttpOpen(
    agent: *const u16,
    access: u32,
    _proxy: *const u16,
    _bypass: *const u16,
    flags: u32,
) -> Handle {
    if access != WINHTTP_ACCESS_TYPE_NO_PROXY {
        once("HTTP proxy ignored", format!("access type {access}"));
    }
    host!("winhttp.dll", "WinHttpOpen": extern "system" fn(*const u16, u32, *const u16, *const u16, u32) -> Handle)(
        agent,
        WINHTTP_ACCESS_TYPE_NO_PROXY,
        std::ptr::null(),
        std::ptr::null(),
        flags,
    )
}

/// See [`WinHttpOpen`]: a proxy set later is accepted and not used.
pub extern "system" fn WinHttpSetOption(
    handle: Handle,
    option: u32,
    buffer: *const c_void,
    len: u32,
) -> i32 {
    if option == WINHTTP_OPTION_PROXY {
        once("HTTP proxy ignored", "WINHTTP_OPTION_PROXY".into());
        return 1;
    }
    host!("winhttp.dll", "WinHttpSetOption": extern "system" fn(Handle, u32, *const c_void, u32) -> i32)(
        handle, option, buffer, len,
    )
}

/// Proxy auto-detection asks the network (DHCP, DNS, a PAC download).
fn no_auto_proxy() -> u32 {
    once("HTTP proxy auto-detection blocked", "WPAD/PAC".into());
    ERROR_WINHTTP_AUTODETECTION_FAILED
}

pub extern "system" fn WinHttpDetectAutoProxyConfigUrl(_flags: u32, _url: *mut *mut u16) -> i32 {
    // SAFETY: no pointers.
    unsafe { SetLastError(no_auto_proxy()) };
    0
}

pub extern "system" fn WinHttpGetProxyForUrl(
    _session: Handle,
    _url: *const u16,
    _options: *const c_void,
    _info: *mut c_void,
) -> i32 {
    // SAFETY: no pointers.

    0
}

    _resolver: Handle,
    _url: *const u16,
    _options: *const c_void,
    _context: usize,

}

pub extern "system" fn WinHttpGetProxyForUrlEx2(

    _options: *const c_void,
    _selection_len: u32,
    _selection: *const u8,

/// Winsock imports by ordinal; the Winsock 1.1 numbers are fixed.
fn ordinal(name: &'static str, f: usize) -> HleExport {
    HleExport { name, address: f }
}

pub(crate) fn module() -> HleModule {
    HleModule {
        name: "net",
        dlls: &["ws2_32.dll", "winhttp.dll"],
        exports: vec![
            hle_export!(connect),
            hle_export!(WSAConnect),
            hle_export!(WSAConnectByNameA),
            hle_export!(WSAConnectByNameW),
            hle_export!(WSAConnectByList),
            hle_export!(WSAJoinLeaf),
            hle_export!(WSAIoctl),
            hle_export!(sendto),
            hle_export!(WSASendTo),
            hle_export!(WSASendMsg),
            hle_export!(bind),
            hle_export!(getaddrinfo),
            hle_export!(GetAddrInfoW),
            hle_export!(GetAddrInfoExA),
            hle_export!(GetAddrInfoExW),
            hle_export!(gethostbyname),
            hle_export!(WSAAsyncGetHostByName),
            hle_export!(WSALookupServiceBeginA),
            hle_export!(WSALookupServiceBeginW),
            hle_export!(gethostbyaddr),
            hle_export!(WSAAsyncGetHostByAddr),
            hle_export!(getnameinfo),
            hle_export!(GetNameInfoW),
            hle_export!(WinHttpConnect),
            hle_export!(WinHttpOpen),
            hle_export!(WinHttpSetOption),
            hle_export!(WinHttpDetectAutoProxyConfigUrl),
            hle_export!(WinHttpGetProxyForUrl),
            hle_export!(WinHttpGetProxyForUrlEx),
            hle_export!(WinHttpGetProxyForUrlEx2),
            hle_export!(WinHttpGetProxySettingsEx),
            ordinal("#2", bind as *const () as usize),
            ordinal("#4", connect as *const () as usize),
            ordinal("#20", sendto as *const () as usize),
            ordinal("#51", gethostbyaddr as *const () as usize),
            ordinal("#52", gethostbyname as *const () as usize),
            ordinal("#102", WSAAsyncGetHostByAddr as *const () as usize),
            ordinal("#103", WSAAsyncGetHostByName as *const () as usize),
        ],
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use victory_pe::ImportSymbol;

    fn v4(ip: [u8; 4], port: u16) -> [u8; 16] {
        let mut a = [0u8; 16];
        a[..2].copy_from_slice(&AF_INET.to_le_bytes());
        a[2..4].copy_from_slice(&port.to_be_bytes());
        a[4..8].copy_from_slice(&ip);
        a
    }

    // TEST-NET-1 (192.0.2.0/24): never routed, and never tried here.
    const AWAY: [u8; 4] = [192, 0, 2, 1];
    const HOME: [u8; 4] = [127, 0, 0, 1];

    #[test]
    fn only_loopback_is_reachable() {
        // Also starts Winsock for the raw calls below.
        let listener = std::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap();
        let port = listener.local_addr().unwrap().port();
        let socket = host!("ws2_32.dll", "socket": extern "system" fn(i32, i32, i32) -> Socket);
        let close = host!("ws2_32.dll", "closesocket": extern "system" fn(Socket) -> i32);
        let last_error = host!("ws2_32.dll", "WSAGetLastError": extern "system" fn() -> i32);
        let null = std::ptr::null_mut::<c_void>();

        // Connects.
        let s = socket(2, 1, 6);
        assert_ne!(s, INVALID_SOCKET);
        assert_eq!(connect(s, v4(AWAY, 80).as_ptr(), 16), SOCKET_ERROR);
        assert_eq!(last_error(), WSAENETUNREACH);
        let n = null.cast();
        assert_eq!(
            WSAConnectByNameA(
                s,
                c"example.com".as_ptr(),
                c"80".as_ptr(),
                n,
                null,
                n,
                null,
                null,
                null
            ),
            0
        );
        assert_eq!(last_error(), WSAHOST_NOT_FOUND);
        assert_eq!(connect(s, v4(HOME, port).as_ptr(), 16), 0);
        listener.accept().unwrap();
        // A stream socket sends to its vetted peer whatever `to` says.
        assert_eq!(sendto(s, b"x".as_ptr(), 1, 0, v4(AWAY, 9).as_ptr(), 16), 1);
        close(s);

        // `ConnectEx` from `WSAIoctl` is the vetted one.
        let s = socket(2, 1, 6);
        let mut f = 0usize;
        let mut size = 0u32;
        let guid = WSAID_CONNECTEX;
        let got = WSAIoctl(
            s,
            SIO_GET_EXTENSION_FUNCTION_POINTER,
            (&raw const guid).cast(),
            16,
            (&raw mut f).cast(),
            8,
            &mut size,
            null,
            null,
        );
        assert_eq!((got, f), (0, connect_ex as *const () as usize));
        assert_eq!(
            connect_ex(s, v4(AWAY, 80).as_ptr(), 16, null, 0, n, null),
            0
        );
        assert_eq!(last_error(), WSAENETUNREACH);
        close(s);

        // Datagram sends.
        let u = socket(2, 2, 17);
        assert_eq!(
            sendto(u, b"x".as_ptr(), 1, 0, v4(AWAY, 9).as_ptr(), 16),
            SOCKET_ERROR
        );
        assert_eq!(last_error(), WSAENETUNREACH);
        assert_eq!(
            sendto(u, b"x".as_ptr(), 1, 0, v4(HOME, port).as_ptr(), 16),
            1
        );
        close(u);

        // Forward and reverse lookups.
        let mut result = null;
        assert_eq!(
            getaddrinfo(
                c"example.com".as_ptr(),
                std::ptr::null(),
                std::ptr::null(),
                &mut result
            ),
            WSAHOST_NOT_FOUND
        );
        let name: Vec<u16> = "example.com\0".encode_utf16().collect();
        assert_eq!(
            GetAddrInfoW(
                name.as_ptr(),
                std::ptr::null(),
                std::ptr::null(),
                &mut result
            ),
            WSAHOST_NOT_FOUND
        );
        let mut text = [0 as c_char; 64];
        let away = v4(AWAY, 80);
        assert_eq!(
            getnameinfo(
                away.as_ptr(),
                16,
                text.as_mut_ptr(),
                64,
                std::ptr::null_mut(),
                0,
                0
            ),
            0
        );
        // SAFETY: NUL-terminated by `getnameinfo`.
        let numeric = unsafe { CStr::from_ptr(text.as_ptr()) };
        assert_eq!(numeric.to_str(), Ok("192.0.2.1"));
        assert_eq!(
            getnameinfo(
                away.as_ptr(),
                16,
                text.as_mut_ptr(),
                64,
                std::ptr::null_mut(),
                0,
                NI_NAMEREQD
            ),
            WSAHOST_NOT_FOUND
        );
        assert!(gethostbyaddr(AWAY.as_ptr().cast(), 4, 2).is_null());

        // WinHTTP.
        assert!(WinHttpConnect(null, name.as_ptr(), 443, 0).is_null());
        // SAFETY: no arguments.
        let error = unsafe { windows_sys::Win32::Foundation::GetLastError() };
        assert_eq!(error, ERROR_WINHTTP_CANNOT_CONNECT);
        assert_eq!(
            WinHttpGetProxyForUrlEx(null, name.as_ptr(), std::ptr::null(), 0),
            ERROR_WINHTTP_AUTODETECTION_FAILED
        );

        // The ordinals we override name the functions they stand for.
        let m = module();
        for e in m.exports.iter().filter(|e| e.name.starts_with('#')) {
            let named = m
                .exports
                .iter()
                .find(|n| n.address == e.address && !n.name.starts_with('#'))
                .unwrap();
            let by_ordinal = ImportSymbol::Ordinal(e.name[1..].parse().unwrap());
            assert_eq!(
                crate::HostPolicy::default().resolve("ws2_32.dll", &by_ordinal),
                crate::host::function("ws2_32.dll", named.name),
                "{} is not {}",
                e.name,
                named.name
            );
        }
        // Every override names a real export of its DLL. Some exports only
        // exist on newer Windows (WinHttpGetProxySettingsEx is absent from
        // Windows 10's winhttp.dll); the HLE supplies those itself, so skip
        // them only when the host really lacks them.
        const NEWER_WINDOWS_ONLY: &[&str] = &["WinHttpGetProxySettingsEx"];
        for e in m.exports.iter().filter(|e| !e.name.starts_with('#')) {
            let dll = if e.name.starts_with("WinHttp") {
                "winhttp.dll"
            } else {
                "ws2_32.dll"
            };
            let present = crate::host::function(dll, e.name).is_some();
            if !present && NEWER_WINDOWS_ONLY.contains(&e.name) {
                continue;
            }
            assert!(present, "{dll} lacks {}", e.name);
        }
    }
}
```

```rs
//! Accessibility: speech synthesis for the title's narration. No voice is
//! installed here, and every stream is valid WAVE audio of no length, so
//! narration is silent.
// shortcut: silent speech. The host's engine (SAPI through COM, or WinRT
// speech synthesis) needs COM bindings this crate has only in diagnostics
// builds, plus voice enumeration and SSML the title sends (slot 0xa8); the
// title then plays the empty stream and goes on.
#![allow(clippy::not_unsafe_ptr_arg_deref)]

use std::ffi::{c_char, c_void};

use super::xgameruntime::{
    Guid, HRESULT, Interface, Methods, Object, S_OK, add_ref, missing, put, text,
};

/// Closed captions, high contrast, speech to text and synthesis.
pub const PROVIDER: Guid = Guid::new(
    0x3e24_1977,
    0x6237,
    0x41e9,
    [0x85, 0x59, 0x10, 0x2c, 0x2d, 0x99, 0x83, 0xf1],
);
/// Unchanged since 2020.
pub const IID: Guid = Guid::new(
    0xd722_b373,
    0x8c4d,
    0x4692,
    [0x9e, 0x51, 0xd6, 0xad, 0x9b, 0x37, 0xaa, 0x7d],
);

pub static OBJECT: Object = Object::new("accessibility", &VTABLE);
pub const INTERFACES: &[Interface] = &[(PROVIDER, IID, &OBJECT)];

/// A WAVE file of 16 kHz mono 16-bit PCM with no samples: RIFF size 36,
/// a 16-byte format chunk (PCM, 1 channel, 16,000 Hz, 32,000 bytes/s,
/// block 2, 16 bits), an empty data chunk.
const SILENCE: [u8; 44] =
    *b"RIFF\x24\0\0\0WAVEfmt \x10\0\0\0\x01\0\x01\0\x80\x3e\0\0\0\x7d\0\0\x02\0\x10\0data\0\0\0\0";

/// Synthesizers and streams hold nothing, so their handles are fixed
/// addresses and closing them is free.
static SYNTHESIZER: u8 = 0;
static STREAM: u8 = 0;

type This = *const Object;

/// No voice is installed, so the callback never runs.
extern "system" fn enumerate_voices(
    _: This,
    _context: *mut c_void,
    _callback: *const c_void,
) -> HRESULT {
    S_OK
}
extern "system" fn create(_: This, out: *mut *const u8) -> HRESULT {
    put(out, &raw const SYNTHESIZER)
}
extern "system" fn close(_: This, _: *const u8) -> HRESULT {
    S_OK
}
extern "system" fn set_default_voice(_: This, _: *const u8) -> HRESULT {
    S_OK
}
extern "system" fn set_custom_voice(_: This, _: *const u8, _voice: *const c_char) -> HRESULT {
    S_OK
}
extern "system" fn create_stream(
    _: This,
    _: *const u8,
    words: *const c_char,
    out: *mut *const u8,
) -> HRESULT {
    tracing::debug!(text = text(words).unwrap_or_default(), "speech (silent)");
    put(out, &raw const STREAM)
}
extern "system" fn stream_size(_: This, _: *const u8, out: *mut usize) -> HRESULT {
    put(out, SILENCE.len())
}
extern "system" fn stream_data(
    _: This,
    _: *const u8,
    size: usize,
    buffer: *mut u8,
    used: *mut usize,
) -> HRESULT {
    if buffer.is_null() || size < SILENCE.len() {
        return super::xasync::E_NOT_SUFFICIENT_BUFFER;
    }
    // SAFETY: the buffer holds `size` bytes, checked above.
    unsafe { buffer.copy_from_nonoverlapping(SILENCE.as_ptr(), SILENCE.len()) };
    if !used.is_null() {
        // SAFETY: checked non-null.
        unsafe { used.write(SILENCE.len()) };
    }
    S_OK
}

    add_ref as *const (),

    enumerate_voices as *const (),  // 0x40
    create as *const (),            // 0x48
    close as *const (),             // 0x50
    set_default_voice as *const (), // 0x58
    set_custom_voice as *const (),  // 0x60
    create_stream as *const (),     // 0x68 from text
    close as *const (),             // 0x70 a stream
    stream_size as *const (),       // 0x78
    stream_data as *const (),       // 0x80
    missing::<17> as *const (),     // 0x88 speech to text
    missing::<18> as *const (),     // 0x90
    missing::<19> as *const (),     // 0x98
    missing::<20> as *const (),     // 0xa0
    create_stream as *const (),     // 0xa8 from SSML
]);

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::modules::xgameruntime::method;

    #[test]
    fn streams_are_empty_wave_files() {
        let this: This = &OBJECT;
        type Create = extern "system" fn(This, *mut *const u8) -> HRESULT;
        type Stream = extern "system" fn(This, *const u8, *const c_char, *mut *const u8) -> HRESULT;
        type Size = extern "system" fn(This, *const u8, *mut usize) -> HRESULT;

        );
        assert_eq!(u32::from_le_bytes(wav[24..28].try_into().unwrap()), 16_000);

    }
```

```rs
//! Persistent local storage: a host folder of the title's own
//! (`runtime::Title::storage`, under the data directory, never the cache)
//! with the quota its manifest declares, seen by the title as a drive
//! (`files`).
#![allow(clippy::not_unsafe_ptr_arg_deref)]

use std::path::Path;

use super::xasync::{self, AsyncBlock, E_ABORT};
use super::xgameruntime::{
    Guid, HRESULT, Interface, Methods, NOT_SUPPORTED, Object, S_OK, add_ref, missing, put,

    0xf4fa_f4d4,
    0x2d04,
    0x4fce,
    [0xb3, 0xe0, 0x47, 0x4a, 0x71, 0x3a, 0x3e, 0x84],

    0x0794,

    [0x8b, 0x27, 0x95, 0xfc, 0x02, 0xd0, 0xf7, 0x5d],

/// As the title (2026) asks for it; it calls 0x20 (path) and 0x28
/// (space) with the same arguments.
pub const IID_2026: Guid = Guid::new(
    0x41a4_e10c,
    0x5a7e,
    0x41d9,
    [0x8c, 0x37, 0x37, 0xbd, 0xe6, 0x2a, 0x07, 0xd6],
);

pub static OBJECT: Object = Object::new("persistent local storage", &VTABLE);
pub const INTERFACES: &[Interface] = &[(PROVIDER, IID, &OBJECT), (PROVIDER, IID_2026, &OBJECT)];

const E_FAIL: HRESULT = 0x8000_4005_u32 as i32;

type This = *const Object;

/// The path titles get: the root of a virtual drive over the folder. On the
/// console storage is a drive of its own, and titles rely on it: Minecraft
/// keeps only what precedes the path's last `:\` and mounts that as a
/// drive, so a host folder such as `C:\Users\..` would make it write to the
/// root of `C:`. None (the path calls fail) before the title is set.
fn folder() -> Option<String> {
    let storage = runtime::title().storage;
    if storage.as_os_str().is_empty() {
        return None;
    }
    #[cfg(windows)]
    return super::files::mount(&storage).map(|letter| format!("{letter}:\\"));
    #[cfg(not(windows))]
    None
}

extern "system" fn path_size(_: This, out: *mut usize) -> HRESULT {
    match folder() {
        Some(path) => put(out, path.len() + 1),
        None => NOT_SUPPORTED,
    }
}

/// A buffer too small for the path fails with `E_FAIL`, the documented
/// Xbox result (a PC gets `ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_BUFFER`).
extern "system" fn path(_: This, size: usize, buffer: *mut u8, used: *mut usize) -> HRESULT {
    match folder() {
        Some(path) if size <= path.len() => E_FAIL,
        Some(path) => put_string(&path, size, buffer, used),
        None => NOT_SUPPORTED,
    }
}

#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct SpaceInfo {
    /// Writable now.
    pub available_free: u64,
    /// Left in the quota.
    pub total_free: u64,
    pub used: u64,
    /// The quota.
    pub total: u64,
}

fn used_bytes(dir: &Path) -> u64 {
    let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(dir) else {
        return 0;
    };
    entries
        .flatten()
        .map(|e| match e.metadata() {
            Ok(m) if m.is_dir() => used_bytes(&e.path()),
            Ok(m) => m.len(),
            Err(_) => 0,
        })
        .sum()
}

/// What the host disk under `dir` has free (unlimited if unknown).
pub(crate) fn disk_free(dir: &Path) -> u64 {
    #[cfg(windows)]
    {
        use std::os::windows::ffi::OsStrExt;
        let wide: Vec<u16> = dir.as_os_str().encode_wide().chain([0]).collect();
        let mut free = 0;
        let null = std::ptr::null_mut();
        // SAFETY: a NUL-terminated path and a valid output.
        let ok = unsafe {
            windows_sys::Win32::Storage::FileSystem::GetDiskFreeSpaceExW(
                wide.as_ptr(),
                &mut free,
                null,
                null,
            )
        };
        if ok != 0 {
            return free;
        }
    }
    let _ = dir;
    u64::MAX
}

fn space() -> SpaceInfo {
    let title = runtime::title();
    let used = used_bytes(&title.storage);
    let free = title.storage_bytes.saturating_sub(used);
    SpaceInfo {
        // Writable now: the quota's rest, as far as the host disk allows.
        available_free: free.min(disk_free(&title.storage)),
        total_free: free,
        used,
        total: title.storage_bytes,
    }
}

extern "system" fn space_info(_: This, out: *mut SpaceInfo) -> HRESULT {
    put(out, space())
}

/// Tells our prompts apart from other calls on the same block.
static PROMPT: u8 = 0;

/// There is nobody to ask: granted when the quota has room, else declined.
extern "system" fn prompt_for_space(_: This, bytes: u64, block: *mut AsyncBlock) -> HRESULT {
    let hr = if bytes <= space().total_free {
        S_OK
    } else {
        E_ABORT
    };
    xasync::finished(block, (&raw const PROMPT).cast(), hr)
}

extern "system" fn prompt_result(_: This, block: *mut AsyncBlock) -> HRESULT {
    let none = std::ptr::null_mut();
    xasync::XAsyncGetResult(block, (&raw const PROMPT).cast(), 0, none, none.cast())
}

static VTABLE: Methods<8> = Methods([
    missing::<0> as *const (),
    add_ref as *const (),
    add_ref as *const (),
    path_size as *const (),        // 0x18
    path as *const (),             // 0x20
    space_info as *const (),       // 0x28
    prompt_for_space as *const (), // 0x30
    prompt_result as *const (),    // 0x38

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::modules::xgameruntime::method;

    #[test]
    fn serves_a_drive_over_the_title_folder_and_its_quota() {
        type Size = extern "system" fn(This, *mut usize) -> HRESULT;
        type Get = extern "system" fn(This, usize, *mut u8, *mut usize) -> HRESULT;
        type Space = extern "system" fn(This, *mut SpaceInfo) -> HRESULT;
        type Prompt = extern "system" fn(This, u64, *mut AsyncBlock) -> HRESULT;
        type Result = extern "system" fn(This, *mut AsyncBlock) -> HRESULT;
        let this: This = &OBJECT;
        let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        std::fs::write(dir.path().join("save.dat"), [0u8; 100]).unwrap();
        runtime::set_title(runtime::Title {
            id: 1,
            storage: dir.path().to_owned(),

        let mut size = 0;

        assert_ne!(

        let mut info = SpaceInfo {

            total_free: 0,
            used: 0,
            total: 0,
        };
        assert_eq!(method::<Space>(&OBJECT, 0x28)(this, &mut info), S_OK);
        assert_eq!((info.used, info.total_free, info.total), (100, 900, 1000));

        let prompt = method::<Prompt>(&OBJECT, 0x30);
        let result = method::<Result>(&OBJECT, 0x38);
        for (bytes, expect) in [(900, S_OK), (901, E_ABORT)] {
            let mut block = AsyncBlock {
                queue: std::ptr::null(),
                context: std::ptr::null_mut(),
                callback: None,
                internal: [0; 4],
            };
            assert_eq!(prompt(this, bytes, &mut block), S_OK);
            assert_eq!(xasync::XAsyncGetStatus(&mut block, true), expect);
            assert_eq!(result(this, &mut block), expect, "{bytes} bytes");
        }
    }
}
```
