```rs
#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    const S_ENDPGM: u32 = 0xBF81_0000;

    const fn sop1(sdst: u8, op: u8, ssrc0: u8) -> u32 {
        0xBE80_0000 | (sdst as u32) << 16 | (op as u32) << 8 | ssrc0 as u32
    }

    const fn vop1(vdst: u8, op: u8, src0: u16) -> u32 {
        (0x3F << 25) | (vdst as u32) << 17 | (op as u32) << 9 | (src0 as u32 & 0x1FF)
    }

    const fn vop2(vdst: u8, op: u8, src0: u16, vsrc1: u8) -> u32 {
        (op as u32) << 25 | (vdst as u32) << 17 | (vsrc1 as u32) << 9 | (src0 as u32 & 0x1FF)
    }

    const fn dpp16(vsrc0: u8, ctrl: u16, row_mask: u8, bank_mask: u8, bound_ctrl: bool) -> u32 {
        (row_mask as u32) << 28
            | (bank_mask as u32) << 24
            | (bound_ctrl as u32) << 19
            | (ctrl as u32) << 8
            | vsrc0 as u32
    }

    const fn vop3(vdst: u8, op: u16, src0: u16, src1: u16, src2: u16) -> [u32; 2] {
        [
            0xD400_0000 | (op as u32) << 16 | vdst as u32,
            (src0 as u32 & 0x1FF) | ((src1 as u32 & 0x1FF) << 9) | ((src2 as u32 & 0x1FF) << 18),
        ]
    }

    fn build(words: &[u32], wave64: bool) -> Program {
        let code: Vec<u8> = words
            .iter()
            .copied()
            .chain(std::iter::once(S_ENDPGM))
            .flat_map(u32::to_le_bytes)
            .collect();
        crate::ir::build(&code, wave64, 256).unwrap()
    }

    #[test]
    fn dpp_lanes_follow_the_isa() {
        // row_shr:1 with bound_ctrl: lane 16 reads 0, lane 17 lane 16.
        let shr = Dpp::Row {
            ctrl: 0x111,
            row_mask: 0xF,
            bank_mask: 0xF,
            bound_ctrl: true,
            fi: false,
        };
        assert_eq!(dpp_lane(shr, 16), Some((16, true, true)));
        assert_eq!(dpp_lane(shr, 17), Some((16, false, true)));
        // row_mirror: lane 3 reads lane 12.
        let mirror = Dpp::Row {
            ctrl: 0x140,
            row_mask: 0xF,
            bank_mask: 0xF,
            bound_ctrl: true,
            fi: false,
        };
        assert_eq!(dpp_lane(mirror, 3), Some((12, false, true)));
        // dpp8 [1,0,3,2,5,4,7,6] swaps neighbours.
        let swap = Dpp::Lanes {
            sel: 1 | 3 << 6 | 2 << 9 | 5 << 12 | 4 << 15 | 7 << 18 | 6 << 21,
            fi: false,
        };
        assert_eq!(dpp_lane(swap, 8), Some((9, false, true)));
    }

    #[test]
    fn prefixes_are_recognised() {
        let (x, m) = (Value(1), Value(2));
        let red = |lanes: u64| Sym::Red {
            op: Some(Op::AddU),
            src: x,
            mask: m,
            ident: 0,
            lanes,
        };
        let inclusive: Vec<Sym> = (0..64).map(|l| red(u64::MAX >> (63 - l))).collect();
        assert_eq!(
            per_lane(&inclusive, u64::MAX),
            Some(Shape::Prefix(Op::AddU, x, m, 0, true))
        );
        let mut exclusive: Vec<Sym> = (0..64).map(|l| red((1u64 << l) - 1)).collect();
        exclusive[0] = Sym::K(0);
        assert_eq!(
            per_lane(&exclusive, u64::MAX),
            Some(Shape::Prefix(Op::AddU, x, m, 0, false))
        );
        assert_eq!(
            per_lane(&vec![red(u64::MAX); 64], u64::MAX),
            Some(Shape::Active(Op::AddU, x, m, 0))
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn constant_decodes_width_and_inline_kinds() {
        let b64 = 0x04;
        let b32 = 0x03;
        let check = |words: &[u32], wave64: bool| -> Option<u64> {
            let p = build(words, wave64);
            constant(&p.blocks[0].insts[0])
        };

        assert_eq!(
            check(&[sop1(EXEC, b64, 194)], true),
            Some(0xFFFF_FFFF_FFFF_FFFE)
        );
        assert_eq!(
            check(&[sop1(EXEC, b64, 196)], true),
            Some(0xFFFF_FFFF_FFFF_FFFC)
        );
        assert_eq!(
            check(&[sop1(EXEC, b64, 208)], true),
            Some(0xFFFF_FFFF_FFFF_FFF0)
        );
        assert_eq!(check(&[sop1(EXEC, b64, 193)], true), Some(u64::MAX));
        assert_eq!(check(&[sop1(EXEC, b64, NULL)], true), Some(0));
        assert_eq!(check(&[sop1(EXEC, b64, 243)], true), None);
        assert_eq!(
            check(&[sop1(EXEC, b64, 255), 0x1234_5678], true),
            Some(0x1234_5678)
        );

        assert_eq!(check(&[sop1(EXEC, b32, 194)], false), Some(0xFFFF_FFFE));
        assert_eq!(check(&[sop1(EXEC, b32, 243)], false), Some(0xBF80_0000));
        assert_eq!(check(&[sop1(EXEC, b32, NULL)], false), Some(0));
        assert_eq!(
            check(&[sop1(EXEC, b32, 255), 0x1234_5678], false),
            Some(0x1234_5678)
        );
        assert_eq!(check(&[sop1(EXEC, b32, 0)], false), None);
    }

    #[test]
    fn exec_minus_two_masks_lane_zero_and_enforces_dpp_guard() {
        for wave64 in [false, true] {
            let mut w = Vec::new();
            let save_op = if wave64 { 0x25 } else { 0x3D };
            let mov_exec = if wave64 { 0x04 } else { 0x03 };
            let push_exec = |w: &mut Vec<u32>, k: u8| w.push(sop1(EXEC, mov_exec, k));
            let push_exec_lit = |w: &mut Vec<u32>, lit: u32| {
                w.push(sop1(EXEC, mov_exec, 255));
                w.push(lit);
            };

            w.push(sop1(0, save_op, 193));
            w.extend(vop3(1, 0x101, 128, 256, 0));
            for shift in [1u16, 2, 4, 8] {
                w.push(vop2(1, 0x25, 0xFA, 1));
                w.push(dpp16(1, 0x110 + shift, 0xF, 0xF, false));
            }
            w.extend(vop3(2, 0x360, 257, 128 + 15, 0));
            push_exec_lit(&mut w, 0xFFFF_0000);
            w.push(vop2(1, 0x25, 2, 1));

            if wave64 {
                w.extend(vop3(2, 0x360, 257, 128 + 31, 0));
                w.push(sop1(EXEC, 0x03, 128));
                w.push(sop1(EXEC + 1, 0x03, 255));
                w.push(0x0000_FFFF);
                w.push(vop2(1, 0x25, 2, 1));

                w.extend(vop3(2, 0x360, 257, 128 + 47, 0));
                w.push(sop1(EXEC, 0x03, 128));
                w.push(sop1(EXEC + 1, 0x03, 255));
                w.push(0xFFFF_0000);
                w.push(vop2(1, 0x25, 2, 1));
            }

            push_exec(&mut w, 193);
            w.push(vop1(3, 0x01, 257));
            w.push(vop1(3, 0x01, 0xFA));
            w.push(dpp16(1, 0x111, 0xF, 0xF, false));

            w.extend(vop3(2, 0x360, 257, 128 + 15, 0));
            push_exec_lit(&mut w, 0x0001_0000);
            w.push(vop1(3, 0x01, 2));

            if wave64 {
                w.extend(vop3(2, 0x360, 257, 128 + 31, 0));
                w.push(sop1(EXEC, 0x03, 128));
                w.push(sop1(EXEC + 1, 0x03, 129));
                w.push(vop1(3, 0x01, 2));

                w.extend(vop3(2, 0x360, 257, 128 + 47, 0));
                w.push(sop1(EXEC, 0x03, 128));
                w.push(sop1(EXEC + 1, 0x03, 255));
                w.push(0x0001_0000);
                w.push(vop1(3, 0x01, 2));
            }

            push_exec(&mut w, 193);
            w.push(vop1(2, 0x01, 128));
            w.push(vop1(5, 0x01, 135));
            push_exec(&mut w, 194);
            w.push(vop1(2, 0x01, 259));
            w.push(vop1(4, 0x01, 0xFA));
            w.push(dpp16(5, 0xE4, 0xF, 0xF, false));
            w.push(sop1(EXEC, mov_exec, 0));

            let p = build(&w, wave64);
            let insts = &p.blocks[0].insts;
            let saved = insts[0].write(Reg::S(0)).unwrap();
            let v0_in = p
                .inputs
                .iter()
                .find_map(|&(r, v)| (r == Reg::V(0)).then_some(v))
                .unwrap();
            let v2_val = insts[insts.len() - 4].write(Reg::V(2)).unwrap();
            let v4_val = insts[insts.len() - 3].write(Reg::V(4)).unwrap();
            let sec = &sections(&p, 0)[&0];
            assert_eq!(
                sec.shapes.get(&v2_val),
                Some(&Shape::Prefix(Op::AddU, v0_in, saved, 0, false))
            );
            assert_eq!(sec.shapes.get(&v4_val), None);
        }
    }

    /// `WaveActiveSum` of 16-bit floats, as compiled in
    /// `compute_graph_ops:CS_TransposeVecMatMulAlignedOperation` (0x19c on): the tree the
    /// lowering reproduces. A tree in another order is not followed.
    #[test]
    fn a_sum_of_halves_over_the_wave_is_followed_in_the_order_of_its_tree() {
        let words = |first: [u32; 2], second: [u32; 2]| {
            [
                0xBE84_25C1, // s_or_saveexec_b64 s[4:5], -1
                0xD501_0001,
                0x0012_0E80, // v_cndmask_b32 v1, 0, v7, s[4:5]
                first[0],
                first[1],
                second[0],
                second[1],
                0x6402_02E9,
                0x0009_2401, // v_add_f16 v1, v1, v1 dpp8:[4,4,4,4,0,0,0,0]
                0x6402_02FA,
                0xFF09_4001, // v_add_f16 v1, v1, v1 row_mirror bound_ctrl:1
                0xD778_0002,
                0x0201_0101, // v_permlanex16_b32 v2, v1, 0, 0
                0x6402_0302, // v_add_f16 v1, v2, v1
                0xD760_0007,
                0x0001_4101, // v_readlane_b32 s7, v1, 32
                0x6402_0207, // v_add_f16 v1, s7, v1
                0xD760_0007,
                0x0001_0101, // v_readlane_b32 s7, v1, 0
                0xBEFE_0404, // s_mov_b64 exec, s[4:5]
            ]
        };
        let pairs = [0x6402_02E9, 0xDE54_C101]; // v_add_f16 v1, v1, v1 dpp8:[1,0,3,2,5,4,7,6]
        let quads = [0x6402_02E9, 0x9360_1201]; // v_add_f16 v1, v1, v1 dpp8:[2,2,0,0,6,6,4,4]
        let shape = |w: &[u32]| {
            let p = build(w, true);
            let insts = &p.blocks[0].insts;
            let saved = insts[0].write(Reg::S(4)).unwrap();
            let v7 = p.inputs.iter().find_map(|&(r, v)| (r == Reg::V(7)).then_some(v)).unwrap();
            // ..., v_readlane_b32 s7, v1, 0; s_mov_b64 exec, s[4:5]; s_endpgm
            let total = insts[insts.len() - 3].write(Reg::S(7)).unwrap();
            (sections(&p, 0)[&0].shapes.get(&total).copied(), Shape::Active(Op::AddH, v7, saved, 0))
        };
        let (found, want) = shape(&words(pairs, quads));
        assert_eq!(found, Some(want));
        // lanes two apart first, neighbours second: every lane counted once, but
        // (x0 + x2) + (x1 + x3) rounds differently from (x0 + x1) + (x2 + x3)
        let (found, _) = shape(&words(quads, pairs));
        assert_eq!(found, None);
    }

    #[test]
    fn buddies_are_the_two_halves_of_an_aligned_run() {
        assert!(buddies(0b01, 0b10));
        assert!(buddies(0b1100, 0b0011));
        assert!(buddies(0xF0, 0x0F));
        assert!(buddies(u64::from(u32::MAX), u64::from(u32::MAX) << 32));
        assert!(!buddies(0b010, 0b100)); // lanes 1 and 2: not one pair
        assert!(!buddies(0b0011, 0b110000)); // pairs 0 and 2
        assert!(!buddies(0b0101, 0b1010)); // not runs
        assert!(!buddies(0b01, 0b1100)); // unequal
        assert!(!buddies(0b11, 0b11));
    }

    #[test]
    fn wave32_mov_b64_all_lanes_keeps_exec_masked_for_dpp() {
        let w = [
            sop1(0, 0x3D, 193),
            vop1(1, 0x01, 135),
            sop1(EXEC, 0x04, 193),
            vop1(2, 0x01, 0xFA),
            dpp16(1, 0xE4, 0xF, 0xF, false),
            sop1(EXEC + 1, 0x03, 193),
            vop1(3, 0x01, 0xFA),
            dpp16(1, 0xE4, 0xF, 0xF, false),
            sop1(EXEC, 0x03, 0),
        ];
        let p = build(&w, false);
        let insts = &p.blocks[0].insts;
        let v2_val = insts[3].write(Reg::V(2)).unwrap();
        let v3_val = insts[5].write(Reg::V(3)).unwrap();
        let sec = &sections(&p, 0)[&0];
        assert_eq!(sec.shapes.get(&v2_val), Some(&Shape::K(7)));
        assert_eq!(sec.shapes.get(&v3_val), Some(&Shape::K(7)));
    }

    #[test]
    fn per_lane_prefix_soundness() {
        let (v0, v_other, m0, m_other) = (Value(1), Value(2), Value(3), Value(4));
        let red = |op: Option<Op>, src: Value, mask: Value, ident: u32, lanes: u64| Sym::Red {
            op,
            src,
            mask,
            ident,
            lanes,
        };

        for (wave, all) in [(32usize, u64::from(u32::MAX)), (64usize, u64::MAX)] {
            let below_mask = |l: usize| if l == 0 { 0 } else { (1u64 << l) - 1 };

            let mut valid_inc: Vec<Sym> = (0..wave)
                .map(|l| red(Some(Op::AddU), v0, m0, 0, below_mask(l) | (1u64 << l)))
                .collect();
            valid_inc[0] = red(None, v0, m0, 0, 1);
            assert_eq!(
                per_lane(&valid_inc, all),
                Some(Shape::Prefix(Op::AddU, v0, m0, 0, true))
            );

            let mut valid_exc: Vec<Sym> = (0..wave)
                .map(|l| red(Some(Op::AddU), v0, m0, 0, below_mask(l)))
                .collect();
            valid_exc[0] = Sym::K(0);
            valid_exc[1] = red(None, v0, m0, 0, 1);
            assert_eq!(
                per_lane(&valid_exc, all),
                Some(Shape::Prefix(Op::AddU, v0, m0, 0, false))
            );

            let mut mixed_other_src = valid_exc.clone();
            mixed_other_src[0] = red(None, v_other, m0, 0, 1);
            assert_eq!(per_lane(&mixed_other_src, all), None);

            let mut mixed_same_src = valid_exc.clone();
            mixed_same_src[0] = red(None, v0, m0, 0, 1);
            assert_eq!(per_lane(&mixed_same_src, all), None);

            let mut exc_bad_lane1_src = valid_exc.clone();
            exc_bad_lane1_src[1] = red(None, v_other, m0, 0, 1);
            assert_eq!(per_lane(&exc_bad_lane1_src, all), None);

            let mut exc_bad_lane1_set = valid_exc.clone();
            exc_bad_lane1_set[1] = red(None, v0, m0, 0, 0b11);
            assert_eq!(per_lane(&exc_bad_lane1_set, all), None);

            for bad0 in [
                red(None, v0, m0, 1, 1),
                red(None, v_other, m0, 0, 1),
                red(None, v0, m_other, 0, 1),
                red(None, v0, m0, 0, 0),
                Sym::K(0),
            ] {
                let mut bad_inc = valid_inc.clone();
                bad_inc[0] = bad0;
                assert_eq!(per_lane(&bad_inc, all), None);
            }

            let mut bad_ident: Vec<Sym> = (0..wave)
                .map(|l| red(Some(Op::AddU), v0, m0, 1, below_mask(l) | (1u64 << l)))
                .collect();
            bad_ident[0] = red(None, v0, m0, 1, 1);
            assert_eq!(per_lane(&bad_ident, all), None);
        }
    }
}

```

`crates/victory-shader/src/emit/wave64_tests.rs`:

```rs
//! A console wave64 compute program on a host of 32-lane waves: a wave reduction inside a
//! per-lane branch, with that branch taken wave-wide ([`crate::structure::structure_wide`])
//! so that the two host waves can exchange their halves inside it. Lowered, validated by
//! `dxil.dll` when present, and run on the host GPU when it takes waves of 32.

use std::collections::HashSet;

use super::host::{Dispatch, Host, Root, View};
use super::{HostShader, lower, validator};
use crate::native::{
    ComputeIo, HwStage, NativeProgram, ResourceType, RootParam, RootType, StageIo, UsedResource,
};
use crate::{ShaderError, io, ir, resource, structure};

const S_ENDPGM: u32 = 0xBF81_0000;

/// 64 threads in one console wave. Each thread t holds the bit `1 << (t >> 1)`; the threads
/// below s0 (a root constant) OR theirs over the wave inside `if (t < s0) { ... }` and store
/// the result to dword 0 of the raw UAV.
/// `skip`: the branch past the body when no thread is below s0: `s_cbranch_execz`, or
/// `s_cbranch_scc0` on the SCC `s_and_saveexec` sets ("some lane is left").
fn program(skip: u32) -> NativeProgram {
    let mut words = vec![
        0x7E0A_0281, // v_mov_b32 v5, 1
        0x2C0C_0081, // v_lshrrev_b32 v6, 1, v0
        0x340E_0B06, // v_lshlrev_b32 v7, v6, v5
        0x7D88_0000, // v_cmp_gt_u32 vcc, s0, v0
        0xBE8C_246A, // s_and_saveexec_b64 s[12:13], vcc
        skip | 23,   // the branch to the restore of EXEC
    ];
    words.extend_from_slice(&super::wave::WAVE_OR_V7_TO_S7);
    words.extend_from_slice(&[
        0x7E00_0207, // v_mov_b32 v0, s7
        0x38 << 26 | 0x1C << 18,
        0x80 << 24 | 2 << 16, // buffer_store_dword v0, off, s[8:11], 0
        0xBEFE_040C, // s_mov_b64 exec, s[12:13]
    ]);
    native(&words)
}

/// A wave64 compute program of 64 threads (one console wave; the thread index in v0) with 4
/// root constants in s0..s3 and a raw UAV's descriptor in s[8:11], then `body`.
fn native(body: &[u32]) -> NativeProgram {
    native_of(body, true, 64)
}

/// The same for a console of 32-lane waves when `wave64` is not set, with `threads` threads.
fn native_of(body: &[u32], wave64: bool, threads: u32) -> NativeProgram {
    let mut words = vec![
        0xBE85_0380, // s_mov_b32 s5, 0
        0x3D << 26 | 0x02 << 18 | 8 << 6 | 2,
        125 << 25, // s_load_dwordx4 s[8:11], s[4:5], 0
    ];
    words.extend_from_slice(body);
    words.push(S_ENDPGM);
    NativeProgram {
        stage: HwStage::Cs,
        wave64,
        vgprs: 16,
        layout: vec![
            RootParam {
                root: RootType::Constants,
                table_offset_dwords: 0,
                sgprs: 4,
                base_register: 0,
                user_data: 0,
                slot: 0,
            },
            RootParam {
                root: RootType::Table,
                table_offset_dwords: 0,
                sgprs: 1,
                base_register: 0,
                user_data: 4,
                slot: 1,
            },
        ],
        used: vec![UsedResource {
            kind: ResourceType::Uav,
            root: RootType::Table,
            table_offset_dwords: 0,
            lower_bound: 0,
            stride: 0,
            dwords: 4,
            user_data: 4,
            slot: 1,
        }],
        io: StageIo::Cs(ComputeIo {
            rsrc2: 5 << 1, // 5 user SGPRs: s0..s4
            threads: [threads, 1, 1],
        }),
        code: words.iter().flat_map(|w| w.to_le_bytes()).collect(),
    }
}

/// `program()` for a host of 32-lane waves, with the branches closing `wide` taken wave-wide.
fn lowered(native: &NativeProgram, p: &ir::Program, wide: &HashSet<usize>) -> Result<HostShader, ShaderError> {
    lowered_on(native, p, wide, 32)
}

/// [`lowered`] for a host whose waves have at most `host_wave` lanes.
fn lowered_on(
    native: &NativeProgram,
    p: &ir::Program,
    wide: &HashSet<usize>,
    host_wave: u32,
) -> Result<HostShader, ShaderError> {
    let st = structure::structure_wide(p, wide).expect("structure");
    let res = resource::track(p, &native.layout, native.stage, Some(&st)).expect("resource::track");
    let io = io::raise(p, native).expect("io::raise");
    let was = lower::TEST_HOST_WAVE.replace(Some(host_wave));
    let lowered = lower::lower(&lower::Parts {
        native,
        p,
        st: &st,
        io: &io,
        res: &res,
        inputs: Vec::new(),
        outputs: Vec::new(),
        prims: Vec::new(),
        mesh_stride: 0,
    });
    lower::TEST_HOST_WAVE.set(was);
    let lowered = lowered?;
    Ok(HostShader {
        stage: HwStage::Cs,
        dxil: lowered.dxil,
        user_data: lowered.user_data,
        samplers: lowered.samplers,
        static_samplers: Vec::new(),
        root_cbvs: lowered.root_cbvs,
        root_srvs: lowered.root_srvs,
        root_uavs: lowered.root_uavs,
        root_indexed_views: res.root_indexed_views,
    })
}

#[test]
fn a_sum_of_halves_over_the_wave_is_the_consoles_tree_bit_for_bit() {
    // thread t holds the 16-bit float with bits 0x3C00 + 37 t (1.0 and up, with odd
    // mantissas, so that additions round); all of them store the wave's sum
    let mut words = vec![
        0x340C_0085, // v_lshlrev_b32 v6, 5, v0
        0x340E_0082, // v_lshlrev_b32 v7, 2, v0
        0x4A0E_0F06, // v_add_nc_u32 v7, v6, v7
        0x4A0E_0F00, // v_add_nc_u32 v7, v0, v7
        0x4A0E_0EFF,
        0x0000_3C00, // v_add_nc_u32 v7, 0x3c00, v7
    ];
    // (the wave OR's words with v_add_f16 for v_or_b32: opcode 50 for 28)
    words.extend(super::wave::WAVE_OR_V7_TO_S7.iter().map(|&w| if w >> 25 == 28 { w & 0x01FF_FFFF | 50 << 25 } else { w }));
    words.extend_from_slice(&[
        0x7E00_0207, // v_mov_b32 v0, s7
        0x38 << 26 | 0x1C << 18,
        0x80 << 24 | 2 << 16, // buffer_store_dword v0, off, s[8:11], 0
    ]);
    let native = native(&words);
    let p = ir::build(&native.code, native.wave64, native.vgprs).expect("ir::build");
    assert_eq!(p.blocks.iter().flat_map(|b| &b.insts).filter(|i| i.name() == "v_add_f16").count(), 6);
    let shader = lowered(&native, &p, &HashSet::new()).expect("lower");
    if let Ok(mut v) = validator::Validator::load(validator::Validator::default_path().as_deref()) {
        let mut copy = shader.dxil.clone();
        v.validate(&mut copy).expect("DXIL validation failed");
    }
    // the console's sum: lanes 2k and 2k+1, then pairs, ... each addition rounded to 16 bits
    // (to nearest, ties to even); values here are normal numbers
    let wide = |h: u16| f32::from_bits((u32::from(h >> 10) + 112) << 23 | u32::from(h & 0x3FF) << 13);
    let narrow = |f: f32| {
        let b = f.to_bits();
        let h = ((b >> 23) - 112) << 10 | (b >> 13 & 0x3FF);
        let rest = b & 0x1FFF;
        (h + u32::from(rest > 0x1000 || rest == 0x1000 && h & 1 == 1)) as u16
    };
    let add = |a: u16, b: u16| narrow(wide(a) + wide(b));
    let terms: Vec<u16> = (0..64u16).map(|t| 0x3C00 + 37 * t).collect();
    let mut tree = terms.clone();
    while tree.len() > 1 {
        tree = tree.chunks(2).map(|c| add(c[0], c[1])).collect();
    }
    let in_a_row = terms.iter().copied().reduce(add).unwrap();
    assert_ne!(tree[0], in_a_row, "these terms tell the tree from another order");
    let _one = super::valu_tests::ONE_AT_A_TIME.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    let Ok(host) = Host::new(false) else {
        eprintln!("no SM 6.6 hardware device; not run");
        return;
    };
    let (root, pso) = match host.compute_pipeline(&shader) {
        Ok(x) => x,
        Err(e) => {
            eprintln!("the hardware device does not take this program (waves of 32?): {e}; not run");
            return;
        }
    };
    let ud = vec![0u32; shader.user_data_dwords().max(1) as usize];
    let out = host
        .dispatch(
            &root,
            &pso,
            &Dispatch {
                roots: vec![(0, Root::Constants(ud))],
                views: &[View::RawUav(1)],
                samplers: &[],
                groups: [1, 1, 1],
            },
        )
        .unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("dispatch failed: {e}"));
    // (the high half is lane 0's term's: zero)
    assert_eq!(out[0][0], u32::from(tree[0]), "tree {:#x}, in a row {in_a_row:#x}", tree[0]);
    eprintln!("ran on the hardware device: the sum {:#x} of the console's tree", tree[0]);
}

/// The console's 16-bit wave sum where the lanes at or past s0 have left the program (a
/// thread past the end of the data): on the console they add +0, and after each step of the
/// tree they hold their run's partial sum all the same. On a host of 64-lane waves (AMD) the
/// lanes that are here read each partner run's sum from a lane of it that is here.
#[test]
fn a_sum_of_halves_where_lanes_have_left_is_the_consoles_tree_bit_for_bit() {
    let mut words = vec![
        0x7DA8_0000, // v_cmpx_gt_u32 exec, s0, v0: the lanes below s0 stay
        0, // s_cbranch_execz to the end (filled in below)
        0x340C_0085, // v_lshlrev_b32 v6, 5, v0
        0x340E_0082, // v_lshlrev_b32 v7, 2, v0
        0x4A0E_0F06, // v_add_nc_u32 v7, v6, v7
        0x4A0E_0F00, // v_add_nc_u32 v7, v0, v7
        0x4A0E_0EFF,
        0x0000_3C00, // v_add_nc_u32 v7, 0x3c00, v7
    ];
    words.extend(super::wave::WAVE_OR_V7_TO_S7.iter().map(|&w| if w >> 25 == 28 { w & 0x01FF_FFFF | 50 << 25 } else { w }));
    words.extend_from_slice(&[
        0x7E00_0207, // v_mov_b32 v0, s7
        0x38 << 26 | 0x1C << 18,
        0x80 << 24 | 2 << 16, // buffer_store_dword v0, off, s[8:11], 0
    ]);
    // past every word after it, to the program's end
    words[1] = 0xBF88_0000 | (words.len() as u32 - 2);
    let native = native(&words);
    let p = ir::build(&native.code, native.wave64, native.vgprs).expect("ir::build");
    let shader = lowered_on(&native, &p, &HashSet::new(), 64).expect("lower");
    if let Ok(mut v) = validator::Validator::load(validator::Validator::default_path().as_deref()) {
        let mut copy = shader.dxil.clone();
        v.validate(&mut copy).expect("DXIL validation failed");
    }
    let wide = |h: u16| {
        if h == 0 {
            0.0
        } else {
            f32::from_bits((u32::from(h >> 10) + 112) << 23 | u32::from(h & 0x3FF) << 13)
        }
    };
    let narrow = |f: f32| {
        if f == 0.0 {
            return 0;
        }
        let b = f.to_bits();
        let h = ((b >> 23) - 112) << 10 | (b >> 13 & 0x3FF);
        let rest = b & 0x1FFF;
        (h + u32::from(rest > 0x1000 || rest == 0x1000 && h & 1 == 1)) as u16
    };
    let add = |a: u16, b: u16| narrow(wide(a) + wide(b));
    let _one = super::valu_tests::ONE_AT_A_TIME.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    let mut ran = false;
    for stay in [64u32, 63, 40, 33, 32, 17, 5, 1] {
        let terms: Vec<u16> = (0..64u32)
            .map(|t| if t < stay { (0x3C00 + 37 * t) as u16 } else { 0 })
            .collect();
        let mut tree = terms.clone();
        while tree.len() > 1 {
            tree = tree.chunks(2).map(|c| add(c[0], c[1])).collect();
        }
        let Some(got) = on_the_card(&shader, [stay, 0]) else {
            return;
        };
        ran = true;
        // (the high half is lane 0's term's: zero)
        assert_eq!(got, u32::from(tree[0]), "{stay} lanes stay: got {got:#x}, the console's tree {:#x}", tree[0]);
    }
    if ran {
        eprintln!("ran on the hardware device: the console's tree with lanes gone, in every case");
    }
}

/// One `v_add_f16` whose exact result lies between two halves: 1 + 3/1024 (0x3C03) plus 2
/// (0x4000) is 3 + 1.5 steps of that range, which the console rounds up to 0x4202. The
/// host's `f32tof16` may give 0x4201 (toward zero); with `VICTORY_F16_NEAREST=1` the
/// translation gives the console's whatever the host does.
#[test]
fn a_16_bit_sum_rounds_to_nearest_when_asked_to() {
    let words = [
        0x7E0E_02FF,
        0x0000_3C03, // v_mov_b32 v7, 0x3c03
        0x7E0C_02FF,
        0x0000_4000, // v_mov_b32 v6, 0x4000
        0x6400_0D07, // v_add_f16 v0, v7, v6
        0x38 << 26 | 0x1C << 18,
        0x80 << 24 | 2 << 16, // buffer_store_dword v0, off, s[8:11], 0
    ];
    let native = native(&words);
    let p = ir::build(&native.code, native.wave64, native.vgprs).expect("ir::build");
    assert!(p.blocks.iter().flat_map(|b| &b.insts).any(|i| i.name() == "v_add_f16"));
    let _one = super::valu_tests::ONE_AT_A_TIME.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    for nearest in [false, true] {
        let was = lower::TEST_F16_NEAREST.replace(Some(nearest));
        let shader = lowered(&native, &p, &HashSet::new());
        lower::TEST_F16_NEAREST.set(was);
        let shader = shader.expect("lower");
        if let Ok(mut v) = validator::Validator::load(validator::Validator::default_path().as_deref()) {
            let mut copy = shader.dxil.clone();
            v.validate(&mut copy).expect("DXIL validation failed");
        }
        let Ok(host) = Host::new(false) else {
            eprintln!("no SM 6.6 hardware device; not run");
            return;
        };
        let Ok((root, pso)) = host.compute_pipeline(&shader) else {
            eprintln!("the hardware device does not take this program; not run");
            return;
        };
        let ud = vec![0u32; shader.user_data_dwords().max(1) as usize];
        let out = host
            .dispatch(
                &root,
                &pso,
                &Dispatch {
                    roots: vec![(0, Root::Constants(ud))],
                    views: &[View::RawUav(1)],
                    samplers: &[],
                    groups: [1, 1, 1],
                },
            )
            .unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("dispatch failed: {e}"));
        let got = out[0][0] & 0xFFFF;
        eprintln!("v_add_f16 0x3c03 + 0x4000 on the hardware device, nearest {nearest}: {got:#x}");
        if nearest {
            assert_eq!(got, 0x4202);
        } else {
            assert!(got == 0x4201 || got == 0x4202, "{got:#x}");
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn a_wave_or_inside_a_lane_branch_needs_the_branch_wave_wide() {
    for (skip, name) in [(0xBF88_0000, "s_cbranch_execz"), (0xBF84_0000, "s_cbranch_scc0")] {
        a_wave_or_inside(skip, name);
    }
}

fn a_wave_or_inside(skip: u32, name: &str) {
    let native = program(skip);
    let p = ir::build(&native.code, native.wave64, native.vgprs).expect("ir::build");
    let branch = (0..p.blocks.len())
        .find(|&b| p.blocks[b].insts.last().is_some_and(|i| i.name() == name))
        .expect("the branch");
    // per lane, the two host waves cannot meet inside the branch
    lower::take_needs();
    let per_lane = lowered(&native, &p, &HashSet::new());
    assert!(
        matches!(&per_lane, Err(ShaderError::Unsupported { what, .. }) if *what == "a wave reduction where not every lane runs"),
        "{:?}",
        per_lane.err()
    );
    // ... and the lowering names the block, around which that branch is the one to widen
    let needs = lower::take_needs();
    let st = structure::structure(&p).expect("structure");
    assert_eq!(lower::branches_around(&st, &needs), Some(vec![branch]));
    // (taken, past the body, when every lane's bit is clear)
    assert_eq!(st.wave_any[branch], Some(false));
    // wave-wide, every lane runs the reduction (EXEC stays a guard on what it does there)
    let wide = HashSet::from([branch]);
    let st = structure::structure_wide(&p, &wide).expect("structure");
    let inside = match p.blocks[branch].exit {
        ir::Exit::Branch { not_taken, .. } => not_taken,
        _ => unreachable!(),
    };
    assert!(st.guards[inside].iter().any(Option::is_some));
    let shader = lowered(&native, &p, &wide).expect("lower");
    if let Ok(mut v) = validator::Validator::load(validator::Validator::default_path().as_deref()) {
        let mut copy = shader.dxil.clone();
        v.validate(&mut copy).expect("DXIL validation failed");
    }
    // On a GPU that takes waves of 32 (two host waves for the console's one): the OR is of
    // both halves, whichever half's lanes take the branch.
    let _one = super::valu_tests::ONE_AT_A_TIME.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    let Ok(host) = Host::new(false) else {
        eprintln!("no SM 6.6 hardware device; not run");
        return;
    };
    let (root, pso) = match host.compute_pipeline(&shader) {
        Ok(x) => x,
        Err(e) => {
            eprintln!("the hardware device does not take this program (waves of 32?): {e}; not run");
            return;
        }
    };
    // (threads below s0 take the branch; thread t gives bit t >> 1)
    for (below, expected) in [(64u32, u32::MAX), (40, 0x000F_FFFF), (33, 0x0001_FFFF), (10, 0x1F), (1, 1)] {
        let mut ud = vec![0u32; shader.user_data_dwords().max(1) as usize];
        for u in &shader.user_data {
            if let (RootType::Constants, 0, 0) = (u.root, u.slot, u.dword) {
                ud[u.index as usize] = below;
            }
        }
        let out = host
            .dispatch(
                &root,
                &pso,
                &Dispatch {
                    roots: vec![(0, Root::Constants(ud))],
                    views: &[View::RawUav(1)],
                    samplers: &[],
                    groups: [1, 1, 1],
                },
            )
            .unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("dispatch failed: {e}"));
        assert_eq!(out[0][0], expected, "{name}: {below} threads in the branch");
    }
    eprintln!("ran on the hardware device ({name}): the OR of both halves in every case");
}

/// Runs `shader` on the hardware device with the root constants `s0`, `s1` and gives dword 0
/// of the UAV; None (and a line) without a device that takes it.
fn on_the_card(shader: &HostShader, constants: [u32; 2]) -> Option<u32> {
    let Ok(host) = Host::new(false) else {
        eprintln!("no SM 6.6 hardware device; not run");
        return None;
    };
    let Ok((root, pso)) = host.compute_pipeline(shader) else {
        eprintln!("the hardware device does not take this program; not run");
        return None;
    };
    let mut ud = vec![0u32; shader.user_data_dwords().max(1) as usize];
    for u in &shader.user_data {
        if let (RootType::Constants, 0, d @ 0..=1) = (u.root, u.slot, u.dword) {
            ud[u.index as usize] = constants[d as usize];
        }
    }
    let out = host
        .dispatch(
            &root,
            &pso,
            &Dispatch {
                roots: vec![(0, Root::Constants(ud))],
                views: &[View::RawUav(1)],
                samplers: &[],
                groups: [1, 1, 1],
            },
        )
        .unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("dispatch failed: {e}"));
    Some(out[0][0])
}

/// A 32-lane console wave. A register holds a lane mask on one path (the lanes below s0)
/// and a number on the other, and is read as a number after the join, as the trace programs
/// keep their lanes' masks and their node numbers on one stack
/// (`deferred_tiled:CS_LaserLightShadowRaytracing`, s46 at 0x104, 0x75c and 0x188). The
/// mask arrives as the ballot of its lanes.
#[test]
fn a_lane_mask_joined_with_a_number_is_read_as_the_number_it_is() {
    let words = [
        0x7D88_0000, // v_cmp_gt_u32 vcc_lo, s0, v0
        0xBE94_036A, // s_mov_b32 s20, vcc_lo
        0xBF06_8001, // s_cmp_eq_u32 s1, 0
        0xBF85_0001, // s_cbranch_scc1 over the next
        0xBE94_0385, // s_mov_b32 s20, 5
        0x7E00_0214, // v_mov_b32 v0, s20
        0x38 << 26 | 0x1C << 18,
        0x80 << 24 | 2 << 16, // buffer_store_dword v0, off, s[8:11], 0
    ];
    let native = native_of(&words, false, 32);
    let p = ir::build(&native.code, native.wave64, native.vgprs).expect("ir::build");
    let shader = lowered(&native, &p, &HashSet::new()).expect("lower");
    if let Ok(mut v) = validator::Validator::load(validator::Validator::default_path().as_deref()) {
        let mut copy = shader.dxil.clone();
        v.validate(&mut copy).expect("DXIL validation failed");
    }
    let _one = super::valu_tests::ONE_AT_A_TIME.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    for (below, other, expected) in [(32u32, 0u32, u32::MAX), (10, 0, 0x3FF), (0, 0, 0), (10, 1, 5)] {
        let Some(got) = on_the_card(&shader, [below, other]) else { return };
        assert_eq!(got, expected, "{below} lanes in the mask, s1 = {other}");
    }
    eprintln!("ran on the hardware device: the mask's bits, or the number");
}

/// A 32-lane console wave. `if (t < s0) { ... SCC = (s1 == 7) }` and a branch on SCC after
/// the join: the skip brings the SCC of `s_and_saveexec` ("some lane is left") along
/// (`rtdirectionalshadows:CS_RTShadowTrace32HQ_TiledFarOnly`, 0x360-0x39c). On the console
/// the skip is taken by the wave, so with some lane inside every lane sees the inner test.
/// A lane that skipped on its own would see "some lane is left" instead: refused per lane,
/// right with the branch taken wave-wide. Lane 31 stores what it saw.
#[test]
fn scc_of_a_mask_operation_joined_with_a_scalar_test_needs_the_skip_wave_wide() {
    let words = [
        0x7D88_0000, // v_cmp_gt_u32 vcc_lo, s0, v0
        0xBE8D_3C6A, // s_and_saveexec_b32 s13, vcc_lo
        0xBF88_0001, // s_cbranch_execz over the next
        0xBF06_8701, // s_cmp_eq_u32 s1, 7
        0xBEFE_030D, // s_mov_b32 exec_lo, s13
        0xBF85_0002, // s_cbranch_scc1 to "seven"
        0x7E0A_0281, // v_mov_b32 v5, 1
        0xBF82_0001, // s_branch over the next
        0x7E0A_0282, // seven: v_mov_b32 v5, 2
        0x7DA4_009F, // v_cmpx_eq_u32 exec_lo, 31, v0
        0x38 << 26 | 0x1C << 18,
        0x80 << 24 | 2 << 16 | 5 << 8, // buffer_store_dword v5, off, s[8:11], 0
    ];
    let native = native_of(&words, false, 32);
    let p = ir::build(&native.code, native.wave64, native.vgprs).expect("ir::build");
    let branch = (0..p.blocks.len())
        .find(|&b| p.blocks[b].insts.last().is_some_and(|i| i.name() == "s_cbranch_execz"))
        .expect("the skip");
    lower::take_needs();
    let per_lane = lowered(&native, &p, &HashSet::new());
    assert!(
        matches!(&per_lane, Err(ShaderError::Unsupported { what, .. }) if *what == "a lane mask read as data"),
        "{:?}",
        per_lane.err()
    );
    let st = structure::structure(&p).expect("structure");
    assert_eq!(lower::branches_around(&st, &lower::take_needs()), Some(vec![branch]));
    let shader = lowered(&native, &p, &HashSet::from([branch])).expect("lower");
    if let Ok(mut v) = validator::Validator::load(validator::Validator::default_path().as_deref()) {
        let mut copy = shader.dxil.clone();
        v.validate(&mut copy).expect("DXIL validation failed");
    }
    let _one = super::valu_tests::ONE_AT_A_TIME.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    // (lanes below s0 inside, s1) -> what lane 31 stores: 2 if SCC was set at the branch
    for (below, s1, expected) in [(0u32, 7u32, 1u32), (10, 7, 2), (10, 3, 1), (32, 3, 1), (32, 7, 2)] {
        let Some(got) = on_the_card(&shader, [below, s1]) else { return };
        assert_eq!(got, expected, "{below} lanes inside, s1 = {s1}");
    }
    eprintln!("ran on the hardware device: the inner test's SCC for every lane once some lane is inside");
}

```

`crates/victory-shader/src/gfx10/fields.rs`:

```rs
//! Operand fields of GFX10 instructions, by encoding.
//!
//! Layouts follow AMD's RDNA ISA reference. Register ranges carry their size
//! in dwords, which depends on the opcode (read from its name) and, for lane
//! masks (VCC, EXEC, compare results), on the wave size.

use super::{Encoding, Instruction};

/// A source or destination of an instruction.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Operand {
    /// Scalar registers by operand code: 0-105 `s0`-`s105`, 106/107
    /// `vcc_lo`/`vcc_hi`, 108-123 `ttmp0`-`ttmp15`, 124 `m0`, 125 `null`,
    /// 126/127 `exec_lo`/`exec_hi`. The decoder gives no code above 127; the
    /// IR names scalars parked in VGPR lanes by the codes from 128 up
    /// (`crate::ir::PARKED`).
    Scalar {
        code: u8,
        dwords: u8,
    },
    Vector {
        reg: u8,
        dwords: u8,
    },
    /// Inline constant or read-only special source, by operand code
    /// (128-192: 0-64, 193-208: -1 to -16, 240-248: floats, 251-254: vccz,
    /// execz, scc, lds_direct).
    Const(u8),
    /// The 32-bit literal that follows the instruction.
    Literal(u32),
    /// Interpolation attribute and channel (0-3 = x-w); `high` selects the
    /// upper f16 half.
    Attr {
        index: u8,
        chan: u8,
        high: bool,
    },
}

/// Operand code of `null` (no register; reads as 0).
pub const NULL: u8 = 125;
const VCC: u8 = 106;
const EXEC: u8 = 126;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Cache {
    pub glc: bool,
    pub slc: bool,
    pub dlc: bool,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Fields {
    /// SOP1, SOP2, SOPC, SOPK; `imm` is SOPK's 16-bit immediate.
    Sop {
        dst: Option<Operand>,
        src: Vec<Operand>,
        imm: Option<u16>,
    },
    /// The 16-bit immediate: branch offset in dwords, wait counts, message...
    Sopp {
        imm: u16,
    },
    Smem {
        data: Option<Operand>,
        base: Operand,
        /// Signed byte offset, added to `soffset`.
        offset: i32,
        soffset: Operand,
        cache: Cache,
    },
    Valu(Valu),
    Vintrp {
        dst: Operand,
        /// The i/j VGPR, or for `v_interp_mov_f32` the parameter (0 `p10`,
        /// 1 `p20`, 2 `p0`) as [`Operand::Const`].
        src: Operand,
        attr: Operand,
    },
    Ds {
        dst: Option<Operand>,
        addr: Option<Operand>,
        data: Vec<Operand>,
        offset0: u8,
        offset1: u8,
        gds: bool,
    },
    /// MUBUF, and MTBUF with `format` set.
    Buffer {
        /// Loaded, stored, or the atomic operand (and result with `glc`).
        data: Option<Operand>,
        addr: Operand,
        rsrc: Operand,
        soffset: Operand,
        offset: u16,
        offen: bool,
        idxen: bool,
        format: Option<u8>,
        lds: bool,
        tfe: bool,
        cache: Cache,
    },
    Image {
        data: Operand,
        /// One range, or one VGPR per address with the NSA form.
        addr: Vec<Operand>,
        rsrc: Operand,
        sampler: Option<Operand>,
        dmask: u8,
        dim: u8,
        unorm: bool,
        r128: bool,
        a16: bool,
        d16: bool,
        tfe: bool,
        lwe: bool,
        cache: Cache,
    },
    /// FLAT, GLOBAL and SCRATCH.
    Flat {
        dst: Option<Operand>,
        addr: Option<Operand>,
        data: Option<Operand>,
        saddr: Option<Operand>,
        offset: i16,
        lds: bool,
        cache: Cache,
    },
    Exp {
        target: u8,
        /// Per channel; `None` when disabled.
        src: [Option<Operand>; 4],
        compr: bool,
        done: bool,
        vm: bool,
    },
}

/// VOP1, VOP2, VOPC, VOP3 and VOP3P, with their SDWA and DPP forms.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Valu {
    /// A VGPR range, an SGPR (`v_readlane_b32`...) or a lane mask (compares).
    pub dst: Option<Operand>,
    /// Carry-out or the second result of VOP3B (`v_add_co_u32`, `v_div_scale_f32`...).
    pub carry: Option<Operand>,
    /// In operand order, including the implicit VCC of VOP2 `v_cndmask_b32`
    /// and carry-in, and the literal of `v_madmk`/`v_madak` forms.
    pub src: Vec<Operand>,
    /// Bit i applies to `src[i]`. For VOP3P, `neg` is the low half's.
    pub neg: u8,
    pub abs: u8,
    /// VOP3P: negate the high half (`v_fma_mix*`: absolute value).
    pub neg_hi: u8,
    /// VOP3: bit 3 is the destination. VOP3P with `opsel_hi`: the halves used.
    pub opsel: u8,
    pub opsel_hi: u8,
    pub clamp: bool,
    /// Output modifier: 1 ×2, 2 ×4, 3 ÷2.
    pub omod: u8,
    pub sdwa: Option<Sdwa>,
    pub dpp: Option<Dpp>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Sdwa {
    /// Selects: 0-3 byte, 4-5 word, 6 dword. Compares have no `dst_sel`.
    pub dst_sel: u8,
    /// 0 pad with zeros, 1 sign-extend, 2 preserve.
    pub dst_unused: u8,
    pub src_sel: [u8; 2],
    /// Bit i sign-extends `src[i]`.
    pub sext: u8,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Dpp {
    /// DPP16: `ctrl` is the 9-bit permutation (quad_perm, row shifts...).
    Row {
        ctrl: u16,
        row_mask: u8,
        bank_mask: u8,
        bound_ctrl: bool,
        fi: bool,
    },
    /// DPP8: eight 3-bit lane selects.
    Lanes { sel: u32, fi: bool },
}

impl Instruction {
    /// Decodes the operand fields. `wave64` sizes lane masks.
    pub fn fields(&self, wave64: bool) -> Fields {
        let name = self.name().unwrap_or("");
        let w = |i: usize| self.words.get(i).copied().unwrap_or(0);
        let (w0, w1) = (w(0), w(1));
        let bit = |word: u32, n: u32| word >> n & 1 != 0;
        let cache = |glc, slc, dlc| Cache { glc, slc, dlc };
        match self.encoding {
            Encoding::Sop2 | Encoding::Sop1 | Encoding::Sopc => {
                let (dst, src0, src1) = salu_dwords(name);
                let sdst = scalar((w0 >> 16 & 0x7F) as u8, dst);
                let ssrc = |shift: u32, dwords| source(w0 >> shift & 0xFF, dwords, w1);
                let (dst, src) = match self.encoding {
                    Encoding::Sop2 => (Some(sdst), vec![ssrc(0, src0), ssrc(8, src1)]),
                    Encoding::Sopc => (None, vec![ssrc(0, src0), ssrc(8, src1)]),
                    _ => match name {
                        "s_getpc_b64" => (Some(sdst), vec![]),
                        "s_setpc_b64" | "s_rfe_b64" => (None, vec![ssrc(0, src0)]),
                        _ => (Some(sdst), vec![ssrc(0, src0)]),
                    },
                };
                Fields::Sop {
                    dst,
                    src,
                    imm: None,
                }
            }
            Encoding::Sopk => {
                let sdst = scalar((w0 >> 16 & 0x7F) as u8, 1 + u8::from(name == "s_call_b64"));
                let (dst, src) = match name {
                    "s_setreg_imm32_b32" => (None, vec![Operand::Literal(w1)]),
                    "s_version" => (None, vec![]),
                    n if n.starts_with("s_cmpk_")
                        || n.starts_with("s_waitcnt_")
                        || n == "s_setreg_b32" =>
                    {
                        (None, vec![sdst])
                    }
                    _ => (Some(sdst), vec![]),
                };
                Fields::Sop {
                    dst,
                    src,
                    imm: Some(w0 as u16),
                }
            }
            Encoding::Sopp => Fields::Sopp { imm: w0 as u16 },
            Encoding::Smem => {
                let data = match name {
                    "s_gl1_inv" | "s_dcache_inv" | "s_dcache_wb" => None,
                    n if n.starts_with("s_dcache_discard") => None,
                    "s_memtime" | "s_memrealtime" => Some(2),
                    _ => Some(data_dwords(name)),
                };
                let base = 2 + 2 * u8::from(name.starts_with("s_buffer_"));
                Fields::Smem {
                    data: data.map(|d| scalar((w0 >> 6 & 0x7F) as u8, d)),
                    base: scalar(((w0 & 0x3F) << 1) as u8, base),
                    offset: (w1 << 11) as i32 >> 11,
                    soffset: scalar((w1 >> 25) as u8, 1),
                    cache: cache(bit(w0, 16), false, bit(w0, 14)),
                }
            }
            Encoding::Vop1 | Encoding::Vop2 | Encoding::Vopc | Encoding::Vop3 | Encoding::Vop3p => {
                Fields::Valu(self.valu(name, if wave64 { 2 } else { 1 }))
            }
            Encoding::Vintrp => {
                let vsrc = (w0 & 0xFF) as u8;
                Fields::Vintrp {
                    dst: vector(w0 >> 18, 1),
                    src: if name == "v_interp_mov_f32" {
                        Operand::Const(vsrc)
                    } else {
                        vector(vsrc.into(), 1)
                    },
                    attr: Operand::Attr {
                        index: (w0 >> 10 & 0x3F) as u8,
                        chan: (w0 >> 8 & 3) as u8,
                        high: false,
                    },
                }
            }
            Encoding::Ds => {
                let ty = data_dwords(name);
                let pair = ds_pair(name);
                let returns = name.contains("read")
                    || name.contains("_rtn")
                    || matches!(
                        name,
                        "ds_swizzle_b32"
                            | "ds_permute_b32"
                            | "ds_bpermute_b32"
                            | "ds_append"
                            | "ds_consume"
                            | "ds_ordered_count"
                    );
                let no_addr = name.starts_with("ds_gws")
                    || name.contains("addtid")
                    || matches!(name, "ds_nop" | "ds_append" | "ds_consume");
                let data = if name.contains("read")
                    || name.contains("src2")
                    || matches!(
                        name,
                        "ds_swizzle_b32"
                            | "ds_nop"
                            | "ds_append"
                            | "ds_consume"
                            | "ds_ordered_count"
                            | "ds_gws_sema_v"
                            | "ds_gws_sema_p"
                            | "ds_gws_sema_release_all"
                    ) {
                    0
                } else if pair || name.contains("cmpst") || name.contains("mskor") {
                    2
                } else {
                    1
                };
                Fields::Ds {
                    dst: returns.then(|| vector(w1 >> 24, ty * (1 + u8::from(pair)))),
                    addr: (!no_addr).then(|| vector(w1 & 0xFF, 1)),
                    data: (0..data)
                        .map(|i| vector(w1 >> (8 + 8 * i) & 0xFF, ty))
                        .collect(),
                    offset0: w0 as u8,
                    offset1: (w0 >> 8) as u8,
                    gds: bit(w0, 17),
                }
            }
            Encoding::Mubuf | Encoding::Mtbuf => {
                let (offen, idxen, tfe) = (bit(w0, 12), bit(w0, 13), bit(w1, 23));
                let mtbuf = self.encoding == Encoding::Mtbuf;
                Fields::Buffer {
                    data: (!name.ends_with("_inv"))
                        .then(|| vector(w1 >> 8 & 0xFF, data_dwords(name) + u8::from(tfe))),
                    addr: vector(w1 & 0xFF, 1 + u8::from(offen && idxen)),
                    rsrc: scalar(((w1 >> 16 & 0x1F) << 2) as u8, 4),
                    soffset: source(w1 >> 24, 1, 0),
                    offset: (w0 & 0xFFF) as u16,
                    offen,
                    idxen,
                    format: mtbuf.then_some((w0 >> 19 & 0x7F) as u8),
                    lds: !mtbuf && bit(w0, 16),
                    tfe,
                    cache: cache(bit(w0, 14), bit(w1, 22), bit(w0, 15)),
                }
            }
            Encoding::Mimg => {
                let (dim, dmask, a16, d16) = (
                    (w0 >> 3 & 7) as u8,
                    (w0 >> 8 & 0xF) as u8,
                    bit(w1, 30),
                    bit(w1, 31),
                );
                let (r128, tfe, lwe) = (bit(w0, 15), bit(w0, 16), bit(w0, 17));
                let mut data = if name.starts_with("image_gather4") {
                    4
                } else {
                    dmask.count_ones().max(1) as u8
                };
                if d16 {
                    data = data.div_ceil(2);
                }
                let count = image_addr_dwords(name, dim, a16);
                let addr = if w0 >> 1 & 3 == 0 {
                    vec![vector(w1 & 0xFF, count)]
                } else {
                    // NSA: one VGPR per address, the first in dword 1, the rest
                    // in the extra dwords.
                    (0..usize::from(count))
                        .map(|i| match i {
                            0 => vector(w1 & 0xFF, 1),
                            i => vector(w(2 + (i - 1) / 4) >> (8 * ((i - 1) % 4)) & 0xFF, 1),
                        })
                        .collect()
                };
                let sampled = ["image_sample", "image_gather4", "image_get_lod"]
                    .iter()
                    .any(|p| name.starts_with(p));
                Fields::Image {
                    data: vector(w1 >> 8 & 0xFF, data + u8::from(tfe || lwe)),
                    addr,
                    rsrc: scalar(((w1 >> 16 & 0x1F) << 2) as u8, if r128 { 4 } else { 8 }),
                    sampler: sampled.then(|| scalar(((w1 >> 21 & 0x1F) << 2) as u8, 4)),
                    dmask,
                    dim,
                    unorm: bit(w0, 12),
                    r128,
                    a16,
                    d16,
                    tfe,
                    lwe,
                    cache: cache(bit(w0, 13), bit(w0, 25), bit(w0, 7)),
                }
            }
            Encoding::Flat | Encoding::Global | Encoding::Scratch => {
                let saddr = (w1 >> 16 & 0x7F) as u8;
                let glc = bit(w0, 16);
                let n = data_dwords(name);
                let (load, atomic) = (name.contains("_load_"), name.contains("_atomic_"));
                let addr = match self.encoding {
                    Encoding::Flat => Some(vector(w1 & 0xFF, 2)),
                    Encoding::Global => Some(vector(w1 & 0xFF, 1 + u8::from(saddr == NULL))),
                    // With an SGPR base, scratch takes no VGPR.
                    _ => (saddr == NULL).then(|| vector(w1 & 0xFF, 1)),
                };
                let ret = if atomic && name.contains("cmpswap") {
                    n / 2
                } else {
                    n
                };
                Fields::Flat {
                    dst: (load || atomic && glc).then(|| vector(w1 >> 24, ret)),
                    addr,
                    data: (!load).then(|| vector(w1 >> 8 & 0xFF, n)),
                    saddr: (self.encoding != Encoding::Flat)
                        .then(|| scalar(saddr, 1 + u8::from(self.encoding == Encoding::Global))),
                    offset: match self.encoding {
                        Encoding::Flat => (w0 & 0x7FF) as i16,
                        _ => ((w0 << 4) as i16) >> 4,
                    },
                    lds: bit(w0, 13),
                    cache: cache(glc, bit(w0, 17), bit(w0, 12)),
                }
            }
            Encoding::Exp => {
                let compr = bit(w0, 10);
                Fields::Exp {
                    target: (w0 >> 4 & 0x3F) as u8,
                    src: std::array::from_fn(|i| {
                        let slot = if compr { i / 2 } else { i };
                        bit(w0, i as u32).then(|| vector(w1 >> (8 * slot) & 0xFF, 1))
                    }),
                    compr,
                    done: bit(w0, 11),
                    vm: bit(w0, 12),
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fn valu(&self, name: &str, lanes: u8) -> Valu {
        // No operands; the console compiler stores a shader hash in their fields.
        if matches!(name, "v_nop" | "v_pipeflush" | "v_clrexcp") {
            return Valu::default();
        }
        let w = |i: usize| self.words.get(i).copied().unwrap_or(0);
        let w0 = w(0);
        let (dst_n, src_n) = valu_dwords(name);
        let compare = match self.encoding {
            Encoding::Vopc => true,
            Encoding::Vop3 => self.opcode < 0x100,
            _ => false,
        };
        let vop3b = VOP3B.contains(&name);
        let carry_in = name.ends_with("_co_ci_u32") || name == "v_cndmask_b32";
        let mut v = Valu::default();
        match self.encoding {
            Encoding::Vop1 | Encoding::Vop2 | Encoding::Vopc => {
                let ext = w(1);
                let mut src0 = w0 & 0x1FF;
                let vsrc1 = 256 + (w0 >> 9 & 0xFF);
                let mut src1 = vsrc1;
                match src0 {
                    0xF9 => {
                        let sdwa = Sdwa {
                            dst_sel: (ext >> 8 & 7) as u8,
                            dst_unused: (ext >> 11 & 3) as u8,
                            src_sel: [(ext >> 16 & 7) as u8, (ext >> 24 & 7) as u8],
                            sext: (ext >> 19 & 1 | ext >> 26 & 2) as u8,
                        };
                        // The s0/s1 bits select an SGPR or constant instead of a VGPR.
                        src0 = (ext & 0xFF) | if ext >> 23 & 1 == 0 { 256 } else { 0 };
                        if ext >> 31 == 1 {
                            src1 = vsrc1 - 256;
                        }
                        v.neg = (ext >> 20 & 1 | ext >> 27 & 2) as u8;
                        v.abs = (ext >> 21 & 1 | ext >> 28 & 2) as u8;
                        if compare {
                            if ext >> 15 & 1 == 1 {
                                v.dst = Some(scalar((ext >> 8 & 0x7F) as u8, lanes));
                            }
                            v.sdwa = Some(Sdwa {
                                dst_sel: 6,
                                dst_unused: 0,
                                ..sdwa
                            });
                        } else {
                            v.clamp = ext >> 13 & 1 == 1;
                            v.omod = (ext >> 14 & 3) as u8;
                            v.sdwa = Some(sdwa);
                        }
                    }
                    0xFA => {
                        src0 = 256 + (ext & 0xFF);
                        v.neg = (ext >> 20 & 1 | ext >> 21 & 2) as u8;
                        v.abs = (ext >> 21 & 1 | ext >> 22 & 2) as u8;
                        v.dpp = Some(Dpp::Row {
                            ctrl: (ext >> 8 & 0x1FF) as u16,
                            row_mask: (ext >> 28) as u8,
                            bank_mask: (ext >> 24 & 0xF) as u8,
                            bound_ctrl: ext >> 19 & 1 == 1,
                            fi: ext >> 18 & 1 == 1,
                        });
                    }
                    0xE9 | 0xEA => {
                        v.dpp = Some(Dpp::Lanes {
                            sel: ext >> 8,
                            fi: src0 == 0xEA,
                        });
                        src0 = 256 + (ext & 0xFF);
                    }
                    _ => {}
                }
                let op0 = source(src0, src_n[0], ext);
                let op1 = source(src1, src_n[1], ext);
                match self.encoding {
                    Encoding::Vopc => {
                        let mask = if name.starts_with("v_cmpx") {
                            EXEC
                        } else {
                            VCC
                        };
                        v.dst = v.dst.or(Some(scalar(mask, lanes)));
                        v.src = vec![op0, op1];
                    }
                    Encoding::Vop1 => {
                        v.dst = Some(valu_dst(name, w0 >> 17 & 0xFF, dst_n));
                        v.src = vec![op0];
                    }
                    _ => {
                        v.dst = Some(vector(w0 >> 17 & 0xFF, dst_n));
                        v.src = match name {
                            n if n.ends_with("mk_f32") || n.ends_with("mk_f16") => {
                                vec![op0, Operand::Literal(ext), op1]
                            }
                            n if n.ends_with("ak_f32") || n.ends_with("ak_f16") => {
                                vec![op0, op1, Operand::Literal(ext)]
                            }
                            _ => vec![op0, op1],
                        };
                        if carry_in {
                            v.src.push(scalar(VCC, lanes));
                        }
                        if name.ends_with("_co_ci_u32") {
                            v.carry = Some(scalar(VCC, lanes));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            Encoding::Vop3 | Encoding::Vop3p => {
                let w1 = w(1);
                let field = |i: u32| w1 >> (9 * i) & 0x1FF;
                let count = match self.opcode {
                    _ if self.encoding == Encoding::Vop3p => {
                        if name.starts_with("v_pk_")
                            && !name.contains("_fma_")
                            && !name.contains("_mad_")
                        {
                            2
                        } else {
                            3
                        }
                    }
                    0x000..0x100 => 2,
                    0x100..0x140 => 2 + usize::from(carry_in),
                    0x180..0x200 => 1,
                    _ if VOP3_TWO_SOURCES.contains(&name) => 2,
                    _ => 3,
                };
                v.src = (0..count)
                    .map(|i| {
                        let code = field(i as u32);
                        if i == 0 && name.starts_with("v_interp_") {
                            Operand::Attr {
                                index: (code & 0x3F) as u8,
                                chan: (code >> 6 & 3) as u8,
                                high: code >> 8 & 1 == 1,
                            }
                        } else if i == 2 && carry_in {
                            source(code, lanes, w(2))
                        } else {
                            source(code, src_n[i], w(2))
                        }
                    })
                    .collect();
                v.clamp = w0 >> 15 & 1 == 1;
                v.neg = (w1 >> 29) as u8;
                if self.encoding == Encoding::Vop3p {
                    v.neg_hi = (w0 >> 8 & 7) as u8;
                    v.opsel = (w0 >> 11 & 7) as u8;
                    v.opsel_hi = (w1 >> 27 & 3 | w0 >> 12 & 4) as u8;
                } else {
                    v.omod = (w1 >> 27 & 3) as u8;
                    if vop3b {
                        v.carry = Some(scalar((w0 >> 8 & 0x7F) as u8, lanes));
                    } else {
                        v.abs = (w0 >> 8 & 7) as u8;
                        v.opsel = (w0 >> 11 & 0xF) as u8;
                    }
                }
                let vdst = w0 & 0xFF;
                v.dst = Some(if compare {
                    scalar(vdst as u8, lanes)
                } else {
                    valu_dst(name, vdst, dst_n)
                });
            }
            _ => unreachable!("not a VALU encoding"),
        }
        v
    }
}

/// VOP3-only opcodes that take two sources (the rest take three).
const VOP3_TWO_SOURCES: &[&str] = &[
    "v_add_f64",
    "v_mul_f64",
    "v_min_f64",
    "v_max_f64",
    "v_ldexp_f64",

    "v_add_nc_i32",

/// VOP3 opcodes whose bits 14:8 hold a scalar destination instead of `abs`/`opsel`.
const VOP3B: &[&str] = &[
    "v_add_co_u32",
    "v_sub_co_u32",
    "v_subrev_co_u32",
    "v_add_co_ci_u32",
    "v_sub_co_ci_u32",
    "v_subrev_co_ci_u32",
    "v_div_scale_f32",
    "v_div_scale_f64",
    "v_mad_u64_u32",
    "v_mad_i64_i32",
];

fn scalar(code: u8, dwords: u8) -> Operand {
    Operand::Scalar { code, dwords }
}

fn vector(reg: u32, dwords: u8) -> Operand {
    Operand::Vector {
        reg: reg as u8,
        dwords,
    }
}

/// A 9-bit source field (8-bit scalar fields are the same codes below 256).
fn source(code: u32, dwords: u8, literal: u32) -> Operand {
    match code {
        0..=127 => scalar(code as u8, dwords),
        255 => Operand::Literal(literal),
        256.. => vector(code - 256, dwords),
        _ => Operand::Const(code as u8),
    }
}

/// VALU destinations that are SGPRs.
fn valu_dst(name: &str, field: u32, dwords: u8) -> Operand {
    match name {
        "v_readlane_b32" | "v_readfirstlane_b32" => scalar(field as u8, 1),
        _ => vector(field, dwords),
    }
}

/// LDS opcodes on two addresses (`ds_read2_b32`...), with `offset0`/`offset1`.
pub(super) fn ds_pair(name: &str) -> bool {
    name.split('_').any(|t| {
        ["read2", "write2", "wrxchg2"]
            .iter()
            .any(|p| t.starts_with(p))
    })
}

/// Dwords of a type suffix such as `b64` or `f32`.
fn type_dwords(token: &str) -> u8 {
    match token {
        "b64" | "u64" | "i64" | "f64" => 2,
        _ => 1,
    }
}

/// (sdst, ssrc0, ssrc1) dwords of a scalar ALU opcode.
fn salu_dwords(name: &str) -> (u8, u8, u8) {
    match name {
        "s_lshl_b64" | "s_lshr_b64" | "s_ashr_i64" | "s_bfe_u64" | "s_bfe_i64"
        | "s_bitcmp0_b64" | "s_bitcmp1_b64" => (2, 2, 1),
        "s_bfm_b64" | "s_bitset0_b64" | "s_bitset1_b64" | "s_bitreplicate_b64_b32" => (2, 1, 1),
        "s_bcnt0_i32_b64" | "s_bcnt1_i32_b64" | "s_ff0_i32_b64" | "s_ff1_i32_b64"
        | "s_flbit_i32_b64" | "s_flbit_i32_i64" => (1, 2, 2),
        _ => {
            let n = type_dwords(name.rsplit('_').next().unwrap_or(""));
            (n, n, n)
        }
    }
}

/// (vdst, [src0, src1, src2]) dwords of a VALU opcode.
fn valu_dwords(name: &str) -> (u8, [u8; 3]) {
    let parts: Vec<&str> = name.split('_').collect();
    match name {
        "v_lshlrev_b64" | "v_lshrrev_b64" | "v_ashrrev_i64" => (2, [1, 2, 2]),
        "v_ldexp_f64" | "v_trig_preop_f64" | "v_cmp_class_f64" | "v_cmpx_class_f64" => {
            (2, [2, 1, 2])
        }
        "v_mad_u64_u32" | "v_mad_i64_i32" => (2, [1, 1, 2]),
        "v_qsad_pk_u16_u8" | "v_mqsad_pk_u16_u8" => (2, [2, 1, 2]),
        "v_mqsad_u32_u8" => (4, [2, 1, 4]),
        "v_frexp_exp_i32_f64" => (1, [2; 3]),
        _ if parts.len() == 4 && parts[1] == "cvt" => {
            (type_dwords(parts[2]), [type_dwords(parts[3]); 3])
        }
        _ => {
            let n = type_dwords(parts.last().copied().unwrap_or(""));
            (n, [n; 3])
        }
    }
}

/// Dwords of loaded, stored or atomic data, from the opcode name.
fn data_dwords(name: &str) -> u8 {
    let mut n: u8 = 1;
    for token in name.split('_') {
        n = match token {
            "dwordx2" | "x2" | "xy" | "b64" | "u64" | "i64" | "f64" => 2,
            "dwordx3" | "xyz" | "b96" => 3,
            "dwordx4" | "xyzw" | "b128" => 4,
            "dwordx8" => 8,
            "dwordx16" => 16,
            _ => n,
        };
    }
    if name.contains("cmpswap") {
        n *= 2;
    }
    if name.contains("format_d16") {
        n = n.div_ceil(2);
    }
    n
}

/// Address dwords of an image opcode: offset, bias, compare, derivatives,
/// coordinates, then LOD/clamp/mip, packed in pairs with `a16`.
fn image_addr_dwords(name: &str, dim: u8, a16: bool) -> u8 {
    // (coordinates, derivatives per direction) for 1D 2D 3D CUBE 1D_ARRAY
    // 2D_ARRAY 2D_MSAA 2D_MSAA_ARRAY.
    const DIMS: [(u8, u8); 8] = [
        (1, 1),
        (2, 2),
        (3, 3),
        (3, 2),
        (2, 1),
        (3, 2),
        (3, 2),
        (4, 2),
    ];
    let (coords, grads) = DIMS[usize::from(dim & 7)];
    match name {
        "image_bvh_intersect_ray" => return if a16 { 8 } else { 11 },
        "image_bvh64_intersect_ray" => return if a16 { 9 } else { 12 },
        "image_get_resinfo" => return 1,
        _ => {}
    }
    let (mut whole, mut derivs, mut packed): (u8, u8, u8) = (0, 0, coords);
    if let Some(rest) = name
        .strip_prefix("image_sample")
        .or_else(|| name.strip_prefix("image_gather4"))
    {
        for token in rest.split('_') {
            match token {
                "o" | "b" | "c" => whole += 1,
                "d" | "cd" => derivs = grads,
                "l" | "cl" => packed += 1,
                _ => {}
            }
        }
    } else if name.contains("_mip") {
        packed += 1;
    }
    if a16 {
        whole + 2 * derivs.div_ceil(2) + packed.div_ceil(2)
    } else {
        whole + 2 * derivs + packed
    }
}
```
