`crates/victory-shader/src/gfx10/mod.rs`:

```rs
//! GFX10 machine code: instruction boundaries, encodings and opcodes.
//!
//! Instructions are found by following control flow from offset 0, not by a
//! linear sweep: compilers place data (constant tables) in the code region
//! after the end of the program. [`Instruction::fields`] decodes the operand
//! fields and [`Instruction::text`] prints them in AMD's SP3 syntax.
//!
//! Encodings by the top bits of the first dword:
//!
//! ```text
//! 0xxxxxxx  VOP2; 0111111 VOP1; 0111110 VOPC
//! 10        SOP2; 1011 SOPK; 101111101 SOP1; 101111110 SOPC; 101111111 SOPP
//! 110010 VINTRP  110011 VOP3P  110101 VOP3  110110 DS  110111 FLAT/GLOBAL/SCRATCH
//! 111000 MUBUF   111010 MTBUF  111100 MIMG  111101 SMEM  111110 EXP
//! ```

mod fields;
mod opcodes;
mod sp3;

pub use fields::{Cache, Dpp, Fields, NULL, Operand, Sdwa, Valu};

use std::collections::BTreeMap;

use crate::ShaderError;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
pub enum Encoding {
    Sop2,
    Sopk,
    Sop1,
    Sopc,
    Sopp,
    Smem,
    Vop2,
    Vop1,
    Vopc,
    Vop3,
    Vop3p,
    Vintrp,
    Ds,
    Mubuf,
    Mtbuf,
    Mimg,
    Exp,
    Flat,
    Global,
    Scratch,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Instruction {
    /// Byte offset in the program.
    pub offset: usize,
    pub encoding: Encoding,
    pub opcode: u16,
    /// Every dword of the instruction, including literals and extra dwords.
    pub words: Vec<u32>,
}

impl Instruction {
    /// AMD's name for the opcode, if it is in our table.
    pub fn name(&self) -> Option<&'static str> {
        name(self.encoding, self.opcode)
    }
}

/// Decodes every instruction reachable from offset 0, sorted by offset.
pub fn decode(code: &[u8]) -> Result<Vec<Instruction>, ShaderError> {
    if !code.len().is_multiple_of(4) {
        return Err(isa(code.len(), "code size is not a multiple of 4"));
    }
    let mut found = BTreeMap::new();
    let mut pending = vec![0usize];
    while let Some(mut offset) = pending.pop() {
        while !found.contains_key(&offset) {
            let inst = instruction(code, offset)?;
            let next = offset + 4 * inst.words.len();
            let flow = control(&inst, code.len(), |at| {
                found.range(..at).next_back().map(|(_, i)| i)
            })?;
            found.insert(offset, inst);
            match flow {
                Flow::Next => offset = next,
                Flow::Stop => break,
                Flow::Jump(target) => offset = target,
                Flow::Branch(target) => {
                    pending.push(target);
                    offset = next;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    let list: Vec<Instruction> = found.into_values().collect();
    if let Some(w) = list
        .windows(2)
        .find(|w| w[0].offset + 4 * w[0].words.len() > w[1].offset)
    {
        return Err(isa(w[1].offset, "a branch lands inside an instruction"));
    }
    Ok(list)
}

/// Where execution goes after an instruction.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum Flow {
    Next,
    /// End of the program, or an indirect jump that is not a far jump.
    Stop,
    Jump(usize),
    /// Conditional: to the target or the next instruction.
    Branch(usize),
}

/// Control flow after `inst`, resolving far jumps. `before(at)` returns the
/// decoded instruction with the highest offset below `at`, if any.
pub(crate) fn control<'a>(
    inst: &Instruction,
    len: usize,
    before: impl Fn(usize) -> Option<&'a Instruction>,
) -> Result<Flow, ShaderError> {
    Ok(match flow(inst, inst.offset + 4 * inst.words.len(), len)? {
        Flow::Stop if inst.name() == Some("s_setpc_b64") => {
            far_jump(before, inst, len)?.map_or(Flow::Stop, Flow::Jump)
        }
        flow => flow,
    })
}

fn flow(inst: &Instruction, next: usize, len: usize) -> Result<Flow, ShaderError> {
    let target = || {
        let delta = 4 * i64::from(inst.words[0] as u16 as i16);
        usize::try_from(next as i64 + delta)
            .ok()
            .filter(|&t| t < len)
            .ok_or(isa(inst.offset, "branch target outside the code"))
    };
    Ok(match (inst.encoding, inst.name().unwrap_or("")) {
        (
            Encoding::Sopp,
            "s_endpgm" | "s_endpgm_saved" | "s_endpgm_ordered_ps_done" | "s_code_end",
        ) => Flow::Stop,
        (Encoding::Sopp, "s_branch") => Flow::Jump(target()?),
        (Encoding::Sopp, name) if name.starts_with("s_cbranch_") => Flow::Branch(target()?),
        (Encoding::Sopk, "s_call_b64") => Flow::Branch(target()?),
        // Indirect jump; `decode` resolves the compiler's far-jump form.
        (Encoding::Sop1, "s_setpc_b64") => Flow::Stop,
        _ => Flow::Next,
    })
}

/// Resolves the far jump compilers emit beyond the reach of a branch offset:
/// `s_getpc_b64 s[n:n+1]`, `s_add_u32|s_sub_u32 sn, sn, literal`, a carry
/// into s(n+1), `s_setpc_b64 s[n:n+1]`, looking back over the straight-line
/// run just decoded. Any other `s_setpc_b64` (e.g. a handover to the next
/// merged stage through registers) gives `None`.
fn far_jump<'a>(
    before: impl Fn(usize) -> Option<&'a Instruction>,
    setpc: &Instruction,
    len: usize,
) -> Result<Option<usize>, ShaderError> {
    let n = setpc.words[0] & 0xFF;
    let mut delta = None;
    let mut at = setpc.offset;
    for _ in 0..4 {
        let Some(prev) = before(at) else {
            break;
        };
        if prev.offset + 4 * prev.words.len() != at {
            break;
        }
        let w = prev.words[0];
        let (sdst, ssrc0, ssrc1) = ((w >> 16) & 0x7F, w & 0xFF, (w >> 8) & 0xFF);
        match (prev.encoding, prev.name()) {
            (Encoding::Sop2, Some(op @ ("s_add_u32" | "s_sub_u32")))
                if sdst == n && ssrc0 == n && ssrc1 == 0xFF && delta.is_none() =>
            {
                // The low dword of a signed 64-bit offset: a backward jump
                // adds a negative one (its high dword is -1).
                let literal = i64::from(prev.words[1] as i32);
                delta = Some(if op == "s_add_u32" { literal } else { -literal });
            }
            (Encoding::Sop1, Some("s_getpc_b64")) if sdst == n => {
                let Some(delta) = delta else { break };
                // s_getpc_b64 yields the address of the instruction after it.
                return usize::try_from(prev.offset as i64 + 4 + delta)
                    .ok()
                    .filter(|&t| t < len)
                    .map(Some)
                    .ok_or(isa(setpc.offset, "far jump target outside the code"));
            }
            _ => {}
        }
        at = prev.offset;
    }
    Ok(None)
}

fn instruction(code: &[u8], offset: usize) -> Result<Instruction, ShaderError> {
    let word = |i: usize| {
        code.get(offset + 4 * i..offset + 4 * i + 4)
            .map(|b| u32::from_le_bytes(b.try_into().expect("4 bytes")))
            .ok_or(isa(offset, "instruction runs past the end of the code"))
    };
    let w = word(0)?;
    let (encoding, opcode, len) = if w >> 31 == 0 {
        let src0 = w & 0x1FF;
        // Literal constant, SDWA, DPP16, DPP8, DPP8 with fetch-inactive.
        let extra = usize::from(matches!(src0, 0xFF | 0xF9 | 0xFA | 0xE9 | 0xEA));
        match w >> 25 {
            0x3F => (Encoding::Vop1, (w >> 9) & 0xFF, 1 + extra),
            0x3E => (Encoding::Vopc, (w >> 17) & 0xFF, 1 + extra),
            op => {
                let mk_ak = name(Encoding::Vop2, op as u16).is_some_and(|n| {
                    matches!(
                        n,
                        "v_madmk_f32"
                            | "v_madak_f32"
                            | "v_fmamk_f32"
                            | "v_fmaak_f32"
                            | "v_madmk_f16"
                            | "v_madak_f16"
                            | "v_fmamk_f16"
                            | "v_fmaak_f16"
                    )
                });
                (Encoding::Vop2, op, 1 + extra.max(usize::from(mk_ak)))
            }
        }
    } else if w >> 30 == 0b10 {
        let literal = |srcs: &[u32]| 1 + usize::from(srcs.contains(&0xFF));
        match w >> 23 {
            0x17D => (Encoding::Sop1, (w >> 8) & 0xFF, literal(&[w & 0xFF])),
            0x17E => (
                Encoding::Sopc,
                (w >> 16) & 0x7F,
                literal(&[w & 0xFF, (w >> 8) & 0xFF]),
            ),
            0x17F => (Encoding::Sopp, (w >> 16) & 0x7F, 1),
            _ if w >> 28 == 0b1011 => {
                let op = (w >> 23) & 0x1F;
                let imm32 = name(Encoding::Sopk, op as u16) == Some("s_setreg_imm32_b32");
                (Encoding::Sopk, op, 1 + usize::from(imm32))
            }
            _ => (
                Encoding::Sop2,
                (w >> 23) & 0x7F,
                literal(&[w & 0xFF, (w >> 8) & 0xFF]),
            ),
        }
    } else {
        let vop3 =
            |w1: u32| 2 + usize::from([w1, w1 >> 9, w1 >> 18].iter().any(|s| s & 0x1FF == 0xFF));
        match w >> 26 {
            0x32 => (Encoding::Vintrp, (w >> 16) & 0x3, 1),
            0x33 => (Encoding::Vop3p, (w >> 16) & 0x7F, vop3(word(1)?)),
            0x35 => (Encoding::Vop3, (w >> 16) & 0x3FF, vop3(word(1)?)),
            0x36 => (Encoding::Ds, (w >> 18) & 0xFF, 2),
            0x37 => {
                let encoding = match (w >> 14) & 3 {
                    0 => Encoding::Flat,
                    1 => Encoding::Scratch,
                    2 => Encoding::Global,
                    _ => return Err(isa(offset, "reserved FLAT segment")),
                };
                (encoding, (w >> 18) & 0x7F, 2)
            }
            0x38 => (Encoding::Mubuf, (w >> 18) & 0x7F | (w >> 25 & 1) << 7, 2),
            0x3A => (
                Encoding::Mtbuf,
                (w >> 16) & 0x7 | (word(1)? >> 21 & 1) << 3,
                2,
            ),
            // Bits 2:1 count extra dwords of non-sequential address registers.
            0x3C => (
                Encoding::Mimg,
                (w >> 18) & 0x7F | (w & 1) << 7,
                2 + (w as usize >> 1 & 3),
            ),
            0x3D => (Encoding::Smem, (w >> 18) & 0xFF, 2),
            0x3E => (Encoding::Exp, 0, 2),
            _ => return Err(isa(offset, "unknown encoding")),
        }
    };
    Ok(Instruction {
        offset,
        encoding,
        opcode: opcode as u16,
        words: (0..len).map(word).collect::<Result<_, _>>()?,
    })
}

fn name(encoding: Encoding, opcode: u16) -> Option<&'static str> {
    use opcodes as t;
    let (table, op) = match encoding {
        Encoding::Sop2 => (t::SOP2, opcode),
        Encoding::Sopk => (t::SOPK, opcode),
        Encoding::Sop1 => (t::SOP1, opcode),
        Encoding::Sopc => (t::SOPC, opcode),
        Encoding::Sopp => (t::SOPP, opcode),
        Encoding::Smem => (t::SMEM, opcode),
        Encoding::Vop2 => (t::VOP2, opcode),
        Encoding::Vop1 => (t::VOP1, opcode),
        Encoding::Vopc => (t::VOPC, opcode),
        // VOP3 also encodes the VOPC, VOP2 and VOP1 opcodes at fixed bases.
        Encoding::Vop3 => match opcode {
            0x000..0x100 => (t::VOPC, opcode),
            0x100..0x140 => (t::VOP2, opcode - 0x100),
            0x180..0x200 => (t::VOP1, opcode - 0x180),
            _ => (t::VOP3, opcode),
        },
        Encoding::Vop3p => (t::VOP3P, opcode),
        Encoding::Vintrp => (t::VINTRP, opcode),
        Encoding::Ds => (t::DS, opcode),
        Encoding::Mubuf => (t::MUBUF, opcode),
        Encoding::Mtbuf => (t::MTBUF, opcode),
        Encoding::Mimg => (t::MIMG, opcode),
        Encoding::Exp => return Some("exp"),
        Encoding::Flat => (t::FLAT, opcode),
        Encoding::Global => (t::GLOBAL, opcode),
        Encoding::Scratch => (t::SCRATCH, opcode),
    };
    table
        .binary_search_by_key(&op, |&(o, _)| o)
        .ok()
        .map(|i| table[i].1)
}

fn isa(offset: usize, reason: &'static str) -> ShaderError {
    ShaderError::Isa { offset, reason }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    const S_ENDPGM: u32 = 0xBF81_0000;
    /// s_branch / s_cbranch_scc0 with a dword offset relative to the next instruction.
    const fn sopp(op: u32, simm16: i16) -> u32 {
        0xBF80_0000 | op << 16 | simm16 as u16 as u32
    }

    fn bytes(words: &[u32]) -> Vec<u8> {
        words.iter().flat_map(|w| w.to_le_bytes()).collect()
    }

    fn summary(code: &[u32]) -> Vec<(usize, usize, &'static str)> {
        decode(&bytes(code))
            .unwrap()
            .iter()
            .map(|i| (i.offset, i.words.len(), i.name().unwrap_or("?")))
            .collect()
    }

    #[test]
    fn tables_are_sorted() {
        for t in [
            opcodes::SOP2,
            opcodes::SOPK,
            opcodes::SOP1,
            opcodes::SOPC,
            opcodes::SOPP,
            opcodes::SMEM,
            opcodes::VOP2,
            opcodes::VOP1,
            opcodes::VOPC,
            opcodes::VOP3,
            opcodes::VOP3P,
            opcodes::VINTRP,
            opcodes::DS,
            opcodes::MUBUF,
            opcodes::MTBUF,
            opcodes::MIMG,
            opcodes::FLAT,
            opcodes::GLOBAL,
            opcodes::SCRATCH,
        ] {
            assert!(t.windows(2).all(|w| w[0].0 < w[1].0));
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn lengths_and_names() {
        let code = [
            0xBE80_03FF,
            0x3F80_0000, // s_mov_b32 s0, literal
            0x0600_0000, // v_add_f32 v0, s0, v0
            0xD54B_0000,
            0x03FE_0000,
            0x4000_0000, // v_fma_f32 with a literal src2
            0xF080_0F0A,
            0,
            0, // image_sample (2D) with one extra address dword
            0xF800_080F,
            0, // exp
            S_ENDPGM,
        ];
        assert_eq!(
            summary(&code),
            [
                (0, 2, "s_mov_b32"),
                (8, 1, "v_add_f32"),
                (12, 3, "v_fma_f32"),
                (24, 3, "image_sample"),
                (36, 2, "exp"),
                (44, 1, "s_endpgm"),
            ]
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn follows_branches_and_skips_data() {
        let code = [
            sopp(0x04, 1), // s_cbranch_scc0 -> 8
            sopp(0x02, 1), // s_branch -> 12
            S_ENDPGM,
            S_ENDPGM,
            S_ENDPGM, // data follows the program end
            0xFFFF_FFFF,
        ];
        let found: Vec<_> = summary(&code).iter().map(|i| i.0).collect();
        assert_eq!(found, [0, 4, 8, 12]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn follows_far_jumps() {
        let code = [
            0xBE88_1F00, // s_getpc_b64 s[8:9]
            0x8008_FF08,
            20,          // s_add_u32 s8, s8, 20  -> 4 + 20 = 24
            0x8209_8009, // s_addc_u32 s9, s9, 0
            0xBE80_2008, // s_setpc_b64 s[8:9]
            0xFFFF_FFFF, // not code
            S_ENDPGM,
        ];
        let found: Vec<_> = summary(&code).iter().map(|i| (i.0, i.2)).collect();
        assert_eq!(
            found,
            [
                (0, "s_getpc_b64"),
                (4, "s_add_u32"),
                (12, "s_addc_u32"),
                (16, "s_setpc_b64"),
                (24, "s_endpgm"),
            ]
        );
        // Through other registers (a handover to another stage): the path ends.
        assert_eq!(summary(&[0xBE80_2018, S_ENDPGM]).len(), 1);
    }

    #[test]
    fn follows_far_jumps_backward() {
        // The compiler's backward far jump adds a negative offset: the low
        // dword as a 32-bit literal, the high dword as -1 with the carry.
        let code = [
            sopp(0x02, 1), // s_branch -> 8, past the jump target
            S_ENDPGM,      // the far jump's target: only it reaches here
            0xBE88_1F00,   // s_getpc_b64 s[8:9]
            0x8008_FF08,
            0xFFFF_FFF8, // s_add_u32 s8, s8, -8 -> 12 - 8 = 4
            0x8209_C109, // s_addc_u32 s9, s9, -1
            0xBE80_2008, // s_setpc_b64 s[8:9]
        ];
        let found: Vec<_> = summary(&code).iter().map(|i| (i.0, i.2)).collect();
        assert_eq!(
            found,
            [
                (0, "s_branch"),
                (4, "s_endpgm"),
                (8, "s_getpc_b64"),
                (12, "s_add_u32"),
                (20, "s_addc_u32"),
                (24, "s_setpc_b64"),
            ]
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn rejects_bad_code() {
        assert!(decode(&[0; 3]).is_err(), "size not a multiple of 4");
        assert!(
            decode(&bytes(&[sopp(0x02, 100)])).is_err(),
            "branch out of range"
        );
        assert!(
            decode(&bytes(&[0xBE80_03FF])).is_err(),
            "literal past the end"
        );
        assert!(
            decode(&bytes(&[0xE400_0000, 0])).is_err(),
            "unknown encoding"
        );
        // s_cbranch_scc0 into the literal of the s_mov_b32 at 4.
        assert!(decode(&bytes(&[sopp(0x04, 1), 0xBE80_03FF, S_ENDPGM, S_ENDPGM])).is_err());
    }
}

```

    (0x05e, "global_atomic_fcmpswap_x2"),
    (0x05f, "global_atomic_fmin_x2"),
    (0x060, "global_atomic_fmax_x2"),
];

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    fn bytes(words: &[u32]) -> Vec<u8> {
        words.iter().flat_map(|w| w.to_le_bytes()).collect()
    }

    /// `s_ttracedata_imm 0x1234` as LLVM's GFX10 disassembler tests have it
    /// (`gfx10_sopp.txt`: `0x34,0x12,0xa8,0xbf`), SOPP opcode 0x28 as in
    /// AMD's RDNA2 ISA. A thread-trace marker, which translation drops.
    #[test]
    fn s_ttracedata_imm_is_sopp_0x28() {
        let code = bytes(&[0xBFA8_1234, 0xBF81_0000]);
        let decoded = super::super::decode(&code).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(decoded[0].name(), Some("s_ttracedata_imm"));
        assert!(crate::ir::build(&code, false, 1).is_ok());
    }
}

`crates/victory-shader/src/gfx10/sp3.rs`:

```rs
//! Instruction text in AMD's SP3 assembly syntax.

use std::fmt::{self, Display, Write};

use super::fields::{Cache, Dpp, Fields, NULL, Operand, Valu};
use super::{Encoding, Instruction};

impl Instruction {
    /// The instruction in SP3 syntax, e.g. `v_add_f32 v1, 0.5, v8`.
    /// Branch targets are written `label_<byte offset>`.
    pub fn text(&self, wave64: bool) -> String {
        let name = self.name().unwrap_or("?");
        let ops = operands(self, name, &self.fields(wave64));
        if ops.is_empty() {
            name.to_owned()
        } else {
            format!("{name} {ops}")
        }
    }
}

impl Display for Operand {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter) -> fmt::Result {
        match *self {
            Operand::Scalar { code, dwords: 1 } => f.write_str(&scalar_name(code)),
            Operand::Scalar {
                code: 106,
                dwords: 2,
            } => f.write_str("vcc"),
            Operand::Scalar {
                code: 126,
                dwords: 2,
            } => f.write_str("exec"),
            Operand::Scalar { code, dwords } if code < 106 => {
                write!(f, "s[{code}:{}]", code + dwords - 1)
            }
            Operand::Scalar { code, dwords } if (108..124).contains(&code) => {
                write!(f, "ttmp[{}:{}]", code - 108, code - 108 + dwords - 1)
            }
            Operand::Scalar { code, .. } => f.write_str(&scalar_name(code)),
            Operand::Vector { reg, dwords: 1 } => write!(f, "v{reg}"),
            Operand::Vector { reg, dwords } => {
                write!(f, "v[{reg}:{}]", reg as u32 + dwords as u32 - 1)
            }
            Operand::Const(code) => f.write_str(&const_name(code)),
            Operand::Literal(value) => write!(f, "lit(0x{value:08x})"),
            Operand::Attr { index, chan, .. } => write!(
                f,
                "attr{index}.{}",
                ['x', 'y', 'z', 'w'][usize::from(chan & 3)]
            ),
        }
    }
}

fn scalar_name(code: u8) -> String {
    match code {
        0..=105 => format!("s{code}"),
        106 => "vcc_lo".into(),
        107 => "vcc_hi".into(),
        108..=123 => format!("ttmp{}", code - 108),
        124 => "m0".into(),
        125 => "null".into(),
        126 => "exec_lo".into(),
        _ => "exec_hi".into(),
    }
}

fn const_name(code: u8) -> String {
    match code {
        128..=192 => (i32::from(code) - 128).to_string(),
        193..=208 => (192 - i32::from(code)).to_string(),
        240 => "0.5".into(),
        241 => "-0.5".into(),
        242 => "1.0".into(),
        243 => "-1.0".into(),
        244 => "2.0".into(),
        245 => "-2.0".into(),
        246 => "4.0".into(),
        247 => "-4.0".into(),
        248 => "0.15915494".into(),
        235 => "src_shared_base".into(),
        236 => "src_shared_limit".into(),
        237 => "src_private_base".into(),
        238 => "src_private_limit".into(),
        239 => "src_pops_exiting_wave_id".into(),
        251 => "src_vccz".into(),
        252 => "src_execz".into(),
        253 => "src_scc".into(),
        254 => "src_lds_direct".into(),
        _ => format!("<src {code}>"),
    }
}

fn join(ops: impl IntoIterator<Item = String>) -> String {
    ops.into_iter().collect::<Vec<_>>().join(", ")
}

fn operands(inst: &Instruction, name: &str, fields: &Fields) -> String {
    let mut out = String::new();
    match fields {
        Fields::Sop { dst, src, imm } => {
            let regs = join(dst.iter().chain(src).map(|o| o.to_string()));
            out = match (name, imm) {
                ("s_getreg_b32", Some(imm)) => format!("{regs}, {}", hwreg(*imm)),
                ("s_setreg_b32" | "s_setreg_imm32_b32", Some(imm)) => {
                    format!("{}, {regs}", hwreg(*imm))
                }
                ("s_call_b64", Some(imm)) => format!("{regs}, {}", label(inst, *imm)),
                (_, Some(imm)) if regs.is_empty() => format!("0x{imm:04x}"),
                (_, Some(imm)) => format!("{regs}, 0x{imm:04x}"),
                (_, None) => regs,
            };
        }
        Fields::Sopp { imm } => {
            out = match name {
                "s_endpgm"
                | "s_barrier"
                | "s_code_end"
                | "s_endpgm_saved"
                | "s_endpgm_ordered_ps_done"
                | "s_wakeup"
                | "s_icache_inv"
                | "s_ttracedata" => String::new(),
                "s_branch" => label(inst, *imm),
                n if n.starts_with("s_cbranch_") => label(inst, *imm),
                "s_waitcnt" => waitcnt(*imm),
                "s_sendmsg" | "s_sendmsghalt" => sendmsg(*imm),
                _ => format!("0x{imm:04x}"),
            };
        }
        Fields::Smem {
            data,
            base,
            offset,
            soffset,
            cache,
        } => {
            if let Some(data) = data {
                let off = match (soffset, offset) {
                    (Operand::Scalar { code: NULL, .. }, 0) => soffset.to_string(),
                    (Operand::Scalar { code: NULL, .. }, _) => {
                        format!("0x{:06x}", offset & 0x1F_FFFF)
                    }
                    (_, 0) => soffset.to_string(),
                    _ => format!("{soffset} offset:0x{:06x}", offset & 0x1F_FFFF),
                };
                out = format!("{data}, {base}, {off}");
            }
            flags(&mut out, cache, false);
        }
        Fields::Valu(v) => out = valu(name, v, inst.encoding),
        Fields::Vintrp { dst, src, attr } => {
            let src = match (name, src) {
                ("v_interp_mov_f32", Operand::Const(p)) => ["p10", "p20", "p0"]
                    .get(usize::from(*p))
                    .map_or("p?".into(), |p| p.to_string()),
                _ => src.to_string(),
            };
            out = format!("{dst}, {src}, {attr}");
        }
        Fields::Ds {
            dst,
            addr,
            data,
            offset0,
            offset1,
            gds,
        } => {
            out = join(dst.iter().chain(addr).chain(data).map(|o| o.to_string()));
            if super::fields::ds_pair(name) {
                if *offset0 != 0 {
                    let _ = write!(out, " offset0:{offset0}");
                }
                if *offset1 != 0 {
                    let _ = write!(out, " offset1:{offset1}");
                }
            } else {
                let offset = u16::from(*offset1) << 8 | u16::from(*offset0);
                if offset != 0 {
                    let _ = write!(out, " offset:{offset}");
                }
            }
            if *gds {
                out.push_str(" gds");
            }
        }
        Fields::Buffer {
            data,
            addr,
            rsrc,
            soffset,
            offset,
            offen,
            idxen,
            format,
            lds,
            tfe,
            cache,
        } => {
            if let Some(data) = data {
                out = format!("{data}, {addr}, {rsrc}, {soffset}");
                if *idxen {
                    out.push_str(" idxen");
                }
                if *offen {
                    out.push_str(" offen");
                }
                if *offset != 0 {
                    let _ = write!(out, " offset:{offset}");
                }
                if let Some(format) = format {
                    let _ = write!(out, " format:[{}]", buffer_format(*format));
                }
            }
            flags(&mut out, cache, false);
            if *lds {
                out.push_str(" lds");
            }
            if *tfe {
                out.push_str(" tfe");
            }
        }
        Fields::Image {
            data,
            addr,
            rsrc,
            sampler,
            dmask,
            dim,
            unorm,
            r128,
            a16,
            d16,
            tfe,
            lwe,
            cache,
        } => {
            let addr = match addr.as_slice() {
                [one] => one.to_string(),
                many => format!(
                    "[{}]",
                    many.iter()
                        .map(|o| o.to_string())
                        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                        .join(",")
                ),
            };
            out = join(
                [data.to_string(), addr, rsrc.to_string()]
                    .into_iter()
                    .chain(sampler.map(|s| s.to_string())),
            );
            if *dmask != 1 {
                let _ = write!(out, " dmask:0x{dmask:x}");
            }
            let dims = [
                "1D",
                "2D",
                "3D",
                "CUBE",
                "1D_ARRAY",
                "2D_ARRAY",
                "2D_MSAA",
                "2D_MSAA_ARRAY",
            ];
            let _ = write!(out, " dim:SQ_RSRC_IMG_{}", dims[usize::from(*dim & 7)]);
            for (on, text) in [(*r128, "r128"), (*unorm, "unorm")] {
                if on {
                    out.push(' ');
                    out.push_str(text);
                }
            }
            flags(&mut out, cache, true);
            for (on, text) in [(*a16, "a16"), (*d16, "d16"), (*tfe, "tfe"), (*lwe, "lwe")] {
                if on {
                    out.push(' ');
                    out.push_str(text);
                }
            }
        }
        Fields::Flat {
            dst,
            addr,
            data,
            saddr,
            offset,
            lds,
            cache,
        } => {
            let addr = addr.map_or("off".into(), |a| a.to_string());
            out = join(
                dst.iter()
                    .map(|o| o.to_string())
                    .chain([addr])
                    .chain(data.iter().chain(saddr).map(|o| o.to_string())),
            );
            if *offset != 0 {
                let _ = write!(out, " inst_offset:{offset}");
            }
            flags(&mut out, cache, false);
            if *lds {
                out.push_str(" lds");
            }
        }
        Fields::Exp {
            target,
            src,
            compr,
            done,
            vm,
        } => {
            let target = match *target {
                0..=7 => format!("mrt{target}"),
                8 => "mrtz".into(),
                9 => "null".into(),
                12..=15 => format!("pos{}", target - 12),
                20 => "prim".into(),
                32..=63 => format!("param{}", target - 32),
                _ => format!("<target {target}>"),
            };
            out = join(
                [target].into_iter().chain(
                    src.iter()
                        .map(|s| s.map_or("off".into(), |o| o.to_string())),
                ),
            );
            for (on, text) in [(*done, " done"), (*compr, " compr"), (*vm, " vm")] {
                if on {
                    out.push_str(text);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    out
}

/// Cache flags; images write `dlc` first.
fn flags(out: &mut String, cache: &Cache, dlc_first: bool) {
    let dlc = (cache.dlc, " dlc");
    let (first, last) = if dlc_first {
        (dlc, (false, ""))
    } else {
        ((false, ""), dlc)
    };
    for (on, text) in [first, (cache.glc, " glc"), (cache.slc, " slc"), last] {
        if on {
            out.push_str(text);
        }
    }
    if out.starts_with(' ') {
        out.remove(0);
    }
}

fn label(inst: &Instruction, imm: u16) -> String {
    let target = inst.offset as i64 + 4 * inst.words.len() as i64 + 4 * i64::from(imm as i16);
    format!("label_{target:04X}")
}

fn hwreg(imm: u16) -> String {
    let (id, offset, size) = (imm & 0x3F, imm >> 6 & 0x1F, (imm >> 11 & 0x1F) + 1);
    let name = match id {
        1 => "HW_REG_MODE".into(),
        20 => "HW_REG_SHADER_FLAT_SCRATCH_LO".into(),
        21 => "HW_REG_SHADER_FLAT_SCRATCH_HI".into(),
        25 => "HW_REG_POPS_PACKER".into(),
        _ => id.to_string(),
    };
    if offset == 0 && size == 32 {
        format!("hwreg({name})")
    } else {
        format!("hwreg({name}, {offset}, {size})")
    }
}

fn waitcnt(imm: u16) -> String {
    let vm = imm & 0xF | (imm >> 14) << 4;
    let exp = imm >> 4 & 7;
    let lgkm = imm >> 8 & 0x3F;
    let mut parts = Vec::new();
    if vm != 0x3F {
        parts.push(format!("vmcnt({vm})"));
    }
    if exp != 7 {
        parts.push(format!("expcnt({exp})"));
    }
    if lgkm != 0x3F {
        parts.push(format!("lgkmcnt({lgkm})"));
    }
    if matches!(parts.len(), 0 | 3) {
        return format!("0x{imm:04x}");
    }
    parts.join(" & ")
}

fn sendmsg(imm: u16) -> String {
    let (msg, op, stream) = (imm & 0xF, imm >> 4 & 7, imm >> 8 & 3);
    let msg_name = match msg {
        2 => "MSG_GS".into(),
        3 => "MSG_GS_DONE".into(),
        7 => "MSG_ORDERED_PS_DONE".into(),
        9 => "MSG_GS_ALLOC_REQ".into(),
        _ => msg.to_string(),
    };
    let op_name = ["GS_OP_NOP", "GS_OP_CUT", "GS_OP_EMIT", "GS_OP_EMIT_CUT"]
        .get(usize::from(op))
        .map_or(op.to_string(), |s| s.to_string());
    if msg == 3 && op == 0 {
        format!("sendmsg({msg_name}, {op_name})")
    } else {
        format!("sendmsg({msg_name}, {op_name}, {stream})")
    }
}

fn buffer_format(format: u8) -> String {
    const NAMES: [&str; 78] = [
        "INVALID",
        "8_UNORM",
        "8_SNORM",
        "8_USCALED",
        "8_SSCALED",
        "8_UINT",
        "8_SINT",
        "16_UNORM",
        "16_SNORM",
        "16_USCALED",
        "16_SSCALED",
        "16_UINT",
        "16_SINT",
        "16_FLOAT",
        "8_8_UNORM",
        "8_8_SNORM",
        "8_8_USCALED",
        "8_8_SSCALED",
        "8_8_UINT",
        "8_8_SINT",
        "32_UINT",
        "32_SINT",
        "32_FLOAT",
        "16_16_UNORM",
        "16_16_SNORM",
        "16_16_USCALED",
        "16_16_SSCALED",
        "16_16_UINT",
        "16_16_SINT",
        "16_16_FLOAT",
        "10_11_11_UNORM",
        "10_11_11_SNORM",
        "10_11_11_USCALED",
        "10_11_11_SSCALED",
        "10_11_11_UINT",
        "10_11_11_SINT",
        "10_11_11_FLOAT",
        "11_11_10_UNORM",
        "11_11_10_SNORM",
        "11_11_10_USCALED",
        "11_11_10_SSCALED",
        "11_11_10_UINT",
        "11_11_10_SINT",
        "11_11_10_FLOAT",
        "10_10_10_2_UNORM",
        "10_10_10_2_SNORM",
        "10_10_10_2_USCALED",
        "10_10_10_2_SSCALED",
        "10_10_10_2_UINT",
        "10_10_10_2_SINT",
        "2_10_10_10_UNORM",
        "2_10_10_10_SNORM",
        "2_10_10_10_USCALED",
        "2_10_10_10_SSCALED",
        "2_10_10_10_UINT",
        "2_10_10_10_SINT",
        "8_8_8_8_UNORM",
        "8_8_8_8_SNORM",
        "8_8_8_8_USCALED",
        "8_8_8_8_SSCALED",
        "8_8_8_8_UINT",
        "8_8_8_8_SINT",
        "32_32_UINT",
        "32_32_SINT",
        "32_32_FLOAT",
        "16_16_16_16_UNORM",
        "16_16_16_16_SNORM",
        "16_16_16_16_USCALED",
        "16_16_16_16_SSCALED",
        "16_16_16_16_UINT",
        "16_16_16_16_SINT",
        "16_16_16_16_FLOAT",
        "32_32_32_UINT",
        "32_32_32_SINT",
        "32_32_32_FLOAT",
        "32_32_32_32_UINT",
        "32_32_32_32_SINT",

    ];
    NAMES
        .get(usize::from(format))
        .map_or(format!("{format}"), |n| format!("BUF_FMT_{n}"))
}

fn valu(name: &str, v: &Valu, encoding: Encoding) -> String {
    let bit = |mask: u8, i: usize| mask >> i & 1 != 0;
    let mix = name.starts_with("v_fma_mix");
    let src = |i: usize| {
        let o = v.src[i];
        let mut s = o.to_string();
        if let Some(sdwa) = v.sdwa
            && bit(sdwa.sext, i)
        {
            s = format!("sext({s})");
        }
        if encoding == Encoding::Vop3p {
            if mix {
                if bit(v.opsel_hi, i) {
                    s = format!("{}({s})", if bit(v.opsel, i) { "sel_hi" } else { "sel_lo" });
                }
                if bit(v.neg_hi, i) {
                    s = format!("abs({s})");
                }
                if bit(v.neg, i) {
                    s = format!("-{s}");
                }
            } else {
                if bit(v.neg, i) && bit(v.neg_hi, i) {
                    s = format!("-{s}");
                }
                match (bit(v.opsel, i), bit(v.opsel_hi, i)) {
                    (false, true) => {}
                    (false, false) => s = format!("sel_lo({s})"),
                    (true, true) => s = format!("sel_hi({s})"),
                    (true, false) => s = format!("sel_hi_lo({s})"),
                }
            }
        } else {
            if bit(v.abs, i) {
                s = format!("abs({s})");
            }
            if bit(v.neg, i) {
                s = format!("-{s}");
            }
            // v_permlane*: the opsel bits are fi and bound_ctrl.
            if bit(v.opsel, i) && !name.starts_with("v_permlane") {
                s = format!("sel_hi({s})");
            }
        }
        s
    };
    let mut ops: Vec<String> = v
        .dst
        .iter()
        .chain(&v.carry)
        .map(|o| o.to_string())
        .collect();
    let mut order: Vec<usize> = (0..v.src.len()).collect();
    if name.starts_with("v_interp_") && order.len() > 1 {
        // dst, i/j, attribute, then the p1 result for p2.
        order.swap(0, 1);
    }
    ops.extend(order.into_iter().map(src));
    let mut out = ops.join(", ");
    let mut suffix = |s: &str| {
        out.push(' ');
        out.push_str(s);
    };
    if let Some(Operand::Attr { high: true, .. }) = v.src.first() {
        suffix("high");
    }
    let omod = ["", "mul:2", "mul:4", "div:2"][usize::from(v.omod & 3)];
    if name.starts_with("v_permlane") {
        if v.opsel & 1 != 0 {
            suffix("fi:1");
        }
        if v.opsel & 2 != 0 {
            suffix("bound_ctrl:1");
        }
    }
    if let Some(sdwa) = v.sdwa {
        if v.clamp {
            suffix("clamp");
        }
        if !omod.is_empty() {
            suffix(omod);
        }
        let sel = [
            "BYTE_0", "BYTE_1", "BYTE_2", "BYTE_3", "WORD_0", "WORD_1", "DWORD", "?",
        ];
        if sdwa.dst_sel != 6 {
            suffix(&format!("dst_sel:{}", sel[usize::from(sdwa.dst_sel & 7)]));
        }
        if sdwa.dst_unused != 0 {
            let unused = ["UNUSED_PAD", "UNUSED_SEXT", "UNUSED_PRESERVE", "?"];
            suffix(&format!(
                "dst_unused:{}",
                unused[usize::from(sdwa.dst_unused & 3)]
            ));
        }
        for (i, s) in sdwa.src_sel.iter().enumerate() {
            if *s != 6 {
                suffix(&format!("src{i}_sel:{}", sel[usize::from(s & 7)]));
            }
        }
    } else {
        if !omod.is_empty() {
            suffix(omod);
        }
        if v.clamp {
            suffix("clamp");
        }
    }
    match v.dpp {
        Some(Dpp::Row {
            ctrl,
            row_mask,
            bank_mask,
            bound_ctrl,
            fi,
        }) => {
            suffix(&match ctrl {
                0x000..=0x0FF => format!(
                    "quad_perm:[{},{},{},{}]",
                    ctrl & 3,
                    ctrl >> 2 & 3,
                    ctrl >> 4 & 3,
                    ctrl >> 6 & 3
                ),
                0x101..=0x10F => format!("row_shl:{}", ctrl & 0xF),
                0x111..=0x11F => format!("row_shr:{}", ctrl & 0xF),
                0x121..=0x12F => format!("row_ror:{}", ctrl & 0xF),
                0x140 => "row_mirror".into(),
                0x141 => "row_half_mirror".into(),
                0x150..=0x15F => format!("row_share:{}", ctrl & 0xF),
                0x160..=0x16F => format!("row_xmask:{}", ctrl & 0xF),
                _ => format!("dpp_ctrl:0x{ctrl:x}"),
            });
            if row_mask != 0xF {
                suffix(&format!("row_mask:0x{row_mask:x}"));
            }
            if bank_mask != 0xF {
                suffix(&format!("bank_mask:0x{bank_mask:x}"));
            }
            if bound_ctrl {
                suffix("bound_ctrl:1");
            }
            if fi {
                suffix("fi:1");
            }
        }
        Some(Dpp::Lanes { sel, fi }) => {
            let lanes: Vec<String> = (0..8).map(|i| (sel >> (3 * i) & 7).to_string()).collect();
            suffix(&format!("dpp8:[{}]", lanes.join(",")));
            if fi {
                suffix("fi:1");
            }
        }
        None => {}
    }
    out
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use crate::gfx10::{Fields, Operand, decode};

    /// Text of each instruction in `words` (a straight-line program).
    fn texts(words: &[u32], wave64: bool) -> Vec<String> {
        let mut code: Vec<u8> = words.iter().flat_map(|w| w.to_le_bytes()).collect();
        code.extend(0xBF81_0000u32.to_le_bytes()); // s_endpgm
        let insts = decode(&code).unwrap();
        insts[..insts.len() - 1]
            .iter()
            .map(|i| i.text(wave64))
            .collect()
    }

    fn one(words: &[u32], wave64: bool) -> String {
        let t = texts(words, wave64);
        assert_eq!(t.len(), 1, "{t:?}");
        t[0].clone()
    }

    #[test]
    fn scalar() {
        assert_eq!(
            texts(&[0xBF88_0001, 0xBF8C_0070, 0xBE80_03FF, 0x1234_5678], true),
            [
                "s_cbranch_execz label_0008",
                "s_waitcnt vmcnt(0) & lgkmcnt(0)",
                "s_mov_b32 s0, lit(0x12345678)",
            ]
        );
        assert_eq!(one(&[0x8782_027E], true), "s_and_b64 s[2:3], exec, s[2:3]");
        assert_eq!(
            one(&[0xF408_0501, 0xFA00_0040], true),
            "s_load_dwordx4 s[20:23], s[2:3], 0x000040"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            one(&[0xF420_0144, 0x0400_0000], true),
            "s_buffer_load_dword s5, s[8:11], s2"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn lane_masks_follow_the_wave_size() {
        let cmp = [0x7C08_06F0]; // v_cmp_gt_f32 with 0.5 and v3
        assert_eq!(one(&cmp, false), "v_cmp_gt_f32 vcc_lo, 0.5, v3");
        assert_eq!(one(&cmp, true), "v_cmp_gt_f32 vcc, 0.5, v3");
        let vop3 = [0xD401_0106, 0x0001_E501]; // v_cmp_lt_f32 to s6, |v1| < 1.0
        assert_eq!(one(&vop3, false), "v_cmp_lt_f32 s6, abs(v1), 1.0");
        assert_eq!(one(&vop3, true), "v_cmp_lt_f32 s[6:7], abs(v1), 1.0");
        assert_eq!(
            one(&[0x0202_0480], false),
            "v_cndmask_b32 v1, 0, v2, vcc_lo"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            one(&[0x5006_0801], true),
            "v_add_co_ci_u32 v3, vcc, s1, v4, vcc"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn vector_modifiers() {
        assert_eq!(
            one(&[0x1004_0AFF, 0x3F00_0001], true),
            "v_mul_f32 v2, lit(0x3f000001), v5"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            one(&[0xD54B_8004, 0x2BC0_0501], true),
            "v_fma_f32 v4, -v1, s2, 0.5 mul:2 clamp"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            one(&[0x7E02_16F9, 0x0605_0602], true),
            "v_cvt_f32_f16 v1, v2 src0_sel:WORD_1"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            one(&[0x7E06_02E9, 0x0539_7701], true),
            "v_mov_b32 v3, v1 dpp8:[7,6,5,4,3,2,1,0]"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            one(&[0x7E0A_02FA, 0xFF08_B106], true),
            "v_mov_b32 v5, v6 quad_perm:[1,0,3,2] bound_ctrl:1"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            one(&[0xCC20_0C01, 0x2C10_0702], true),
            "v_fma_mix_f32 v1, -sel_hi(v2), s3, abs(v4)"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn memory_and_export() {
        assert_eq!(
            one(&[0xE034_7010, 0x0102_0402], true),
            "buffer_load_dwordx2 v[4:5], v[2:3], s[8:11], s1 idxen offen offset:16 glc"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            one(&[0xD8DC_0302, 0x0600_0001], true),
            "ds_read2_b32 v[6:7], v1 offset0:2 offset1:3"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            one(&[0xF800_1C0F, 0x0000_0302], true),
            "exp mrt0, v2, v2, v3, v3 done compr vm"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn image_d16_data_is_packed() {
        // Three f16 channels occupy two VGPRs; NSA lists the addresses.
        let words = [0xF09C_070A, 0x8024_0801, 0x0000_0005];
        assert_eq!(
            one(&words, true),
            "image_sample_lz v[8:9], [v1,v5], s[16:23], s[4:7] dmask:0x7 dim:SQ_RSRC_IMG_2D d16"
        );
        let code: Vec<u8> = words
            .iter()
            .chain(&[0xBF81_0000])
            .flat_map(|w| w.to_le_bytes())
            .collect();
        let Fields::Image { data, addr, .. } = decode(&code).unwrap()[0].fields(true) else {
            panic!("not an image instruction");
        };
        assert_eq!(data, Operand::Vector { reg: 8, dwords: 2 });
        assert_eq!(addr.len(), 2);
    }
}

```

`crates/victory-shader/src/io.rs`:

```rs
//! I/O raising (decision 0003): what a program's input registers, its
//! interpolation and its exports mean.
//!
//! Pixel shaders get the VGPRs `SPI_PS_INPUT_ADDR` enables, in a fixed
//! order (barycentrics, then position, front face...). `v_interp_p1` and
//! `v_interp_p2` (and their f16 forms) evaluate an attribute from a pair of
//! barycentrics; `v_interp_mov` reads one vertex's value. After the 32-bit
//! export patch ([`NativeProgram::patched_code`]) exports carry plain
//! 32-bit values: `mrt<n>` is render target n, `mrtz` depth, stencil and
//! sample mask, `null` nothing. A lane whose EXEC bit is clear at the
//! export that ends the program (`done`) is discarded: that export's guard
//! after structurisation.
//!
//! Vertex shaders that run as the hardware VS get the vertex id in v0, the
//! primitive id in v2 and the instance id in v3; the fetch shader loads
//! channel k of each attribute into its VGPR + k. `exp pos0` is the
//! position, `exp param<n>` the output with parameter n.
//!
//! Attributes and outputs are named by their row: a register of the
//! container's signature part.
//!
//! Compute programs get the thread id in the group in v0-v2 and the group
//! id in the SGPRs after the user data, as `COMPUTE_PGM_RSRC2` enables them.
//!
//! Mesh programs run as one NGG stage. The program computes its thread
//! index from the wave index (s3 bits 24-27) and the lane (`v_mbcnt`), and
//! its group id from v5 of the first lane (`v_readfirstlane`: the group
//! times the group size). Lane n exports vertex n (`exp pos`, `exp param`)
//! and primitive n (`exp prim`: 10-bit vertex indices at bits 0, 10, 20,
//! bit 31 culls); `param` entries with bit 7 are per-primitive outputs. One
//! lane sends the output counts (`s_sendmsg` GS_ALLOC_REQ, m0 = vertices |
//! primitives << 12).

use crate::ShaderError;
use crate::gfx10::{Fields, Operand};
use crate::ir::{Exit, Inst, Program, Reg, Value, operand_reads};
use crate::native::{HwStage, NativeProgram, PsInput, StageIo, Usage};
use crate::resource::Site;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Input {
    VertexId,
    PrimitiveId,
    InstanceId,
    /// A vertex attribute the fetch shader loads.
    Attribute {
        row: u8,
        channel: u8,
    },
    /// `index` 0 is i, 1 is j (2 the pull model's w).
    Barycentric {
        kind: Barycentric,
        index: u8,
    },
    /// Pixel position channel (0-3: x, y, z, w).
    Position(u8),
    FrontFace,
    /// Sample id and other bits.
    Ancillary,
    SampleCoverage,
    FixedPosition,
    LineStipple,
    /// Compute: thread-group id component (an SGPR).
    GroupId(u8),
    /// Compute: thread id within the group, component (a VGPR).
    ThreadIdInGroup(u8),
    /// Compute: the thread-group info SGPR (wave index and count).
    GroupInfo,
    /// Mesh: v5, the group id times the group size (read as uniform).
    MeshGroup,
    /// Mesh: s3, the wave's index in the group in bits 24-27.
    MergedWaveInfo,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Barycentric {
    PerspectiveSample,
    PerspectiveCenter,
    PerspectiveCentroid,
    PerspectivePullModel,
    LinearSample,
    LinearCenter,
    LinearCentroid,
}

/// The pixel input VGPRs in hardware order: one entry per
/// `SPI_PS_INPUT_ADDR` bit.
const PS_VGPRS: [(u8, Option<Barycentric>); 16] = [
    (2, Some(Barycentric::PerspectiveSample)),
    (2, Some(Barycentric::PerspectiveCenter)),
    (2, Some(Barycentric::PerspectiveCentroid)),
    (3, Some(Barycentric::PerspectivePullModel)),
    (2, Some(Barycentric::LinearSample)),
    (2, Some(Barycentric::LinearCenter)),
    (2, Some(Barycentric::LinearCentroid)),
    (1, None), // line stipple
    (1, None), // position x
    (1, None), // y
    (1, None), // z
    (1, None), // w
    (1, None), // front face
    (1, None), // ancillary
    (1, None), // sample coverage
    (1, None), // fixed-point position
];

fn ps_system(bit: usize) -> Input {
    match bit {
        7 => Input::LineStipple,
        8..=11 => Input::Position(bit as u8 - 8),
        12 => Input::FrontFace,
        13 => Input::Ancillary,
        14 => Input::SampleCoverage,
        _ => Input::FixedPosition,
    }
}

/// An attribute channel of the input signature.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Attribute {
    pub usage: Usage,
    pub row: u8,
    pub channel: u8,
    /// The upper f16 half of the channel (packed fp16 inputs).
    pub high: bool,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Interp {
    /// This site's result (`v_interp_p2*`) is the attribute interpolated
    /// with `barycentric`; `first` are the `v_interp_p1*` halves it
    /// completes (one per path where the compiler shares a first half).
    Interpolated {
        attribute: Attribute,
        barycentric: Barycentric,
        first: Vec<Site>,
    },
    /// One vertex's value (`v_interp_mov_f32`), as encoded: 0 for P10,
    /// 1 for P20, 2 for P0 (the provoking vertex).
    Vertex { attribute: Attribute, vertex: u8 },
    /// A half of an interpolation whose i or j is computed rather than
    /// loaded: each half evaluates as the hardware does, from the
    /// attribute's vertex values (`v_interp_p1*`: P0 + i P10, with P10 =
    /// P1 - P0; `v_interp_p2*`: its old dst + j P20, with P20 = P2 - P0).
    Weighted { attribute: Attribute },
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Target {
    Color(u8),
    /// Depth, stencil, sample mask (channels as `DB_SHADER_CONTROL` enables).
    Depth,
    Null,
    Position(u8),
    Param {
        usage: Usage,
        row: u8,
    },
    /// `param0` of a vertex shader without outputs: the hardware wants one
    /// parameter export regardless.
    Unread,
    /// The primitive export of a merged or mesh stage.
    Primitive,
    /// A mesh program's per-primitive output (a row of `PSG1`).
    PrimitiveParam {
        usage: Usage,
        row: u8,
    },
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Export {
    pub site: Site,
    pub target: Target,
    /// Per channel, as the instruction enables them.
    pub values: [Option<Value>; 4],
    /// Two f16 values per dword.
    pub compressed: bool,
    /// The program's last export (for pixels: kills the lanes not in EXEC).
    pub done: bool,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Io {
    /// Input values the hardware loads, with their meaning; other VGPRs
    /// read before written hold undefined values.
    pub inputs: Vec<(Value, Input)>,
    pub interps: Vec<(Site, Interp)>,
    pub exports: Vec<Export>,
    /// Compute: how many SGPRs the hardware initializes
    /// ([`ComputeIo::initialized_sgprs`](crate::native::ComputeIo::initialized_sgprs)).
    pub initialized_sgprs: Option<u8>,
}

/// Raises the I/O of `p`, built from `native`'s patched code. Fails for
/// stages whose stage data is not read and on constructs not covered yet.
pub fn raise(p: &Program, native: &NativeProgram) -> Result<Io, ShaderError> {
    let unsupported = |offset, what| ShaderError::Unsupported { offset, what };
    let (loaded, ps_inputs, params) = match (&native.io, native.stage) {
        (
            StageIo::Ps {
                inputs, input_addr, ..
            },
            HwStage::Ps,
        ) => {
            // A pixel shader exports no parameters; `[]` never reaches `Unread`.
            let loaded = ps_vgprs(*input_addr)
                .into_iter()
                .map(|(r, i)| (Reg::V(r), i))
                .collect();
            (loaded, &inputs[..], &[][..])
        }
        (StageIo::Vs { inputs, outputs }, HwStage::Vs) => {
            let mut loaded = vec![
                (Reg::V(0), Input::VertexId),
                (Reg::V(2), Input::PrimitiveId),
                (Reg::V(3), Input::InstanceId),
            ];
            for i in inputs {
                for channel in (0..4).filter(|c| i.mask >> c & 1 != 0) {
                    let input = Input::Attribute {
                        row: i.row,
                        channel,
                    };
                    loaded.push((Reg::V(i.vgpr + channel), input));
                }
            }
            (loaded, &[][..], &outputs[..])
        }
        // Compute: thread ids in v0-v2, group ids and the group info in the
        // SGPRs after the user data.
        (StageIo::Cs(cs), HwStage::Cs) => {
            let (ids, info) = cs.system_sgprs();
            let mut loaded: Vec<(Reg, Input)> = (0..cs.thread_id_vgprs())
                .map(|c| (Reg::V(c), Input::ThreadIdInGroup(c)))
                .collect();
            for (c, s) in ids.into_iter().enumerate() {
                if let Some(s) = s {
                    loaded.push((Reg::S(s), Input::GroupId(c as u8)));
                }
            }
            loaded.extend(info.map(|s| (Reg::S(s), Input::GroupInfo)));
            (loaded, &[][..], &[][..])
        }
        (StageIo::Ms(ms), HwStage::Ms) => {
            // The group input, and the phis that may carry it past a join.
            let mut group: Vec<Value> = p
                .inputs
                .iter()
                .filter(|i| i.0 == Reg::V(5))
                .map(|i| i.1)
                .collect();
            // No lane is active over the EXEC-zero edge of s_cbranch_execz or
            // _execnz, the same case as a partial-EXEC write below.
            let no_lanes = |q: usize, b: usize| match (
                p.blocks[q].insts.last().map(Inst::name),
                p.blocks[q].exit,
            ) {
                (Some("s_cbranch_execz"), Exit::Branch { taken, not_taken }) => {
                    taken == b && not_taken != b
                }
                (Some("s_cbranch_execnz"), Exit::Branch { taken, not_taken }) => {
                    not_taken == b && taken != b
                }
                _ => false,
            };
            while let Some(v) = p
                .blocks
                .iter()
                .enumerate()
                .flat_map(|(b, k)| k.phis.iter().map(move |f| (b, f)))
                .find_map(|(b, f)| {
                    let mut args = f.args.iter().zip(&p.blocks[b].preds);
                    let carried = args.any(|(a, &q)| group.contains(a) && !no_lanes(q, b));
                    (carried && !group.contains(&f.value)).then_some(f.value)
                })
            {
                group.push(v);
            }
            // The group input holds the same value in every lane only as the
            // first lane reads it. A write to v5 reads its old value too, which
            // only lanes outside EXEC keep.
            // shortcut: writes that may keep the old v5 in active lanes
            // (v_fmac_f32's accumulator, a 16-bit half or d16 load,
            // v_writelane_b32, v_movreld_b32, DPP that skips lanes) and
            // partial-EXEC writes pass; check those too if a mesh program
            // writes v5 that way.
            let per_lane = p.blocks.iter().flat_map(|b| &b.insts).find(|i| {
                i.read(Reg::V(5)).is_some_and(|v| group.contains(&v))
                    && i.name() != "v_readfirstlane_b32"
                    && (i.write(Reg::V(5)).is_none() || operand_reads(p, i).contains(&Reg::V(5)))
            });
            if let Some(i) = per_lane {
                return Err(unsupported(
                    i.machine.offset,
                    "the mesh group input read per lane",
                ));
            }
            let loaded = vec![
                (Reg::V(5), Input::MeshGroup),
                (Reg::S(3), Input::MergedWaveInfo),
            ];
            (loaded, &[][..], &ms.outputs[..])
        }
        _ => return Err(unsupported(0, "I/O of this stage")),
    };
    let inputs: Vec<(Value, Input)> = p
        .inputs
        .iter()
        .filter_map(|&(reg, v)| loaded.iter().find(|l| l.0 == reg).map(|l| (v, l.1)))
        .collect();
    let input_of = |v: Value| inputs.iter().find(|i| i.0 == v).map(|i| i.1);
    let attribute = |inst: &Inst, attr: &Operand| match *attr {
        Operand::Attr { index, chan, high } => ps_inputs
            .iter()
            .find(|i: &&PsInput| i.attr == index)
            .map(|i| Attribute {
                usage: i.usage,
                row: i.row,
                channel: chan,
                high,
            })
            .ok_or(unsupported(
                inst.machine.offset,
                "an interpolated attribute the stage data does not list",
            )),
        _ => Err(unsupported(inst.machine.offset, "an interpolation operand")),
    };
    // A VGPR value's barycentric kind and index, if it is one as loaded.
    let barycentric = |v: Option<Value>| match v.and_then(input_of) {
        Some(Input::Barycentric { kind, index }) => Some((kind, index)),
        _ => None,
    };

    let mut io = Io {
        inputs: inputs.clone(),
        initialized_sgprs: match &native.io {
            StageIo::Cs(cs) => Some(cs.initialized_sgprs()),
            _ => None,
        },
        ..Io::default()
    };
    let defs: std::collections::HashMap<Value, Site> = p
        .blocks
        .iter()
        .enumerate()
        .flat_map(|(b, block)| {
            block
                .insts
                .iter()
                .enumerate()
                .flat_map(move |(i, inst)| inst.writes.iter().map(move |w| (w.1, (b, i))))
        })
        .collect();
    let phis: std::collections::HashMap<Value, (usize, usize)> = p
        .blocks
        .iter()
        .enumerate()
        .flat_map(|(b, block)| {
            block
                .phis
                .iter()
                .enumerate()
                .map(move |(i, phi)| (phi.value, (b, i)))
        })
        .collect();
    let halves = Halves {
        p,
        defs: &defs,
        phis: &phis,
    };
    for (b, block) in p.blocks.iter().enumerate() {
        for (i, inst) in block.insts.iter().enumerate() {
            let site = (b, i);
            let at = inst.machine.offset;
            let name = inst.name();
            match &inst.fields {
                Fields::Vintrp { dst, src, attr } => {
                    let attribute = attribute(inst, attr)?;
                    match (name, *src) {
                        ("v_interp_mov_f32", Operand::Const(vertex)) => {
                            io.interps
                                .push((site, Interp::Vertex { attribute, vertex }));
                        }
                        ("v_interp_p1_f32", _) => {}
                        ("v_interp_p2_f32", Operand::Vector { reg, .. }) => {
                            let Operand::Vector { reg: d, .. } = *dst else {
                                return Err(unsupported(at, "an interpolation operand"));
                            };
                            // The first half's result is this one's old dst.
                            let interp = halves
                                .pair(
                                    attr,
                                    inst.read(Reg::V(d)),
                                    inst.read(Reg::V(reg)),
                                    &barycentric,
                                )
                                .map_err(|what| unsupported(at, what))?;
                            push_pair(&mut io, site, interp, attribute);
                        }
                        _ => return Err(unsupported(at, "an interpolation form")),
                    }
                }
                Fields::Valu(v) if name.starts_with("v_interp_") => match name {
                    "v_interp_p1ll_f16" => {}
                    "v_interp_p2_f16" => {
                        let attribute = attribute(inst, &v.src[0])?;
                        let read = |k: usize| match v.src.get(k) {
                            Some(&Operand::Vector { reg, .. }) => inst.read(Reg::V(reg)),
                            _ => None,
                        };
                        let interp = halves
                            .pair(&v.src[0], read(2), read(1), &barycentric)
                            .map_err(|what| unsupported(at, what))?;
                        push_pair(&mut io, site, interp, attribute);
                    }
                    _ => return Err(unsupported(at, "an interpolation form")),
                },
                Fields::Exp {
                    target,
                    src,
                    compr,
                    done,
                    ..
                } => {
                    let target = match *target {
                        t @ 0..=7 => Target::Color(t),
                        8 => Target::Depth,
                        9 => Target::Null,
                        t @ 12..=16 => Target::Position(t - 12),
                        20 => Target::Primitive,
                        32 if params.is_empty() => Target::Unread,
                        t @ 32..=63 => {
                            // Bit 7: a mesh program's per-primitive output.
                            let o = params.iter().find(|o| o.param & 0x7F == t - 32).ok_or(
                                unsupported(at, "a parameter export the stage data does not list"),
                            )?;
                            let (usage, row) = (o.usage, o.row);
                            if o.param & 0x80 != 0 {
                                Target::PrimitiveParam { usage, row }
                            } else {
                                Target::Param { usage, row }
                            }
                        }
                        _ => return Err(unsupported(at, "an export target")),
                    };
                    let values = src.map(|s| match s {
                        Some(Operand::Vector { reg, .. }) => inst.read(Reg::V(reg)),
                        _ => None,
                    });
                    io.exports.push(Export {
                        site,
                        target,
                        values,
                        compressed: *compr,
                        done: *done,
                    });
                }
                _ => {}
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(io)
}

/// The pixel input VGPRs that `addr` enables, with their meaning.
fn ps_vgprs(addr: u32) -> Vec<(u8, Input)> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    let mut next = 0u8;
    for (bit, &(count, kind)) in PS_VGPRS.iter().enumerate() {
        if addr >> bit & 1 == 0 {
            continue;
        }
        for index in 0..count {
            let input = match kind {
                Some(kind) => Input::Barycentric { kind, index },
                None => ps_system(bit),
            };
            out.push((next + index, input));
        }
        next += count;
    }
    out
}

/// An interpolation before its attribute is known: `barycentric` none
/// when i or j is computed.
struct Pair {
    barycentric: Option<Barycentric>,
    first: Vec<Site>,
}

impl Pair {
    fn with(self, attribute: Attribute) -> Interp {
        match self.barycentric {
            Some(barycentric) => Interp::Interpolated {
                attribute,
                barycentric,
                first: self.first,
            },
            None => Interp::Weighted { attribute },
        }
    }
}

/// Records interpolation `pair` at `site`, and its first halves too when
/// they evaluate on their own (computed barycentrics).
fn push_pair(io: &mut Io, site: Site, pair: Pair, attribute: Attribute) {
    if pair.barycentric.is_none() {
        for &f in &pair.first {
            if !io.interps.iter().any(|(s, _)| *s == f) {
                io.interps.push((f, Interp::Weighted { attribute }));
            }
        }
    }
    io.interps.push((site, pair.with(attribute)));
}

/// Finds the first halves of interpolations.
struct Halves<'a> {
    p: &'a Program,
    defs: &'a std::collections::HashMap<Value, Site>,
    phis: &'a std::collections::HashMap<Value, (usize, usize)>,
}

impl Halves<'_> {
    /// The interpolation whose second half reads the first half's result
    /// `acc`, the barycentric `j`, and attribute `attr`: every first half
    /// must read the same attribute channel. With j and every first half's
    /// i loaded as one kind's, the pair interpolates with that kind;
    /// otherwise each half evaluates on its own (`Interp::Weighted`).
    fn pair(
        &self,
        attr: &Operand,
        acc: Option<Value>,
        j: Option<Value>,
        barycentric: &impl Fn(Option<Value>) -> Option<(Barycentric, u8)>,
    ) -> Result<Pair, &'static str> {
        let mut first = Vec::new();
        self.sites(
            acc.ok_or("an interpolation without its first half")?,
            &mut Vec::new(),
            &mut first,
        )?;
        let mut kind = match barycentric(j) {
            Some((kind, 1)) => Some(kind),
            _ => None,
        };
        for &(b, i) in &first {
            let inst = &self.p.blocks[b].insts[i];
            let (a, i) = match &inst.fields {
                Fields::Vintrp {
                    src: Operand::Vector { reg, .. },
                    attr,
                    ..
                } if inst.name() == "v_interp_p1_f32" => (*attr, inst.read(Reg::V(*reg))),
                Fields::Valu(v) if inst.name() == "v_interp_p1ll_f16" => match v.src.get(1) {
                    Some(&Operand::Vector { reg, .. }) => (v.src[0], inst.read(Reg::V(reg))),
                    _ => return Err("an interpolation without its first half"),
                },
                _ => return Err("an interpolation without its first half"),
            };
            if a != *attr {
                return Err("interpolation halves of different attributes");
            }
            if kind.is_some_and(|k| barycentric(i) != Some((k, 0))) {
                kind = None;
            }
        }
        Ok(Pair {
            barycentric: kind,
            first,
        })
    }

    /// The instructions `v` comes from, through phis (`seen`: phis on the
    /// way; a loop back to one adds nothing).
    fn sites(
        &self,
        v: Value,
        seen: &mut Vec<Value>,
        out: &mut Vec<Site>,
    ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
        if let Some(&site) = self.defs.get(&v) {
            if !out.contains(&site) {
                out.push(site);
            }
            return Ok(());
        }
        let &(b, i) = self
            .phis
            .get(&v)
            .ok_or("an interpolation without its first half")?;
        if !seen.contains(&v) {
            seen.push(v);
            for &a in &self.p.blocks[b].phis[i].args {
                self.sites(a, seen, out)?;
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::native::ExportPatch;

    const S_ENDPGM: u32 = 0xBF81_0000;

    fn program(words: &[u32]) -> Program {
        let code: Vec<u8> = words.iter().flat_map(|w| w.to_le_bytes()).collect();
        crate::ir::build(&code, false, 256).unwrap()
    }

    fn pixel(inputs: Vec<PsInput>, input_addr: u32) -> NativeProgram {
        NativeProgram {
            stage: HwStage::Ps,
            wave64: false,
            vgprs: 256,
            layout: vec![],
            used: vec![],
            io: StageIo::Ps {
                inputs,
                input_addr,
                db_shader_control: 0,
                patches: Vec::<ExportPatch>::new(),
            },
            code: vec![],
        }
    }

    const TEXCOORD: PsInput = PsInput {
        usage: Usage::Generic,
        row: 1,
        mask: 3,
        attr: 0,
        flat: false,
        fp16: false,
        pack2: false,
        row2: 1,
    };

    #[test]
    fn interpolation_pairs_and_color_exports() {
        // Blit's pixel shader: TEXCOORD.xy from the perspective-center i/j
        // in v0/v1, then exported unconverted to MRT0.
        let p = program(&[
            0xC808_0000, // v_interp_p1_f32 v2, v0, attr0.x
            0xC809_0001, // v_interp_p2_f32 v2, v1, attr0.x
            0xF800_180F,
            0x0302_0102, // exp mrt0, v2, v1, v2, v3 done vm
            S_ENDPGM,
        ]);
        let io = raise(&p, &pixel(vec![TEXCOORD], 2)).unwrap();
        let input = |reg| p.inputs.iter().find(|i| i.0 == Reg::V(reg)).unwrap().1;
        let center = |index| Input::Barycentric {
            kind: Barycentric::PerspectiveCenter,
            index,
        };
        assert!(io.inputs.contains(&(input(0), center(0))));
        assert!(io.inputs.contains(&(input(1), center(1))));
        // v2 and v3 are read before written but hold nothing.
        assert!(!io.inputs.iter().any(|i| i.0 == input(3)));
        assert_eq!(
            io.interps,
            [(
                (0, 1),
                Interp::Interpolated {
                    attribute: Attribute {
                        usage: Usage::Generic,
                        row: 1,
                        channel: 0,
                        high: false
                    },
                    barycentric: Barycentric::PerspectiveCenter,
                    first: vec![(0, 0)],
                }
            )]
        );
        let [e] = &io.exports[..] else {
            panic!("{:?}", io.exports)
        };
        assert_eq!(
            (e.target, e.done, e.compressed),
            (Target::Color(0), true, false)
        );
        assert_eq!(e.values[0], p.blocks[0].insts[1].write(Reg::V(2)));
    }

    #[test]
    fn unpaired_or_unknown_interpolation_fails() {
        // p2 alone: its old dst is no p1's result.
        let lone = program(&[0xC809_0001, S_ENDPGM]); // v_interp_p2_f32 v2, v1, attr0.x
        assert!(raise(&lone, &pixel(vec![TEXCOORD], 2)).is_err());
        // attr1 is not in the stage data.
        let other = program(&[0xC808_0400, S_ENDPGM]); // v_interp_p1_f32 v2, v0, attr1.x
        assert!(raise(&other, &pixel(vec![TEXCOORD], 2)).is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn computed_barycentrics_evaluate_each_half() {
        // i scaled before the first half: both halves stand on their own.
        let p = program(&[
            0x1006_00F0, // v_mul_f32 v3, 0.5, v0
            0xC808_0003, // v_interp_p1_f32 v2, v3, attr0.x
            0xC809_0001, // v_interp_p2_f32 v2, v1, attr0.x
            S_ENDPGM,
        ]);
        let io = raise(&p, &pixel(vec![TEXCOORD], 2)).unwrap();
        let attribute = Attribute {
            usage: Usage::Generic,
            row: 1,
            channel: 0,
            high: false,
        };
        let mut interps = io.interps.clone();
        interps.sort_by_key(|i| i.0);
        assert_eq!(
            interps,
            [
                ((0, 1), Interp::Weighted { attribute }),
                ((0, 2), Interp::Weighted { attribute }),
            ]
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn mesh_inputs_and_primitive_export() {
        let mesh = |words: &[u32]| {
            let code: Vec<u8> = words.iter().flat_map(|w| w.to_le_bytes()).collect();
            let p = crate::ir::build(&code, true, 256).unwrap();
            let native = NativeProgram {
                stage: HwStage::Ms,
                wave64: true,
                vgprs: 256,
                layout: vec![],
                used: vec![],
                io: StageIo::Ms(crate::native::MeshIo {
                    outputs: vec![],
                    clip_cntl: 0,
                    threads: 128,
                    max_vertices: 128,
                    max_primitives: 128,
                    topology: 2,
                    lds_bytes: 0,
                }),
                code,
            };
            raise(&p, &native)
        };
        let io = mesh(&[
            0x7E04_0505, // v_readfirstlane_b32 s2, v5
            0xF800_0941,
            0x0000_0009, // exp prim, v9, off, off, off done
            S_ENDPGM,
        ])
        .unwrap();
        assert!(io.inputs.iter().any(|i| i.1 == Input::MeshGroup));
        assert_eq!(io.exports[0].target, Target::Primitive);
        // The group input is uniform only as the first lane reads it.
        assert!(mesh(&[0x7E02_0305, S_ENDPGM]).is_err()); // v_mov_b32 v1, v5
        // Also as an operand of a write to v5, or after a join.
        let per_lane: [&[u32]; 5] = [
            &[0x4A0A_0305, S_ENDPGM],              // v_add_nc_u32 v5, v5, v1
            &[0x7E0A_0D05, S_ENDPGM],              // v_cvt_f32_u32 v5, v5
            &[0xDC30_8000, 0x0500_0005, S_ENDPGM], // global_load_dword v5, v5, s[0:1]
            &[0x7E0A_CB01, S_ENDPGM],              // v_swap_b32 v5, v1
            &[
                0xBF06_8001, // s_cmp_eq_u32 s1, 0
                0xBF85_0001, // s_cbranch_scc1 -> 0xc
                0x7E0A_0280, // v_mov_b32 v5, 0
                0x7E02_0305, // 0xc: v_mov_b32 v1, v5
                S_ENDPGM,
            ],
        ];
        let accepted: Vec<_> = per_lane.iter().filter(|w| mesh(w).is_ok()).collect();
        assert!(accepted.is_empty(), "accepted: {accepted:08X?}");
        // Overwriting v5 reads the group input only for lanes outside EXEC:
        // v_mov_b32 v5, 0; v_mov_b32 v1, v5.
        assert!(mesh(&[0x7E0A_0280, 0x7E02_0305, S_ENDPGM]).is_ok());
        // Skipping that write with s_cbranch_execz is the same case: under the
        // same mask, the read sees only the 0.
        let reuse = [
            0x7E04_0505, // v_readfirstlane_b32 s2, v5
            0x7D88_0084, // v_cmp_gt_u32 vcc, 4, v0
            0xBE86_246A, // s_and_saveexec_b64 s[6:7], vcc
            0xBF88_0001, // s_cbranch_execz -> 0x14
            0x7E0A_0280, // v_mov_b32 v5, 0
            0x88FE_067E, // 0x14: s_or_b64 exec, exec, s[6:7]
            0xBE86_246A, // s_and_saveexec_b64 s[6:7], vcc
            0xBF88_0001, // s_cbranch_execz -> 0x24
            0x7E02_0305, // v_mov_b32 v1, v5
            0x88FE_067E, // 0x24: s_or_b64 exec, exec, s[6:7]
            S_ENDPGM,
        ];
        assert_eq!(mesh(&reuse).map(|_| ()), Ok(()));
    }

    #[test]
    fn pixel_vgprs_follow_the_input_address() {
        // Linear center (bit 5), then position x and y (bits 8, 9).
        let v = ps_vgprs(1 << 5 | 1 << 8 | 1 << 9);
        assert_eq!(
            v,
            [
                (
                    0,
                    Input::Barycentric {
                        kind: Barycentric::LinearCenter,
                        index: 0
                    }
                ),
                (
                    1,
                    Input::Barycentric {
                        kind: Barycentric::LinearCenter,
                        index: 1
                    }
                ),
                (2, Input::Position(0)),
                (3, Input::Position(1)),
            ]
        );
    }
}
